tc: 走近門前，你發現上面是她的字跡，上面寫道：前輩，屋內桌上有一信，請您閱讀。
en: You walk to the door and discover that it is her handwriting, and she wrote: There is a letter on the table in the house. Please read it.

ch: 将门推开，你见桌上确有一信，便将信封拆开，凭着窗外阳光阅读信上字句。当你读完最后一个字时，手中信纸悄然滑落，本来准备交给愿知的问心也悄然掉落在地上。
tc: 將門推開，你見桌上確有一信，便將信封拆開，憑著窗外陽光閱讀信上字句。當你讀完最後一個字時，手中信紙悄然滑落，本來準備交給願知的問心也悄然掉落在地上。
en: You push the door open and see that there is indeed a letter on the table. You open the envelope and read the words by the sunlight through the window. The letter slips from your hands as you finish reading the last word. The book which you were planning to give to Yuanzhi, Examine Oneself, also fell quietly to the ground.

ch: 致前辈：\n当您读到这封信时，我已经不在了，您可记得我初次见面提出的问题？\n那时我问您“求知于世人而言可否重要？”我并不清楚世人的想法，但对于我而言，求知便是唯一所剩之物。
tc: 致前輩：\n當您讀到這封信時，我已經不在了，您可記得我初次見面提出的問題？\n那時我問您“求知於世人而言可否重要？”我並不清楚世人的想法，但對於我而言，求知便是唯一所剩之物。
en: O' Kind One,\nWhen you read this letter, I will no longer be here. Do you remember the question I asked when we first met? \nI asked you if the truth of a matter is important to people. I don't know how ordinary people think, but to me, seeking knowledge is the only thing I have left.

ch: 我已寻到了获得所追求答案的方法，为此，无论我需要付出何种，即便是生命，我也愿意将其抛弃，以换取答案。\n感谢前辈一直以来的关照，桌上放有一枚坚岩戒，戒指内存着我多年来的积蓄及一些丹药，愿它们能在前辈求道路途上发挥作用。\n 君愿知
tc: 我已尋到了獲得所追求答案的方法，為此，無論我需要付出何種，即便是生命，我也願意將其拋棄，以換取答案。\n感謝前輩一直以來的關照，桌上放有一枚堅岩戒，戒指記憶體著我多年來的積蓄及一些丹藥，願它們能在前輩求道路途上發揮作用。\n 君願知
en: I have found a new way to obtain the answers I seek. I am willing to give up everything for the answers, even my life.\nThank you for your care. There is a Hardened Stone Ring on the table, and it holds my savings and some Elixirs. I hope that they will be useful on your path of the Heavenly Way.\nJun Yuanzhi

ch: 你想为愿知报仇但无奈不敌妖兽，你受到妖兽的攻击晕了过去。醒来后发现身体并无大碍，只是妖兽已经不知所踪…
tc: 你想為願知報仇但無奈不敵妖獸，你受到妖獸的攻擊暈了過去。醒來後發現身體並無大礙，只是妖獸已經不知所蹤…
en: You want to avenge Yuanzhi, but are helpless against the monster. You are hit by the monster's attack and faint. When you wake up, you discover that you are not seriously injured, and the monster has disappeared...

ch: 你见到一座石碑，石碑上刻着一行字：君若道行尚浅之，切莫误入不归途。
tc: 你見到一座石碑，石碑上刻著一行字：君若道行尚淺之，切莫誤入不歸途。
en: You see a stone Stele. On it is engraved: If you wallow only in the shallows of cultivation, step not on this path by mistake.

ch: 你要下船命令船夫停下
tc: 你要下船命令船夫停下
en: Order the sailors to stop so you can leave
Try to break through the array

ch: 破解不成只怕招来反噬
tc: 破解不成只怕招來反噬
en: There is a risk of harm if you fail to break through the array

ch: 听说龙一身都是宝，今日趁其虚弱，不如……
tc: 聽說龍一身都是寶，今日趁其虛弱，不如……
en: Dragons are supposedly full of treasures. Since it's weakened, you should...

ch: 尊重她的想法，不再询问
tc: 尊重她的想法，不再詢問
en: Respect her opinion and stop questioning

ch: 不愿让她陷入危险，阻止她
tc: 不願讓她陷入危險，阻止她
en: Stop her to protect her from danger

ch: 当前位置不可卸下坐骑
tc: 當前位置不可卸下坐騎
en: You can\'t dismount in your current location.

ch: {0}资质<g>低于{1}</g>时才能使用。\n（当前{2}资质：{3}）。
tc: {0}資質<g>低於{1}</g>時才能使用。\n（當前{2}資質：{3}）。

ch: 宗门亲密度大于{0}：价格倍数{1}倍
tc: 宗門親密度大於{0}：價格倍數{1}倍

ch: 与该宗门的亲密度越高，在该宗门消费时所需要的灵石就越少。宗门亲密度由该宗门的门人对你的评价而决定，与该宗门中的门人提升关系就能够提升与该宗门的亲密度。
tc: 與該宗門的親密度越高，在該宗門消費時所需要的靈石就越少。宗門親密度由該宗門的門人對你的評價而決定，與該宗門中的門人提升關係就能夠提升與該宗門的親密度。
en: Increase your Affinity with a sect to lower the Spirit Stones you have to pay for the same item. Sect Affinity is determined by the sect members\' attitudes toward you. Improve your relationships with the members of a sect to increase your Affinity with the sect.

ch: 一只猴子在一颗异树下仰望树上的果子。
tc: 一隻猴子在一顆異樹下仰望樹上的果子。
en: A monkey sits under a strange tree, staring up at its fruit.

ch: 猴子迅速拿走果实，钻进了树林里，很快又跑了过来将一包物品放在了你的脚下，快速钻回了树林。
tc: 猴子迅速拿走果實，鑽進了樹林裏，很快又跑了過來將一包物品放在了你的腳下，快速鑽回了樹林。
en: It grabs the fruit and disappears into the trees. After a moment it runs over, drops a bag at your feet, then retreats back into the trees.

ch: 只觉身前一股大力传来，你被弹出老远，感觉到这棵树并不欢迎你的到来，你无奈离去。
tc: 只覺身前一股大力傳來，你被彈出老遠，感覺到這棵樹並不歡迎你的到來，你無奈離去。
en: A tremendous force strikes you from the front, sending you flying. You get the feeling the tree is not pleased to see you and are left with no choice but to leave.

ch: 赶走偷果实的猴子以后你正要离去，突然大地摇晃地上出现一个地洞，里面似有宝气传出。
tc: 趕走偷果實的猴子以後你正要離去，突然大地搖晃地上出現一個地洞，裡面似有寶氣傳出。
en: You chase off the thieving monkey and are about to leave when a large hole appears in the ground and the scent of treasure wafts out.

ch: 你上前拿出宝物，满树的树叶也开始飘荡，似乎在向你表示感谢,你拿起宝物后离去。
tc: 你上前拿出寶物，滿樹的樹葉也開始飄蕩，似乎在向你表示感謝,你拿起寶物後離去。
en: You go forward and take out the treasure. All the leaves on the tree start shaking, as if in thanks. You pick up the treasure and leave.

ch: 猴子赶走你后开始爬树摘果子，怎奈你修为不够无力相助只好离去。
tc: 猴子趕走你後開始爬樹摘果子，怎奈你修為不夠無力相助只好離去。
en: The monkey gets rid of you and starts climbing the tree to pick fruit. Your cultivation is just too weak and you have no choice but to leave.

ch: 猴子与树慢慢消失在你的身后。
tc: 猴子與樹慢慢消失在你的身後。
en: Behind you the monkey and the tree slowly fade away.

ch: 你路过一片江河，只见从水中跃出数条怪鱼，鱼身而鸟翼，发出像鸭子的叫声，扇动翅膀渐渐远去，转瞬间暴雨降下将你淋成落汤鸡。
tc: 你路過一片江河，只見從水中躍出數條怪魚，魚身而鳥翼，發出像鴨子的叫聲，扇動翅膀漸漸遠去，轉瞬間暴雨降下將你淋成落湯雞。
en: You pass along a stretch of river and notice a school of strange-looking fish leaping out of the water. The fish appear to have birds' wings and make quacking sounds like ducks. Flapping their wings, they fly away into the distance. Suddenly the skies open, drenching you from head to toe.

ch: 山林中突然传来惊天鼓声。你寻声而去，只见林间一只异兽马身虎齿，身上白色而尾部漆黑头上还长有一角，与前方数只巨虎争斗。
tc: 山林中突然傳來驚天鼓聲。你尋聲而去，只見林間一隻異獸馬身虎齒，身上白色而尾部漆黑頭上還長有一角，與前方數隻巨虎爭鬥。
en: Suddenly you hear the deafening sound of drums coming from the forest. Going to investigate, you find a strange beast with the body of a horse and the teeth of a tiger. It has a white coat, a black tail and a horn on its head, and it is facing off against some enormous tigers.

ch: 看着他们的争斗你心有所悟，在它们注意到你之前离开了这里。
tc: 看著他們的爭鬥你心有所悟，在它們注意到你之前離開了這裡。
en: Watching them fight is very enlightening and you leave before they can notice you.

ch: 你路过一条河，只见一条怪鱼腹部朝上一动不动，似乎已经死去，你走近前去，只见此鱼，鱼首似蛇眼似马耳身有六足。
tc: 你路過一條河，只見一條怪魚腹部朝上一動不動，似乎已經死去，你走近前去，只見此魚，魚首似蛇眼似馬耳身有六足。
en: Crossing a river, you notice an odd-looking fish. It is belly-up and not moving, as though dead. As you move closer, you see it has snake-like eyes, horse\'s ears and six little feet.

ch: 你心念一动，难道此鱼就是冉遗？你挥刀切下一片食下，只觉周围阴霾一扫而空。
tc: 你心念一動，難道此魚就是冉遺？你揮刀切下一片食下，只覺周圍陰霾一掃而空。
en: You have a thought. Could it be a Ranyi fish? You pull out your knife and cut a slice off to eat. Suddenly you sense the shadows lift.

ch: 前方草丛中传来悉悉索索的声音，你仔细看去，只见一只长着紫色翅膀的奇怪的老鼠正在翻找一处小地洞。
tc: 前方草叢中傳來悉悉索索的聲音，你仔細看去，只見一隻長著紫色翅膀的奇怪的老鼠正在翻找一處小地洞。
en: You hear rustling coming from some bushes up ahead. Looking closely, all you can see is a strange mouse with purple wings rummaging around in a burrow.

ch: 你怀着好奇往前走了一步，老鼠一惊用双翼掩住脑袋，双眼从羽翼间看到你后转瞬飞走。
tc: 你懷著好奇往前走了一步，老鼠一驚用雙翼掩住腦袋，雙眼從羽翼間看到你後轉瞬飛走。
en: Curiously you move forward. The startled mouse covers its head with its wings. As soon as it spots you, it flies away.

ch: 你轰开地洞露出了藏在里面的东西。
tc: 你轟開地洞露出了藏在裡面的東西。
en: You blast open the hole to get at the things inside.

ch: 行走间天空乌云密布，远处一道道闪电蓄势待发，你急忙寻找避雨之处，可附近一片荒野，情急之下你躲入一颗大树底下。
tc: 行走間天空烏雲密佈，遠處一道道閃電蓄勢待發，你急忙尋找避雨之處，可附近一片荒野，情急之下你躲入一顆大樹底下。
en: The sky darkens and lightning starts striking in the distance. You desperately search for somewhere to shelter but there is nothing around. Finally, you take shelter under a large tree.

ch: 暴雨瞬间而至电闪雷鸣，你正自庆幸，突然一道闪电劈向大树。
tc: 暴雨瞬間而至電閃雷鳴，你正自慶倖，突然一道閃電劈向大樹。
en: The rain thunders down and lightning flashes all around. Just as you are thinking yourself very clever, a massive fork of lightning strikes the tree under which you are standing.

ch: 等你醒来时发现全身焦黑。
tc: 等你醒來時發現全身焦黑。
en: When you come to, your entire body is charred black.

ch: 前方悬崖上一颗灵果发出阵阵诱人的香味。
tc: 前方懸崖上一顆靈果發出陣陣誘人的香味。
en: A Spiritual Fruit growing on a cliff is giving off a wonderful fragrance.

ch: 一只猿猴一跃而出向你攻来。
tc: 一隻猿猴一躍而出向你攻來。

ch: 你心有疑虑，看了灵果一眼离开了此地。
tc: 你心有疑慮，看了靈果一眼離開了此地。
en: You take one look at the Spiritual Fruit, hesitate, and walk away.
You take the Spiritual Fruit and depart.

ch: 没想到此果竟有如此强力魔猿守护，你念念不舍得离开了此地。
tc: 沒想到此果竟有如此強力魔猿守護，你念念不捨得離開了此地。
en: You didn't think this fruit would be guarded by such a powerful Dire Ape. Reluctantly you tear yourself away.

ch: 天边泛起一道彩虹下方似有灵气汇聚。
tc: 天邊泛起一道彩虹下方似有靈氣彙聚。
en: A rainbow unfurled beneath the clouds. There appears to be a confluence of Qi energy beneath it.

ch: 彩虹下有一潭雾气升腾的清水，旁边有一颗异树长有人面果实。
tc: 彩虹下有一潭霧氣升騰的清水，旁邊有一顆異樹長有人面果實。
en: Under the rainbow mist rises off a pool of clear water. On the bank there is a strange tree with human-faced fruit.
You\'re not really in the mood and continue on your way.

ch: 你刚刚喝下一口潭水，潭水似乎受惊一般迅速渗入地下，雾气消散只剩一口干枯多时的水潭痕迹。
tc: 你剛剛喝下一口潭水，潭水似乎受驚一般迅速滲入地下，霧氣消散只剩一口乾枯多時的水潭痕跡。
en: You take a sip of the pond water. The water seems to startle and sinks into the soil. The mist dissipates, leaving a dry cracked depression in the ground.

ch: 喝下潭水后你觉得自己修为提升了。
tc: 喝下潭水後你覺得自己修為提升了。
en: You feel like drinking the pool water has enhanced your Cultivation.

ch: 突如其来的狂暴力量在你体内翻滚，你压制不住一口鲜血喷出晕了过去。醒来时发现体内灵气竟散去不少。
tc: 突如其來的狂暴力量在你體內翻滾，你壓制不住一口鮮血噴出暈了過去。醒來時發現體內靈氣竟散去不少。
en: Suddenly you feel a powerful surge of energy inside you. Fresh blood erupts out of your mouth and you pass out. When you come to, you feel like your Qi has been seriously depleted.

ch: 你刚一摘取果实，树木瞬间枯萎消散，只有留在你手中的果实证明了你看到的并非幻觉。
tc: 你剛一摘取果實，樹木瞬間枯萎消散，只有留在你手中的果實證明了你看到的並非幻覺。
en: As soon as you pick the fruit, the wood withers and vanishes. The fruit in your hand is the only proof you didn't just imagine the tree.

ch: 你经过一片山峦，山谷内传来鹿的叫声似有光亮传出。
tc: 你經過一片山巒，山谷內傳來鹿的叫聲似有光亮傳出。
en: You're passing through a mountainous area when you hear the sound of deer bleating. Light is coming from somewhere.

ch: 在山谷的一个洞内你发现了宝物。
tc: 在山谷的一個洞內你發現了寶物。
en: You find a treasure inside a cave in the valley.

ch: 顺着叫声你在谷底的一面湖上找到了一只羽毛赤红的野鸡，正发出叫声捕食湖里的鱼。
tc: 順著叫聲你在穀底的一面湖上找到了一隻羽毛赤紅的野雞，正發出叫聲捕食湖裡的魚。
en: Following the sounds, you come to a lake on the valley floor where you find red-feathered fowl. It is making all kinds of noises as it hunts fish in the lake.

ch: 你心头一颤，此鸟竟是胜遇,遇之则国泽!你迅速向城内报告此事让人早做准备。
tc: 你心頭一顫，此鳥竟是勝遇,遇之則國澤!你迅速向城內報告此事讓人早做準備。
en: Your heart skips a beat. It\'s the Shengyu bird! It is a good omen! You rush back to town to tell everyone.

ch: 你一不小心跌入一片深潭。
tc: 你一不小心跌入一片深潭。
en: Carelessly you fall into the pool.

ch: 等爬起来时发现，身上似乎丢了什么。
tc: 等爬起來時發現，身上似乎丟了什麼。
en: You think you lose something as you climb out.

ch: 只见谭中一物发出淡淡光芒，你将其抓入手中爬出水潭。
tc: 只見譚中一物發出淡淡光芒，你將其抓入手中爬出水潭。
en: Something is glimmering at the bottom of the water. You grab it and climb out.

ch: 天空中一只绿色的鹦鹉从你身边飞过，嘴里边飞边重复着“南边桥下挂着我留给你的东西，翼儿，你切记不可说与他人知晓。”
tc: 天空中一隻綠色的鸚鵡從你身邊飛過，嘴裡邊飛邊重複著“南邊橋下掛著我留給你的東西，翼兒，你切記不可說與他人知曉。”
en: A green parrot flies right past you. It is talking as it flies. \"I left you something under the bridge to the south, Chickadee. Don't tell anyone.\"

ch: 你顺着河流找到了那座桥，果然在桥下挂着一个袋子，你收起袋子在别人发现之前快步离去。
tc: 你順著河流找到了那座橋，果然在橋下掛著一個袋子，你收起袋子在別人發現之前快步離去。
en: Presently you come to the bridge. Sure enough, there's a bag hanging under the arch. You take it down before anyone else can notice and leave quickly.

ch: 一只黄鼠狼叼着一颗珠子从你身边跑过，后面一只狐狸正在猛追。
tc: 一隻黃鼠狼叼著一顆珠子從你身邊跑過，後面一隻狐狸正在猛追。
en: A weasel holding a small sphere in its mouth runs past you. It is being chased by an angry fox.

ch: 你赶走了狐狸，黄鼠狼叼着珠子跑开，一会儿又出现时嘴里咬着一个盒子，放到你脚下后就跑走了。
tc: 你趕走了狐狸，黃鼠狼叼著珠子跑開，一會兒又出現時嘴裡咬著一個盒子，放到你腳下後就跑走了。
en: You chase off the fox and weasel gets away with the bead. After a while it returns, carrying a box in its mouth and places it at your feet.

ch: 你收起盒子内的东西离开了这里。
tc: 你收起盒子內的東西離開了這裡。
en: You remove the contents of the box and leave.

ch: 你拦下黄鼠狼，取回珠子扔到狐狸脚下，狐狸盯着你迟疑一番，似乎最终顶不住诱惑，跳过去叼起珠子眨眼就跑开了。
tc: 你攔下黃鼠狼，取回珠子扔到狐狸腳下，狐狸盯著你遲疑一番，似乎最終頂不住誘惑，跳過去叼起珠子眨眼就跑開了。
en: You stop the weasel, take the bead and throw it towards the fox. The fox stares warily at you, but then picks it up and runs off as fast as it can.

ch: 再次出现时一股紫气从狐狸身上升腾而起，而后融入你的体内，再看去时狐狸早已不见踪影。
tc: 再次出現時一股紫氣從狐狸身上升騰而起，而後融入你的體內，再看去時狐狸早已不見蹤影。
en: When the fox re-emerges, a purplish mist is rising off it. The mist seeps into your body, but when you look back, the fox is already gone.

ch: 野兽之间的事情就让它们自己解决吧，你继续赶路。
tc: 野獸之間的事情就讓它們自己解決吧，你繼續趕路。
en: Let them sort it out. You keep walking.

ch: 看你拦不住狐狸，黄鼠狼发力往前逃去。
tc: 看你攔不住狐狸，黃鼠狼發力往前逃去。
en: When you fail to stop the fox, the weasel runs away at high speed.

ch: 眼看你拦不住，狐狸发力追向黄鼠狼。
tc: 眼看你攔不住，狐狸發力追向黃鼠狼。
en: When you fail to stop it, the fox runs after the weasel at high speed.

ch: 你结束修炼正要睁眼起身，突然灵海中出现了一片石壁的模糊影像。
tc: 你結束修煉正要睜眼起身，突然靈海中出現了一片石壁的模糊影像。
en: You finish mediating and are just about to get up, when the image of a stone wall appears in your mind.

ch: 你凝神看了半天一种若有若无的感觉一直笼罩着你，却始终得不到突破，慢慢影像消失了，你仍然一无所获。
tc: 你凝神看了半天一種若有若無的感覺一直籠罩著你，卻始終得不到突破，慢慢影像消失了，你仍然一無所獲。
en: You stare at it for what seems like an age. A sense of uncertainty comes over you and you do not achieve Breakthrough. Gradually the image fades away and you are back where you started.

ch: 石壁上的影像越来越清晰，仿佛是某种修炼方法，你依法修炼，感觉到自身修为更进一步。
tc: 石壁上的影像越來越清晰，仿佛是某種修煉方法，你依法修煉，感覺到自身修為更進一步。
en: The image of the wall becomes clearer and clearer, as though you are engaging in a form of practice. You feel like your cultivation has been enhanced.

ch: 黑暗中突然出现无数双眼睛盯着你。
tc: 黑暗中突然出現無數雙眼睛盯著你。
en: Countless pairs of eyes appear in the darkness, staring at you.

ch: 你望向那些眼睛似乎有一丝陶醉，突然一个红点融入了你的体内，一股狂暴之力传遍了全身。
tc: 你望向那些眼睛似乎有一絲陶醉，突然一個紅點融入了你的體內，一股狂暴之力傳遍了全身。
en: Watching these eyes you feel a little distracted. Suddenly something red leaps into you and berserk energy spreads through your body.

ch: 你盯着这些眼睛无所畏惧，眼睛在你的盯视下一个个消失。
tc: 你盯著這些眼睛無所畏懼，眼睛在你的盯視下一個個消失。
en: You look back at the eyes fearlessly. One by one they disappear.

ch: 一种毛骨悚然的感觉让你本能地狂奔起来离开了这个地方，但内心的恐惧仍然挥之不去。
tc: 一種毛骨悚然的感覺讓你本能地狂奔起來離開了這個地方，但內心的恐懼仍然揮之不去。
en: A feeling of terror sweeps over you and you run madly away from the scene, but the fear remains with you.

ch: 你走在草丛间，耳中传来歌谣之声。
tc: 你走在草叢間，耳中傳來歌謠之聲。
en: Walking through the brush you hear someone or something singing.

ch: 你正觉得奇怪，一匹面部白色身上带有虎纹的马唱着歌谣绕你一圈后走过，它红色的尾巴甚至在你身上扫了几下。
tc: 你正覺得奇怪，一匹面部白色身上帶有虎紋的馬唱著歌謠繞你一圈後走過，它紅色的尾巴甚至在你身上掃了幾下。
en: A strange horse with a white face and tiger stripe coat trots over to you, circles around you, flicking its red tail at you several times before galloping away. It is singing.

ch: 看着离去的虎纹马你不禁哑然失笑。
tc: 看著離去的虎紋馬你不禁啞然失笑。
en: Watching its tiger haunches disappear into the distance, you burst out laughing.

ch: 前方山谷传来震天咆哮。
tc: 前方山谷傳來震天咆哮。
en: Ferocious snarling sounds are coming from a valley up ahead.

ch: 你凝神望去，只见一只白首赤足的猿猴正与一只通体漆黑头上冒着青光的巨蟒扭打在一起，嘶吼中大地震颤。
tc: 你凝神望去，只見一隻白首赤足的猿猴正與一隻通體漆黑頭上冒著青光的巨蟒扭打在一起，嘶吼中大地震顫。
en: Peering into the distance you see a white ape fighting a massive black snake. Their roaring fills the skies.

ch: 看见如此惊心动魄的战斗，你心有明悟，忽有所感，修为得到提升。
tc: 看見如此驚心動魄的戰鬥，你心有明悟，忽有所感，修為得到提升。
en: Witnessing this epic battle, you gain sudden insight. Your cultivation has been enhanced.

ch: 一阵大风卷起，你立足不稳跌下山崖。
tc: 一陣大風卷起，你立足不穩跌下山崖。
en: Strong winds pick up. You lose your footing and fall down the cliff.

ch: 此时一狮头鹿角，虎眼麋身身披龙鳞的异兽腾云而至，将你托起并带回了山上，而后踏云而去。
tc: 此時一獅頭鹿角，虎眼麋身身披龍鱗的異獸騰雲而至，將你托起並帶回了山上，而後踏雲而去。
en: At that moment, a strange beast with the head of a lion, antlers of a deer, body of a moose and covered in dragon scales gallops towards you on a cloud, lifts you up, returns you to the mountain and then gallops away.

ch: 你心中感叹时发现一丝灵气留在了体内。
tc: 你心中感歎時發現一絲靈氣留在了體內。
en: Sighing inwardly, you find a trace of Qi has rubbed off on you.

ch: 一道叱咤之声划过天空，你抬头看时一只人面之蛇扇动翅膀从天空飞过，其后滔天洪水呼啸而来，你拼尽全力逃离这片区域后精疲力尽。
tc: 一道叱吒之聲劃過天空，你抬頭看時一隻人面之蛇扇動翅膀從天空飛過，其後滔天洪水呼嘯而來，你拼盡全力逃離這片區域後精疲力盡。
en: You hear something above you. Looking up, you see a snake-like creature with the face of a person and wings of a bird flying over. In its wake you hear the roaring of flood waters converging. You get the hell out of there before collapsing in exhaustion.
Help the monkey pick the fruit (Battle)

ch: 赶走猴子帮树保护果子（战斗）
tc: 趕走猴子幫樹保護果子（戰鬥）
en: Shoo away the monkeys to protect the fruit (Battle)

ch: 位置如此显眼却无人采摘 只怕有异
tc: 位置如此顯眼卻無人採摘 只怕有異
en: Nobody trying to harvest in such an obvious place? This is uncanny.
Search for the source of the voice

ch: 你在心里给自己起个小名叫翼儿
tc: 你在心裡給自己起個小名叫翼兒
en: You internally decide that your nickname is now Chickadee.

ch: 收起贪念告诉自己这是他人之物
tc: 收起貪念告訴自己這是他人之物
en: Restrain your greed. This is not yours to take.

ch: 打起精神汇聚灵力去看清石壁
tc: 打起精神彙聚靈力去看清石壁
en: Focus your energy to see what is on the stone wall

ch: 一股正气从你身上升起。
tc: 一股正氣從你身上升起。
en: An air of righteousness emanates from your body.

ch: 喝下潭水后你觉得自己修为提升了。
tc: 喝下潭水後你覺得自己修為提升了。
en: You feel like drinking the pool water has enhanced your Cultivation.

ch: 醒来时发现体内灵气竟散去不少。
tc: 醒來時發現體內靈氣竟散去不少。
en: When you come to, you feel like your Qi has been seriously depleted.

ch:
欢迎各位抢到饭票的道友！
为了顺利完成本次技术A测，请道友务必阅读以下须知：

1、【测试时间】
从2020年12月10日激活后，至13日23点59分。
请注意：14日零点开始游戏将失效。本次为删档测试，数据、存档均不会保留，请道友留意游玩时间。

2、【本次版本内容】
A测版本仅为EA（抢先体验）发售版的小部分内容，有如下限制：
	①游戏时长为游戏内8年		②地图中雷电沼泽等部分格子不可进入，请注意
	③宗门可体验入门小比，正式玩法不开放	④境界仅能突破到筑基初期

3、【问题及意见反馈】
测试游玩中，遇到任何问题或想反馈的内容，请在内测群中提出。如尚未加群的道友，可添加Q群1138175274 ，在群里联系群主、管理进行登记或沟通。或者也可在微博@鬼谷八荒官方 私信反馈情况。

4、【向测试道友的请求】
①本次内测不可直播或放出录屏，请求大家保护处在早期版本的新生鬼谷~
②可以将游戏的内容和体验在大群或其他渠道向其他道友解说分享，但恳请大家温和沟通，嘴下留情~~感谢各位铁子！

再次感谢各位道友对ggbh伸出援手，也再次欢迎大家来到开饭世界！
tc:
歡迎各位搶到飯票的道友！
為了順利完成本次技術A測，請道友務必閱讀以下須知：

1、【測試時間】
從2020年12月10日啟動後，至13日23點59分。
請注意：14日零點開始遊戲將失效。本次為刪檔測試，資料、存檔均不會保留，請道友留意遊玩時間。

2、【本次版本內容】
A測版本僅為EA（搶先體驗）發售版的小部分內容，有如下限制：
	①遊戲時長為遊戲內8年		②地圖中雷電沼澤等部分格子不可進入，請注意
	③宗門可體驗入門小比，正式玩法不開放	④境界僅能突破到築基初期

3、【問題及意見回饋】
測試遊玩中，遇到任何問題或想回饋的內容，請在內測群中提出。如尚未加群的道友，可添加Q群1138175274 ，在群裡聯繫群主、管理進行登記或溝通。或者也可在微博@鬼谷八荒官方 私信回饋情況。

4、【向測試道友的請求】
①本次內測不可直播或放出錄屏，請求大家保護處在早期版本的新生鬼谷~
②可以將遊戲的內容和體驗在大群或其他渠道向其他道友解說分享，但懇請大家溫和溝通，嘴下留情~~感謝各位鐵子！

再次感謝各位道友對ggbh伸出援手，也再次歡迎大家來到開飯世界！
en:
Thank you for participating in our alpha test!
Please read the following before proceeding:

1. [Test Period]
12/10/2020 - 12/13/2020 (23:59)
The alpha test will end at midnight on the 14th. All game data and saves will be erased.

2. [Game Content]
Only a small portion of the game will be available during the alpha test:
	① Players can only play for 8 years (in-game time)		② Some spaces on the world map (Swamp, etc.) are locked.
	③ Sect function: Not available expect Sect Tryouts	④ Realm caps at Foundation Early

3. [Feedback]
Please contact us to send your feedback. Thank you!

4. [Requests from Us]
① Please do not stream or upload any game videos during the alpha test.
② Please be supportive if you introduce our game to others.

Thank you for your support!

5. Bug fix: Sect Mission errors.

11. Bug fix: Jingwei couldn't be killed.
12. Bug fix: Players had to fight themselves during Promotion Duels and couldn't be promoted.
13. Bug fix: Reputation would drop after killing people in order to complete certain missions.
14. Bug fix: Initiate Disciples couldn't use Portals.

16. Bug fix: Duration and difficulty level of Mystic Realms.
17. Bug fix: It took too long to learn Manuals in the late stages.
18. Optimization: Item rewards from Ruins
19. Optimization: Difficulty level and rewards of tombs.
20. Optimization: Some descriptions of item sources.
21. Optimization: Some sound effects.
22. New: Some adventure resources.

21.修正了心法词条（当召唤物死亡时留下毒沼）的伤害威力显示不正确问题。

23.优化了在战斗中体力或灵力已满时，还能使用恢复体力或灵力的丹药的问题。

28.修复了人物的生涯统计数据不正确的问题。
29.修复了逆天改命武神残诀在进入无极之境或不归之境时可能会直接死亡的问题。
30.修复了逆天改命通天之眼在学习到重复的技能时，技能的修炼等级会被重置的问题。
31.修复了逆天改命通天之眼的冷却时间不生效的问题。
32.修复了逆天改命双修大法、肉搏之交在某些情况下不生效的问题。
33.修复了逆天改命魔剑精通在某些情况下吸取的灵力不会回到角色身上的问题。
34.修正了逆天改命妖术入门使敌人变形之后，敌人的防御大幅降低的问题。
35.修复了灵石不足也可在酒馆喝酒的问题。

37.修复了在危险区域中碰到大妖兽后，实际进入的却是小怪副本的问题。
38.优化了长右的技能特效在战斗中容易造成卡顿的问题。
39.修正了月结事件（当某人遭到他人攻击时，攻击方与被攻击方的显示反了）的显示问题。

<size=25>[0.8.1051 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 9 PM, 2/26/2021
1. 2 new rewritten Destinies: Jo's Here! and Chicken King's Here!
2. 4 new adventures:
 Soul Lamp
 Mirage Island
 Broken Array
 Xingxing
3. New: Added a function that allows players to skip dialogue in main stories and adventures in Chaos mode.
4. New: Added the [Mail] button on the world map.
5. Bug fix: Players would be teleported to towns if they interacted with NPCs when starting a new month.
6. Bug fix: Auctions couldn't start sometimes.
7. Bug fix: Wrong Manual rarities in the Manual Pavilion in Chaos mode.
8. Bug fix: No rewards from Spiritlock Circle and Demonseal Circle if players had already cleared them before.
9. Bug fix: Skill affix (increased damage to all enemies) couldn't take effect once stacked.
10. Bug fix: Skill affix (Fire Flare).
11. Bug fix: Skill affix (Spiritual Torrent).
12. Bug fix: Skill affix (Rolling Rock).
13. Bug fix: Skill affix (Void Spirit Blast).
14. Bug fix: Skill affix (Poisonous Plants).
15. Bug fix: Skill affix (Primal Energy).
16. Bug fix: Skill affix (Icy Aura).
17. Bug fix: Some affixes of Earth Special Skills weren't displayed.
18. Bug fix: Wrong stat bonuses of Mind Skills were displayed.
19. Bug fix: A Mind Skill affix could freeze the game when players entered a dungeon.
20. Bug fix: The Mind Skill affix that increases players' stats after they kill other cultivators couldn't take effect if they killed someone above Golden Core.
21. Bug fix: Wrong damage stat of the Poisonous Marsh left behind by a dead summoned unit.
22. Bug fix: Character would disappear after killing a boss using a Motion Skill.
23. Bug fix: Players could still use Vitality and Energy Elixirs even after already full.
24. Bug fix: Wrong boss would appear in the Vengeance event.
25. Bug fix: In Everfrost, Mythical Beast Maps would mark locations in the bottom-left corner of the world map.
26. Bug fix: After multiple caves had been discovered, only one Mythical Beast Map was consumed.
27. Bug fix: Wrong Motion Skill Realms shown in the Manual Pavilion and the Manual Library.
28. Bug fix: Incorrect character statistics.
29. Bug fix: Players with Warlord's Phantom could be instantly killed upon entering Land of Beyond and Land of No Return.
30. Bug fix: Fight and Learn could reset skill level when players were learning duplicate skills.
31. Bug fix: Fight and Learn's cooldown couldn't take effect.
32. Bug fix: Training Partner and Respectable Opponent couldn't take effect sometimes.
33. Bug fix: Energy absorbed by Spiritual Sword III wasn't added to the character.
34. Bug fix: Enemies transformed by Witchcraft I would lose DEF by a large amount.
35. Bug fix: Players without enough Spirit Stones could still drink at Taverns.
36. Bug fix: Textbooks could still be used even after players' stats were above the limits.
37. Bug fix: After encountering a Mythical Beast, players would enter a normal monster dungeon, instead.
38. Optimization: Fel Vermin's skill effects no longer cause lag.
39. Bug fix: The attacker and the attacked were reversed in the monthly summary.
40. Optimization: Adjusted NPCs' behaviors when they're parents or children.
41. Bug fix: Sometimes adventures wouldn't disappear once they were triggered.
42. Bug fix: In adventures, the same NPC would appear on both sides of the dialogue box.
43. Optimization: Adjusted notifications about stat changes when stats are at max.
44. Optimization: Adjusted the Mount interface and fixed the bug where players couldn't check the info of the mount they're equipped with.
45. Optimization: Players' sect icon on the minimap.
46. Optimization: When checking others' info on the minimap, players can now see their relationship.
47. Optimization: Adjusted the special effects when players mark NPCs.
48. Bug fix: Audio would be played multiple times in the monthly summary.
49. Optimization: Adjusted the effects when background music is switched.
50. New: Added sound effects for some bosses.
51. Optimization: Adjusted the notifications when players import saves.
52. Bug fix: The relationship interface couldn't be completely shown when a player has too many masters.
53. Bug fix: NPCs would say the wrong player name in dialogue.
54. Bug fix: Wrong NPC dialogue.
55. Bug fix: Wrong text in some adventures.

<size=25>【0.8.2001 版本更新内容】</size>2021年3月27日14时更新
1.开放暮仙州与迷途荒漠区域。
2.开放化神境与悟道境。
3.新增了神魂技能（突破化神后可获得）。
4.新增了规则领域技能（突破悟道后可获得）。
5.新增主线剧情：夸父逐日。
6.新增支线剧情：天狗食月。
7.新增了以下副本。
　盘龙山。
　千岩谷。
　通幽谷。
　镇邪峰。
　月落山。
　封神天梯。
　道界。
8.新增了大妖兽蛟龙、勾陈、玄龟、陆吾、重明、天狗、封魔剑、神官、天门引者、穷奇、夔、血魅鲮鱼、朱厌、计蒙。
9.新增了精英怪物憨熊、土蝼。
10.新增了25个小怪。
11.优化了NPC的以下AI行为。
　优化了NPC很少主动向他人请求结为亲族关系的问题。
　优化了NPC不会主动提升声望的问题。
12.新增了2个逆天改命——风力四射、木力四射。
13.拍卖会新增了请求与威胁行为，且NPC会在拍卖过程中会出现对话。
14.修复了当有多个修改技能冷却时间的效果时，叠加方式错误的问题（由原来的加法叠加改为乘法叠加）。
15.修复了使用分身类技能时，某些提升伤害的效果会重复对自身以及所有分身生效，导致伤害越来越高的问题。
16.修复了风系身法在正常情况下，变形成龙卷风的过程中仍然可以使用技能的问题。
17.修复了部分神通的施展条件标记单位会被判定为友方单位的问题。
18.修复了水系技能的词条（对被冰冻的敌人造成的伤害增加）没有效果的问题。
19.修复了水系技能的词条（场上每有一个敌人被冻结时，可回复灵力）没有效果的问题。
20.修复了剑系神通骤天剑的词条（每激活一道剑影，可使自身无敌一段时间）的无敌时间不正确的问题。
21.优化了拳系神通巨王拳的效果（每秒按百分比回复体力），改为按固定数值回复体力，避免遇到一些拥有此技能的BOSS，无法被击败的问题。
22.修复了在击杀敌人的分身时，也会掉落道具的问题。
23.修复了在某些情况下，与残破锁灵阵中的乌龟对话后会导致游戏卡死的问题。
24.修复了在某些情况下，无极之境与不归之境的阵眼灼烧伤害会变高的问题。
25.修复了逆天改命剑灵入门系列的伤害计算不正确的问题（原来的伤害重复计算了多次威力加成，导致实际伤害比显示的威力要大得多），修复后提升了其消耗灵力时所获得的威力加成。
26.修复了逆天改命小李飞剑系列的伤害计算不正确的问题（原来的伤害没有计算威力加成，导致实际伤害比显示的威力要少得多），修复后略微降低了其威力。
27.修复了逆天改命双修大法在连续与同一个NPC进行双修时，可能会出现赠送道具效果不生效的问题。
28.修复了逆天改命归一诀系列在雷系神通天雷劫对自己造成伤害时不计算伤害次数的问题。
29.修复了逆天改命李四来也在装备了剑系神通骤天剑时，在某些情况下会导致无限生成剑影的问题。
30.修复了逆天改命蘑菇仙力系列在装备了变身系技能时，可能会出现在变身结束后技能没有还原成正常技能的问题。
31.修复了先天气运大智若愚每月损失灵石效果未生效的问题。
32.修复了一丝元魂状态下的NPC可能会被偷取道具的问题（现在对一丝元魂的NPC只能进行赠送道具的行为）。
33.优化了NPC之间进行战斗的计算过程，使胜负结果更合理。
34.优化了战斗中的传送阵的判定范围，避免在角色移动速度过快时，很难踩中进入下一房间的问题。
35.优化了云陌州的城镇图标及背景图。
36.优化了在修炼技能界面中，技能的修炼等级提升后没有实时在界面左侧中显示出来的问题。
37.修复了在战斗准备界面中查看武技预览时，可能会引发一些异常的问题。
38.修正了部分角色的战斗模型与立绘不匹配的问题。
39.优化了在突破中选择逆天改命时，界面中的选择按钮会与逆天改命的描述重叠的问题。
40.修正了部分界面的文字显示位置在某些分辨率下会发生偏移的问题。
41.优化了部分界面、技能、怪物的音效表现。

<size=25>[0.8.2001 Patch Notes]</size> Update Time: 2 PM, 3/27/2021
1. New areas: Mu Xian and Wayward Desert.
2. New Realms: Soul Formation (Ⅶ) and Enlightenment (Ⅷ).
3. New: Divine Soul Skills (available after breaking through Soul Formation).
4. New: Rule Field Skills (available after breaking through Enlightenment).
5. New main story: Kuafu Chases the Sun.
6. New side story: Tiangou.
7. New dungeons:
 Panlong Mountain
 Rocky Valley
 Secluded Valley
 Exorcism Peak
 Moonfall Mountain
 Stairway to Heaven
 Tao Realm
8. New Mythical Beasts: Jiaolong, Gouchen, Xuangui, Luwu, Chongming, Tiangou, Soulstealer Sword, Priest, Skygate Keeper, Qiongqi, Kui, Bloodspell Carpia, Hellspawn, and Jimeng.
9. 2 new elite monsters.
10. 25 new normal monsters.
11. Optimization: NPC AI
 NPCs will form family relationship more often.
 NPCs will actively increase their Reputation.
12. 2 new rewritten Destinies: Wind Burst and Wood Burst.
13. Threaten and Request options have been added to auctions, and NPCs will talk during auctions.
14. Bug fix: Cooldown reductions were stacked incorrectly.
15. Bug fix: Skills generating clones would increase damage of both the character and their clones.
16. Bug fix: During Wind Motion Skills, character could still cast skills after having transformed into a tornado.
17. Bug fix: Enemies marked by some Ultimate Skills could be mistaken for allies.
18. Bug fix: Water Skill affixes (deal more damage to frozen enemies) couldn't take effect.
19. Bug fix: Water Skill affixes (recover Energy when enemies are frozen) couldn't take effect.
20. Bug fix: Skyfall Sword.
21. Optimization: Titan Fist.
22. Bug fix: Dead enemy clones would drop items.
23. Bug fix: Talking to the turtle in Spiritlock Circle would freeze the game.
24. Bug fix: Array Core's burning damage would increase in Land of Beyond and Land of No Return.
25. Bug fix: Wrong damage calculation for Spiritual Sword I.
26. Bug fix: Wrong damage calculation for Jo's Flying Sword I.
27. Bug fix: Gifted items wouldn't take effect (Training Partner).
28. Bug fix: Damage to self wasn't counted in Lightning Retribution.
29. Bug fix: When Jo's Here! and Skyfall Sword existed at the same time, sword shadows would sometimes get generated non-stop.
30. Bug fix: When Mushroom Power II and transformation skills existed at the same time, skills wouldn't reset to normal after the transformation was over.
31. Bug fix: No Spirit Stone loss every month when Generous was triggered.
32. Bug fix: NPCs in Last Breath status could get their items stolen.
33. Optimization: Battle results between NPCs are now more reasonable.
34. Optimization: Using Portals during combat is easier.
35. Optimization: Adjusted town icons and background images in Yun Mo.
36. Optimization: When skills are being upgraded, skill levels will be shown on the left side of the interface in real-time.
37. Bug fix: Previewing Martial Skills during battle preparation would lead to errors.
38. Bug fix: Some characters' battle models didn't match their portraits.
39. Bug fix: The Select button and Destiny descriptions would overlap on the Rewrite Destiny page.
40. Bug fix: Wrong text display under certain resolutions.
41. Optimization: Some interfaces, skills, and monster sound effects.

<size=25>【0.8.2006 版本更新内容】</size>2021年3月28日15时更新
1.修复了在道界副本中刷新词条时，可能会出现游戏卡死的BUG。
2.降低了五个镇灵BOSS以及天门引者的伤害。
3.因为我们经验的不足，没有提前和大家公告风身法的修正方案。这是我们自己的锅，我们应该自己承担这个责任。所以我们决定先恢复风身法在持续时间内可以释放技能，直到后续大版本更新新的更多的流派出来之前，都不会对风身法进行修正。0CD是因为叠加机制出错了，是必须要修正的，抱歉，否则我们后面游戏技能框架没法做，包括后面的新神通、法宝等。玩家实际上也是可以通过构筑来接近0CD。另外，其它一些明显被大家弃用的身法（例如蝶变、雷变），我们也会在接下来抽时间逐步强化。我们梳理了一下前期可升级的逆天改命，大部分用3个位置换来的逆天改命强度也是很不够的，导致很多道友也弃用，反而成了污染池。今天晚上我们会先更新加强一部分。包括剑灵（以前是有BUG直接放大了10倍伤害，修了BUG后又太弱，这都是内部测试时间不够的表现）。今晚会增加新的逆天改命，跟屁虫也会化龙（这个承诺过大家）！我们近期会在各州开放一个神秘人物，可以让大家在完成任务后，可以修改个别自己不满意的逆天改命。同时，下周我们会更新一套新的定制立绘，以及与NPC约会的玩法。感谢大家的支持，4月份还有个惊喜送给大家！

13. Bug fix: New cursor styles couldn't be properly shown after players interacted with NPCs.
14. Bug fix: The leech effect in Tao Realms couldn't take effect when Wind Motion Skills were cast.
15. Bug fix: Effects of some affixes would disappear after players entered a new room in Tao Realms.
16. Optimization: some NPC dialogue.

<size=25>【0.8.2022 版本更新内容】</size>2021年4月23日20时更新
1.优化了NPC的主动互动频率变低了的问题。
2.优化了NPC在装备技能时，可能会将更强的技能替换成更弱的技能的问题。
3.优化了NPC在战斗中不会攻击召唤物的问题。
4.所有难度在突破时的可选逆天改命数量均调整为原来的2倍（与洪荒难度的规则一致）。
5.所有难度在击败区域大妖兽时均会有红色秘籍掉落（与洪荒难度的规则一致）。
6.修复了勾陈的神魂技能（在战斗中，每次使用神通时可激发一次勾陈之缚）在使用刀系神通魔煞刀过程中，会持续激发勾陈之缚的问题。
7.修复了重明的神魂技能（当受到伤害时，可激发一次重明冲击，对命中的敌人造成伤害）在切换房间之后，可能会无法触发的问题。
8.修复了在风系身法的持续时间内，若自身带有护盾，在受到范围伤害时不会无敌，仍然会消耗护盾值的问题。
9.修复了火系绝技踏火术会阻挡一些非弹道类技能（如旋风刀等）的问题。
10.修复了心法词条（当自身拥有至少6层破势时，绝技的充能速度提升）在某些情况下，可能会使绝技的冷却时间增加的问题。
11.优化了心法词条（每有1点木灵根可使己方召唤物的体力上限提升）在提升体力上限时也会同时提升等量的当前体力。
12.修复了逆天改命双灵共生系列可能会导致技能的冷却时间不正常的问题。
13.修复了当触发了逆天改命青帝遗录后，无法触发逆天改命盾灵入门系列、金蝉假影系列，以及后天气运招魂幡的问题。
14.优化了逆天改命青帝遗录的花妖的弹道，使其可以穿透障碍物。
15.修复了在某些情况下，自己对NPC的亲密度可能会被清空的问题。
16.修复了参悟技能时的消耗数值不正确的问题。
17.修复了大地图中的邀约场景在某些情况下可能会无法消失的问题。
18.修复了约会中切磋可以使用丹药的问题（正常切磋是不能使用丹药的）。
19.修复了永恒冰原的五岳真形图的堪舆地点可能会出现在暮仙州的问题。
20.修复了在一丝元魂的NPC背包已满时，无法收取他人赠送的救命丹药的问题。
21.修复了丹炉中的技能（提升炼丹熟练度）无效的问题。
22.修复了在神魂技能界面中打开其它界面时，可能会导致神魂技能界面无法关闭的问题。

ch: 【0.8.3012 版本更新内容】2021年7月16日12时更新 1.新增了以下奇遇。 　君愿知（由玩家黑雨投稿）。 　天玄论道（由玩家城南的花未开投稿）。 2.新增了器灵的特殊小事件。 3.修复了器灵云梦衣天赋（增加左键效果的最大叠加层数）对部分效果仍然不生效的问题。 4.修复了器灵的部分技艺在使用时没有反馈的问题。 5.修复了木领域的效果会对心魔生效，导致其无法被击败的问题。 6.修复了在邀约场景内，劝离他人后，对方可能会在场景内卡住不动的问题。 7.修复了法宝炽阳之旗的词条（吸收达到灵力上限上可发射火球）在某些情况下可能会导致游戏卡死的问题。 8.修复了法宝炽阳之旗的技能效果（吸收灵力可增加作用范围）未生效的问题。 9.修复了在陨幽谷内击败心魔后，若心魔使用了法宝血纹假面，可能会导致自身在副本内持续受到其伤害的问题。 10.修复了武罗副本中，武罗变身后可能会出现2个武罗的问题。 11.修复了逆天改命（双修大法）使对方赠送道具的功能可能会不生效的问题。 12.修复了幽陨谷副本内的音效音量可能会变低的问题。 13.修正了部分技能的文本说明。

ch: 【0.8.3014 版本更新内容】2021年7月30日17时更新 1.新增了更换主界面主题的功能。 2.新增了保存主界面壁纸的功能。 3.新增了制作手机壁纸的功能。 4.新增了2套立绘（男女各一套）。 5.新增了以下奇遇。 　远志游人。 　生死棋局（由玩家沙思羽投稿）。 6.修复了使用水系灵技灵流术时，若太接近目标，则无法造成伤害的问题。 7.修复了拥有逆天改命青帝遗录，在某些副本中触发后仍然被判定为死亡的问题，以及通关副本后无法复活的问题。 8.修复了逆天改命双修大法触发后，显示对方赠送了道具，但实际却没有收到的问题。 9.修复了法宝技能可能会出现不正确的词条的问题。 10.修复了部分器灵的天赋解锁条件（消耗橙色品质的秘籍）不能正确检测到背包中达到要求的秘籍的问题。 11.下调了陨幽谷中使用冥魂之息召唤的酸与难度。 12.修复了陨幽谷中使用冥魂之息召唤酸与后立即切换房间，会导致酸与直接死亡的问题。 13.降低了宗门立场不合格的惩罚（包括灵石、贡献、禁足时间）。 14.修复了奇遇（君愿知）的纪念品书信无法丢弃的问题。 15.修复了奇遇（道心阁）可能产出错误秘籍的问题。 16.优化了部分奇遇的发生条件，使其更加合理。 17.修复了堪舆出的特殊地点可能会与城镇位置重叠的问题。 18.修复了学习秘籍之后，音效没有关闭的问题。 19.修复了部分怪物的技能音效不正确的问题。 20.修复了某些战斗场景的音效音量过低的问题。 21.优化了各仙露的产出说明，使其产出位置更直观。 22.修正了土系绝技震地波的技能描述。 23.修正了心法词条（每有1点拳法资质可使会心提升）中需求资质图标不正确的问题。 24.修复了装备幽凝摘星戒后，会出现错误的效果图标的问题。
tc: 【0.8.3014 版本更新內容】2021年7月30日17時更新 1.新增了更換主界面主題的功能。 2.新增了保存主界面壁紙的功能。 3.新增了製作手機壁紙的功能。 4.新增了2套立繪（男女各一套）。 5.新增了以下奇遇。 　遠志遊人。 　生死棋局（由玩家沙思羽投稿）。 6.修復了使用水系靈技靈流術時，若太接近目標，則無法造成傷害的問題。 7.修復了擁有逆天改命青帝遺錄，在某些副本中觸發後仍然被判定為死亡的問題，以及通關副本後無法復活的問題。 8.修復了逆天改命雙修大法觸發後，顯示對方贈送了道具，但實際卻沒有收到的問題。 9.修復了法寶技能可能會出現不正確的詞條的問題。 10.修復了部分器靈的天賦解鎖條件（消耗橙色品質的秘笈）不能正確檢測到背包中達到要求的秘笈的問題。 11.下調了隕幽谷中使用冥魂之息召喚的酸與難度。 12.修復了隕幽谷中使用冥魂之息召喚酸與後立即切換房間，會導致酸與直接死亡的問題。 13.降低了宗門立場不合格的懲罰（包括靈石、貢獻、禁足時間）。 14.修復了奇遇（君願知）的紀念品書信無法丟棄的問題。 15.修復了奇遇（道心閣）可能產出錯誤秘笈的問題。 16.優化了部分奇遇的發生條件，使其更加合理。 17.修復了堪輿出的特殊地點可能會與城鎮位置重疊的問題。 18.修復了學習秘笈之後，音效沒有關閉的問題。 19.修復了部分怪物的技能音效不正確的問題。 20.修復了某些戰鬥場景的音效音量過低的問題。 21.優化了各仙露的產出說明，使其產出位置更直觀。 22.修正了土系絕技震地波的技能描述。 23.修正了心法詞條（每有1點拳法資質可使會心提升）中需求資質圖標不正確的問題。 24.修復了裝備幽凝摘星戒後，會出現錯誤的效果圖標的問題。

41.新增了宗门战防守宗主激活传承的特效。

<size=25>【0.8.4001 版本更新内容】</size>2021年10月22日18时更新
1.新增了宗门大比玩法。
　在华封州、云陌州、暮仙州区域内每隔3年将会举办一次。
　举办时将邀请本区域的各大宗门参赛，参与大比需要消耗1个月时间。
　参赛的宗门将派出宗门内的真传弟子参与大比，长老、大长老及宗主可对参赛弟子进行督战，为弟子在大比中提供帮助。
　大比分为积分赛与擂台赛。
　积分赛时，每个宗门的参赛弟子逐一与其他宗门的弟子进行比试，每轮的胜者会获得积分，最终积分排名靠前的宗门可晋级参加擂台赛。
　擂台赛为已经晋级的宗门的所有参赛弟子自由进行一对一的比试，在擂台赛中每击败一名弟子也可获得积分，最终总积分最多的宗门为本州第一宗，个人积分最多的弟子则为大比魁首。
　大比结束后，将会根据每个宗门及弟子获得的名次发放奖励。
2.新增了资源点争夺玩法。
　在大地图中会随机出现各种资源点，宗门可以派弟子去占领或是掠夺资源点。
　宗门占领资源点后，需要派弟子驻守，即可每个月获得对应的宗门资源。
　宗门也可派弟子去掠夺其他宗门的资源点，直接掠夺一次资源。
3.新增了宗门大战玩法。
　宗主可向本州的其他宗门发起宗门战。
　发起宗门战后将会全宗出动，向目标宗门进行攻击。
　出动时需要携带一定的宗门资源，用于在宗门战中治疗受伤的弟子，使其可以继续参战。
　宗门战分为外部战场、神兽战场与巅峰战场。
　内门弟子与外门弟子在外部战场击破对方宗门的大阵。
　高级弟子则在大阵被击破的时机穿过大阵，进入对方宗门内部，攻击其神兽。
　将对方的神兽击败后，宗主即可进入巅峰战场，与对方的宗主战斗，击败其宗主即可胜利。
　宗门战胜利后，可以选择掠夺或是直接覆灭其宗门。
　掠夺宗门可将对方宗门的资源掠夺给本宗弟子。
　覆灭宗门则可以在其宗门位置上建立自己的宗门分舵，并获得其主修功法与传承（若有）。
4.重做了各区域宗门的分布规则。
　大型宗门的总部会在高级的州，低级的州将会有这些宗门的分舵。
　去往高级区域时，可继续加入同一个宗门。
5.新增了宗门搬迁功能。
　宗主可以建造飞舟，带领本宗弟子前往下一个区域，并建立新的宗门。
6.调整了部分宗门建筑的功能。
　任务大厅：新增了长老及以上的职位可以在任务大厅中分配任务给弟子的功能。
　议事大厅：优化了宗门各项资源的显示与说明，以及宗门日志内容。
　聚宝仙楼：优化了聚宝仙楼中可产出的道具类型（现在有概率产出突破材料、技能修炼材料等）。
　藏经阁：新增了宗主可以藏经阁中修改本宗主修功法的功能（修改后可在下次刷新时生效）。
　灵阁：原来的灵阁，在灵阁中突破，会出现宗门特有的逆天改命可选。
　神兽峰：可与神兽互动，神兽有化灵的功能（消耗2个灵果，可以转化出1个指定属性的灵果）。
7.优化了宗门各项资源的作用。
　宗门领地：领地可提升宗门繁荣度的上限。
　宗门名誉：名誉可决定宗门藏经阁产出的秘籍数量与品质。
　安定度：安定度较高时，可使宗门的繁荣度稳步提升，反之繁荣度则会下降。
　繁荣度：繁荣度决定每月从宗门领地内收取的税收灵石。
　忠诚度：忠诚度决定每月主动离开宗门的记名弟子数量。
　灵石：用于给宗门弟子发放俸禄、扩展领地以及建造飞舟。
　矿材：用于聚宝仙楼中，补充突破灵气、丹炉、技能修炼材料、炼器材料等道具。
　药材：用于聚宝仙楼中，补充天材地宝、丹药、灵果、药材等道具。
8.新增了宗门的宗旨、门规与特质。
　门规为本宗门弟子不可做的行为，若违反门规，则会受到宗门的惩罚。
　特质为本宗门的特殊效果。
9.调整了宗门的职位框架、晋升方式以及各职位的人数与权利。
　宗主：开放了玩家可以晋升为宗主的功能，宗主拥有调整宗门弟子职位、发动宗门战、发动资源战、设置宗门主修功法、修改宗门名字、门规等权利。
　大长老：大长老拥有调整其属下弟子职位、发动资源战、派遣弟子任务的权利。
　长老：长老拥有调整其属下弟子职位、派遣弟子任务的权利。
　真传弟子：拥有参与宗门大比的资格。
10.新增了各个职位的宗门任务。
　职位越高，可以领取难度越高的任务，获得的奖励也越高。
　旧存档在进入游戏后，需要运转一个月后才会有新的任务出现。
11.新增了宗门专属的逆天改命。
　每个宗门都有一个特有的逆天改命，只有本宗的弟子可获得。
12.新增了宗门传承。
　每个宗门的总部都会有一个传承，新晋升的宗主通过传承的考验后，即可获得该传承。
13.新增了天骄NPC。
　天骄NPC拥有更强的属性与技能。
　天骄NPC会更难提升亲密度。
　天骄NPC拥有道心，拥有道心后突破即可获得逆天改命。
　新增了天骄NPC的对话内容。
14.新增了器灵语音。
15.新增了动态立绘功能。
16.新增了NPC的烦恼功能。
17.新增了部分NPC的对话文本。

<size=25>【0.8.4001 版本更新內容】</size>2021年10月22日18時更新
1.新增了宗門大比玩法。
　在華封洲、雲陌洲、暮仙洲區域內每隔3年將會舉辦一次。
　舉辦時將邀請本區域的各大宗門參賽，參與大比需要消耗1個月時間。
　參賽的宗門將派出宗門內的真傳弟子參與大比，長老、大長老及宗主可對參賽弟子進行督戰，為弟子在大比中提供幫助。
　大比分為積分賽與擂台賽。
　積分賽時，每個宗門的參賽弟子逐一與其他宗門的弟子進行比試，每輪的勝者會獲得積分，最終積分排名靠前的宗門可晉級參加擂台賽。
　擂台賽為已經晉級的宗門的所有參賽弟子自由進行一對一的比試，在擂台賽中每擊敗一名弟子也可獲得積分，最終總積分最多的宗門為本洲第一宗，個人積分最多的弟子則為大比魁首。
　大比結束後，將會根據每個宗門及弟子獲得的名次發放獎勵。
2.新增了資源點爭奪玩法。
　在大地圖中會隨機出現各種資源點，宗門可以派弟子去占領或是掠奪資源點。
　宗門占領資源點後，需要派弟子駐守，即可每個月獲得對應的宗門資源。
　宗門也可派弟子去掠奪其他宗門的資源點，直接掠奪一次資源。
3.新增了宗門大戰玩法。
　宗主可向本洲的其他宗門發起宗門戰。
　發起宗門戰後將會全宗出動，向目標宗門進行攻擊。
　出動時需要攜帶一定的宗門資源，用於在宗門戰中治療受傷的弟子，使其可以繼續參戰。
　宗門戰分為外部戰場、神獸戰場與巔峰戰場。
　內門弟子與外門弟子在外部戰場擊破對方宗門的大陣。
　高級弟子則在大陣被擊破的時機穿過大陣，進入對方宗門內部，攻擊其神獸。
　將對方的神獸擊敗後，宗主即可進入巔峰戰場，與對方的宗主戰鬥，擊敗其宗主即可勝利。
　宗門戰勝利後，可以選擇掠奪或是直接覆滅其宗門。
　掠奪宗門可將對方宗門的資源掠奪給本宗弟子。
　覆滅宗門則可以在其宗門位置上建立自己的宗門分舵，並獲得其主修功法與傳承（若有）。
4.重做了各區域宗門的分布規則。
　大型宗門的總部會在高級的洲，低級的洲將會有這些宗門的分舵。
　去往高級區域時，可繼續加入同一個宗門。
5.新增了宗門搬遷功能。
　宗主可以建造飛舟，帶領本宗弟子前往下一個區域，並建立新的宗門。
6.調整了部分宗門建築的功能。
　任務大廳：新增了長老及以上的職位可以在任務大廳中分配任務給弟子的功能。
　議事大廳：優化了宗門各項資源的顯示與說明，以及宗門日誌內容。
　聚寶仙樓：優化了聚寶仙樓中可產出的道具類型（現在有概率產出突破材料、技能修煉材料等）。
　藏經閣：新增了宗主可以藏經閣中修改本宗主修功法的功能（修改後可在下次刷新時生效）。
　靈閣：原來的靈閣，在靈閣中突破，會出現宗門特有的逆天改命可選。
　神獸峰：可與神獸互動，神獸有化靈的功能（消耗2個靈果，可以轉化出1個指定屬性的靈果）。
7.優化了宗門各項資源的作用。
　宗門領地：領地可提升宗門繁榮度的上限。
　宗門名譽：名譽可決定宗門藏經閣產出的秘笈數量與品質。
　安定度：安定度較高時，可使宗門的繁榮度穩步提升，反之繁榮度則會下降。
　繁榮度：繁榮度決定每月從宗門領地內收取的稅收靈石。
　忠誠度：忠誠度決定每月主動離開宗門的記名弟子數量。
　靈石：用於給宗門弟子發放俸祿、擴展領地以及建造飛舟。
　礦材：用於聚寶仙樓中，補充突破靈氣、丹爐、技能修煉材料、煉器材料等道具。
　藥材：用於聚寶仙樓中，補充天材地寶、丹藥、靈果、藥材等道具。
8.新增了宗門的宗旨、門規與特質。
　門規為本宗門弟子不可做的行為，若違反門規，則會受到宗門的懲罰。
　特質為本宗門的特殊效果。
9.調整了宗門的職位框架、晉升方式以及各職位的人數與權利。
　宗主：開放了玩家可以晉升為宗主的功能，宗主擁有調整宗門弟子職位、發動宗門戰、發動資源戰、設置宗門主修功法、修改宗門名字、門規等權利。
　大長老：大長老擁有調整其屬下弟子職位、發動資源戰、派遣弟子任務的權利。
　長老：長老擁有調整其屬下弟子職位、派遣弟子任務的權利。
　真傳弟子：擁有參與宗門大比的資格。
10.新增了各個職位的宗門任務。
　職位越高，可以領取難度越高的任務，獲得的獎勵也越高。
　舊存檔在進入遊戲後，需要運轉一個月後才會有新的任務出現。
11.新增了宗門專屬的逆天改命。
　每個宗門都有一個特有的逆天改命，只有本宗的弟子可獲得。
12.新增了宗門傳承。
　每個宗門的總部都會有一個傳承，新晉升的宗主通過傳承的考驗後，即可獲得該傳承。
13.新增了天驕NPC。
　天驕NPC擁有更強的屬性與技能。
　天驕NPC會更難提升親密度。
　天驕NPC擁有道心，擁有道心後突破即可獲得逆天改命。
　新增了天驕NPC的對話內容。
14.新增了器靈語音。
15.新增了動態立繪功能。
16.新增了NPC的煩惱功能。
17.新增了部分NPC的對話文本。

<size=25>[0.8.4001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated on 22 October 2021 at 18:00
**Due to time constraints, some of the English text has not been translated yet. We will update the English text as soon as possible.
1. The Sect Competition is now available.
　The Sect Competition will be held once every 3 years in the Huafeng, Yunmao and Muxian continents.
　All sects in the region will be invited to participate in the competition, which will take 1 month to complete.
　The competing Sects will send their True Disciples to participate in the competition. The Elders, Grand Elders and Sect Leaders will supervise the competing Disciples and help them in the competition.
　The Sect Competition is divided into a points competition and a ring competition.
　In the points competition, each disciple competes one by one against the disciples from other sects, with the winner of each round gaining points.
　In the Tournament, all participating disciples of the sect that have already advanced will compete in a one-on-one match.
　At the end of the Sect Competition, rewards will be given to each sect and disciple according to their ranking.
2. Added resource spot competition.
　Various resource spot will appear randomly on the map and sects can send their disciples to occupy or plunder them.
　Once a sect has occupied a resource spot, they will need to send their disciples to guard it and receive the corresponding sect resources every month.
　Sects can also send their disciples to plunder other clan's resource points to directly plunder resources once.
3. Added Sect War 
　The sect leader can start a sect war with other sects in his state.
　After starting a sect war, the whole sect will be mobilised to attack the target sect.
　You will need to bring a certain amount of sect resources with you to heal your injured disciples during the sect war so that they can continue to fight.
　The sect war are divided into external battles, divine beast battles and summit battles.
　Inner disciples and outer disciples break down the opposing sect's battlefield in the external battlefield.
　The senior disciples will go through the array when it is broken and enter the opponent's sect to attack the  legendary beast.
　Once the legendary beast has been defeated, the sect leader can enter the battlefield and fight the enemy sect leader to win.
　Once the sect has won the war, the victor can choose to plunder or destroy the defeated sect.
　Plundering a clan allows you to plunder the resources of the other clan for your own disciples.
　If you destroy a sect, you can create your own sect rudder in the sect's place and gain access to its main martial and legacy (if any).
4. Redone of the distribution rules for regional sects
　Large sects will have their headquarters in the higher continents and the lower continents will have their subsection.
　You can continue to join the same sect when you go to a higher level region.
5. Added sect relocation function
　The sect leader can build a flying boat to lead his sect's disciples to the next region and establish a new sect.
6. Adjusted the functions of some sect buildings.
　Mission Hall:A new function has been added for disciples in the position of Elder and above to be able to assign tasks to other disciples in the Task Hall.
　Council Hall: optimise the display and description of the sect's resources and the content of the sect log.
　Treasure Pavilion:  the types of items that can be produced in the Treasure Pavilion have been optimised (they now have a probability of producing breakthrough materials, skill materials, etc.).
　Manual Library: now allows thesect leader to modify the sect's main techniques (the modification will take effect on the next refresh).
　Spirit Pavilion: the original Cultivation Chamber, breakthrough in the Spirit Pavilion, will appear the sect's unique optional Destiny.
　Legendary Beast Peak: You can interact with the legendary beast, which has the function of transforming into a spirit (consume 2  Spiritual Fruit to transform into 1  Spiritual Fruit with specified attributes).
7. Optimised the role of various resources of the sect.
　Sect's territory: The territory can raise the maximum prosperity of the sect.
　Sect's reputation: reputation determines the quantity and quality of Manuals produced in the Sect's Manual Library.
　Stability: A high level of stability will steadily increase the prosperity of the sect, while the opposite will decrease it.
　Prosperity: Prosperity determines the amount of tax spirit stones collected from the sect's territory each month.
　Loyalty: Loyalty determines the number of registered disciples who leave the sect each month.
　Spirit Stones: These are used to pay Wage to sect members, to expand the territory and to build Flying boats.
　Ore: Used in the Treasure Pavilion to replenish Qi, Furnace, skill training materials, forging material and other items.
　Herb: Used in the Treasure Pavilion to replenish Heaven and Earth Treasure, Elixirs, sprit fruits and herbs.
8. The Sect Purpose, Sect Rules and Traits have been added.
　The Sect Rules are the rules of the sect that disciples are not allowed to do, and if they violate them, they will be punished by the sect.
　Traits are special effects of the sect.
9. Adjusted sect's position framework, promotion methods and the number and power of each position.
　Sect leader: player now can promote to leader. Sect leader has the right to adjust the positions of the disciples of the sect, to launch sect wars, resource spot competition, set the sect's main techniques, and modify the sect's name and rules.
　Grand Elder: The Grand Elder has the right to adjust the positions of the disciples under him, to wage resource wars and to dispatch disciples on missions.
　Elders: Elders have the right to adjust the positions of their subordinate disciples and dispatch disciples on missions.
　True disciples: they are eligible to participate in the sect competition.
10. Added the sect mission for each position.
　The higher the position, the more difficult the mission and the higher the reward.
11. Added new sect-exclusive Destiny
　Each sect has a unique Destiny, which can only be obtained by disciples of the sect.
12. Added new sect legacy
　Each sect has a legacy at its headquarters, which can be obtained by newly promoted sect leader once they have passed the legacy test.
13. Added new Heaven Chosen NPC
　The Heaven Chosen NPCs have stronger Stats Info and skills.
　Heaven Chosen NPCs will be harder to raise in affinity.
　The Heaven Chosen NPC has a Heart of a Taoist, after a breakthrough was achieved by having a Heart of a Taoist, they can get Ultimate Skills.
　14.New dialogue content for the Heaven Chosen NPCs has been added.
15. Added dynamic drawing function.
16. Added the function of NPC's worry
17. Added dialogue text for some NPCs.

2. Optimized the AI of NPCs in the sect.
    When there are too many people in the sect, NPCs will feel hopeless to be promoted and cause to leave the sect.
    NPCs may also leave the sect when the loyalty is too low.
    NPCs who have a kinship with the sect leader will not leave the sect easily.

30. Fixed the issue where stamina could be 0 after returning to the large map at the end of a resource battle.

32. Optimised the plot of sending disciples on resource point looting missions.

36. Fixed the issue where characters might drift after the sect Tournament.
37. Fixed the issue where players could not supervise some of the disciples in the Tournament when they were leading the sect as the Grand Elder of the branch.

<size=25>[0.8.4023 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 01:00 on November 20, 2021
1. Added a part of the English text (the translated text is the first version of the translation, and will be adjusted and corrected in future updates to make it more uniform and more relevant to express the original meaning).
2. Added the function of filtering manuals in the Manual Library.
3. Optimized the current privilege hints of the Manual Library, Treasure Pavilion and Cultivation Chamber.
4. Fixed the problem that in some cases, the actual consumption of the Manual Library to buy manuals does not match the displayed value.
5. Fixed the problem that the player could not get the reward from the sect dispatch mission when he was the Grand Elder.
6. Fixed the problem that the  Artifact would not appear after the bounty mission (rescue others) defeated the Mythical Beasts and then used the  Artifact.
7. Fixed the problem that the effect of Destinies (Junior's Care) did not take effect.
8. Fixed the problem that the Heaven Chosen NPCs did not easily change their skills actively under certain circumstances.
9. Fixed the problem that under certain circumstances, the Heaven Chosen NPCs would not release their special skill in battle.
10. Fixed the problem that pressing space continuously after humiliating an enemy would keep getting stuck in the scene and could not settle the dungeon normally.
11. Fixed the problem that elders may ask themselves to choose to change their Destiny.
12. Fixed the problem that when attacking between sect members and both parties are above the status of elder, it will affect the affinity of disciples.
13. Optimized the dialogue text of the appearance of the disciples of the same sect who come to help when a battle occurs in the sect territory.
14. Fixed the problem that the sect punishment notification also appears after killing some non-sect NPCs.  
15. Fixed the problem that the population of the branch sector would always be automatically assigned.
16. Fixed the problem that when the sect's headquarters and branch are in the same area, it will not be possible to exit the branch after exiting the headquarters and joining the branch again.
17. Fixed the problem that the Artisanship (Quick Learner) of the Artifact Spirit (Lingge) had no feedback after selecting manuals that did not meet the learning conditions. It is now changed to not being able to select manuals that does not meet the conditions.

23. Optimized the problem that after the occupation of other sects, the Destiny in the Cultivation Chamber did not change to Destiny of the occupying party.

25. Fixed the problem that the flag style of other sects in some interfaces of the sect competition was displayed incorrectly.
26. Fixed the problem that some text in the ranking of the sect competition was displayed incorrectly.
27. Fixed the problem of inconsistency between the content of the dialogue in the scene and the content of the plot option selected by the Branch Leader in the scene of the sect competition.
28. Fixed the problem that the shield of the Destiny (Warlord's Phantom) would not be returned to the physical strength after the Points Race in the sect competition.
29. Optimized that when the number of sects in a certain area is greater than 6, sect with lower reputation will not participate in the sect competition, and added the corresponding monthly refreshing tips.
30. Fixed the problem of incorrect color display of the summoned creatures' blood bar in the sect competition.
31. Fixed the problem that the escape button did not change to the leave button when all the enemies died in the resource raid dungeon.
32. Fixed the issue that under certain circumstances would cause players to enter the resource war with enemies all around them.
33. Fixed the problem that in some cases there were no enemies in the resource scene, but the mini-map showed that there were enemies and could not leave the room normally.
34. Fixed the problem that the compensation of resources may cause the sect's spirit stone to become negative after the failed attack of resource war.
35. Optimized some of the plot performance of sect war.
36. Optimized the dialogue display style of NPCs in the resource war.

tc: 【0.8.4025 版本更新內容】2021年11月30日22時更新 1.新增了一個特殊宗門御龍山莊（需要創建新檔並且選擇先天氣運龍祖靈息才能生成）。 2.新增了道號功能。 3.新增了精衛的動態效果。 4.洪荒模式下的道具掉落改為了雙倍掉落。 5.洪荒模式下突破時最多可以出現9個逆天改命選項。 6.提升了宗門任務的貢獻獎勵。 7.修復了當玩家成為宗主後，任務大廳刷出某些任務的概率會大幅變低的問題。 8.優化了部分宗門任務刷新的位置與宗門距離過遠的問題。 9.調整了部分宗門任務奇遇的產出。 10.修復了宗門繁榮度上限無法正常提升的問題。 11.修復了槍系絕技的詞條（有概率回復1點充能）回復的充能點數不正確的問題。 12.修復了宗門的聚寶仙樓在消耗宗門藥材及礦材後，產出的材料不正確的問題。 13.修復了在某些情況下，遊戲會卡在存檔升級界面的問題。 14.修復了使用雷系功法時可能會出現偶爾卡頓的問題。 15.修復了在某些情況下發起宗門戰時，己方宗門的分舵會支援敵方宗門的問題。 16.修復了內門小比時，參賽的NPC與真傳弟子戰鬥時的結果不正確的問題。 17.修復了宗門戰的日誌可能會記錄到敵方宗門內的問題。 18.修復了宗門的分舵被滅宗後，其總部可能會仍然向該分舵調派人員的問題。 19.修復了先天氣運（神匠門徒）獲得的法寶沒有融合器靈的問題。 20.修復了在戰鬥中有多個爆靈湖疊在同一個地方時，其中一個爆靈湖消失可能會導致其它爆靈湖的效果也消失的問題。 21.修復了切磋時輸了可能會觸發器靈對話的問題。 22.修復了在某些副本中救助NPC時，可以重複給予丹藥，獲得正道值獎勵。 23.修復了在某些情況下搬遷宗門會導致遊戲卡死的問題。 24.修復了宗門推薦信在入宗小比時沒有效果的問題。 25.修復了在某些情況下，宗門搬遷時選擇資源界面顯示不正確問題。 26.修復了首次進入藏經閣及聚寶仙樓觸發小師妹的對話後，沒有獲得獎勵的問題。 27.修復了在宗門大比開啟時，選擇拒絕參賽可能仍然會進入到宗門大比的問題。 28.修復了在劇情中產出道具時，獎勵界面會被劇情對話遮擋住的問題。 29.優化了逆天改命（水力四射）的特效。 30.優化了宗門神獸的化靈功能的引導劇情。 31.優化了部分宗門日誌文本。
en: [0.8.4025 Patch Notes] Updated at 22:00 on November 30, 2021 1. Added a part of English text (the translated text is the first version of the translation, and will be adjusted and corrected in future updates to make it more uniform and relevant to express the original meaning). Up to version 0.8.4025, 80% of Sect·Heaven Chosen(updated on October 22, 2021) text translation has been added to the game. The text of the content generated by this new version(0.8.4025) is still being translated. 2. Added a new special sect Dragon Mountain Hamlet (need to create a new file and select the Destiny(Nature) Elder Dragon Aura to generate it). 3. Added a new Taoist Title function. 4. Added the dynamic effect of Jingwei. 5. Prop drops in Chaos mode have been changed to double drops. 6. Up to 9 Destiny options can appear when breaking through in Chaos mode. 7. Improved the contribution rewards of sect missions. 8. Fixed the problem that the probability of certain quests in the Mission Hall would become significantly lower when the player became the sect leader. 9. Optimized the problem that some of the sect missions were refreshed at locations too far away from the sect. 10. Adjusted the output of some sect adventures missions. 11. Fixed the problem that in some cases, the game will be stuck in the archive upgrade interface. 12. Fixed the problem that the game may occasionally lag when using Lightning Manual. 13. Fixed the problem that the branch of your own sect would support the enemy sect when launching a sect war under certain circumstances. 14. Fixed the problem that the results of the battle between the participating NPCs and true disciples were incorrect during the Promotion Duel (Disciple). 15. Fixed the problem that the logs of sect war might be recorded in the enemy sect. 16. Fixed the problem that after a sect's branch was destroyed, its headquarters might still transfer personnel to that branch. 17. Fixed the problem that magic treasures obtained by Destiny(Nature) (Forging Apprentice) did not fuse with the Artifact Spirit. 18. Fixed the problem that when multiple Energy Pond is stacked in the same place in a battle, the disappearance of one of the Energy Pond may cause the effects of the others to disappear as well. 19. Fixed the problem that losing a sparring match may trigger the Artifact Spirit dialogue. 20. Fixed the problem that when rescuing NPCs in certain Dungeon, you can repeatedly give elixirs to get Righteous Points. 21. Fixed the problem that relocating the sect would cause the game to get stuck under certain circumstances. 22. Fixed the problem that the sect recommendation letter had no effect when entering the Sect Duel. 23. Fixed the problem of incorrect display of the resource selection screen when relocating sects under certain circumstances. 24. Fixed the problem that the first time you enter the Manual Library and the treasure Pavilion after triggering the dialogue of the Junior, the player does not get the reward. 25. Optimized the text of the monthly refreshing when unable to participate in the sect competition. 26. Fixed the problem that when the sect competition was launched, choosing to refuse to participate may still lead to the competition. 27. Fixed the problem that the reward screen would be blocked by the plot dialogue when the items were produced in the plot. 28. Optimized the special effects of Rewrite Destiny (Water Burst). 29. Optimized the guidance plot of the Sect beast's Spirit Transformation function. 30. Optimized the text of some sect logs.

1. Fixed the problem that the main quest (breakthrough to a certain realm) would not be completed if you collect it after reaching the realm.
2. Increased the output of Furnace in the town's market.
3. Fixed the problem that the main storyline (Increase EXP) might not generate Qi.
4. Fixed the problem that when the sect relocated to the edge of the map, it might cause the game to get stuck.
5. Fixed the problem that the sect could be relocated to the territory of other sects, resulting in the sect territory not expanding properly.
6. Fixed the problem that the number of deaths would increase when being humiliated by NPCs when failing in the Promotion Duel (Grand Elder& Grand Elders).
7. Optimized the penalty rule for attacking NPCs when they steal from each other (attacking will not be punished, but killing will still be punished).
8. Optimized the interface display of the sect's hospital, Treasure Pavilion and challenge the Tradition.
9. Fixed the problem that under certain circumstances, it is possible to repeat breakthroughs in the Cultivation Chamber in the sect.
10. Fixed the problem that the monthly ending was incorrect when the sect did not meet the conditions for participating in the sect competition.
11. Fixed the problem that the output of the Darkfire Mask in the sect task (Inspect the Feng Shui of the Land) did not match the current regional realm.
12. Fixed the problem that some summons could not attack the divine beasts in the sect battle.
13. Fixed the problem that the ranking interface display in the IImmortal Tournament may appear abnormal.
14. Optimized the operation of the interface of the challenge Taoist Title.
15. Optimized the triggering probability of some Adventures.
16. Fixed the problem that the damage of Destiny (Shadowchase Pill) was too low.
17. Optimized the description text of the Destiny (Fiery Bristle).
18. Optimized the text of the tip that you can't use the potion to break the bottleneck when you have Destiny (Nurture)(Upset).
19. Fixed the problem that the effect of the passive skill (Savage Wrath) of the spirit artifact was incorrect.

<size=25>[0.8.4036 Patch Notes]</size>Update Time: 23:00 12/31/2021
1. Added 2 mysterious organizations (Taoist Mind Pavilion, Mindsnap Temple) that lurk in the darkness with secrets.
　Yun Mo ordinary dungeons have chance to drop clues about the mysterious organizations.
　Taoist Mind Pavilion exclusive Taoist Mind - Holy (Special Rewrite Destiny - Seven Star Sword), Mindsnap Temple exclusive Taoist Mind - Unique (Special Rewrite Destiny - Lord of Nether River).
2. Added face parts for the full-body standing up drawings of some characters.
3. Bug fix: The game would sometimes freeze after a character with Dragonspawn dies.
4. Improved the special effect of Dragonspawn transformation.
5. Bug fix: The game would freeze when cultivating in Spirit Pavilion if the sect doesn't have Rewrite Destiny.
6. Bug fix: When a marked NPC is a soul, it might not be displayed on the mark page.
7. Bug fix: NPC could receive Taoist Title in soul status.
8. Added Taoist Titles (Elixir and Forge series).
9. Improved the display of How to Obtain on Taoist Title obtaining page.
10. Bug fix: Recruit button might appear in NPC info page even when recruitment authority is not available (Only a display error. Pressing this button won't have actual effect.)
11. Bug fix: Artifact Spirit - Cangya skill (stacking Shield after dealing damage a certain number of times) wouldn't properly function.
12. Bug fix: After Artifact Spirit - Lingge skill (Art of Defense) was unleashed, the Vitality gauge of its Artifact would be displayed as not full.
13. Improved the buff icon display of Rewrite Destiny (Borderless).
14. Improved the contents display on Alchemy page.

<size=25>【0.8.5001 版本更新内容】</size>2022年1月17日21时更新
1.解锁了神器（昊天眼），功能如下。
　增加了1格大地图的视野。
　查看NPC背包时有概率可查看到更多道具。
　与大妖兽战斗时，有概率学习到其施放的技能。
　在战斗中受到致命伤害时，可发动时光倒流回到重伤前的状态并脱离战斗。
2.新增了以下奇遇。  
　风起萍末（完成主线钻木取火后可触发）。
3.新增了NPC对话时的动态表情。
4.优化了御龙山庄的部分奇遇事件。
5.优化了奇遇、对话以及过月的选项的确认方式（使用WASD与空格进行选择和确认）。
6.优化了聚宝仙楼购买界面。
7.优化了施放蓄力技能时，蓄力条的显示效果。
8.修复了在炼气期时，可能会有NPC来请教指点的问题。
9.新增了赠送物品的分类功能。
10.新增了小地图筛选建筑的功能。
11.优化了在创建角色界面切换性别时会随机一次立绘的问题。
12.修复了道号的威压效果不正确的问题。
13.修复了挑战道号时更换功法卡住的问题。
14.修复了道具（访胜灵签）无法被正常消耗的问题。
15.新增了调整大长老或长老调度人口的权限功能。
16.修复了退宗后，可能还会有原宗门的NPC来询问宗门事务的问题。
17.修复了绝世聪慧先天气运，有时减少心情上限与描述不符的问题（以前是减少百分比，而描述是减少固定值）。
18.优化了器灵姜菱歌的天赋描述（灵力可提升攻击力）不完整的问题（效果没有变化，补充了遗漏的描述）。
19.修复了某些攻击弹道可能会造成多次伤害的问题。
20.修复了NPC使用蓄力技能时也会显示蓄力条的问题。

18. Optimized the Artifact Spirit Jiang Lingge's talent description (Energy can improve ATK ) incomplete problem (the effect did not change, supplemented the missing description).
19. Fixed the problem that some attack ballistics may cause multiple damage.
20. Fixed the issue that NPCs would also show the charged bar when using the charged skill.

<size=25>[Internal Test Version 062102 Patch Notes]</size> Update time: 12 AM, 6/22/2022
<size=20>This version is for test uses, and there may be some unexpected problems in it. Besides, many contents in this version may be subject to future amendments. If you find any glitch that may impact your gaming experience, please let us know, and we will fix it ASAP. We are also looking forward to your advices and suggestions, thanks for your support!
<r>The path of save files in this version is different from the path applied in official versions. Upon entering the test version for the first time, save files in official versions would be automatically copied to:
C:\Users\(username)\AppData\LocalLow\guigugame\guigubahuang\SteamApotheosis\CacheData</r></size>
1. Reduced the true form HP in G1, G2 and G3 Nether Demons.
2. Reduced the HP and skill damage of Jiuying, a Boss encountered in Main Missions.
3. Reduced the HP and skill damage of Bloodthirst Sparrow.
4. New: Added a guide to offer sacrifice when finding the first Immortal Shrine.
5. Bug fix: Related stories cannot be trigged in some Immortal Shrines.
6. Optimization: The display of Heavenly Arts. Now the collection progress of them can be found in the Heavenly Arts interface.
7. New: Added a dungeon mechanism. Now after the player picked up Mind Spirits in the Mind Sea in the dungeons of Nether Seeds, they would gain a Vitality recovery and increase their ATK for a short time.
8. Bug fix: Game freeze upon opening some interfaces in the Mod Editor.
9. Bug fix: Arrays in the Transcendent Breakthrough dungeon would occasionally move.
10. Bug fix: Display glitches found in some effects when using the Power of Law to enter the Stage II in the Transcendent Breakthrough dungeon.
11. Bug fix: Game freeze after becoming the Master of the Cultivator’s Alliance.
12. Bug fix: Display error on stats shown in the interface of choosing a Nether Feather to enhance when breaking through minor realms in Reborn.
13. Bug fix: Abnormal damage from Heavenly Arts.
14. Bug fix: Data loss of some buildings (Market, Mission Hall, Auction House, etc.) after the moving of the Cultivator’s Alliance.
15. Adjustment: The location of Mirage in the Transcendent Breakthrough mission "Look for Mirage Qi Orb".
16. New: Icons for new skills of Eye of Providence are added.
17. Optimization: The name and skill description for Immortal Chickens; also added icons for their skills.
18. Adjustment: Stats of different kinds of fighting chicken; also optimized the cast chance of triggerable skills, and the accumulation rate of Immortal Chicken’s Ultimate Skill slot.
19. New: Added combat animation for some Immortal Chickens; also optimized the UI when sending Chickens into fight.
20. Bug fix: Abnormal attack frequency of Immortal Chickens under certain circumstances.
21. Bug fix: Occasional game freeze during chicken fighting.
22. New: A set of Mind Skills for Wood sets.
23. Adjustment: Super Armor effect of all Bosses in Chi You. Now when a Boss’s accumulated time under control reaches 20s, it will gain a Super Armor for 20s.
24. Bug fix: Buying items in Treasure Pavilion of the Sect would cost Contribution after the player became a Sect Leader.
25. Bug fix: The mission "Yuan'er's Request for Help" could be accepted after the completion of Main Missions.
26. New: Added the item drop from the Main Mission "Xingtian Slayer"
27. Optimization: Some dungeon scenes when fighting bosses in Chi You.

<size=25>[0.8.6001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 22:00 on June 29, 2022
Hello Cultivators, the Reborn and Transcendent version is now officially released! At this stage, only 70% of the text content in the new version has been localized, and it will take approximately 2 weeks for the rest of the text to be fully translated. Of course, we understand that some cultivators who can't wait to experience the new version and intend to use Google Translator on their own, we still suggest that players wait for a few weeks until the English localization is fully completed to maximize your gaming experience~
1. Opened the outer area of Chi You and Tian Yuan Mountain.
2. Opened the Reborn Realm and the Transcendent Realm.
3. Added the function of Nether Feather  (available after breaking through the Reborn Realm).
4. Added new Heavenly Art (available after breaking through the Transcendent Realm).
5. Added the plot and challenge of Shrine, where you can get part of Heavenly Art.
6. Added the Shattered Altar challenge (you can get part of Heavenly Art and props for Rewrite Destiny).
7. Added 33 sets of Traditional Mind Skills.
8. Added the main plot: Xingtian Slayer main story.
9. Added the function of Cultivator Alliance.
10. Added the Wave of Monsters.
11. Added the tavern request of Hua Feng (you can get the breakthrough material or manuals after completion).
12. Added BOSS (Xuan bird, Vermilion Bird, Phoenix, Kun Peng, Roc, Golden Roc, Miemeng, Firefly, Candlelight, Peacock, Blue Bird, Nether Beast, Water God Xuanming, Wood God Goumang, Earth God Houtu, Ferocious Beast, Taotie, Jiuying, Xingtian, Demon, etc.
13. New NPCs of Demon.
14. Added the new Taoist Title.
15. Added new Rewrite Destiny for the new realm(Ghost Slash, Lethal Dance, Win-win, Northland Frost, Mirage Miasma, Fire Star, Conflagration, Universe on Palm).
16. Added a variety of NPC interactive plots (after triggering such a plot in, the NPC will have a unique tie to the player, and this NPC in interaction with the player, will be based on the player's choice and affect its subsequent behavior patterns).
17. Cockfight Chicken is being optimized and is not yet open.
18. Optimized the function of the Bagua Jade.
　Players can give half of the Bagua Jade to NPCs, which can be summoned into the battle to fight together.
　When an NPC with half of a double fish pendant is on the verge of death or Last Breath, players can use the Bagua Jade to revive the NPC (requires 1 point of energy).
19. Added some new BOSS skills of Eye of Providence.
20. Optimized the breakthrough experience in the Qi Condensation and Origin Spirit (new entrusted tasks have been added in the taverns of various towns in Huafeng, and completing the delegated tasks may lead to breakthrough materials and advanced manuals, etc.).
21. Optimized some AI behaviors of NPCs.
22. Optimized the AI of some BOSSes in Chaos mode.
23. Optimized the performance of Motion Skill after the Reborn Realm.
24. Optimized the numerical experience of learning manuals and skill levels.
25. Fixed the problem of incorrect values of some mind skills and affixes in Reborn Realm and the Transcendent Realm.

1. All traditional mind skills from  are changed from 4-piece sets to 6-piece sets. But the number of requirements to trigger the effect of the set remains the same, still 2 and 4 pieces.
2. Fixed the problem that the affix effect (reduce cooldown time) of the traditional mind skill (Jo Set) did not take effect.
3. Fixed the problem that the Advanced Monoliths summoned by the traditional mind skill (Earthquake Set) could not obtain the shocking effect of the traditional mind skill and the affix effect of the Monoliths in other skills.
4. Fixed the problem that the effect of the traditional mind skill (Khayanirodha Set) would take effect on all fire special Skill.
5. Added the function of modifying nether feather after transcendent (the entrance is in the Go Immortal).
6. Fixed the problem that the phrase (Spiritual Heavenly Soaring) of the Plume of the Underworld did not take effect.
7. Adjusted the effect of the affix of the Candlelight (Wind Shadow): 
 The description of the effect before adjustment is: for every 10 damage dealt by the Ethereal Power, it increases its motion skill by 30%, which can be stacked for 3 levels and lasts for 40 seconds. 
 The effect before adjustment is abnormal and does not match the description. The actual effect is: for every 10 damage dealt by Ethereal Power, it increases all damage by 360%, can be stacked for 3 layers (total increase is 1080%), lasts for 4 seconds.

<size=25>【0.8.7001 版本更新内容】</size>2022年10月11日21时更新
1.解锁了神器（炼妖壶），炼妖壶的功能如下。
　在战斗中，可在大妖兽虚弱时打开炼妖壶，有概率将其吸入炼妖壶中炼化成壶妖。
　将任意壶妖设置为护卫后，可在战斗中协助自身进行战斗。
　在战斗中被击败时，被设置为护卫的壶妖会为你抵挡致命攻击，并协助你逃离战斗。
　可派遣壶妖外出历练，历练结束后壶妖可获得修为，并有概率获得额外的道具。
2.深度优化了战斗模块，提升了战斗时的性能表现，使战斗画面更加流畅（对底层进行了优化，可能会出现部分词条效果不正常，有问题请及时反馈给我们）。
3.由于本次更新增加了大量图片资源，会使部分图集内容产生变化，当玩家使用了某些修改了图集的MOD，可能会引起游戏画面混乱，若出现此情况，请取消MOD并耐心等待MOD作者修复。
4.新增了神秘组织奇遇——丹道真意（在永宁州可触发）。
5.新增了部分丹药（千毒香、天罡丸、聚气丹、幻心魔香、魔焰灼腚珠、元阳丹），更多新的丹药将会持续更新。
6.优化了部分丹方的必要材料需求，降低了炼丹的难度。
7.优化了炼丹流程的操作体验，并优化了炼丹熟练度的提升效率、丹药产出权重。
8.新增了逆天改命（悬壶御妖、天级幻灵锅、灵丹妙药、丹精药髓、玉液归元）。
9.优化了部分逆天改命（小宝的盾、中宝的盾、大宝的盾、青帝遗录、剑灵入门、剑灵进阶、剑灵精通、血祭入门、血祭进阶、血祭精通）的效果。
10.新增了2套立绘及部分其它部件。
11.新增了在副本暂停界面可查看大妖兽技能描述的功能。
12.修复了在背包界面打开查看道具详情的界面时，使用快捷键关闭背包界面后，查看道具详情的界面还可以点击操作按钮的问题。
13.修复了绝技灵影指无法触发逆天改命神火天星的问题。
14.优化了宗门藏经阁的秘籍筛选功能，现在能记录筛选偏好。
15.修复了在迷途荒漠与赤幽州区域宗门附近使用道具鬼草赤露时，无法吸引宗门灵兽的问题。

<size=25>[0.8.7001 Patch Notes]</size> Updated at 21:00 on October 11, 2022
1. Unlocked the Mythical Gourd; the function is as follows.
a. During the battle, you can open the Mythical Gourd when the Mythical Beast is weak; there is a probability that it will be devoured into the Mythical Gourd to refine into Imp.
b. After setting any Imp as a guard, it will assist itself in battle.
c. When you are defeated in battle, the Imp set as a guard will defend you from fatal attacks and help you escape from the battle.
d. Imp can be sent out for adventures after the training and will be rewarded with the appropriate props.
2. Deeply optimize the battle module, improve its performance, making it more smooth.
3. Added a new mysterious organization adventure which can be triggered in Yongning.
4. Added some new elixirs and more new elixirs will be updated continuously.
5. Optimized the necessary material requirements for some elixir recipes and reduced the difficulty of alchemy.
6. Optimized the operation experience of the alchemy process and optimized the efficiency of alchemy proficiency and the weight of elixir output.
7. Added new Rewrite Destiny (Mirage Pot II, Mirage Pot I, Incredible Elixirs, and so on).
8. Optimized the effect of some of the Rewrite Destiny (Mysterious Shield I, Mysterious Shield II, Mysterious Shield III, Emperor's Legacy, Spiritual Sword I, Spiritual Sword II, Spiritual Sword III, Blood Claw I, Blood Claw II, Blood Claw III).
9. Added 2 sets ofcharacter paintings and some other accessories.
10. Added the function of viewing the skill description of the Mythical Beas in the pause screen of the dungeon.
11. Fixed the problem that when the backpack interface is opened to view the prop details interface, the prop details interface can still be clicked after using the shortcut key to close the backpack interface.
12. Fixed the problem that the Shadowy Finger could not trigger the Fire Star.
13. Optimized the manual filtering function of the sect's Manual Library and now can record filtering preferences.
14. Fixed the problem that the sect's spiritual beasts could not be attracted when using the prop Ghost Grass Serum near the sect in the Wayward Desert and Chi You.

3. Added new elixirs, which can be unlocked through the plot or in the Master's Recluse Room.
4. Fixed the problem that in some cases after defeating enemies in the Invitation, you may not be able to leave the dungeon properly.
5. Fixed the problem that feeding elixirs to NPCs within certain dungeons would cause the dungeon to end immediately.
6. Fixed the problem that in some cases, the imp could not be summoned normally in the Sect battle.

8. Fixed the problem that the EXP value would become negative when increase your Realm through adventure.

<size=25>【0.8.8001 版本更新内容】</size>2023年2月15日12时更新
1.新增了天元山主线剧情（上古之卦、异律之器、龙眠之屿）。
2.新增了天元山副本（蹈虚之径、妄象镜海、望仙圣台、雾海烟渚、天元之巅、地脉关元）
3.新增了风水图推演、玲珑石盘的玩法（风水图可通过拍卖会、各区域大妖兽掉落等途径获取）。
4.新增了画符玩法及相关符箓道具。
5.新增了系列奇遇任务（符箓奇闻）。可在华封、云陌、暮仙三个区域的各城镇酒馆中接取任务，完成任务可获得画符图谱与画符资质道具。
6.新增了丹药（隐匿丹和逆脉丹）。
7.新增了立绘（燕处超然、景星凤麟、紫璇天韵、素衣授仙、梦中客），在达成对应的结局后解锁，在创建角色时使用了该立绘后，即可选择特殊的先天气运（天翎剑意、分元地火、幽盈碧羽、镇域流沙、剑气纵横）。
8.新增了创建存档时，可修改此存档生成的NPC数量（减少NPC的数量会提升部分性能体验，但NPC的生态活力也可能会减弱）。
9.新增了师徒之间的交互行为（指导与学习）。
10.新增了道侣与夫妻部分互动事件（可劝说对方与他人断绝关系）。
11.新增了父母可感应到子女遇险的功能。
12.新增了宗门中弟子的部分互动事件（可关怀或欺压宗门中的弟子）。
13.新增了与NPC一起探险的互动行为。
14.新增了宗门中大长老及长老NPC的部分互动事件（可向宗主提出额外获得某种宗门资源的提议）。
15.新增了符箓（上古遗迹传送符），玩家可使用此符邀请其他NPC一起进入战斗，可通过风水奇遇事件获得。
16.新增了通关后的生涯记录展示功能（目前旧存档能够展示的内容不多且可能存在误差，后续更新会增加存档可记录的数据并提升数据的准确性，以展示更多的内容）。
17.优化了NPC结成关系的AI，使NPC更主动与他人结成关系。

7. New illustrations (Solitary Skylark, Dark Cynosure, Violet Melody, Immortal In White and Carefree Wanderer) will be unlocked after reaching the specific endings, and you will be able to choose a specific Destiny (Nature)(Empyrean Edge, Scorching Eruption, Verdant Quills, Quicksand, Sword Boost) after using the illustration when creating a character.

16. Players are now able to check the Player Statistics after the ending（Currently the archives of old version can only show limited contents and may inlude mistakes, we will add more contents that can be recorded and improve the accuracy in the future updates)

30. Optimazation: stats info of the Artifact.
31. Bug Fix: wrong dialogue in the Accident of Ugly Taoist.
32. Bug Fix: players fail to breakthrough when triggered the great power transmission accident .
33. Bug Fix: the inconsistent size of some dead normal monsters.
34. Added some of the achievements.
35. Added the function of debugging skills to Mod Maker.

鬼谷工作室致道友：
	在经过将近两年半的开发之后，《鬼谷八荒》这趟修仙之旅在诸位道友的陪伴下，也到了一个新的里程碑。我们后续还会继续优化鬼谷八荒，并新增能被框架包含的新内容，敬请期待！
	这一路走来，是一个个存档角色的突破与修行，也是鬼谷工作室从零到一的突破，从无至有的修行。感谢此刻在屏幕前阅读这封致谢信的每一个你，是道友们的建议、鼓励及鞭策，支持着我们将游戏从抢鲜体验状态一步步完善至正式版。工作室在此，向购买了EA版本的所有玩家表示由衷的感谢。
	大道三千，遁去其一。心中有道者，无处不可悟，无处不可证。《鬼谷八荒》愿抛砖引玉，助道友们踏出这一步，不断追寻心目中理想的修仙世界——得一方天地，证本源本心。
	最后，在各位道友进入游戏前，我们有一则关于【存档】的提醒：
	由于游戏已经经过了多次版本更新，如果您是在游戏上架早期创建的存档，曾经使用过“修改器”、“Mod”等改变存档内容的工具，或曾在游戏运行过程中以强退、S/L等方法多次强行关闭过游戏，将可能会遇到正式版上线后，旧存档无法兼容的情况。如果出现这种情况，我们建议您做如下处理：
	1、如有曾经手动导出保存的存档副本，可以尝试替换导入；
	2、在留言板及创意工坊页面寻找相应工具，或与群友等交流，是否有类似情况曾经得到过解决；
	3、进行新档体验；
	4、将您的旧存档发送至info@lightning.games，工作室将尝试为您修复。
	传送阵法即将启动，预祝您的修行之旅圆满大成。
鬼谷工作室全体
敬上

	這一路走來，是一個個存檔角色的突破與修行，也是鬼谷工作室從零到一的突破，從無至有的修行。感謝此刻在屏幕前閱讀這封致謝信的每一個你，是道友們的建議、鼓勵及鞭策，支持着我們將遊戲從搶鮮體驗狀態一步步完善至正式版。工作室在此，向購買了EA版本的所有玩家表示由衷的感謝。
	大道三千，遁去其一。心中有道者，無處不可悟，無處不可證。《鬼谷八荒》願拋磚引玉，助道友們踏出這一步，不斷追尋心目中理想的修仙世界——得一方天地，證本源本心。
	最後，在各位道友進入遊戲前，我們有一則關於【存檔】的提醒：
	由於遊戲已經經過了多次版本更新，如果您是在遊戲上架早期創建的存檔，曾經使用過「修改器」、「Mod」等改變存檔內容的工具，或曾在遊戲運行過程中以強退、S/L等方法多次強行關閉過遊戲，將可能會遇到正式版上線後，舊存檔無法兼容的情況。如果出現這種情況，我們建議您做如下處理：
