en: I see! I really like fighting, that relaxing fighting!

ch: 那么，仙法和仙力也一并给你吧。
tc: 那麼，仙法和仙力也一併給你吧。
en: Thus, I'll give you both Heavenly Art and Heavenly Power.

ch: 听说玉鸾族的族人都很会音律，不如就让东方茗雪弹弹琴给本王陶冶一番情操。
tc: 聽說玉鸞族的族人都很會音律，不如就讓東方茗雪彈彈琴給本王陶冶一番情操。
en: It’s said that the people of Jade Bird Clan are all born musicians. Bring Dongfang Mingxue here and let her play some pleasant tunes with guqin for me.

ch: 那本王就等你的好消息。
tc: 那本王就等你的好消息。
en: Okay. Wait for your good news.

ch: 本王倒是挺喜欢这个老爷爷的，有一种莫名的亲切感。
tc: 本王倒是挺喜歡這個老爺爺的，有一種莫名的親切感。
en: I am so fond of this elder. He bears a curious sense of amicability.

ch: 本王已将全部仙法都已赠予你。
tc: 本王已將全部仙法都已贈予你。
en: I have bestowed upon you all my Heavenly Arts.

ch: 喏，拿去吧。以后可别再拿小杯子喝酒了！
tc: 喏，拿去吧。以後可別再拿小杯子喝酒了！
en: Here. Don’t drink with tiny cups the next time!
(After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

ch: 我最喜欢瑶姬姐姐了，她那里有好多仙花灵草。
tc: 我最喜歡瑤姬姐姐了，她那裡有好多仙花靈草。
en: I really like Yaoji! She has so many extraordinary plants.

ch: 诶……你刚刚说什么？我在想别的事情。
tc: 誒……你剛剛說什麼？我在想別的事情。
en: Eh... What were you saying? I zoned out just now.
Wow! Your story is so interesting!

ch: 你你……你不可以说我笨！我只有点反应慢而已！但是，玩游戏的话我速度很快的哦。
tc: 你你……你不可以說我笨！我只有點反應慢而已！但是，玩遊戲的話我速度很快的哦。
en: You... You can't say I'm stupid! I'm just a little slow in thinking! However, I will be quick when playing.

ch: 这个嘛……我想一想。嗯嗯！你说得有道理呢。
tc: 這個嘛……我想一想。嗯嗯！你說得有道理呢。
en: Well... Let me think. Yes! You are right.

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
tc: （一道光後，你所供奉之物已然消失。隨後，你身上多了一道仙力的恩賜。）
en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: 你途径一处森林，你感受到了其中深处似乎有仙力的气息。
tc: 你途徑一處森林，你感受到了其中深處似乎有仙力的氣息。
en: You pass by a forest and sense a smell of Heavenly Power coming from its depths.

ch: 你进入了森林深处……突然，有一只似鹿非鹿的生灵靠近了你，并且对你毫无防备。
tc: 你進入了森林深處……突然，有一隻似鹿非鹿的生靈靠近了你，並且對你毫無防備。
en: You're making your way into the depths of the woods when a deer-like creature approaches you, looking friendly.

ch: 它似乎对你颇有好感，与你玩耍了好一阵…突然，生灵身上发出一道光，一位女子出现在你面前。
tc: 它似乎對你頗有好感，與你玩耍了好一陣…突然，生靈身上發出一道光，一位女子出現在你面前。
en: It seems to feel close to you and plays with you for a while... Suddenly, it is shrouded in light, from which appears a woman.

ch: 你非常惊讶，交谈后才得知她就是鹿林溪仙子。她说道：“要与我玩游戏吗？”
tc: 你非常驚訝，交談後才得知她就是鹿林溪仙子。她說道：「要與我玩遊戲嗎？」
en: You're amazed. After talking, you know she is Immortal Lu Linxi. She says, \"Would you like to play together with me?\"

ch: 你看着那双水汪汪的眼睛，实在不忍说出拒绝的话。
tc: 你看著那雙水汪汪的眼睛，實在不忍說出拒絕的話。
en: She looks at you with gleaming eyes. You realize that you are not that cruel to turn her down.

ch: 它见你无意玩耍，便蹦蹦跳跳地准备离开。此时，你施展仙法想捉住它，它呆呆的转过头来望着你，仙法仅穿过它却并未有任何效果。
tc: 它見你無意玩耍，便蹦蹦跳跳地準備離開。此時，你施展仙法想捉住它，它呆呆的轉過頭來望著你，仙法僅穿過它卻並未有任何效果。
en: It finds you have no intention to play with it and is about to hop away. You then cast a Heavenly Art to capture it, and it turns its head and looks at you blankly, but the Heavenly Art fails to take any effect.

ch: 它以为是你在与它玩耍，甚是开心地跳到了你面前。
tc: 它以為是你在與它玩耍，甚是開心地跳到了你面前。
en: It thinks you are playing with it, and it hops back toward you happily.

ch: 林溪温声细语地说道：“只要在规定时间内，抓到我足够次数。我就将仙法给你啦。”
tc: 林溪溫聲細語地說道：「只要在規定時間內，抓到我足夠次數。我就將仙法給你啦。」
en: \"I'll bestow upon you my Heavenly Art if you could catch me enough times in the duration I said.\" Linxi says softly.

ch: 林溪嘻嘻一笑，问你还要不要再玩一次。
tc: 林溪嘻嘻一笑，問你還要不要再玩一次。
en: Linxi giggles and asks whether you want to play with her again.

ch: 好呀，那我以后就不四处游玩了，不然你就找不到我了。我会回到仙祠里，但你要记得经常来找我玩呀~
tc: 好呀，那我以後就不四處遊玩了，不然你就找不到我了。我會回到仙祠里，但你要記得經常來找我玩呀~
en: Okay, I’ll stop wandering in the future, or you will lose the whereabouts of me. I’ll return to the Shrine, and - remember visit me often there!

ch: 林溪温声细语地说道：“只要在规定时间内，抓到我足够次数。我就将仙法给你啦。”
tc: 林溪溫聲細語地說道：「只要在規定時間內，抓到我足夠次數。我就將仙法給你啦。」
en: \"I'll bestow upon you my Heavenly Art if you could catch me enough times in the duration I said.\" Linxi says softly.
Do you want to play something harder?

ch: 哇哦~你真厉害。这个给你……
tc: 哇哦~你真厲害。這個給你……

ch: 林溪嘻嘻一笑，问你还要不要再玩一次。
tc: 林溪嘻嘻一笑，問你還要不要再玩一次。
en: Linxi giggles and asks whether you want to play with her again.

ch: 谢谢你陪我玩，我很开心。
tc: 謝謝你陪我玩，我很開心。
en: Thanks for your company. It’s delightful.

ch: 我现在要出去玩，仙法之事等你遇到我了再说吧。
tc: 我現在要出去玩，仙法之事等你遇到我了再說吧。
en: I'll go outside to play now. For Heavenly Arts, maybe we could talk about them when you encounter me again.
All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you.
(After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

ch: 敢招惹本尊的人都不见了，你猜猜他们都去哪里了？
tc: 敢招惹本尊的人都不見了，你猜猜他們都去哪裡了？
en: Those who crossed me all disappeared. Guess where they went?

ch: 一招制敌，一击必杀。此乃本尊一贯的作风。
tc: 一招制敵，一擊必殺。此乃本尊一貫的作風。
en: Kill at one strike, victory at one stroke. This is my style.

ch: 要么，击败本尊。要么，就接受本尊的惩罚吧。
tc: 要麼，擊敗本尊。要麼，就接受本尊的懲罰吧。
en: Defeat me, or take my punishment.

ch: 不要招惹本尊，否则，后果自负。
tc: 不要招惹本尊，否則，後果自負。
en: Don't cross me, or you'll pay with your life.

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
tc: （一道光後，你所供奉之物已然消失。隨後，你身上多了一道仙力的恩賜。）
en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)
Do you really want to spar with me?

ch: 想要本尊的仙法？先替本尊寻两株{itemLink5031051}来。
tc: 想要本尊的仙法？先替本尊尋兩株{itemLink5031051}來。
en: You want my Heavenly Art? Find 2 {itemLink5031051} for me first.

ch: 你还要再想想？要么，打赢本尊。要么，就乖乖接受本尊的要求。
tc: 你還要再想想？要麼，打贏本尊。要麼，就乖乖接受本尊的要求。
en: You need to think it over? Either you defeat me in a fight, or you accept my requirement.

ch: 本尊要的东西带来了吗？
tc: 本尊要的東西帶來了嗎？
en: Do you find the thing I want?
This is not the thing I want.

ch: 再替本尊寻……不对，本尊好像记错了。
tc: 再替本尊尋……不對，本尊好像記錯了。
en: Find me some... Well, I got it wrong.

ch: 本尊想起来了，应该是要两株{itemLink5031081}。
tc: 本尊想起來了，應該是要兩株{itemLink5031081}。
en: I found it! I need two {itemLink5031081}.
This is not the thing I want.
Where is the {itemLink5031324} I asked for?
This is not the thing I want.

ch: 再替本尊寻……奥，本尊又记错了。
tc: 再替本尊尋……奧，本尊又記錯了。
en: Next, find me some... Well, I got it wrong again.
Do you find the {itemLink5031284} I asked for?
This is not the thing I want.
Where is the {itemLink5031506} I asked for?
This is not the thing I want.
This is not the thing I want.

ch: 还想要本尊的仙法？那就看看你有没有那个本事！
tc: 還想要本尊的仙法？那就看看你有沒有那個本事！
en: You want more Heavenly Arts? Let's see if you are mighty enough to grasp them!

ch: 本尊需要一味玄天碧米，你可有所耳闻？
tc: 本尊需要一味玄天碧米，你可有所耳聞？
en: I need an ingredient called Cerulean Rice. Have you heard of it?

ch: 不错。那奸商，卖的甚是昂贵。本尊看你倒是有些本事，可否能替本尊低价购入？事成以后，本尊不会吝啬报酬的。
tc: 不錯。那奸商，賣的甚是昂貴。本尊看你倒是有些本事，可否能替本尊低價購入？事成以後，本尊不會吝嗇報酬的。
en: Yes. That profiteer sells it at a super high price. You seem to be mighty enough, then could you buy it at a low price for me? I will reward you handsomely.

ch: 本尊只能告诉你，此人名为季沽魂。你若是能从他那里低价购入，再交给本尊，本尊定少不了你的好处。
tc: 本尊只能告訴你，此人名為季沽魂。你若是能從他那裡低價購入，再交給本尊，本尊定少不了你的好處。
en: I could only tell you that, the profiteer is called Ji Guhun. If you could buy it from him at a low price and bring it to me, I will surely get you rewarded.

ch: 既然如此，那你快去快回。
tc: 既然如此，那你快去快回。

ch: 仙法、仙力还有一千灵石都已给你，就不必向本尊言谢了。
tc: 仙法、仙力還有一千靈石都已給你，就不必向本尊言謝了。
en: I have given you the Heavenly Art and Heavenly Power, and 1000 Spirit Stones. No need to thank me.

ch: 这是本尊的一根羽毛，现如今赠于你。
tc: 這是本尊的一根羽毛，現如今贈於你。
en: It’s one of my feathers. Now it is yours.
How dare you keep messing with me?

ch: 你若是无法战胜本尊，可就要从头开始完成本尊的要求哦。桀桀桀……
tc: 你若是無法戰勝本尊，可就要從頭開始完成本尊的要求哦。桀桀桀……
en: If you couldn't defeat me, you will need to try again from the first mission I gave you. *sinister sneer*
Oh? You are not that puny.

ch: 还是乖乖给本尊找材料吧。
tc: 還是乖乖給本尊找材料吧。
en: Fine. Find materials for me, then.

ch: 哼。一把年纪了，还尽整幺蛾子。
tc: 哼。一把年紀了，還盡整么蛾子。
en: Hmph. Sad to see an elder keeps playing tricks.

ch: 不是本尊吹牛，本尊一拳就能打倒他。
tc: 不是本尊吹牛，本尊一拳就能打倒他。
en: I’m not boasting! I can beat him up with one strike of fist!

ch: 哦？这个老东西派你来是吗？
tc: 哦？這個老東西派你來是嗎？
en: Oh? You are sent by the old man?

ch: 哼。你倒是比那个老东西有趣些。
tc: 哼。你倒是比那個老東西有趣些。
en: Hmph. You’re a bit less boring than him.
Hmph. The Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you!

ch: 就在你险些被杀掉之时，传来一声：“手下留人！”话声未落，芦花王飞来，一拳拦下了所有伤害。
tc: 就在你險些被殺掉之時，傳來一聲：「手下留人！」話聲未落，蘆花王飛來，一拳攔下了所有傷害。
en: Just at the critical moment, you hear someone yelling \"Stop!\" Then, you see King Luhua flies toward you, and parries the attack with his wings.

ch: 御鸡天尊你也敢动？看来是想尝尝我拳头的滋味！还不快滚！
tc: 御雞天尊你也敢動？看來是想嘗嘗我拳頭的滋味！還不快滾！
en: Do you know the person is the Chicken Deity? Want to be hit by my fist? Get out of my sight!

ch: 喏，这只小鸡崽子送你了。
tc: 喏，這隻小雞崽子送你了。

en: (After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

ch: 只要给我足够的报酬，我便能满足你的任何心愿。
tc: 只要給我足夠的報酬，我便能滿足你的任何心願。
en: I can make any wish come true as long as you pay the price.

ch: 我憎恶言而无信，倘若你有一日也如此，那么就别怪我不择手段。
tc: 我憎惡言而無信，倘若你有一日也如此，那麼就別怪我不擇手段。
en: I hate slander and dishonesty. If you should commit such a sin, I'll do whatever I can to ensure your downfall.

ch: 拥有足够实力，才有拒绝的资格。
tc: 擁有足夠實力，才有拒絕的資格。
en: Only those with power have the right to say no.

ch: 总有些人喜欢自作聪明，以为自己的小把戏不会被我发现。
tc: 總有些人喜歡自作聰明，以為自己的小把戲不會被我發現。
en: There are always some smart alecks who think they can get away with their shabby tricks.

ch: 缘分……谁说缘分是不可以买到？
tc: 緣分……誰說緣分是不可以買到？
en: Destiny... Who said our destinies are not made for sale?

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
tc: （一道光後，你所供奉之物已然消失。隨後，你身上多了一道仙力的恩賜。）
en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

ch: 你若是同我做交易，我倒是愿意与你聊上几句。
tc: 你若是同我做交易，我倒是願意與你聊上幾句。
en: If you want to trade with me, I could also chat with you for a while.
Ten manuals for supreme Martial Arts. No bargaining.

ch: 你只需要将自己的顶级功法都交予我，我便会给予你仙晶，只有仙晶可以从我这里买到东西，你们的灵石对于我而言可没有用处。希望你可以从我这里找到想要的东西。
tc: 你只需要將自己的頂級功法都交予我，我便會給予你仙晶，只有仙晶可以從我這裡買到東西，你們的靈石對於我而言可沒有用處。希望你可以從我這裡找到想要的東西。
en: You only need to give all of your supreme Martial Arts to me in exchange for Heavenly Crystals. Here, I accept only those Crystals, and the Spirit Stones circulated among you are of no use to me. I hope you could find something you want in my store.

ch: 这是我要的东西吗？你可别想耍手段。
tc: 這是我要的東西嗎？你可別想耍手段。
en: You think it is the one I want? Don’t cheat me, please.

ch: 不必心急，待到有缘之日仙法自是会到你面前。
tc: 不必心急，待到有緣之日仙法自是會到你面前。
en: Don't be haste. The Heavenly Art will find you when your destiny allows.

ch: 看在你如此照顾我的生意的份上，那便赠你一枚仙石碎片。
tc: 看在你如此照顧我的生意的份上，那便贈你一枚仙石碎片。
en: I often see you patronizing my store. Here, take this Shard of Heavenly Stone as a gift.

ch: 凡事都可以，但是得付些报酬。既然都活了如此之久，想必好宝贝不少吧。
tc: 凡事都可以，但是得付些報酬。既然都活了如此之久，想必好寶貝不少吧。
en: Everything is smooth once it’s paid well. There must be many treasures in the hands of such a long-living person.

ch: 既然是我的顾客，你想要的仙法，自然会给你。
tc: 既然是我的顧客，你想要的仙法，自然會給你。
en: You are my customer, and I'll give you the Heavenly Art you want.

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: 我已将仙法给你了，不如去我的店里看看别的。
tc: 我已將仙法給你了，不如去我的店裡看看別的。
en: I've sold you my Heavenly Arts. Perhaps there are goods you need in my store.
(After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

ch: 想要得到仙法的话，那就先击败我的三成功力吧。
tc: 想要得到仙法的話，那就先擊敗我的三成功力吧。
en: Defeat 30% of my power first if you want my Heavenly Art.

ch: 热爱之事，永远不会放弃！
tc: 熱愛之事，永遠不會放棄！
en: It's the passion of my life!

ch: 凡事都祸福相依，虽然我是玉鸾族唯一不会音律的，但这也成为了我的杀手锏。
tc: 凡事都禍福相依，雖然我是玉鸞族唯一不會音律的，但這也成為了我的殺手鐧。
en: Every cloud has a silver lining. Though I'm the only one in the Jade Bird Clan that is tone-deaf, it has become my trump-card.

ch: 任何强者，在我绝对的速度下都无法抵抗。
tc: 任何強者，在我絕對的速度下都無法抵抗。
en: No one, however strong they are, is a rival for my speed.

ch: 小沐晴真可爱，与众不同的可爱！当然，你也可爱。
tc: 小沐晴真可愛，與眾不同的可愛！當然，你也可愛。
en: Muqing is so cute! So uniquely cute! Of course you are cute too.

ch: 我也曾为自己的不一样而感到自卑，但后来我想明白了，这正是我的特点。
tc: 我也曾為自己的不一樣而感到自卑，但後來我想明白了，這正是我的特點。
en: I used to feel inferior for being different, but I later came around and see it as my feature.

ch: 这八荒界似乎有我玉鸾族人的气息。
tc: 這八荒界似乎有我玉鸞族人的氣息。
en: I feel the existence of our Jade Bird Clan member here.

ch: 咦？你身上有小沐晴的气息，你为何把她藏起来了。
tc: 咦？你身上有小沐晴的氣息，你為何把她藏起來了。
en: Hm? I seem to find Muqing here, just around you. Do you hide her from me?

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
tc: （一道光後，你所供奉之物已然消失。隨後，你身上多了一道仙力的恩賜。）
en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: 想要我使出几成功力呢？
tc: 想要我使出幾成功力呢？
en: How much power do you want me to use?

ch: 战胜我的三成功力，就将仙法给你。
tc: 戰勝我的三成功力，就將仙法給你。
en: I'll give you my Heavenly Art if you defeat 30% of my power.

ch: 你获得仙法后，沐晴好像突然感受到了什么，向你吵着闹着非要见此人：“茗雪是我们玉鸾族最厉害的将士了！沐晴小时候听过好多关于她上阵杀敌的故事呢，就让人家见见她嘛。”
tc: 你獲得仙法後，沐晴好像突然感受到了什麼，向你吵著鬧著非要見此人：「茗雪是我們玉鸞族最厲害的將士了！沐晴小時候聽過好多關於她上陣殺敵的故事呢，就讓人家見見她嘛。」
en: After you obtained the Heavenly Art, Muqing seems to feel something and insists on meeting this person, \"Mingxue is the best warrior in our Jade Bird Clan! I've heard so many of her war legends since I was a child! Let me meet her!\"

ch: 一道光后，茗雪出现在你和沐晴面前，沐晴叽叽喳喳的说了许多。她听着沐晴的话，面容也缓和了不少。
tc: 一道光後，茗雪出現在你和沐晴面前，沐晴嘰嘰喳喳的說了許多。她聽著沐晴的話，面容也緩和了不少。
en: After a flash of light, Mingxue appears before you and Muqing. Muqing chatters to her happily, and hearing the words of Muqing, Mingxue’s expression softens.

ch: 再跟我过两招，胜过我的话就把仙法给你~
tc: 再跟我過兩招，勝過我的話就把仙法給你~
en: Fight me again, and I'll give you my Heavenly Art if you win.
Yeah... You are not that powerless.

ch: 你看到茗雪在努力的练习歌唱，可惜实在不堪入耳。
tc: 你看到茗雪在努力的練習歌唱，可惜實在不堪入耳。
en: You see Mingxue working hard practicing singing, but it's too harsh to any ears.

ch: 你又看到茗雪在努力的练习歌唱，可惜依旧那么不堪入耳。
tc: 你又看到茗雪在努力的練習歌唱，可惜依舊那麼不堪入耳。
en: You see Mingxue working hard practicing singing again, but it's still too harsh to any ears.

ch: 你又看到茗雪在努力的练习歌唱，可是这次茗雪发现了你。她嗔怒的让你快些离开，你便赶紧走了。走时余光发现她耳朵有些红红的，似乎是很不好意思。
tc: 你又看到茗雪在努力的練習歌唱，可是這次茗雪發現了你。她嗔怒的讓你快些離開，你便趕緊走了。走時餘光發現她耳朵有些紅紅的，似乎是很不好意思。
en: You see Mingxue working hard practicing singing again, but she sees you this time. She is a little upset and urges you to leave her alone. You take your leave and notice her red ears. She seems a little embarrassed.

ch: 你要是每月都让可爱的小沐晴教我音律，一年以后我就给你仙法！
tc: 你要是每月都讓可愛的小沐晴教我音律，一年以後我就給你仙法！
en: If you allow little Muqing to teach me music, I'll give you my Heavenly Art after one year!

ch: 好呢，那以后每月的月末我会过来找你和小沐晴。
tc: 好呢，那以後每月的月末我會過來找你和小沐晴。
en: Okay. I’ll visit you two at the end of every month.

ch: 沐晴拿出自己最爱的陶埙，却发现茗雪完全听不懂沐晴所讲的东西，只好又从基础的音律开始。
tc: 沐晴拿出自己最愛的陶塤，卻發現茗雪完全聽不懂沐晴所講的東西，只好又從基礎的音律開始。
en: Muqing takes out her most cherished xun, and begins her lessons. But Mingxue finds them too hard to grasp, then Muqing could only start from the ABC of music.

ch: 沐晴教习音律第一月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴教習音律第一月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the first month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴教习音律第二月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴教習音律第二月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the second month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴教习音律第三月，茗雪一无所获，但你学会了。
tc: 沐晴教習音律第三月，茗雪一無所獲，但你學會了。
en: It's the third month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress. But you have made some progress.

ch: 沐晴和你一起教习音律第一月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴和你一起教習音律第一月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the first month Muqing and you give a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴和你一起教习音律第二月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴和你一起教習音律第二月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the second month Muqing and you give a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴和你一起教习音律第三月，茗雪一无所获，她决定放弃音律，想直接学习弹琴。
tc: 沐晴和你一起教習音律第三月，茗雪一無所獲，她決定放棄音律，想直接學習彈琴。
en: It's the third month Muqing and you give a lesson about the ABC of music, and Mingxue has made no progress. Then she decides to give up learning the theory and wants to learn the guqin right away.

ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第一月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴教習彈琴第一月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the first month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第二月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴教習彈琴第二月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the second month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第三月，茗雪一无所获。
tc: 沐晴教習彈琴第三月，茗雪一無所獲。
en: It's the third month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress.

ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第四月，茗雪一无所获，但她觉得自己有些长进。
tc: 沐晴教習彈琴第四月，茗雪一無所獲，但她覺得自己有些長進。
en: It's the fourth month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress, but she feels she has.

ch: 沐晴教习弹琴第五月，茗雪一无所获还把琴弄坏了，但她觉得自己已经学会了。
tc: 沐晴教習彈琴第五月，茗雪一無所獲還把琴弄壞了，但她覺得自己已經學會了。
en: It's the fifth month Muqing gives a lesson about the ABC of guqin, and Mingxue has made no progress except for how to break the instrument up, but she feels she has mastered it.

ch: 我可是很守约的哦，仙法就给你啦。
tc: 我可是很守約的哦，仙法就給你啦。
en: I never go back on my words. This Heavenly Art is yours now.

ch: 哦？她何时也有这般闲情逸致了。
tc: 哦？她何時也有這般閒情逸緻了。
en: Well? Is she so leisurely recently?

ch: 可是，我没有琴啊。小沐晴呢？她应该可以制作一把琴。
tc: 可是，我沒有琴啊。小沐晴呢？她應該可以製作一把琴。
en: But I don’t have a guqin. Where is Muqing? She could make one.

ch: 沐晴睁着圆圆的眼睛，告诉你们当然可以。不过需要7根{itemLink5301102}哦。还有奥，你找到材料以后，记得把我所待着的法宝装备着哦。
tc: 沐晴睜著圓圓的眼睛，告訴你們當然可以。不過需要7根{itemLink5301102}哦。還有奧，你找到材料以後，記得把我所待著的法寶裝備著哦。
en: Muqing's eyes widen. She says she could certainly make a guqin, but she needs 7 {itemLink5301102}. She also reminds you to equip yourself with the Artifact she resides in after you find the material.

ch: 你把材料拿出来交到沐晴手上，沐晴东敲敲西锤锤的，折腾了许久才完成。
tc: 你把材料拿出來交到沐晴手上，沐晴東敲敲西錘錘的，折騰了許久才完成。
en: You gather the materials up and hand them to Muqing. Muqing then crafts a guqin after many times of hammering and chiseling.

ch: 茗雪拿着琴就冲到了沧泷面前，开始弹琴。
tc: 茗雪拿著琴就衝到了滄瀧面前，開始彈琴。
en: Mingxue rushes to Canglong with the guqin in hands and starts playing.

ch: 然而，结局如你所预料的那般，不堪入耳。沧泷一脸呆滞地看着茗雪。
tc: 然而，結局如你所預料的那般，不堪入耳。滄瀧一臉呆滯地看著茗雪。
en: However, as you expected, the tune is too harsh to any ears. Canglong gazes at Mingxue blankly.

ch: 茗雪弹了整整五个时辰，沧泷也保持整整五个时辰的一脸呆滞。
tc: 茗雪彈了整整五個時辰，滄瀧也保持整整五個時辰的一臉呆滯。
en: Mingxue plays for ten full hours, and Canglong keeps being dazed during that time.

ch: 哼！！！真是对牛弹琴，气煞我也！
tc: 哼！！！真是對牛彈琴，氣煞我也！
en: What!!! The tune is beyond anyone's understanding!

ch: 可是，我没有琴啊。玉鸾族之人在儿时都会上一门制作乐器的课，奈何我实在没有天赋。
tc: 可是，我沒有琴啊。玉鸞族之人在兒時都會上一門製作樂器的課，奈何我實在沒有天賦。
en: But I don’t have a guqin. All members in our clan should attend a course on how to make musical instruments when we were children, though I truly know nothing about music.

ch: 咦？！可爱的沐晴~看来她可以帮我做把琴！
tc: 咦？！可愛的沐晴~看來她可以幫我做把琴！
en: Oh, lovely Muqing! Maybe she could make a guqin for me!

ch: 你，过来。让我发泄一下怒火！
tc: 你，過來。讓我發泄一下怒火！
en: You, come here. I’ll unleash my wrath upon you.

ch: 哼。这还差不多。仙法就给你了。
tc: 哼。這還差不多。仙法就給你了。
en: Hmph. Good. The Heavenly Art is yours now.

ch: 哦？正好能给我找些事做，我最近可太无聊了。
tc: 哦？正好能給我找些事做，我最近可太無聊了。
en: Oh? It’ll be a chance for me to kill time. I’m so bored these days.
All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you.

ch: 既然如此，那就送给你个笛子吧。没事，不用过于感谢我，我做了好几百个笛子呢。
tc: 既然如此，那就送給你個笛子吧。沒事，不用過於感謝我，我做了好幾百個笛子呢。
en: Thus, take this flute as my gift. No need to thank me! I have made hundreds of them.
(After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

ch: 我近些时日有些忙碌呢。
tc: 我近些時日有些忙碌呢。
en: I’m a bit busy these days.

ch: 什么？你问我是什么仙。这个嘛……我还有要事，改日再告知于你。
tc: 什麼？你問我是什麼仙。這個嘛……我還有要事，改日再告知於你。
en: What? You wonder what immortal I am? Well... I’m busy dealing with a critical matter now, and I’ll tell you that someday.

ch: 你这人，还真是！若是让你知道了本仙子的名字，岂不是就会被你一直缠着索要仙法，本仙可不会告知于你。
tc: 你這人，還真是！若是讓你知道了本仙子的名字，豈不是就會被你一直纏著索要仙法，本仙可不會告知於你。
en: What a naughty person! If you know my name, you'll keep bothering me for my Heavenly Arts! So I certainly won't tell you that.

ch: 我同你讲，有颗药灵精他满嘴谎言，你若是遇到了可千万别信他一句话。
tc: 我同你講，有顆藥靈精他滿嘴謊言，你若是遇到了可千萬別信他一句話。
en: Mind you, there is a Mushroom Man who tells lies all the time. Don't trust anything he says.

ch: 我可不是无所事事的，其实我肩负着很重要的责任！
tc: 我可不是無所事事的，其實我肩負著很重要的責任！
en: I'm not idling around. I have a very sacred duty to fulfill!

ch: 可算有些闲暇时间了，前些时日可真是忙死本仙子了。
tc: 可算有些閒暇時間了，前些時日可真是忙死本仙子了。
en: Finally, all my businesses are settled. I was buried with all sorts of matters days ago.

ch: 平时本仙子有诸多事务，所以只有每年只有十二月份才有些许闲暇。
tc: 平時本仙子有諸多事務，所以只有每年只有十二月份才有些許閒暇。
en: I'm occupied most of the time, and I can only find time in December every year.

ch: 凡人们对本仙子可是非常崇拜的呢。
tc: 凡人們對本仙子可是非常崇拜的呢。
en: All the mortals worship me devoutly!

ch: 那颗药灵精真是口无遮拦。
tc: 那顆藥靈精真是口無遮攔。
en: That Mushroom Man is so loose-lipped.

ch: 我近些时日有些忙碌呢。
tc: 我近些時日有些忙碌呢。
en: I’m a bit busy these days.

ch: 我可不是无所事事的，其实我肩负着很重要的责任！
tc: 我可不是無所事事的，其實我肩負著很重要的責任！
en: I'm not idling around. I have a very sacred duty to fulfill!

ch: 可算有些闲暇时间了，前些时日可真是忙死本仙子了。
tc: 可算有些閒暇時間了，前些時日可真是忙死本仙子了。
en: Finally, all my businesses are settled. I was buried with all sorts of matters days ago.

ch: 平时本仙子有诸多事务，所以只有每年只有十二月份才有些许闲暇。
tc: 平時本仙子有諸多事務，所以只有每年只有十二月份才有些許閒暇。
en: I'm occupied most of the time, and I can only find time in December every year.

tc: 凡人們對本仙子可是非常崇拜的呢。
en: All the mortals worship me devoutly!

ch: 那颗药灵精真是口无遮拦。
tc: 那顆藥靈精真是口無遮攔。
en: That Mushroom Man is so loose-lipped.

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
tc: （一道光後，你所供奉之物已然消失。隨後，你身上多了一道仙力的恩賜。）
en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

ch: 咦，你这法宝总竟还有器灵的存在。如此宝物，本仙子还未曾见过呢。
tc: 咦，你這法寶總竟還有器靈的存在。如此寶物，本仙子還未曾見過呢。
en: Well, there is a spirit in your Artifact. I have never seen this treasure before.

ch: 本仙子事务繁多，此处只是本仙子的一介分身。若想向本仙子祈愿，等到每年十二月吧，届时我会有几缕神识寄分身之上。
tc: 本仙子事務繁多，此處只是本仙子的一介分身。若想向本仙子祈願，等到每年十二月吧，屆時我會有幾縷神識寄分身之上。
en: I'm a busy Immortal, and this is only one of my many clones. If you want to make a wish, come back in December every year. I will leave some of my focus on this clone then.

ch: 由于你并不知道此仙的名，你只好驱动念力称呼其为上仙，但似乎仙像并无任何反应。或许可以同其他仙人闲聊时旁敲侧击一番，知道其名字时就会有回应了。
tc: 由於你並不知道此仙的名，你只好驅動念力稱呼其為上仙，但似乎仙像並無任何反應。或許可以同其他仙人閒聊時旁敲側擊一番，知道其名字時就會有回應了。
en: Because you don’t know her name, you could only apply your Focus to communicate with her and address her as Your Immortal. However, the statue gives no reaction. Maybe you could ask about the name when you’re chatting with other immortals, and maybe the Immortal before you would respond once she hears her true name.

ch: 你想起曾经在蔽日仙菌口中得知的“紫姑”之名， 你便试着呼唤了一声。
tc: 你想起曾經在蔽日仙菌口中得知的「紫姑」之名， 你便試著呼喚了一聲。
en: Suddenly, a name you’ve heard of from the Sun Blocking Heavenly Mushroom occurs to you. You try to call her as \"Zigu\".

ch: 你如何得知了本仙子的名号的？！！
tc: 你如何得知了本仙子的名號的？！！
en: How did you know my name?!

ch: 哼。你不必说我也知道定然是那个老头子。
tc: 哼。你不必說我也知道定然是那個老頭子。
en: Hmph. You see? I guess it was him, and I’m true.

ch: 真是糟心。本仙子平日如此繁忙，好不容易有些闲暇可以作画。
tc: 真是糟心。本仙子平日如此繁忙，好不容易有些閒暇可以作畫。
en: It’s so annoying. I am busy everyday and could hardly find some time for painting.

ch: 行吧，既然你能机缘巧合得知本仙子的名号，不如你来当本仙子的作画模特。
tc: 行吧，既然你能機緣巧合得知本仙子的名號，不如你來當本仙子的作畫模特。
en: Fine. Now that you know my name by chance, you could act as my model to be painted down.

ch: 嗯？那日后可就没机会得到本仙子的仙法了哦。
tc: 嗯？那日後可就沒機會得到本仙子的仙法了哦。
en: Eh? If you decline, I wouldn't give you my Heavenly Art in the future.

ch: 你按照紫姑仙子的要求，摆出各种姿势让她作画。
tc: 你按照紫姑仙子的要求，擺出各種姿勢讓她作畫。
en: You make a variety of postures for her according to her requirements.

ch: 本仙子还要把画裱起来，你且先回去吧。仙法就给你了。
tc: 本仙子還要把畫裱起來，你且先回去吧。仙法就給你了。
en: I am going to frame up the painting. You could go back. The Heavenly Art is given to you.

ch: 哦？看来你对本仙子的画技非常认可。
tc: 哦？看來你對本仙子的畫技非常認可。
en: Oh? You found my painting beautiful?

ch: 若要本仙子帮你，也不是不可以。只是……
tc: 若要本仙子幫你，也不是不可以。只是……
en: Surely, I would not decline to help you. But...

ch: 本仙子缺一钟颜料，需要大量的{itemLink5341201}研磨而成。
tc: 本仙子缺一鍾顏料，需要大量的{itemLink5341201}研磨而成。
en: I have run out of a kind of pigment. It is made from lots of {itemLink5341201}.

ch: 如果你能带来20个{itemLink5341201}，那么本仙子可以答应你的请求。日后闲暇之余，可以帮你作画。
tc: 如果你能帶來20個{itemLink5341201}，那麼本仙子可以答應你的請求。日後閒暇之餘，可以幫你作畫。
en: If you could bring 20 {itemLink5341201} to me, I'll undertake your commission. When I'm idle, I could paint for you.

ch: 只见紫姑仙子将材料收下后，一顿研磨。然后拿起画笔，唰唰就画完了。
tc: 只見紫姑仙子將材料收下後，一頓研磨。然後拿起畫筆，唰唰就畫完了。
en: Immortal Zigu fills the material into the mortar and grinds them for a long time. Then, she takes her brush and finishes the painting in just a few minutes.

ch: 这可不是本仙子需要的。
tc: 這可不是本仙子需要的。
en: That’s not what I’ve asked for.

ch: 那你可得快些哦。不然再想见到本仙子，就是明年了。
tc: 那你可得快些哦。不然再想見到本仙子，就是明年了。
en: Hurry up then. Or you could see me only in the next year.

ch: 当然可以，但是本仙子只会帮你画一幅哦。
tc: 當然可以，但是本仙子只會幫你畫一幅哦。
en: Surely. But I will only paint for you once.

ch: 需要本仙子帮你画一副与器灵的画像吗？
tc: 需要本仙子幫你畫一副與器靈的畫像嗎？
en: Do you need a portrait of you and your Artifact Spirit?

ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
tc: 紫姑仙子寥寥幾筆，就畫完了一幅畫。
en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

ch: 你想与谁同在一幅画内？
tc: 你想與誰同在一幅畫內？
en: Who would you like to put at your side in the painting?

ch: 紫姑仙子寥寥几笔，就画完了一幅画。
tc: 紫姑仙子寥寥幾筆，就畫完了一幅畫。
en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

tc: 紫姑仙子寥寥幾筆，就畫完了一幅畫。
en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

tc: 紫姑仙子寥寥幾筆，就畫完了一幅畫。
en: Immortal Zigu finishes a painting with just a few strokes.

ch: 都行，都行。不过本仙子没时间就是了。
tc: 都行，都行。不過本仙子沒時間就是了。
en: All right. But you know I’m very busy.

ch: 本仙子的仙法已赐予你，好不容易有些闲暇，就不要再来扰我清净了，当然闲聊的话是可以的。
tc: 本仙子的仙法已賜予你，好不容易有些閒暇，就不要再來擾我清淨了，當然閒聊的話是可以的。
en: All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you. I could hardly be idle like now, why do you come here to bother me? Well, if you just want to chat, then go ahead.
(After infusing Heavenly Power, you intend to...)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: 一剑破开仙门，踏于九重云霄之上。
tc: 一劍破開仙門，踏於九重雲霄之上。
en: I broke the gate to the Heavenly Realm with one slash and rose above the clouds.

ch: 多少次面对冷眼与嘲笑，我仍未放弃剑修之路。
tc: 多少次面對冷眼與嘲笑，我仍未放棄劍修之路。
en: I met endless sneers and contempt, but I never gave up my path of sword.

ch: 我今日要练剑，有何事下次再同我讲。
tc: 我今日要練劍，有何事下次再同我講。
en: I must practice sword today. Come back another day.

ch: 我生来便是凡人，但凡人亦能逆天改命！
tc: 我生來便是凡人，但凡人亦能逆天改命！
en: I was born a mortal, but a mortal can also rewrite their destiny!

ch: 若我在八荒界，定要与八荒第一剑修、刀修、火修……好好打一场。
tc: 若我在八荒界，定要與八荒第一劍修、刀修、火修……好好打一場。
en: If I were here, I would be glad to duel with all No. 1 Cultivators in this world.

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)
How much power do you want me to use?

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （一道光后，你所供奉之物已然消失。随后，你身上多了一道仙力的恩赐。）
tc: （一道光後，你所供奉之物已然消失。隨後，你身上多了一道仙力的恩賜。）
en: (After a flash of light, your sacrifices are gone. You find a blessing of Heavenly Power is bestowed upon you.)

ch: （仙像闪过了一丝光，但并未有其他反应。）
tc: （仙像閃過了一絲光，但並未有其他反應。）
en: (A beam of light flashes by the Immortal's statue, but there is no other reaction.)

ch: （你试图进入此地，但被仙力拦住。）
tc: （你試圖進入此地，但被仙力攔住。）
en: (You try to go inside but are stopped by Heavenly Power.)

ch: （你试图进入此地，但那个一团剑气让迷雾突然散开。）
tc: （你試圖進入此地，但那個一團劍氣讓迷霧突然散開。）
en: (You try to go inside, but that aura of sword suddenly dissipates the mist.)

ch: 站住，我已无法抑制心中的杀意，遇见我算你倒霉！受死吧！
tc: 站住，我已無法抑制心中的殺意，遇見我算你倒霉！受死吧！
en: Halt. I'm gonna kill someone today! Too bad it's got to be you!

ch: 前辈，{itemLink7000305}乃我最珍贵的东西，还请前辈在收下后饶我一条性命…
tc: 前輩，{itemLink7000305}乃我最珍貴的東西，還請前輩在收下後饒我一條性命…
en: I have a treasure, this {itemLink7000305}! Please take it and spare my life...
... In that case, I'll be going.

ch: 当你翻到最后一页时，竟掉落出一块剑碎。
tc: 當你翻到最後一頁時，竟掉落出一塊劍碎。
en: You turn to the last page, from which drops a sword fragment.
Are you going to comprehend the stele of sword?

ch: 你似乎对剑的理解更深刻了。
tc: 你似乎對劍的理解更深刻了。
en: You seem to have acquired more understanding of sword.

ch: 你似乎什么也没有感悟到，或许先前那位道友所言的一年只能参悟一次乃事实。
tc: 你似乎什麼也沒有感悟到，或許先前那位道友所言的一年只能參悟一次乃事實。
en: You seem to have comprehended nothing. The cultivator told to you the stele could only be comprehended once a year - perhaps it's true.

ch: 你似乎什么也没有感悟到，或许在{itemLink7000305}或{itemLink7000306}里有参悟剑碑的奥秘。
tc: 你似乎什麼也沒有感悟到，或許在{itemLink7000305}或{itemLink7000306}里有參悟劍碑的奧秘。
en: You try to comprehend it, but find nothing. Perhaps you could learn about the key to understand its inscription from {itemLink7000305} or {itemLink7000306}.

ch: 想不到我找了这么久的{itemLink7000305}竟然在你身上。赶紧给我交出来！
tc: 想不到我找了這麼久的{itemLink7000305}竟然在你身上。趕緊給我交出來！
en: I have been looking for this {itemLink7000305} for a long time! Give it to me!

ch: 想必你很想要这{itemLink7000306}吧。赶紧放了我，否则我就把它毁掉！
tc: 想必你很想要這{itemLink7000306}吧。趕緊放了我，否則我就把它毀掉！
en: You must want this {itemLink7000306} badly. Let me go, or I'll destroy it!

ch: 哼！我都还没仔细琢磨琢磨就给你抢走了，卑鄙！
tc: 哼！我都還沒仔細琢磨琢磨就給你搶走了，卑鄙！
en: Hmph! I haven't had enough time to study it yet! You villain!
My friend, why are you still here?

ch: 仙盟附近有一剑碑，只有登仙境之人才可接近，每年可参悟一次，参悟成功能获得剑资质增长。传闻，与一上古大能有关！
tc: 仙盟附近有一劍碑，只有登仙境之人才可接近，每年可參悟一次，參悟成功能獲得劍資質增長。傳聞，與一上古大能有關！
en: There is a stele of sword near the Alliance. Only those of the Transcendent Realm can get near it, and it can be comprehended once a year. Those who manage to comprehend it will receive a bonus on Sword. According to the legend, the stele's power comes from a master cultivator centuries ago!

ch: 在下方才也去参悟了一番，奈何并无所获。你若是感兴趣，就也去试试吧。
tc: 在下方才也去參悟了一番，奈何並無所獲。你若是感興趣，就也去試試吧。
en: I tried to comprehend it just now but failed. If you are interested, you may give it a try.

ch: 无妨。待你日后感兴趣了，也可以再去尝试一番。
tc: 無妨。待你日後感興趣了，也可以再去嘗試一番。
en: That's all right. You may come back again in the future.

ch: 你来剑碑之处，周围人群熙熙攘攘，随着最后一人的失败，大家也都悻悻离去。
tc: 你來劍碑之處，周圍人群熙熙攘攘，隨著最後一人的失敗，大家也都悻悻離去。
en: You arrive at the stele of sword and find a crowd of people gathering around it. With the failure of the last one, they are leaving in dismay.

ch: 你走至剑碑面前，探出神识想试探一下。那块剑碎竟直接飞了进去。
tc: 你走至劍碑面前，探出神識想試探一下。那塊劍碎竟直接飛了進去。
en: You walk over to the stele of sword and activate your focus to attempt it. To your surprise, that sword fragment flies straight into it.
Suddenly, a beam of golden light bursts out of it.

ch: 你被卷入了一个莫名的空间，你向着光的方向前行。
tc: 你被捲入了一個莫名的空間，你向著光的方向前行。
en: You are dragged into a mysterious space, and you have no choice but to walk toward the light source.

ch: 两侧的墙壁上皆是一名男子练剑的幻象。
tc: 兩側的牆壁上皆是一名男子練劍的幻象。
en: On the walls on the two sides are the phantoms of a man practicing sword.

ch: 你一路向前走，但那名男子练剑的幻象似乎不停的出现在你的脑海中。你觉得此人似乎正是之前那本书里的剑修。
tc: 你一路向前走，但那名男子練劍的幻象似乎不停的出現在你的腦海中。你覺得此人似乎正是之前那本書里的劍修。
en: You keep walking and can't help thinking about the phantoms of the swordsman. You feel it must be the sword cultivator in that book.

ch: 走到路的尽头，是一处石桌。桌上有两本略有残损的密卷，似乎是{itemLink7000305}的其他残本。
tc: 走到路的盡頭，是一處石桌。桌上有兩本略有殘損的密卷，似乎是{itemLink7000305}的其他殘本。
en: At the end of the path is a stone table, on which sit two slightly damaged books. They seem to be the other volumes of {itemLink7000305}.

ch: 你读完这四本残卷后，突然有一团剑气围绕着你。似乎这团剑气与那座被迷雾掩盖住的仙祠，气息十分相似，你内心若有所思。
tc: 你讀完這四本殘卷後，突然有一團劍氣圍繞著你。似乎這團劍氣與那座被迷霧掩蓋住的仙祠，氣息十分相似，你內心若有所思。
en: After reading the four volumes, a swordsman's aura appears around you. You find the aura is somewhat similar to the shrine shrouded in mists, and you are occupied by some inexplicable thoughts.

ch: 你又一次被卷入到了这个奇异的空间里，与之前不同的是挂着那副你所寻到的画。而你没有想到的是，剑一正在此地练剑。
tc: 你又一次被捲入到了這個奇異的空間裡，與之前不同的是掛著那副你所尋到的畫。而你沒有想到的是，劍一正在此地練劍。
en: You are dragged into this strange space again. But this time, the painting you are looking for is hung right here. To your surprise, Jianyi is practicing sword here.

ch: 看来你已经知道了我的所有故事。
tc: 看來你已經知道了我的所有故事。
en: So you have heard about all my stories.

ch: 我知道你前来所为何事。拿去吧
tc: 我知道你前來所為何事。拿去吧
en: I know why you come here. Take it.

ch: （这道剑气与似乎某个建筑有关，不如前去探探？）
tc: （這道劍氣與似乎某個建築有關，不如前去探探？）
en: (This sword aura seems to come from a building. Go there for investigation?)

ch: 你若能战斗我的一成功力，仙法便归你所有。
tc: 你若能戰鬥我的一成功力，仙法便歸你所有。
en: If you can defeat 10% of my power, my Heavenly Art will be yours.

ch: 我的仙法并非何人都能得到，你若是还未积攒够实力，可去其他仙祠看看，有些仙人无需战斗也可获得仙法的恩赐。
tc: 我的仙法並非何人都能得到，你若是還未積攢夠實力，可去其他仙祠看看，有些仙人無需戰鬥也可獲得仙法的恩賜。
en: My Heavenly Arts are not bestowed upon everyone. If you're not powerful enough to obtain them, you could visit other Immortal Shrines - some immortals are willing to give you their Heavenly Arts without fighting.

ch: 你倒是有些意思，可否要再与我过上两招？
tc: 你倒是有些意思，可否要再與我過上兩招？
en: You look interesting. Do you want to fight me?

ch: 你认为练剑的哪个境界最强？
tc: 你認為練劍的哪個境界最強？
en: Which do you think is the top realm of swordsmanship?

ch: 你再回去好好琢磨一番。
tc: 你再回去好好琢磨一番。
en: Go and take your time to think it through.

ch: 想你日后定大有所为，今日我便赐你一番造化。
tc: 想你日後定大有所為，今日我便賜你一番造化。
en: One day you will achieve something extraordinary. I'll teach you something today.

ch: 我已经寻觅多年，剑修之中已无敌手。
tc: 我已經尋覓多年，劍修之中已無敵手。
en: I have been searching for a worthy opponent for many years but only in vain.

ch: 想不到你还是{appellationName|101|A}，那这次挑战可不会跟之前一样轻松了。
tc: 想不到你還是{appellationName|101|A}，那這次挑戰可不會跟之前一樣輕鬆了。
en: Oh, you are {appellationName|101|A}. This challenge won't be as easy as before.

ch: 想你日后定大有所为，今日我便赐你一番造化。
tc: 想你日後定大有所為，今日我便賜你一番造化。
en: One day you will achieve something extraordinary. I'll teach you something today.

ch: 想必你也自己想要保护的人，那么我就给你一场额外的挑战。
tc: 想必你也自己想要保護的人，那麼我就給你一場額外的挑戰。
en: You must have someone you want to protect. I'll give you an extra challenge.

ch: 当然，会比先前的更难。你可敢挑战？
tc: 當然，會比先前的更難。你可敢挑戰？
en: Of course, it will be more difficult than the previous one. Do you have the courage to take it up?

ch: 拿去吧。希望你可以保护你想要保护的人。
tc: 拿去吧。希望你可以保護你想要保護的人。
en: Take this. I hope you will be able to protect those you love.

ch: 想必你也自己想要保护的人，那么我就给你一场额外的挑战。
tc: 想必你也自己想要保護的人，那麼我就給你一場額外的挑戰。
en: You must have someone you want to protect. I'll give you an extra challenge.

ch: 这些已是尘封的过往，已经是太遥远的事情了。
tc: 這些已是塵封的過往，已經是太遙遠的事情了。
en: These are all stories in the ancient past.

ch: 曾几何时，我也幻想过。和月儿过着简简单单的生活，带着她见我的养爹娘。
tc: 曾幾何時，我也幻想過。和月兒過著簡簡單單的生活，帶著她見我的養爹娘。
en: Once upon a time, I dreamed about it. To live a simple life with Yue'er, and take her to meet my adoptive parents.

ch: 如此，也好。那就麻烦你了。
tc: 如此，也好。那就麻煩你了。
en: That would be fine. Thank you.

ch: 听闻琼芳仙的画技了得，你可以去问问她。
tc: 聽聞瓊芳仙的畫技了得，你可以去問問她。
en: I have heard of the extraordinary painting technique of an Immortal titled the Jade Blossom. Perhaps you could discuss the matter with her.

ch: 你是来将画的给我的吗？
tc: 你是來將畫的給我的嗎？
en: You are bringing the painting to me?

ch: 多谢。想必挂在剑碑之内，应该很合适。
tc: 多謝。想必掛在劍碑之內，應該很合適。
en: Thank you. It will be a good decoration for the stele of sword.

ch: 正愁无人与我比剑，来吧！
tc: 正愁無人與我比劍，來吧！
en: I do want a sword opponent. Come!

ch: 此事不妥。但你已决意加入的话，我不会反对。
tc: 此事不妥。但你已決意加入的話，我不會反對。
en: That's not proper. But I wouldn’t prevent you if you are determined.

ch: 我的仙法都已赐予你了。
tc: 我的仙法都已賜予你了。
en: All my Heavenly Arts are bestowed upon you.

ch: 甚好！那么我将曾经儿时的剑赠予你。
tc: 甚好！那麼我將曾經兒時的劍贈予你。
en: Very good! Then I’ll give you the sword I used when I was a child.

ch: 你看到前方有一人行色匆匆，走向一个充满仙力的建筑。
tc: 你看到前方有一人行色匆匆，走向一個充滿仙力的建築。
en: You see someone in front of you. The person is hurrying into a building full of Heavenly Power.

ch: 此人从储物戒拿出什么东西，虔诚地供奉，而后有一道光闪过。
tc: 此人從儲物戒拿出什麼東西，虔誠地供奉，而後有一道光閃過。
en: This person takes something out from the Interspatial Ring and offers it to the Shrine devoutly. Then a beam of light flashes by.

ch: 敢问道友，这是在做甚？此建筑是何物？
tc: 敢問道友，這是在做甚？此建築是何物？
en: My friend, would you mind telling me, what are you doing? And what is the building for?

ch: 此乃仙祠，为前些时日出现的，传闻是为供奉和参拜仙人所设，八荒各州皆有。
tc: 此乃仙祠，為前些時日出現的，傳聞是為供奉和參拜仙人所設，八荒各州皆有。
en: This is an Immortal Shrine. They appeared just several days before. It is said to be built for worshiping and sacrifice offering, and you could find them in every corner of the world.

ch: 据说诚心供奉足够数量的东西时，会得到仙人的回馈。似乎不同的仙祠，回馈的东西并不相同，道友若是感兴趣也可前去试试。
tc: 據說誠心供奉足夠數量的東西時，會得到仙人的回饋。似乎不同的仙祠，回饋的東西並不相同，道友若是感興趣也可前去試試。
en: You would be repaid by the Immortal if you offered enough sacrifices and expressed your true wish. Different Immortal Shrines can grant you different rewards, and you could visit them if you want.

ch: 这位道友，看来你也是为仙法所来。
tc: 這位道友，看來你也是為仙法所來。
en: My friend, maybe you come here for the Heavenly Art too.

ch: 此乃剑仙的仙祠。无论是不是剑修，都会想要得到这个神秘剑仙的仙法，道友也是为此而来的吧。
tc: 此乃劍仙的仙祠。無論是不是劍修，都會想要得到這個神秘劍仙的仙法，道友也是為此而來的吧。
en: Here is the Shrine of Sword Sage. Whether my peers are Sword Cultivators or not, they all want to obtain the Heavenly Arts of the mysterious immortal. Do you come here for them too?

ch: 既然如此，那么在下先告辞了。
tc: 既然如此，那麼在下先告辭了。
en: I see. Thus I’ll depart. Goodbye.

ch: 反正这些也是稍微打探一下就能知道的消息，告知于你也无妨。
tc: 反正這些也是稍微打探一下就能知道的消息，告知於你也無妨。
en: All of these are information easily to be known once inquired. Things won’t go worse if I tell them to you.

ch: 据说有几本关于此仙的话本残卷，残卷中有着参悟剑碑的方法。传闻，剑碑之内有着打开此仙祠的秘法。
tc: 據說有幾本關於此仙的話本殘卷，殘卷中有著參悟劍碑的方法。傳聞，劍碑之內有著打開此仙祠的秘法。
en: It is said that there are several incomplete collections of legends regarding this Immortal Shrine. The method for comprehending the stele of sword is recorded in those books. And, the secret technique for opening the Shrine is hidden in the stele.

ch: 奈何在下寻觅多年，也未曾见过残卷的影子。或许此事不过是杜撰，又或许在下并无机缘。
tc: 奈何在下尋覓多年，也未曾見過殘卷的影子。或許此事不過是杜撰，又或許在下並無機緣。
en: However, after years of finding, I still have no clue on the whereabouts of those collections. Maybe it’s just another rumor, or maybe my destiny prevents me.

ch: 不必言谢。那么，在下先告辞了。
tc: 不必言謝。那麼，在下先告辭了。
en: No need to thank me. Thus I’ll depart. Goodbye.

ch: 你的诚意，我已经感受到了。
tc: 你的誠意，我已經感受到了。
en: I have already seen your sincerity.

ch: 咦？你居然供奉了如此之多的东西。
tc: 咦？你居然供奉了如此之多的東西。
en: Hm? You presented so many offerings.

ch: 你的虔诚，我已经感受到了。
tc: 你的虔誠，我已經感受到了。
en: I have already seen your faith.

ch: 哦？想不到你倒是个颇有诚意的。
tc: 哦？想不到你倒是個頗有誠意的。
en: Oh? Your wish is much more sincere than I thought.

ch: 啾啾~凡人，既然你诚心诚意地供奉了。
tc: 啾啾~凡人，既然你誠心誠意地供奉了。
en: (Chirps) Good day, mortal! Your wish is truly sincere!

ch: 多谢小友如此为我费心。
tc: 多謝小友如此為我費心。
en: Thank you, my friend, for being so considerate towards me.

ch: 哦？！看来你对本座颇为敬仰。
tc: 哦？！看來你對本座頗為敬仰。
en: Oh! You must see me as your idol!
Now I know your wish, and find it not feigned.

ch: 本王倒是被你的诚心所感动。
tc: 本王倒是被你的誠心所感動。
en: I am really moved by your good faith.

ch: 哇哦，你居然给我送了这么多东西。
tc: 哇哦，你居然給我送了這麼多東西。
en: Wow, so many offerings from you.

ch: 既然你如此虔诚地供奉本尊，本尊又岂会吝啬。
tc: 既然你如此虔誠地供奉本尊，本尊又豈會吝嗇。
en: I am never a miser, especially when talking to such a pious follower.
A trustworthy person surely deserves a reward.

ch: 哇哦！你供奉了这么多的嘛。
tc: 哇哦！你供奉了這麼多的嘛。

ch: 那这{0}你要吗？如果你要的话，我就把这个{0}赐予你。
tc: 那這{0}你要嗎？如果你要的話，我就把這個{0}賜予你。
en: Do you want this {0}? If you want, I’ll give it to you.

ch: 那奴家也就不吝啬了。这{0}赏你了。
tc: 那奴家也就不吝嗇了。這{0}賞你了。
en: It’s good to be generous. Here, the {0} is yours.

ch: 那么本仙就大发慈悲的恩赐你{0}吧！
tc: 那麼本仙就大發慈悲的恩賜你{0}吧！
en: Then I should repay you a truly sincere gift as well! Here, accept this {0}!
I wonder if this {0} would be useful to you.
Is {0} the one you are looking for?
I’ll give you {0}. Do you like it?
I should give you {0} in return.

ch: {0}，本尊就大发慈悲的赠予你了。
tc: {0}，本尊就大發慈悲的贈予你了。

en: Is {0} something you are looking for?
Perhaps this {0} would be useful to you.

ch: 本仙子念在你如此虔诚的份上，就赐你{0}吧。
tc: 本仙子念在你如此虔誠的份上，就賜你{0}吧。
en: I’ll repay your piety with this {0}.
Tell the plan of Heavenly Mushroom
I have some sacrifices for you

ch: 不错，在下正是为此而来。
tc: 不錯，在下正是為此而來。
en: Yes, that's why I come here.
Please let me have it, Immortal.
What do you want to eat, your Immortal?
What kind of test would that be?
It took me a little longer
It's more valuable than ten years' schooling
As if three years have passed
As if one week has passed

ch: 拥有了突破羽化和登仙的能力
tc: 擁有了突破羽化和登仙的能力
en: Acquired the ability to break through to Reborn and Transcendent
The new will replace the old
The old will be surpassed by the new
This sword has never been used yet
It took five years to forge half of the sword
It means I have a Sect
It means I have an enemy
It's not my duty to rescue that person.
Please let me think about it...
I want to know the mystery of Immortals.

ch: 那就先告辞了，晚辈先行寻个僻静之地参悟仙法。
tc: 那就先告辭了，晚輩先行尋個僻靜之地參悟仙法。
en: Goodbye. I'll find a quiet place to comprehend the Heavenly Art.
Tell the plan of Heavenly Mushroom

ch: 快停！我的精血已经所剩无几了！
tc: 快停！我的精血已經所剩無幾了！
en: Stop! My vitae is seeping away from me!

ch: 我的精血已一滴不剩了，不能再继续了！
tc: 我的精血已一滴不剩了，不能再繼續了！
en: My vitae may get drained by it! Please stop now!

ch: 是的，我就随便看看，马上就离开
tc: 是的，我就隨便看看，馬上就離開
en: Yes, I'm just taking a walk. I'm leaving.

ch: 好吧，其实我是想要您的仙法
tc: 好吧，其實我是想要您的仙法
en: All right, actually, I want your Heavenly Art

ch: 或许……不是，不如我们聊聊仙法的事情。
tc: 或許……不是，不如我們聊聊仙法的事情。
en: Perhaps... No, how about we talk about the Heavenly Art.

ch: 帝江上仙，您还能继续战斗吗？
tc: 帝江上仙，您還能繼續戰鬥嗎？
en: Immortal Dijiang, can you still fight?

ch: 帝江上仙，您还能继续战斗吗？
tc: 帝江上仙，您還能繼續戰鬥嗎？
en: Immortal Dijiang, can you still fight?
Tell the plan of Heavenly Mushroom
Yes! Please do me a favor.
Activate Shuoli with Lightning Martial Arts
Tell the plan of Heavenly Mushroom

ch: 冷惊棠，兀蛇族少主。兀蛇族天生被具备魔化血脉的蛮豚族克制。在冷惊棠出生之际，多亏无数族人牺牲，他才能在九死一生的险境中幸存。随后，在对身世毫不知情的情况下，他自发背负上对抗天敌的使命——唯有成蛟化龙，才可修改天天地法则！为了扭转种族悲惨的宿命，冷惊棠依据族中的远古传说，踏上收集仙界所有种族血液的道路。天敌魔化阻隔在前，更有灼龙、玉鸾不可匹敌，他的每一步却都走得毅然决然。
tc: 冷驚棠，兀蛇族少主。兀蛇族天生被具備魔化血脈的蠻豚族克制。在冷驚棠出生之際，多虧無數族人犧牲，他才能在九死一生的險境中倖存。隨後，在對身世毫不知情的情況下，他自發背負上對抗天敵的使命——唯有成蛟化龍，才可修改天天地法則！為了扭轉種族悲慘的宿命，冷驚棠依據族中的遠古傳說，踏上收集仙界所有種族血液的道路。天敵魔化阻隔在前，更有灼龍、玉鸞不可匹敵，他的每一步卻都走得毅然決然。
en: Leng Jingtang, the young master of the Voodoo Serpent Clan. Born countered by the Wild Boar Clan, which bears the innate demonic blood, Jingtang was saved by many of his tribesmen at the cost of their lives in the most critical moment. Then, unknown of his past, he voluntarily undertakes the mission to fight against his natural enemies, and he knows the laws of nature oppressing his clan can only be shattered by his strength as a dragon. To achieve it, Jingtang follows the ancient legends of the clan and sets out to collect blood from all races in the Immortal Realm. Though demonic enemies from his opponent clan always attempt to stop him, and the power of his tribesmen could never compare to those of Flaming Dragon and Jade Bird, he continues his journey with utter determination.

ch: 越来越难以抑制对鲜血的渴望了……我，我究竟是怎么了！
tc: 越來越難以抑制對鮮血的渴望了……我，我究竟是怎麼了！
en: My thirst for blood is devouring me... What’s happening!

ch: 不要死，你们快走！为什么，为什么会这样！
tc: 不要死，你們快走！為什麼，為什麼會這樣！
en: Go, escape and survive! Why would I become this!

ch: 龙鸾之战，果然精彩，不过若我族与蛮豚族也是这般宿敌的关系，我族也不至于落魄至此……
tc: 龍鸞之戰，果然精彩，不過若我族與蠻豚族也是這般宿敵的關係，我族也不至於落魄至此……
en: Such a marvelous campaign between dragons and birds. If we, the serpents, could fight the boars but once, our clan would not be trapped in that despicable fate...

ch: 与酒将军一战还真是痛快，虽然为了取到蛮豚族的血液……我可能……要死了……
tc: 與酒將軍一戰還真是痛快，雖然為了取到蠻豚族的血液……我可能……要死了……
en: General Jiu, you are a respectable opponent. I come here for the blood of your clan... and now, perhaps I will... die soon...

ch: 这具蛇蜕，将继承我的遗志……希望族人看到它之时，已然能够坦荡地活在阳光下。
tc: 這具蛇蛻，將繼承我的遺志……希望族人看到它之時，已然能夠坦蕩地活在陽光下。
en: This shed will be my legacy... and I hope, on the day when my tribesmen find it, they could live safely under the sky.

ch: 烛遥月，灼龙族皇女，一代枭雄女帝。在她幼年之时，其父皇身染恶疾、撒手人寰。面对内忧外患的局势，小遥月被迫迅速成长并变得城府深沉——她需要承担维持灼龙族“仙界第一种族”名号的使命。然而，这一切谈何容易，玉鸾族主战派对此名号觊觎已久，更兼其笼络了苍禺、骨木诸族一同发难。在领悟父亲教诲之后，遥月终于解开了父亲遗物的封印，那一刻，她明白父亲的恶疾因何而来，也知道自己将会为何而死。
tc: 燭遙月，灼龍族皇女，一代梟雄女帝。在她幼年之時，其父皇身染惡疾、撒手人寰。面對內憂外患的局勢，小遙月被迫迅速成長並變得城府深沉——她需要承擔維持灼龍族「仙界第一種族」名號的使命。然而，這一切談何容易，玉鸞族主戰派對此名號覬覦已久，更兼其籠絡了蒼禺、骨木諸族一同發難。在領悟父親教誨之後，遙月終於解開了父親遺物的封印，那一刻，她明白父親的惡疾因何而來，也知道自己將會為何而死。
en: Zhu Yaoyue, the princess of Flaming Dragon Clan, and the great empress among her contemporaries. When she was a girl, her emperor father died of a serious disease. Grown up under threats from both domestic and abroad, Yaoyue becomes clever and diplomatic to keep the reputation of her clan as the First Race in the Immortal Realm. However, the journey before her is never smooth. The hawkish figures in the Jade Bird Clan have long been planning to seize the title, and even other clans like Cyan Monkey and Callous Wood are enticed and collude in their scheme. Finally, Yaoyue breaks open the seal on the items left by her father and knows the cause of his disease, as well as the bane of her own.

ch: 灼龙族便是为了统御仙界百族而生，可谁又知晓为此所要付出的代价。
tc: 灼龍族便是為了統御仙界百族而生，可誰又知曉為此所要付出的代價。
en: The Flaming Dragon Clan is the born ruler of all other races in the Immortal Realm. However, few could see the price behind it.

ch: 这皇位……你或许无法理解，但我有非要不可的理由。
tc: 這皇位……你或許無法理解，但我有非要不可的理由。
en: This crown... Perhaps you will never understand me, but it must be mine.

ch: 父亲若是因此而亡，当真乃为全族献出了一切……
tc: 父親若是因此而亡，當真乃為全族獻出了一切……
en: If my father really died because of this, he truly sacrificed everything for all of us...

ch: 全身被炽流灼烧的痛感更加强烈了……或许我已然无法坚持太久。
tc: 全身被熾流灼燒的痛感更加強烈了……或許我已然無法堅持太久。
en: The agony of being consumed by blazing currents... Perhaps I’ll be burnt to ashes in seconds.

ch: 仙界第一种族？可笑……可悲……但或许这便是我的宿命。
tc: 仙界第一種族？可笑……可悲……但或許這便是我的宿命。
en: The First Race in the Immortal Realm? Absurd and pitiful... but maybe that’s what I’m destined to fight for.

ch: 仙盟用秘法凝结八荒灵冥二气凝结而成的丹药，可以使修仙者在进入登仙境后提升修为。

第一卷

　　吾受友所托，著《剑修往事》四卷，待有缘人。
　　　　　　                                —云游散人|　　黑夜降临，剑庄之上电闪雷鸣，风雨欲来。

　　十岁的剑一独自一个人躲在幽暗的密室中，听着尖锐的打击之声不断地从室外传来，刚刚开始修行的他，却什么都做不了。

　　不知过了多久，密室外彻底安静下来，他从密室中走出，院中早已是一片血红，曾经高悬的“剑庄”牌匾也断裂在他的脚边。|　　剑一本是孤儿，被师父捡到带回剑庄，几年的时光，他早把这里当做了自己的家。

　　而这一切，如今都被化成了泡影。

　　他第一次是如此地渴望变强，若自己足够强，是不是这一切都不会发生？|　　剑一一把火将剑庄的痕迹从这世上抹去，但仇恨却深深根植在他的内心。

　　他拿起手中的剑，寻到一处深山老林之中，没日没夜地修行，饿了便打些野兽野果吃，困了就随意寻一处山洞休息，不过短短数年，修为突飞猛进达到了瓶颈。

　　静极思动，剑一决定离开山林，于俗世间继续历练。

第一卷

　　吾受友所託，著《劍修往事》四卷，待有緣人。
　　　　　　                                —雲遊散人|　　黑夜降臨，劍莊之上電閃雷鳴，風雨欲來。

　　十歲的劍一獨自一個人躲在幽暗的密室中，聽著尖銳的打擊之聲不斷地從室外傳來，剛剛開始修行的他，卻什麼都做不了。

　　不知過了多久，密室外徹底安靜下來，他從密室中走出，院中早已是一片血紅，曾經高懸的「劍莊」牌匾也斷裂在他的腳邊。|　　劍一本是孤兒，被師父撿到帶回劍莊，幾年的時光，他早把這裡當做了自己的家。

　　而這一切，如今都被化成了泡影。

　　他第一次是如此地渴望變強，若自己足夠強，是不是這一切都不會發生？|　　劍一一把火將劍莊的痕跡從這世上抹去，但仇恨卻深深根植在他的內心。

　　他拿起手中的劍，尋到一處深山老林之中，沒日沒夜地修行，餓了便打些野獸野果吃，困了就隨意尋一處山洞休息，不過短短數年，修為突飛猛進達到了瓶頸。

　　靜極思動，劍一決定離開山林，於俗世間繼續歷練。
en:
Book 1

    My friend asked me to record a marvelous figure, and I wrote this Sword Cultivator's Story in 4 Books. Perhaps someone would read them in the future.
                                             -- Wandering Cultivator|    Night fell. Bolts of lightning flashed by the Swordsmanship Manor, and a storm was gathering.

    Jianyi, a 10-year-old boy at that time, hid alone in a dark chamber. The clattering of weapons came from outside the room, but he could only stay here helplessly. He was just an apprentice, and it would be impossible for him to join in the battle.

    Finally, the sounds of fighting disappeared. Jianyi slipped out of the chamber and walked through the court. The soil beneath him was wet with crimson stains, and next to his feet, the once-impressive plaque of the Swordsmanship Manor was split into parts.|    Jianyi had been deserted before, but then his master found the boy and brought him back to the Manor. After several years of living, he already saw here his home.

    Now, that carefree life was gone forever.

    It was the first time he felt a strong desire of being powerful. If I were mighty enough, he thought, would I be able to prevent them?|    Jianyi set fire to the Manor's ruin and burned his past into ashes, but hatred had already rooted in his mind.

    He began wandering with his sword and found a secluded mountain forest to reside. He trained diligently, and only stopped when he must find something to eat or somewhere to sleep. His sword mastery advanced rapidly, and just a few years later, he felt he had outgrown the teachings learned in the Manor.

    Time to find another stage. Jianyi decided to leave the forest and carry on his training in a wider world.

ch:
第二卷

　　　　        作者　　云游散人|　　在俗世历练数年，剑一虽才弱冠，但脸上早已没了少年的青涩，瘦削的面容上透露着一丝坚毅。

　　这数年里，剑一不知踏过多少山，涉过多少水，诸番感悟之下，修为在一步步稳定地提升。

　　一路上，他看到不平之事，会出手相助，因此也惹到了不少仇家。

　　这日，他被多位仇人追杀，不得已遁入深山，不巧惊扰大妖兽，危在旦夕。|　　看着大妖兽逐渐迫近，剑一没有一丝害怕，只是觉得对不起死掉的同门，不能为他们报仇。

　　谁知附近突然发生了巨大的爆炸，强大的冲击将妖兽吸引走，而他也被震晕了过去。

　　“你醒啦？”剑一从昏迷中醒来，一位年纪与他相仿的姑娘正温声细语地问着他。|　　常年警惕的他在陌生的环境中下意识要起身，那个姑娘急忙开口：“你别动，我爹说了你需要静养。”

　　姑娘仿佛看出了剑一内心的担心，继续安慰道：“你放心，我们村子一直没什么外人，很安全。”

　　就这般，剑一在这个村子里修养了数日后，方才知道之前是两位大能修士在周围交战方才引起巨大的冲击，才间接让他从妖兽下逃过一劫，随后被上山采药的月儿姑娘发现，将他救了回来。|　　凡人的药只能治好他的外伤，而经脉内伤只能靠自己慢慢疗养。

　　就这样，他暂时住在了月儿姑娘的家里，还经常帮着干一些粗活杂活。

　　远离纷争的这些日子，宁静而美好，而从未经历过情爱之事的这对男女，在朝夕相处之下，眼中也渐渐有了彼此。

　　　　        作者　　雲遊散人|　　在俗世歷練數年，劍一雖才弱冠，但臉上早已沒了少年的青澀，瘦削的面容上透露著一絲堅毅。

　　這數年裡，劍一不知踏過多少山，涉過多少水，諸番感悟之下，修為在一步步穩定地提升。

　　一路上，他看到不平之事，會出手相助，因此也惹到了不少仇家。

　　這日，他被多位仇人追殺，不得已遁入深山，不巧驚擾大妖獸，危在旦夕。|　　看著大妖獸逐漸迫近，劍一沒有一絲害怕，只是覺得對不起死掉的同門，不能為他們報仇。

　　誰知附近突然發生了巨大的爆炸，強大的衝擊將妖獸吸引走，而他也被震暈了過去。

　　「你醒啦？」劍一從昏迷中醒來，一位年紀與他相仿的姑娘正溫聲細語地問著他。|　　常年警惕的他在陌生的環境中下意識要起身，那個姑娘急忙開口：「你別動，我爹說了你需要靜養。」

　　姑娘仿佛看出了劍一內心的擔心，繼續安慰道：「你放心，我們村子一直沒什麼外人，很安全。」

　　就這般，劍一在這個村子裡修養了數日後，方才知道之前是兩位大能修士在周圍交戰方才引起巨大的衝擊，才間接讓他從妖獸下逃過一劫，隨後被上山採藥的月兒姑娘發現，將他救了回來。|　　凡人的藥只能治好他的外傷，而經脈內傷只能靠自己慢慢療養。

　　就這樣，他暫時住在了月兒姑娘的家裡，還經常幫著干一些粗活雜活。

　　遠離紛爭的這些日子，寧靜而美好，而從未經歷過情愛之事的這對男女，在朝夕相處之下，眼中也漸漸有了彼此。
en:
Book 2

                By    Wandering Cultivator|    Time went by. Now Jianyi turned twenty and became a young swordsman. However, he was never as reckless as most lads were, and, when you gaze at his slender face, you could find glimmers of courage in his eyes.

    During these years, Jianyi traversed mountains and rivers and encountered many difficulties. But he was always ready to draw lessons from them, and his technique was thus enhanced step by step.

    He traveled the world. When he found someone committing misdeeds, he would punish them with his sword. Therefore, he made many enemies.

    This day, his enemies were chasing him down, and to escape them, he entered the mountain depth. Unfortunately, formidable monsters there felt his presence and were about to pounce on him.|    He did not flinch at the imminent danger, but at that critical moment, the image of perished peers emerged before his eyes. My life will end here soon, and it's sad to know I could never avenge you all. He thought.

    Suddenly, a huge explosion occurred nearby. The monsters left him to investigate it, and he was also struck into unconsciousness by the shockwave.

    "You're awake?" Jianyi opened his eyes and saw a girl of about his age speaking to him with a soft voice.|    Found himself in an unfamiliar environment, he was alerted and tried to stand up. Seeing it, the girl hurried to tell him: "Calm down. My dad said you need to rest now."

    His anxiety was felt by the considerate girl, and she continued: "Don't worry, there is no stranger in our village. You're safe here."

    Therefore, after several days of rest here, Jianyi finally knew the cause of the explosion. It was triggered by the fight between two master cultivators, and its sounds distracted the monsters. He was also knocked down by it but was soon found and rescued by the girl called Yue'er, who was gathering herbs in the mountains then.|    Ordinary drugs could only heal the wounds on the surface, and the damages in meridians could only recover over time.

    Now, he lodged with the family members of Yue'er and helped them with domestic chores.

    These peaceful days were so different from the life he led after he left the Manor. At the same time, the two innocent youngsters began to feel something never known before during their daily lives.

ch:
第三卷

　　　　        作者　　云游散人|　　剑一和月儿之间的感情，早就落在月儿爹娘的眼中。

　　在他们看来，剑一相貌堂堂，品性端正，勤劳能干，和月儿又互相喜欢，结为连理是水到渠成之事。

　　第二日，他们正打算向剑一提起此事，却发现他消失了。|　　原来剑一感知到村子周围开始出现陌生的气息，为了让村子里的人免遭牵连，剑一在深夜便悄然离开了。

　　他们看到了剑一留下的信，信中他感谢了月儿姑娘一家的照顾，还留下了一份不菲的钱财，这够他们无忧的过一辈子。

　　而对于月儿的一片情意，他却只字不提。|　　剑一身上背负了太多东西，这些都会给月儿一家带来毁灭的灾难，他和月儿，这辈子注定有缘无分，又何必留下不可能的念想。

　　剑一离开村子半日，仇家便围了上来，这次的敌人前所未有的强，剑一手持一剑鏖战数日，精疲力尽，那把剑也彻底碎裂。|　　而敌人还剩下最后一人，那人便是当年灭掉剑庄的敌宗宗主。

　　看着剑一单膝跪倒在地上，无力反抗，敌宗宗主大松一口气，此子的剑道天赋如此可怕，他们这一行人竟然全数被杀，只剩他一人。

|　　若再给此子些时日，只怕无人可制，所幸……所幸此子到底是没机会成长了。

　　　　        作者　　雲遊散人|　　劍一和月兒之間的感情，早就落在月兒爹娘的眼中。

　　在他們看來，劍一相貌堂堂，品性端正，勤勞能幹，和月兒又互相喜歡，結為連理是水到渠成之事。

　　第二日，他們正打算向劍一提起此事，卻發現他消失了。|　　原來劍一感知到村子周圍開始出現陌生的氣息，為了不讓村子裡的人免遭牽連，劍一在深夜便悄然離開了。

　　他們看到了劍一留下的信，信中他感謝了月兒姑娘一家的照顧，還留下了一份不菲的錢財，這夠他們無憂的過一輩子。

　　而對於月兒的一片情意，他卻隻字不提。|　　劍一身上背負了太多東西，這些都會給月兒一家帶來毀滅的災難，他和月兒，這輩子註定有緣無分，又何必留下不可能的念想。

　　劍一離開村子半日，仇家便圍了上來，這次的敵人前所未有的強，劍一手持一劍鏖戰數日，精疲力盡，那把劍也徹底碎裂。|　　而敵人還剩下最後一人，那人便是當年滅掉劍莊的敵宗宗主。

　　看著劍一單膝跪倒在地上，無力反抗，敵宗宗主大鬆一口氣，此子的劍道天賦如此可怕，他們這一行人竟然全數被殺，只剩他一人。

|　　若再給此子些時日，只怕無人可制，所幸……所幸此子到底是沒機會成長了。
en:
Book 3

                By    Wandering Cultivator|    Yue'er's parents had also noticed the affection between the two.

    They found Jianyi a handsome and righteous swordsman. Besides, the love between them was so true. It would be good for Yue'er to find a husband so diligent and attentive as him.

    The next day, just before they were about to talk to him about the marriage proposal, Jianyi disappeared.|    He left there at midnight because he had sensed the presence of strange things appearing around the village. They aimed at him, and he was unwilling to get the villagers involved.

    Jianyi also left a letter for Yue'er and her parents. He expressed his gratitude to them and provided them with a large amount of money. He knew they could lead a much easier life with it since then.

    However, he did not mention the affection between Yue'er and him.|    Jianyi knew love would be too good for him. His past was chequered, and his path was never smooth. Anyone who got close to him may be caught by the merciless fate, and he was sensible enough to leave his beloved one in a safer place.

    His enemies found him just a half day later. This time, Jianyi encountered opponents that were much more difficult to deal with than before. Their battle lasted for days, and finally, Jianyi was exhausted; his sword shattered.|    But there was still one enemy before him. He was the sect leader that had eliminated Jianyi's peers in the Manor years ago.

    Jianyi, fatigued and disarmed, supported himself with one knee on the ground. This youth has slain all of my companions except for me alone! The sect leader shuddered to think of the swordsmanship of the young man. But now found his opponent unable to issue any counterattack, he was much relieved.

|    He was indeed talented, and if he could have more time to advance, he would be invincible. Perhaps it is good... to end his career here and now.

ch:
第四卷

　　　　        作者　　云游散人|　　红日当空，春树耸翠。

　　剑一看着敌宗宗主持剑向自己刺来，平静的神色下藏着一丝不甘。

　　若再给他些时间，大仇便可全报了，何至于还剩这最后一人，不甘啊……

　　剑一闭上眼睛，等待着夺命一剑的到来。|　　忽然，有风吹起，天地俱静，手中已无剑的剑一，感觉周遭陡然有无数的剑在等待着他地召唤。

　　他放出神识，方才发觉，那些等待他召唤的剑，皆是草木。

　　剑一心神微微一动，无数的草木离地而起，化作一抹剑气，在他的上空中不停盘旋，形成一个越来越大的剑气旋涡。|　　敌宗宗主更是发现，自己竟然无法控制手中之剑，隐隐约约要脱离自己的控制。

　　眼见不妙，此人果断弃剑逃离。

　　就在此时，剑一睁开双眼，看着那急速逃离的背影，轻轻喝了一字：“去。”|　　剑一声音刚落，头顶上空盘旋的剑气旋涡顿时化作了一道银白色的剑气长龙，往逃离方向冲去，顷刻间便穿破了逃离之人的身体。

　　敌宗宗主低头看着自己被穿出大洞的身体，脸上露出不可思议的神情，随即倒地而亡。

　　剑一也彻底力竭倒在了地上，大仇得报，剑心圆满。

　　从此天高任鸟飞，海阔凭鱼跃。|　　不知多少年后，极北之地，有一剑破空，天门顿时大开，有一男子，一袭青衣，满头白发，飘然飞升。

　　所有人都不意外，因为他们知道，那男子便是当世第一人，剑一。

　　就在天门即将关闭之际，突然有千万道惊天剑意从门后破空而下，冲向诸天万界，其中一道剑意落入八荒大陆，于赤幽州削掉一座山脉。|　　八荒的后人们从这座山脉中感悟到了诸多剑意，便称之为剑碑。

en:
Book 4

                By    Wandering Cultivator|    It was in spring. The warm sun shined behind verdant foliage.

    The sect leader was ready to launch one last blow. Seeing the sword drawn closer with a cold flash, Jianyi was unusually calm. However, a bitter animosity was gnawing at him.

    If only I could fight for another minute! I would bring justice to our enemies and would let no one escape, but now...

    Jianyi closed his eyes and waited for his death.|    A breeze came. The world quieted down, and now Jianyi, a swordsman without a sword, felt his weapons everywhere around him.

    He focused his mind and tried to sense them, and found those readily available swords were leaves of grass and trees.

    He gave them a command, and numerous green blades floated into the air and transformed into a swordsman's aura. The aura continued to expand, and soon, it became an immense whirlpool above him.|    Even the metallic sword in his opponent's hand was caught. The sect leader discovered to his astonishment that he could no longer grasp his weapon as if it had awakened and was about to reunite with other blades.

    Seeing his advantage was lost, he could only discard the sword and flee.

    Jianyi opened his eyes again. He looked at the fleeing opponent and said, "Go."|    Then, a silvery blade thrust from the whirlpool of the swordsman's aura and ran through his last enemy.

    The sect leader stared at the impossible wound, unable to understand the origin of the blade that pierced him. Then he breathed his last.

    Jianyi also collapsed to the ground. Now he avenged his peers, and his journey culminated.

    From then on, he could pursue whatever he wanted.|    Years after, in the north end of the world, a sword cut the sky into two, and the Skygate opened. A cyan-robed man ascended there into the Immortal Realm, his white hair as pure as snow.

    The finale was already known to everyone, for people knew he was the first sword cultivator in his time, Jianyi.

    When the Skygate was about to close, myriad sword's wills fell from the realm behind it. They pierced through barriers between worlds, and one of them came into this world. A mountain in Chi You was chopped to cliffs by it.|    Descendants in this world could still feel the legendary figure's mastery of swords there, thus the place was named "Stele of Sword".

ch: 你正想取走风符，两只妖兽竟同时向你攻来……

ch: 已经取得风符，依真诰所言，使用此符召来天雨天雷即能探查到冥种幽窟的确切位置。
tc: 已經取得風符，依真誥所言，使用此符召來天雨天雷即能探查到冥種幽窟的確切位置。

ch: 风符一经使用立即化为烟尘。同时，远方天地变色，四处发出轰隆巨响，天雷不断劈落，击碎周围石洞。待得周围声响停息，冥山边缘果然出现一个洞窟。

Numerous bolts of lightning fall from the sky, smashing the rocks under them. After the turbulence ends, you find a cave on the verge of the Nether Mountains.

ch: 你使用风符，但周围并未发生反应。看来必须要在雷雨天气使用才有效。
tc: 你使用風符，但周圍並未發生反應。看來必須要在雷雨天氣使用才有效。

ch: 风符果然让冥山洞窟重现世间，这便过去查探吧。
tc: 風符果然讓冥山洞窟重現世間，這便過去查探吧。

ch: 天边层云之中，露出一角冰棱，细看之下，果然看见一座巨大的冰宫悬于高空之中。
tc: 天邊層雲之中，露出一角冰棱，細看之下，果然看見一座巨大的冰宮懸於高空之中。
en: You see a pinnacle of ice piercing through heavy clouds. After closer inspection, you recognize an elevating profile of an impressive ice palace.

ch: 冰宫之中道路纵横交错，一路上都看见有人一动不动躺在地上，更有甚者纠缠一起，似乎正在争斗。

ch: 你继续前进，进入冰宫深处，只见不远处一朵冰花长在穴壁之上。
tc: 你繼續前進，進入冰宮深處，只見不遠處一朵冰花長在穴壁之上。
en: You continue to advance and enter into the depth of the palace. There, you find an ice flower on the wall not far from you.

ch: 你刚接触冰花打算将之取走，一股寒意直透骨髓，让你感觉一阵迷糊。同时脑海出现一个景象，那是一个幽暗的洞窟！冥种洞窟！
tc: 你剛接觸冰花打算將之取走，一股寒意直透骨髓，讓你感覺一陣迷糊。同時腦海出現一個景象，那是一個幽暗的洞窟！冥種洞窟！
en: You try to pick the flower, but at the time your hand touches it, a bitter chill flows through your body. You begin to feel dizzy, and a view of a dim cave emerges in front of your eyes - the Cave of Nether Seeds!

tc: 你一個激靈清醒過來，你發現冰花已經融解，手上只剩一灘寒冷冰水。
en: With a sudden shiver, your mind is clear again. The ice flower has melted, and what remains in your hand is merely a pool of icy water.

tc: 暮仙州的冥種洞窟就在冥山邊上麼？

ch: 地上之人生机已绝，不过是因为冰宫之中寒冷异常，所以肉身不腐。这些人应是来取冰花的……
tc: 地上之人生機已絕，不過是因為冰宮之中寒冷異常，所以肉身不腐。這些人應是來取冰花的……
en: They are already dead, but their appearance looks normal due to the extreme cold inside the palace. Perhaps they came here for the ice flower...

ch: 据传为上界遗落的符箓。一经使用能够改变天气。但似此符同样受天地法则限制，使用之后灵力耗尽即消失不见，经过一段时间后才能重聚实体，再化符箓。此物一旦现世，便即惹来雷泽妖兽争夺，乃八荒至宝。
tc: 據傳為上界遺落的符籙。一經使用能夠改變天氣。但似此符同樣受天地法則限制，使用之後靈力耗盡即消失不見，經過一段時間後才能重聚實體，再化符籙。此物一旦現世，便即惹來雷澤妖獸爭奪，乃八荒至寶。
en: A charm said to be an immortal’s treasure lost in this world, its power can be used to change weather. However, the charm is also under restriction from the Law of the world, and it will disappear once its power is released. After that, it may take some time to concentrate power into another charm again. The Charm is one of the world’s most desired treasures, and every time its whereabouts are known, monsters in Lei Ze will fight for it.

ch: 据《真诰》记载，</r>使用<r>风符</r>招引天雷，才能使隐藏的冥种幽窟显形。
tc: 據《真誥》記載，</r>使用<r>風符</r>招引天雷，才能使隱藏的冥種幽窟顯形。
en: According to the Reborn Canon, you should use the <r>Wind Charm</r> to induce Lightning and to indicate the location of the hidden Cavern.

ch: 侦察出永恒冰原的冰花在玉髓冰宫之上。此天上冰宫已在附近，赶紧设法进入取得冰花。
tc: 偵察出永恆冰原的冰花在玉髓冰宮之上。此天上冰宮已在附近，趕緊設法進入取得冰花。
en: You have known that the Ice Flower of the Everfrost is on top of the Jade-cored Ice Palace. Now you are near the palace, and you should enter it for the flower as soon as possible.

ch: 战胜全部冥羽幻身，融合冥羽并使其强化到最后阶段
tc: 戰勝全部冥羽幻身，融合冥羽並使其強化到最後階段
en: Defeat all mirror images of Nether Feathers, merge them and enhance them to the last stage

ch: 抵御住八荒天地法则对意欲登仙之人的全部考验
tc: 抵禦住八荒天地法則對意欲登仙之人的全部考驗
en: Endure the trials prepared for the Cultivators by the Law of the world

ch: 此地是仙盟发布任务的地方，仙盟所属修仙者可以在此为守护人类而建功立业，同时会获得仙盟发放的战功作为报酬。
tc: 此地是仙盟發布任務的地方，仙盟所屬修仙者可以在此為守護人類而建功立業，同時會獲得仙盟發放的戰功作為報酬。
en: Here is the mission board of the Alliance. Its Cultivators could find chances here to help human and receive Battle Contributions granted by the Alliance.

ch: 关于巡查仙盟潜在危险的任务将会发布于此，完成此处的任务可以提高仙盟安全的程度。
tc: 關於巡查仙盟潛在危險的任務將會發布於此，完成此處的任務可以提高仙盟安全的程度。
en: Missions like patrolling and finding potential threats will be posted here. They could improve the safety of the Alliance.

ch: 关于仙盟城内各类事务的任务将会发布于此，完成此处的任务可以提高仙盟繁荣的程度。
tc: 關於仙盟城內各類事務的任務將會發布於此，完成此處的任務可以提高仙盟繁榮的程度。
en: Missions like dealing with matters inside the city will be posted here. They could improve the prosperity of the Alliance.

ch: 关于抵御外部妖兽入侵的任务将会发布于此，完成此处的任务可以提高仙盟稳固的程度。
tc: 關於抵禦外部妖獸入侵的任務將會發布於此，完成此處的任務可以提高仙盟穩固的程度。
en: Missions like resisting the invasion of monsters will be posted here. They could improve the stability of the Alliance.

tc: 鴻蒙至寶，使用可以獲得1點仙力點。
en: A treasure born in endless chaos. Use it to gain 1 Immortal Power Pt.

ch: 冥妖一脉的初生状态，在特定情况下可化为真身——玄鬼蚀夜体，其修为堪比人类羽化初期之境
tc: 冥妖一脈的初生狀態，在特定情況下可化為真身——玄鬼蝕夜體，其修為堪比人類羽化初期之境
en: A cultivation phase for infant Nether Demons. Under certain circumstances, they could transform into their true form - Profound Night Form. Their strength equals to human in Reborn Early.

ch: 冥妖一脉的青年状态，在特定情况下可化为真身——苍森辟云体，其修为堪比人类羽化中期之境
tc: 冥妖一脈的青年狀態，在特定情況下可化為真身——蒼森辟雲體，其修為堪比人類羽化中期之境
en: A cultivation phase for juvenile Nether Demons. Under certain circumstances, they could transform into their true form - Verdant Forest Form. Their strength equals to human in Reborn Middle.

ch: 冥妖一脉的成年状态，在特定情况下可化为真身——惊涛摧岳体，其修为堪比人类羽化后期之境
tc: 冥妖一脈的成年狀態，在特定情況下可化為真身——驚濤摧嶽體，其修為堪比人類羽化後期之境
en: A cultivation phase for adult Nether Demons. Under certain circumstances, they could transform into their true form - Potent Surge Form. Their strength equals to human in Reborn Late.

ch: 冥妖一脉十分强大的存在，在特定情况下可化为真身——紫虹摄星体，其修为堪比人类登仙初期之境
tc: 冥妖一脈十分強大的存在，在特定情況下可化為真身——紫虹攝星體，其修為堪比人類登仙初期之境
en: A cultivation phase for powerful Nether Demons. Under certain circumstances, they could transform into their true form - Spectral Starhunter Form. Their strength equals to human in Transcendent Early.

ch: 冥妖一脉极其顶尖的存在，在特定情况下可化为真身——幻沙葬月体，其修为堪比人类登仙中期之境
tc: 冥妖一脈極其頂尖的存在，在特定情況下可化為真身——幻沙葬月體，其修為堪比人類登仙中期之境
en: A cultivation phase for extraordinary Nether Demons. Under certain circumstances, they could transform into their true form - Engulfing Quicksand Form. Their strength equals to human in Transcendent Middle.

ch: 冥妖一脉最为巅峰的存在，在特定情况下可化为真身——炽炎焚日体，其修为堪比人类登仙大圆满之境
tc: 冥妖一脈最為巔峰的存在，在特定情況下可化為真身——熾炎焚日體，其修為堪比人類登仙大圓滿之境
en: A cultivation phase for the most accomplished Nether Demons. Under certain circumstances, they could transform into their true form - Furious Inferno Form. Their strength equals to human reached Perfection in Transcendent Realm.

ch: 仙鸡不足3只，无法进行比试
tc: 仙雞不足3隻，無法進行比試
en: Unable to fight - Immortal Chickens less than 3.

ch: 刑天近日出现不同寻常的动静，危机迫在眉睫。请你尽快挑战刑天。
tc: 刑天近日出現不同尋常的動靜，危機迫在眉睫。請你儘快挑戰刑天。
en: Xingtian’s behavior is increasingly worrying these days. The threat is imminent, please challenge Xingtian as soon as possible.

ch: 你不敌刑天，而骆瑛为了救你，被刑天击中，落在远处，需速速前往救援。
tc: 你不敵刑天，而駱瑛為了救你，被刑天擊中，落在遠處，需速速前往救援。
en: You fled from the attack of Xingtian, and when rescuing you, Luo Ying was hit by your opponent and fell somewhere in the distance. Come find and help her quickly.

ch: 骆瑛身受重伤，不能留在外面，需尽快带回去治愈。
tc: 駱瑛身受重傷，不能留在外面，需儘快帶回去治癒。
en: Luo Ying is heavily wounded. It's not safe to leave her alone here, and you should bring her back for healing.

ch: 赤幽州危在旦夕，必须击杀刑天。
tc: 赤幽州危在旦夕，必須擊殺刑天。
en: Chi You is on the verge of destruction. Xingtian must be slain.

ch: 你败给刑天，和周围的伙伴谈谈吧。或者他们能给你打气呢。
tc: 你敗給刑天，和周圍的夥伴談談吧。或者他們能給你打氣呢。
en: You are defeated by Xingtian. Chat with other companions around you, perhaps they would cheer you up.

ch: 施放剑斩斩击全场，对所有敌人多次造成威力&710001_xfwl&的伤害，并释放1次斩击剑气。
tc: 施放劍斬斬擊全場，對所有敵人多次造成威力&710001_xfwl&的傷害，並釋放1次斬擊劍氣。
en: Issue a slash with the sword onto the entire battlefield, dealing &710001_xfwl& damage to all enemies for 4 times, and unleashing 1 sword aura.

ch: 一声鸡鸣，召唤大量金蛋从天而降攻击全场敌人，造成威力&710002_ddwl&的伤害，随后会有大量仙鸡飞过，生下&710002_mjsl&个鸡蛋，鸡蛋对砸中的单位造成&710002_ddwl&的伤害，并在一定时间后孵化出各种仙鸡。
tc: 一聲雞鳴，召喚大量金蛋從天而降攻擊全場敵人，造成威力&710002_ddwl&的傷害，隨後會有大量仙雞飛過，生下&710002_mjsl&個雞蛋，雞蛋對砸中的單位造成&710002_ddwl&的傷害，並在一定時間後孵化出各種仙雞。
en: Let out a cluck and summon lots of golden eggs falling from the sky, dealing &710002_ddwl& damage to all enemies on the battlefield. Then, many Immortal Chickens will fly through the battlefield, laying &710002_mjsl& eggs and dealing &710002_ddwl& damage to enemies hit. Various kinds of Immortal Chickens will be hatched from the eggs after some time.

ch: 召唤一个从天而降的蘑菇砸击全场，对敌人造成威力&710003_zmgwl&的伤害，然后喷射&710003_jcbzsl&个孢子，孢子降落后会长成所有友方单位均可食用的可食用蘑菇，回复食用者&710003_cmghfbl&%的体力。同时会在全屏生成一个持续&710003_cmsj&秒的<o>菌膜</o>。
tc: 召喚一個從天而降的蘑菇砸擊全場，對敵人造成威力&710003_zmgwl&的傷害，然後噴射&710003_jcbzsl&個孢子，孢子降落後會長成所有友方單位均可食用的可食用蘑菇，回復食用者&710003_cmghfbl&%的體力。同時會在全屏生成一個持續&710003_cmsj&秒的<o>菌膜</o>。
en: Summon a huge mushroom falling from the sky, dealing &710003_zmgwl& damage to enemies, and spread &710003_jcbzsl& spores around. The spores will fall to the ground and grow into mushrooms edible to all allied units, and eating the mushroom will recover &710003_cmghfbl&% Vitality. Meanwhile, the Art will also generate a full-screen <o>Fungus Film</o>, lasting for &710003_cmsj&s.

ch: 从天而降&710004_ddsl&个道纹进行攻击，随后进入持续&710000_zdxfsjxz%3+1|/1000|f0&秒的<o>仙道状态</o>。
tc: 從天而降&710004_ddsl&個道紋進行攻擊，隨後進入持續&710000_zdxfsjxz%3+1|/1000|f0&秒的<o>仙道狀態</o>。
en: Call &710004_ddsl& Taoist Symbols falling from the sky to attack enemies, then activate <o>Immortal Path</o> status for &710000_zdxfsjxz%3+1|/1000|f0&s.

ch: 在场上生成一个风障切割全场所有敌人，风障会快速切割&710005_fzqgcs&次，每次造成威力&710005_fzqgwl&的伤害，随后爆炸再造成总威力&710005_fqbzwl&的伤害。仙法使用者获得<o>乐仙仙力</o>，持续&710005_xfcxsj&秒。
tc: 在場上生成一個風障切割全場所有敵人，風障會快速切割&710005_fzqgcs&次，每次造成威力&710005_fzqgwl&的傷害，隨後爆炸再造成總威力&710005_fqbzwl&的傷害。仙法使用者獲得<o>樂仙仙力</o>，持續&710005_xfcxsj&秒。
en: Generate a barrier of wind on the battlefield to cut all enemies. The barrier will quickly cut for &710005_fzqgcs& times, dealing &710005_fzqgwl& damage each time, and then dealing &710005_fqbzwl& total damage through an explosion. The user of the Heavenly Art will also gain <o>Music Immortal's Power</o> for &710005_xfcxsj&s.

ch: 召唤一柄巨大的光枪从天而降砸击并爆炸，每次对全场造成造成威力&710006_gqzxwl&的伤害。随后在天空召唤&710006_fzsl&个法阵，每个法阵会射出&710006_sfgqsl&道小光枪，对敌人造成威力&710006_fsxgqwl&的伤害。小光枪在全部射出后会爆炸，对附近的单位造成威力&710006_xgqwl&的伤害。使用者会变身<o>离珠斗神体</o>，获得一套新的技能，持续&710006_bscxsj&秒。
tc: 召喚一柄巨大的光槍從天而降砸擊並爆炸，每次對全場造成造成威力&710006_gqzxwl&的傷害。隨後在天空召喚&710006_fzsl&個法陣，每個法陣會射出&710006_sfgqsl&道小光槍，對敵人造成威力&710006_fsxgqwl&的傷害。小光槍在全部射出後會爆炸，對附近的單位造成威力&710006_xgqwl&的傷害。使用者會變身<o>離珠斗神體</o>，獲得一套新的技能，持續&710006_bscxsj&秒。
en: Summon a huge spear of light piercing from the sky, then the spear explodes, dealing &710006_gqzxwl& to all enemies on the battlefield each time. Then summon &710006_fzsl& arrays in the sky, each array can launch &710006_sfgqsl& little spears of light, dealing &710006_fsxgqwl& damage to enemies hit. After all of the little spears are launched, they will explode, dealing &710006_xgqwl& damage to nearby units. The user of the Heavenly Art will transform into <o>Lizhu’s Fighting Soul</o> for &710006_bscxsj&s, and acquire a new set of skills during that time.

ch: 吸引星球碰撞，对场上所有单位造成&710007_bzshcs&次威力&710007_xqbzwl&的伤害。使用者获得<o>沧泷仙力</o>持续&710007_xycxsj&秒。
tc: 吸引星球碰撞，對場上所有單位造成&710007_bzshcs&次威力&710007_xqbzwl&的傷害。使用者獲得<o>滄瀧仙力</o>持續&710007_xycxsj&秒。
en: Draw planets near for collisions, dealing &710007_xqbzwl& damage for all units on the battlefield for &710007_bzshcs& times. The user of the Heavenly Art will gain <o>Canglong's Power</o> for &710007_xycxsj&s.

ch:
<o>斩魂</o>
剑斩会斩开敌人的灵魂，持续&710001_lhsj&秒。
灵魂继承本体&710001_lhtlbl&%的最大体力和全部技能，灵魂消失时对本体造成损失体力的伤害。

劍斬會斬開敵人的靈魂，持續&710001_lhsj&秒。
靈魂繼承本體&710001_lhtlbl&%的最大體力和全部技能，靈魂消失時對本體造成損失體力的傷害。
仙法對仙人的傷害&810018_dxsh|-10000|f0&%
仙法對冥妖的傷害&810019_dysh|-10000|f0&%
en:
<o>Soulslash</o>
The slash of the sword will also cut a part of the enemy's soul away for &710001_lhsj&s. 
The soul will have a Vitality equal to &710001_lhtlbl&% Max Vitality of its owner and can use all skills of them. Upon vanishing, the soul will deal damage equal to its lost Vitality to its owner.
The Heavenly Art deals &810018_dxsh|-10000|f0&% damage to Immortals

en: Every time you summon a unit, the damage of Heavenly Arts will be increased by &810012_xfsh&% for &810012_jnlq&s. Stackable at max &810012_djcs& times.

ch: 仙法在沟通期间，获得&810013_shjd&%伤害减免。
tc: 仙法在溝通期間，獲得&810013_shjd&%傷害減免。
en: Gain &810013_shjd&% Damage Reduction during the communication of the Heavenly Art.

ch: 当自身剩余仙力点大于5点时，每5秒会获得&810014_xljd&%的仙力运转进度。
tc: 當自身剩餘仙力點大於5點時，每5秒會獲得&810014_xljd&%的仙力運轉進度。
en: When the remaining Immortal Power Pts are no less than 5, you will gain &810014_xljd&% circulation progress for Heavenly Power every 5 seconds.

ch: 当前消耗仙力点为2的倍数时，每次绝技造成伤害会提供&810017_xljd&%的仙力运转进度。
tc: 當前消耗仙力點為2的倍數時，每次絕技造成傷害會提供&810017_xljd&%的仙力運轉進度。
en: When the current Immortal Power Pts consumed are even numbers (can be divided by 2), every time you deal damage with Special Skills, you will gain &810017_xljd&% circulation progress for Heavenly Power.

ch: 仙力运转过程中，每秒提高当前仙法&810015_xfsh&%的伤害，最大提高&810015_djcs&次，持续&810015_cxsj&秒，冷却&810015_jnlq&秒。
tc: 仙力運轉過程中，每秒提高當前仙法&810015_xfsh&%的傷害，最大提高&810015_djcs&次，持續&810015_cxsj&秒，冷卻&810015_jnlq&秒。
en: During the circulation of Heavenly Power, the damage dealt by your current Heavenly Art will increase by &810015_xfsh&% every second, stackable at max &810015_djcs& layers, and last for &810015_cxsj&s. Cooldown: &810015_jnlq&s.

ch: 释放神通时，会消耗当前的所有仙力运转值，每消耗&810016_xfld&%仙力运转值，神通伤害提高&810016_stsh&%，持续&810016_cxsj&秒。
tc: 釋放神通時，會消耗當前的所有仙力運轉值，每消耗&810016_xfld&%仙力運轉值，神通傷害提高&810016_stsh&%，持續&810016_cxsj&秒。
en: Cast Ultimate Skill will also consume all current circulation of Heavenly Power. Every &810016_xfld&% of circulation consumed will increase the damage of the Ultimate Skill by &810016_stsh&% for &810016_cxsj&s.

ch: 释放仙法后，立即恢复自身&810018_llhf&%灵力。
tc: 釋放仙法後，立即恢復自身&810018_llhf&%靈力。
en: Instantly recover &810018_llhf&% Energy after casting Heavenly Arts.

ch: 仙盟需要云陌州魔族的帮助，但魔族似乎正遭遇了一些危难，身为仙盟之人，理应帮助魔族脱困，使其前来帮助仙盟成就大事。\n\n完成“钻木取火”全部主线任务。
tc: 仙盟需要雲陌州魔族的幫助，但魔族似乎正遭遇了一些危難，身為仙盟之人，理應幫助魔族脫困，使其前來幫助仙盟成就大事。\n\n完成「鑽木取火」全部主線任務。
en: The Cultivator Alliance needs help from the Demons in Yun Mo. However, those demons seem to be troubled by something. As a member of the Alliance, you should assist the demons to solve their problems and pave the way for them to come here and help us with important decisions.\n\nFinish all Main Missions in \"Suiren Kindles the First Flame\".

ch: 选择需要供奉给仙人的物品
tc: 選擇需要供奉給仙人的物品

ch: 顾鸢儿实力不足以应付厉害妖兽，她需要你的帮助。
tc: 顧鳶兒實力不足以應付厲害妖獸，她需要你的幫助。
en: Gu Yuan'er is still inexperienced in fighting monsters. She needs your help.

ch: 每隔一段时间会出现一只小鹿, 点到指定次数的小鹿即视为胜利, 点错了会扣除剩余时间。
tc: 每隔一段時間會出現一隻小鹿, 點到指定次數的小鹿即視為勝利, 點錯了會扣除剩餘時間。
en: A deer will emerge at a certain interval. Win the minigame by clicking on the deer several times, and the wrong clicks will cost you extra seconds.
No opponents available in the Arena

tc: 我方還可以派出{0}只仙雞進行戰鬥
en: You could send {0} more Immortal Chickens into fight

ch:
1.登仙每个境界都会获得一定的本源仙力。
2.本源仙力可以用于装配仙法。
3.每装配一个仙法都会消耗仙法对应的本源仙力，本源仙力不足时无法装配仙法。
4.获得仙祠仙人的认可，便可参悟更多的本源仙力。
tc:
1.登仙每個境界都會獲得一定的本源仙力。
2.本源仙力可以用於裝配仙法。
3.每裝配一個仙法都會消耗仙法對應的本源仙力，本源仙力不足時無法裝配仙法。
4.獲得仙祠仙人的認可，便可參悟更多的本源仙力。
en:
1. Entering every Realm will grant you some Essence Heavenly Power.
2.Essence Heavenly Power could be used to equip Heavenly Arts.
3. Every time you equip a Heavenly Art, the corresponding Essence Heavenly Power will be consumed. Once your Essence Heavenly Power is insufficient, you will not be able to equip Heavenly Arts.
4. More Essence Heavenly Power could be obtained once you have gained the recognition of the Immortals in the Shrines.

ch: 嗯，又是一位羽化成功的修仙者……
tc: 嗯，又是一位羽化成功的修仙者……
en: Eh. Another Cultivator that has reached Reborn...

ch: 本座乃八荒气运所化的守护灵，与赤幽州深处的句芒并非同一人。本座在此，特为指引有缘之人领悟八荒山海的本源法则，以至抵达——<r>登仙之境</r>……
tc: 本座乃八荒氣運所化的守護靈，與赤幽州深處的句芒並非同一人。本座在此，特為指引有緣之人領悟八荒山海的本源法則，以至抵達——<r>登仙之境</r>……
en: I am the Guardian Spirit formed through the circulation of Qi in this world, and am not the same one as the Goumang you saw in the hinterland of Chi You. I come here as a guide for those fortunate enough to grasp the Essence Law of the world and reach - <r>Transcendent</r>...

ch: 本源法则乃是登仙的必需之物，然而以你如今修为尚且无法参透……若你修行至<r>羽化后期</r>，本座自会再度出现。
tc: 本源法則乃是登仙的必需之物，然而以你如今修為尚且無法參透……若你修行至<r>羽化後期</r>，本座自會再度出現。
en: The Essence Law is indispensable if you want to be Transcendent. However, you are unable to understand it currently, due to insufficient experience... If your cultivation reaches <r>Reborn Late</r>, I’ll emerge before you again.

ch: 没错，正是本座，你既然到达了羽化后期，本座就将八荒之机要尽皆告知于你。
tc: 沒錯，正是本座，你既然到達了羽化後期，本座就將八荒之機要盡皆告知於你。
en: Yes, it's me. Now that you have reached Reborn Late, I'll tell you all the secrets about the world.

ch: 登仙，便是让灵气与冥气在体内互生轮转，维持平衡，于自身躯体这一方天地内成就太极，主宰天道。
tc: 登仙，便是讓靈氣與冥氣在體內互生輪轉，維持平衡，於自身軀體這一方天地內成就太極，主宰天道。
en: Transcendent means to circulate the Qi and the Nether Air within the body, and find a balance between their powers. Thus, cultivators could reach the ultimate perfection inside their bodies, and dominate the Heavenly Path.

ch: 众所周知，八荒之内灵冥二气水火不容，此乃自然之理。人类乃是血肉之躯，生而有灵，若吸入冥气便会身死，究其根源在于灵冥二气性质的绝对相反。
tc: 眾所周知，八荒之內靈冥二氣水火不容，此乃自然之理。人類乃是血肉之軀，生而有靈，若吸入冥氣便會身死，究其根源在於靈冥二氣性質的絕對相反。
en: As you know, it is the law of nature in this world for Qi and Nether Air to repel each other. Humans' mortal flesh is born with Qi, but inhaling Nether Air will result in death. It is the result of the antagonism between Qi and Nether Air.

ch: 冥气进入人体，与灵气碰撞湮灭，释放出巨大的能量，从而将五脏六腑摧折殆尽……
tc: 冥氣進入人體，與靈氣碰撞湮滅，釋放出巨大的能量，從而將五臟六腑摧折殆盡……
en: After Nether Air enters a human body, it will collide with Qi and cause annihilation, releasing huge energy to blast the visceral organs into pieces...

ch: 而登仙，便是要在体内彻底改变此等法则，让灵冥二气阴阳相生，最终成就仙力。
tc: 而登仙，便是要在體內徹底改變此等法則，讓靈冥二氣陰陽相生，最終成就仙力。
en: To rise to the Transcendent Realm is to reverse this law and blend Qi and Nether Air in your body until they co-exist in harmony and transform into Heavenly Power.

ch: ……不过，八荒山海不会轻易容许威胁其规则的存在诞生，故会降下天道雷劫来抹杀试图登仙之人。
tc: ……不過，八荒山海不會輕易容許威脅其規則的存在誕生，故會降下天道雷劫來抹殺試圖登仙之人。
en: ...However, this world will not easily allow its laws to be threatened by anyone, so it will summon lightning bolts to kill anyone who attempts to do it.

ch: 若决意要登仙，你需要收集三道仙力作为条件，而参悟<r>先天一气</r>是你目前唯一获取仙力的方式。
tc: 若決意要登仙，你需要收集三道仙力作為條件，而參悟<r>先天一氣</r>是你目前唯一獲取仙力的方式。
en: If you are determined, you should obtain three strains of Heavenly Power to be Transcendent. Now, the only method to obtain them for you is to comprehend the <r>Primordial Airs</r>.

ch: 至于先天一气如何获得，每个登仙之人都有其各自的机缘……
tc: 至於先天一氣如何獲得，每個登仙之人都有其各自的機緣……
en: As for how to gain access to those Primordial Airs, every Transcendent cultivator had their unique opportunities...

ch: 而你的机缘……这是本座要赋予你的<r>先天一气·木</r>，你将之吸收炼化，便能获得一道仙力。修炼至羽化境大圆满并将三道仙力收集完毕，你便可<r>登仙</r>！
tc: 而你的機緣……這是本座要賦予你的<r>先天一氣·木</r>，你將之吸收煉化，便能獲得一道仙力。修煉至羽化境大圓滿並將三道仙力收集完畢，你便可<r>登仙</r>！
en: And your opportunity... I'll give you <r>Primordial Air - Wood</r>, once absorbed and fused, you could obtain one strain of Heavenly Power. After your cultivation reaches perfection in Reborn Realm and all three Heavenly Powers are found, you will be able to be <r>Transcendent</r>!

ch: 本座推演得出，西北方向似有一丝先天一气的气息，若你意欲登仙，则可循此迹前往探查……至于最后一枚先天一气，怕是要等你抵达羽化境大圆满，才会出世。
tc: 本座推演得出，西北方向似有一絲先天一氣的氣息，若你意欲登仙，則可循此跡前往探查……至於最後一枚先天一氣，怕是要等你抵達羽化境大圓滿，才會出世。
en: I have deduced the whereabouts of one of them. It appears somewhere Northwest. If you want to be Transcendent, you could go there to find it... As for the last Primordial Air, perhaps it will only appear after you reached perfection in Reborn Realm.
