en: After I divided my soul into three, both of you will have your own unique experience. You may develop into persons entirely different from me, and here, I apologize for any unfairness caused by it.

ch: 自此，天元山通道将接通一万年前。然后，我要在远古的八荒召唤修为高深的修仙者前来天元山中终结衡天，终结这一切。而我一旦施法，自己也将化为齑粉。不过在此之前，我会以一气化三清之法将自己神念分离开去。
en: However, now we must take the last opportunity to defeat the Pavilion Master by following a risky decision. You're the middle-aged me, and I know you are determined to carry out what I am planning since all doubts concerning your beliefs have been clarified. Therefore, I'll put you into Ghost Valley. You need to search for master cultivators there and tell them to go to Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 以三清之法将尔等分离后，你们都会有自己的历练和遭遇，然后不再是我。这对于你们是极为不公的。
en: You're the young me. I know you are always adventurous, and I believe that you will be a great guide in leading the way to Tian Yuan Mountain for cultivators.

ch: 然而眼前是对付阁主的最后机会，事急从权，只好行险一搏。作为中年的我，对于心中认定的事情已无疑惑，当能好好贯彻我的想法，因此我希望你留存于鬼谷之中，不断搜寻合适的修仙大能，召唤他们来到天元山中。
en: Zhang San's middle-aged figure begins to ask something upon hearing it.

ch: 年轻的我，对任何事都锐意进取，定能将引导修仙者来到天元山的事情做好。
en: Indeed. I also thought about it, and I chose another mission for my young soul. He will just pursue his ambition to attain ascension rather than introduce cultivators to Tian Yuan Mountain to help me.

ch: 正在此时，张三中年的虚影发出了疑问。
en: But I will ban him from entering Tian Yuan Mountain. He wants to rise to the Immortal Realm, but he can't get close to the key secret of it. Therefore, he must be curious about the reason behind the ban, and in order to solve it, he will ask numerous cultivators to climb up to the Mountain for him and for me.

ch: 你的担忧不无道理。我也有过考虑，因此我给年轻神念的任务不是引导修仙者前来天元山协助我。而是忠于自己心底的愿望，设法飞升。
en: The middle-aged Zhang San is thinking about something. Meanwhile, you see the young soul offering himself to a task.

ch: 但我会给他落下禁制，禁止年轻的我进入天元山中。他心怀飞升之念，却又无法进入，一定会千方百计查明其中缘由，因此他会不断的为我指引修仙者前来。
en: You, the young me, will become a person different from the man here and now. You will feel betrayed by fate and live in desperation as long as the problem has not been solved.

ch: 张三中年的虚影正在沉吟，年轻的虚影则在请缨。
en: I know it's cruel for you...

ch: 你，或者说是年轻的我，最后会慢慢成长变为另外一个人，你会觉得被命运捉弄，十分痛苦。而且此事只要一日不曾解决，你就会一直留在这个痛苦的漩涡之中。
en: The figures are nodding. They seem to reach a consensus.

ch: 此事对你，其实十分残忍……
en: Promote Taoist Minds to save the world. Yes. It's the most important thing to do now.

ch: 虚影似乎发出了共识，均在不断点头。
en: The figures are nodding. They seem to reach a consensus.

ch: 传播道心，拯救八荒。不错，这才是眼前最重要的事。
en: Promote Taoist Minds to save the world. Yes. It's the most important thing to do now.

ch: 你在洞中摸索一阵，竟然发现洞中设有暗径，不知通向何处。
en: You fumble in the cave and find a secret path leading to somewhere unknown.

ch: 你从洞中暗径一路前行，竟找到列另外一处洞穴。而里面还放着另外几个盒子。
en: You follow the path and arrive at another cave. There are some caskets in it as well.

ch: 你进入内穴，里面也整齐放着几个与外穴相似的木盒。
en: You enter the inner cave and find some neatly arranged caskets similar to those you saw in the outer cave.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 只见李四醉在酒馆之中，他口角流出酒浆，在桌面聚成一滩，而失去意识的他嘴里还念念有词，正说着什么。
en: You see Jo in a tavern. He leans forward on a table amid a pool of liquor dripping from his mouth. He is murmuring unconsciously.

ch: 别人都能进入天元山中，为什么就我不能……？
en: Why can others enter Tian Yuan Mountain, but I can't?

ch: 我哪里不好了？我修炼十年就突破至悟道之境，已经快过多少修仙者了？
en: Am I slow-witted? I reach Enlightenment after only ten years of cultivation. Isn't it a deed second to but a few cultivators?

ch: 还有，还有，我四方行侠，生平光明磊落，最多也就卖两个聚气丸，赚赚酒钱。这么好的人，哪找了？
en: And am I evil-minded? I am a righteous man who is always willing to help others. The most outrageous thing I have done is just selling Qi Refining Pills to new cultivators. Is there a man as good as me?

ch: 为什么就是进不去天元山？？？飞升……飞升是修仙者梦寐以求之事，我也不例外……
en: Why? Why can't I enter Tian Yuan Mountain? Cultivators all want to ascend to Immortal Realm, and... so do I...

ch: 李四糊糊涂涂的说了一通，终于头一歪，睡倒在桌面之上。
en: Jo continues to babble for a while. Then, his head droops to the tabletop. He falls into a drunken dream.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 李兄，似你这般狂饮滥醉，修为再高也禁不住伤了自家。
en: Brother Jo, your cultivation is profound indeed, but heavy drinking hurts.
Shut up and get away from me!

ch: 李兄，你的为难我都知道。人各有命……
en: Brother Jo, I am with you. People have their own fates...

ch: 人各有命？！你说什么？！这是我的命吗？！
en: Own fates?! Mind your words! Is this my fate?

ch: 你敢再说一遍？！看我不拿老大耳刮子打烂你的狗嘴！
en: How dare you speak like that! Repeat it, and I'll give you a slap on the face!

ch: 李兄，你可以做的事情还有很多很多。何必在这自暴自弃？！这不是我认识的李四！
en: Brother Jo, there are still many other goals waiting for you. Why do you abandon yourself here?! You're not the man I have known!

ch: 你认识的李四？你真的认识李四？你知道我吗？！你知道个屁！你们，你们这些蠢货，至少还有个念想，可我就是进不去天元山。我还能做什么？！
en: The man you have known? Do you really know Jo? Do you think you understand me? No! At least you, and your fellow fools, can hope to attain ascension, but Tian Yuan Mountain rejects me no matter how hard I try. What should I do?!

ch: 嘿嘿，我还能跑到天元山里面，被雷劈死，被火烧死，被水淹死，被石头埋死！！！命，我跟你说，这就是我的命！！！
en: Well, I know. I can enter Tian Yuan Mountain and get struck by lightning bolts, burnt with flames, drowned in torrents, and buried under stones! Do you see? Fate, that's my fate!

ch: 李四歇斯底里的说完这话，双膝一跪，趴在地上嚎啕大哭。他双眼泪水如注，流个不停，伤心难过，已到极处。
en: Jo yells out his words and kneels down. He curls to the ground and begins to cry. Bitter teardrops flow through his face.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 哎呦哎哟，头可真痛，昨晚……我发酒疯了吗？
en: Well, my head aches. Did I... have a drunken fit last night?

ch: 哈？你看我这不是废话吗？真抱歉，给你添麻烦了。
en: Eh... No need to answer. Sorry for any inconvenience.

ch: 迷惘之际，的确需要将心中苦水全部吐了出来，才能继续往前走。
en: Sometimes we all need to say everything if we want to live to the next day.

ch: 往前走……是的，我又没入土为安，还得向前看，往前走。多谢你，好兄弟。
en: Live to the next day... Indeed. I should never abandon my hope as long as I am alive. Thank you, my dude.

ch: 我艰难的时候你扶了我一把，现在你需要旁人帮助了，我正好还你人情。
en: You helped me in my dark days. Now I'm repaying your kindness with my assistance.

ch: 你还不了的，你都不知道那时候的你，就像一坨泥，扶都扶不起来。
en: How can you repay it? You were dejected like a spread of mud, and it took me many efforts to uplift you.

ch: 还得了的，你都不知道昨晚的你，就像一坨屎，我碰都不想碰，不过最后还是碰了。
en: I can repay it. Last night you lay on the ground motionlessly like a pile of dung, and it took me no fewer efforts to carry you back.

ch: 你他……嘿嘿……好锋利的嘴巴，好尖锐的舌头！李四认栽了！
en: What the... Well, what a clever reply. You win.

ch: 一向滑稽玩世的李四目视前方，他眼神之中，不自觉流露出一丝惘然，但很快又变得十分坚毅，最后终于笑逐颜开，再次显出李四式招牌表情。
en: You see Jo gazing into the distance. In the mischievous swordsman's eyes, you find a hint of hesitation, then sparks of determination. He smiles again - his characteristic hilarity returns.

ch: 我要设法查明自己不能进入天元山的原因。我进不去天元山的话，我就找资质卓绝的修仙者代我进去看，进去查！
en: I will try my best to find out why I couldn't enter Tian Yuan Mountain. If it is inaccessible to me, I'll ask other talented cultivators to enter it and find out the reason for me!

ch: 如果老天非要与我开玩笑，我就违逆天意，改变命运！
en: If my destiny betrays me, I will rewrite it!

ch: 这话听着有点意思，这才是我认识的李四嘛！你不妨多找些资质卓绝的修仙者，我这里多的是聚气丸！都可以给你去坑他们！
en: That's it! That's the man I have known, Jo! You can search for more talented cultivators and sell them Qi Refining Pills! I have piles of them, and if you like, you can just peddle your pills at a higher price and see who'll be duped into buying them!

ch: 胡说！我是在他们最需要帮助的时候，提供帮助！
en: Nonsense! I am helping those who're in direst need!

ch: 这些木盒旁边还留有两封书信，其中一封较为老旧，边角已然泛黄。另外一封信封白皙，应是新近写就。
en: Beside these caskets, you find two letters. One of them has been worn out by time, its margins tainted in light brown. Another one's envelope is still clean and white; maybe it was written in just a few days.

ch: 恩，来此之前，李四曾有留有嘱托。我应该怎么办呢？
en: Well. Jo entrusted me with a task before I came here. What should I do?

ch: 你调动灵力，聚于指尖，然后在石壁上刻字。不片刻，“李四来也”四个大字已跃然壁上。
en: You condense your Energy into the fingertip and write on the wall. Soon, you leave the words \"JO WAS HERE\" on it.

ch: 恩，这不可以。我岂能跟他一般胡闹呢？
en: No, that's not proper. I shouldn't be as frivolous as him.

ch: 该回去告知李四查探所得了。
en: Time to go back and inform Jo.

ch: 回来啦？是不是已帮在下破解夸父族的洞窟封印啦？
en: You return here so rapidly? Have you found anything?

ch: 你……你说什么？！你说的东西，我一个字都不信！
en: What... are you talking about?! No, that's all nonsense!

ch: 李四抱着头十分痛苦，似乎在竭力要想起什么，片刻之后，他咬牙切齿双眼放出凶光，死死的盯着你。
en: Jo holds his head painfully. Perhaps he is trying his best to remember something. Seconds after, he grits his teeth and glares at you with uttermost malice.

ch: 你呆在这做什么，该做什么做什么去……走，你走！
en: Why are you still here? Don't you have other things to do? Go away... Go away from me!

ch: 李四陷入迷乱之中，他一边大呼小叫，一边急步疾走，只片刻间已经不见了人影。
en: Jo loses his mind. He shouts and yells and scurries away. Soon, he's gone.

ch: 嘿嘿，很好很好，那家伙千方百计封印那个地方，如今还是被人跑进去了，定会气个半死！
en: I see. You can't find anything? Interesting.

ch: 对了，这边的风水经我悉心布置已契合天机，也就是说，道路已经打开了。
en: Jo is observing you with his playful grin. In his smiling eyes, you see something close to suspicion. Maybe he is weighting you, as well as your words.

ch: 嘿嘿，上山之后，<r>若有机会回到这里，不要忘了要将山上情形告诉我啊</r>。我在此等你消息！
en: Good. You are the most honest person in the world, and I believe you. After you return from the Mountain, please tell me what's going on there.

ch: 嗯，天元山上充满未知之数，需养精蓄锐，再上山探索。
en: Jo finishes speaking and steps away. He walks to a place not far from you and waits for you there.

ch: 嘿嘿，你果然不同一般，没死在上面。快快快，告诉我山上是什么情形？
en: Wow. I know such an extraordinary cultivator like you will not perish on the Mountain. Come on, tell me what's going on there?

ch: 夜雨楼……她是琅琊阁主的大弟子……有一只当世罕见的青空重瞳……
en: Night Rain... She is the head disciple of the Master of the Pavilion... Her Sky Double Pupils are so special in the world...

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 当年我进入天元山勘踏由此察觉山中情况特异……
en: Years ago, I surveyed Tian Yuan Mountain and found the place strange... Therefore, I made my attempt to conjure space for the first time following the Mountain's features. Then, I got my connection to the ancient world with the technique and gave hints to cultivators, asking them to investigate Nether Air in Chi You...

ch: 是衡天命夜雨楼另外布置风水之局牵引八荒形势，导致冥气急剧泄露……
en: And Hengtian asked Night Rain to alter the Feng Shui in the world, leading Nether Air to rush out...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.

ch: 哈哈……多谢你告诉我这些，你继续上山吧。记得……记得再遇见什么尽可能下山告诉我……
en: Haha... Thank you for telling me these things, now you can continue to explore the Mountain. Remember... to let me know if you found anything noteworthy, please...

ch: 你来告诉我山上情况吗？李四洗耳恭听！
en: Do you come here to tell me what's going on there? Come on, I'm listening!

ch: 女娲……已经式微的盘古之血？！
en: Nuwa... That already declined Pangu blood?!

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 女娲是阁主捕捉的魔族之人，她体内盘古之血十分活泼，呈现即将觉醒之兆……
en: Nuwa is a Demon member caught by the Pavilion Master. Her Pangu blood was active at that time, and soon her strength would be awakened...

ch: 是……是我！当日是她先将我道心升华，我道心升华后再反过来刺激了她的盘古之血，让她正式觉醒！
en: It's... me! On that day, she promoted my Taoist Mind first, and my Taoist Mind activated her Pangu blood in turn, thus awakening her!

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.

ch: 朋友，快快上山，继续告诉我接下来的事情。
en: My friend, return to the Mountain now. I'm expecting what you can bring to me next time.

ch: 咳咳！你不是经过的吧？我知道的，你肯定是特意来告诉我上面情形。你来，给我好好说，细细说！
en: Ahem! You must come here for a reason, and I know you must find more secrets in the Mountain! Here, tell them to me!

ch: 苍龙……九族龙纹……创世元音……远古希声……
en: Black Dragon... The jade plate of Nine Dragons... Creating note... Ancient sound...

ch: 我和他是朋友吗？他总是装作一副崖岸自高的样子。
en: Is he my friend? He has always been, or always pretends to be, aloof.

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 与阁主决战那天，苍龙要我离开……我知道他在担心我……他还是留下来了……他舍弃了自己回归上界的机会，留下来帮我了……
en: Black Dragon wanted me to leave as we fought the last battle against the Pavilion Master... I knew he was worrying about me... He chose to stay there... He stayed there to help me at the cost of his chance to return to the upper realm...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.
Well... Black Dragon... Is he still there?

ch: 你……你上山……快上去……万万不能等了……
en: You, now... go to the Mountain quickly... right now...

ch: 你……你来做什么？我……我是谁……
en: Why... do you come here? Who... Who am I...

ch: 夜雨楼……她是琅琊阁主的大弟子……有一只当世罕见的青空重瞳……
en: Night Rain... She is the head disciple of the Master of the Pavilion... Her Sky Double Pupils are so special in the world...

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 当年我进入天元山勘踏由此察觉山中情况特异……于是效法天元山特性首度尝试构筑空间，后来利用这门秘术成功联络古时八荒，并给出提示请托修仙者进入赤幽州查探冥气之事……
en: Years ago, I surveyed Tian Yuan Mountain and found the place strange... Therefore, I made my attempt to conjure space for the first time following the Mountain's features. Then, I got my connection to the ancient world with the technique and gave hints to cultivators, asking them to investigate Nether Air in Chi You...

ch: 是衡天命夜雨楼另外布置风水之局牵引八荒形势，导致冥气急剧泄露……
en: And Hengtian asked Night Rain to alter the Feng Shui in the world, leading Nether Air to rush out...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.

ch: 呵呵……这是当年的事？你……你上山吧。我想静一静……
en: Eh... That's what happened at that time? You... can return to the Mountain. Now leave me alone...

ch: 为什么要这么做？难道他不知道这样一来我就会变成另外一个人吗？为什么要给禁止我进入……他究竟在想什么……
en: Why would he do it? Didn't he know I would grow into a different person under his decision? Why would he ban me from entering... What did he think about...

ch: 啊？！我记起来了……她就是狩仙子！
en: Ah?! I recalled her nickname... She is Hunting Fairy!

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 她是让后世仙盟日夜头痛的恐怖对手……是狩猎修仙者的杀手！
en: A dreadful opponent against Cultivator Alliance for generations... She became a grim huntress for cultivators!

ch: 这一切……都是因为琅琊阁主，将她捕获并强行灌输冥气……他是希望将狩仙子变成超越仙体的存在……
en: The Master of the Pavilion... made her transform by capturing her and infusing Nether Air into her... He wanted to shape that Hunting Fairy into someone more formidable than an immortal vessel...

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 你……还呆在这里干什么？你走！你走！快上山！
en: Why... are you still here? Go away! Go back to the Mountain!

ch: 我是谁？我……是被张三玩弄股掌上吗？不是真的……不是真的……
en: Who am I? Am I just a toy in Zhang San's hands? No... It's not true...

ch: 苍龙……九族龙纹……创世元音……远古希声……
en: Black Dragon... The jade plate of Nine Dragons... Creating note... Ancient sound...

ch: 我和他是朋友吗？他总是装作一副崖岸自高的样子。
en: Is he my friend? He has always been, or always pretends to be, aloof.

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 与阁主决战那天，苍龙要我离开……我知道他在担心我……他还是留下来了……他舍弃了自己回归上界的机会，留下来帮我了……
en: Black Dragon wanted me to leave as we fought the last battle against the Pavilion Master... I knew he was worrying about me... He chose to stay there... He stayed there to help me at the cost of his chance to return to the upper realm...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.
Well... Black Dragon... Is he still there?

ch: 事态紧急，你快上山，一刻、不，半刻也不能等了……
en: It's urgent. Go up to the Mountain right now. Quickly. Go there now...

ch: 李四设法施恩于我族，为的就是查明自己身上的谜团。\n我当初以为昭灵上祖昔年的占卜片段中或会找到李四的人生际遇的线索。只需将之设法调来，就能查知他的身世谜团。\n只万万没想到，李四正是作为重八征验的重要一环。是上祖仔细占卜推敲的其中一个重要人物，同时亦是影响八荒大陆命运走向的其中一个重要人物。
en: Jo did us a favor in exchange for a solution to his trouble.\nI used to believe that clues about Jo's past were included in the prophecy clips from Zhao Ling the ancestor, and all we needed to do was to sift through them.\nBut I failed to see another possibility: Jo plays a vital role in the murals. He is a significant figure in the ancestor's prophecy and one of the few persons who can change the course of our world.

ch:
李四想要知道的我都已经设法查明了。
只是怎么将他的身世转告于他这件事，却又让我犯了难。
李四一直在努力，努力改变自己的命运。
他认为无法进入天元山飞升是一个该死的弄人的命运。
但无法进入天元山不是他的命，一直引导修仙者前来才是他的命。
他无论如何都无法改变这点。一直努力改命的张三，竟给自己的年轻时的神念开了这么大一个玩笑。
en:
I have found the answers he wanted to know.
However, how could I tell him my findings?
Jo tries hard to change his fate.
He believes his despicable destiny is making fun of him by not letting him enter Tian Yuan Mountain to attain ascension.
No. His destiny is not being rejected by the Mountain but leading the way there for cultivators.
That's the fate he can never change. Zhang San, the challenger of his fate, sealed the fate of his young soul through such an arrangement.

ch:
李四于我族有恩，我应该告诉他此事。
可是告诉他此事，只会让他更加痛苦。
或者，不告诉他，才是最好的。
他要我为他查明一切，我已经为他查明了。
他对夸父族的好，夸父族已经报恩了。
剩下的不义，就由我个人来承担吧。
我要设下封印，禁止李四进入此处。如此一来，他就永远无法知道自己的过去了。
另，后人需另设封印，严防李四另寻他人代为查探我夸父一族秘境。
en:
Jo helped our clan, and I should repay him by answering his questions.
But my findings can only aggravate his depression.
Is it better to conceal the truth?
He asked me to investigate, and I did it.
I have repaid his favor to the Kuafu Clan.
I am prepared to risk my reputation. If someone thinks I'm eating my words, then let it be.
Now I'll set up a seal here and block Jo from entering. Therefore, his past will remain unknown to him forever.
PS. Jo may ask others to investigate the cave. Future clansmen should prevent him from doing it too.

ch:
前任族长你好，我受命来到这里镇守，打算好好干认真干的。可是如今夸父族人丁单薄，要将我召回并暂代族长之职。
原本我想等到你回来再动身离去，但是我发现了天上金乌的踪迹。
已经有好久好久没发现金乌的行踪了吧？找到金乌的话就有办法设法查知冥气特性了吧？
对不起，前任族长，我要擅离职守了。
en:
Greetings, former Chief! I was sent to guard the place, and I hoped I could do well. But now our clan's population is decreasing, and they want to have me back as an acting Chief.
I planned to wait for you here before I leave, but I found traces of Golden Crow soaring in the sky.
That holy creature has been unknown to us for so long, and I guess we can learn more about Nether Air if we find the Crow.
Pardon me, former Chief. Now the guardian must leave his post.

ch:
前任族长，我觉得报答李四的办法，是帮他戒酒。
他纯粹是因为心情不好，这才养成玩世不恭的性子以及四处买醉的坏习惯。我觉得这样对身体不好。
其实，我觉得这个叫李四的人能自己站起来的。
他没那么脆弱。
en:
Dear former Chief, I think the way to repay Jo is to help him quit drinking.
He acts mischievously and drinks away worries just because he's in a bad mood. I know alcohol hurts.
To be honest, I believe the man will get himself back on his feet.
He's not weak.

ch: 你来到李四所指的地方，但周围云遮雾罩，根本看不见四下情形。此时只有前方一点微弱光芒不断闪烁；
en: You follow Jo's instructions and find the place. However, everything around is covered by dense mists, and all you can see is but a faint point of light twinkling ahead.

ch: 你发现发出微弱光芒的竟是一个玲珑石盘。
en: You find a Feng Shui plate. The faint glow comes from it.

ch: 前方风水盘发出微弱光芒。
en: The Feng Shui plate is glowing faintly in front of you.

ch: 你解开风水盘后，周围云雾散去，却不料四下里竟出现大量妖物。这些妖物原本一动不动，此时慢慢活动开来，一起向你袭来。
en: You recovered the plate, and the dense mists dispersed, revealing herds of monsters waiting still around. These creatures start to move slowly, and in the next second, they pounce upon you.

ch: 你将妖物全部击败后，前方出现一个洞穴。你进入查探，只见里面放置三个奇特木盒。
en: A cave emerges before you after you defeated all monsters. You step into it and find there are three curious wooden caskets.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 只见李四醉在酒馆之中，他口角流出酒浆，在桌面聚成一滩，而失去意识的他嘴里还念念有词，正说着什么。
en: You see Jo in a tavern. He leans forward on a table amid a pool of liquor dripping from his mouth. He is murmuring unconsciously.

ch: 别人都能进入天元山中，为什么就我不能……？
en: Why can others enter Tian Yuan Mountain, but I can't?

ch: 我哪里不好了？我修炼十年就突破至悟道之境，已经快过多少修仙者了？
en: Am I slow-witted? I reach Enlightenment after only ten years of cultivation. Isn't it a deed second to but a few cultivators?

ch: 还有，还有，我四方行侠，生平光明磊落，最多也就卖两个聚气丸，赚赚酒钱。这么好的人，哪找了？
en: And am I evil-minded? I am a righteous man who is always willing to help others. The most outrageous thing I have done is just selling Qi Refining Pills to new cultivators. Is there a man as good as me?

ch: 为什么就是进不去天元山？？？飞升……飞升是修仙者梦寐以求之事，我也不例外……
en: Why? Why can't I enter Tian Yuan Mountain? Cultivators all want to ascend to Immortal Realm, and... so do I...

ch: 李四糊糊涂涂的说了一通，终于头一歪，睡倒在桌面之上。
en: Jo continues to babble for a while. Then, his head droops to the tabletop. He falls into a drunken dream.

ch: 木盒投射的虚象慢慢消失，其后自行关闭，与取得之时，更无异样。
en: The views fade away, and the casket closes automatically. Now it looks like an ordinary object with nothing special.

ch: 木盒投射的虚象慢慢消失，其后自行关闭。你一一查看这些木盒，发现最后一个里面并未保存虚像片段，而是放着两封书信。而其中一封较为老旧，边角已然泛黄。另外一封纸质顺滑，恍如白绢，应是新近写就。
en: The views fade away, and the casket closes automatically. You check out each casket and find the last one contains something different. Inside the casket are not clips of past events but two letters. One of them has been worn out by time, its margins tainted in light brown. Another one is still clean and white like a piece of satin; maybe it was written in just a few days.

ch: 这个盒子之中，似乎藏有许多事件的片段……难道这就是李四当日请托高人为自己占卜未来的映像吗？
en: The casket seems to contain many clips of the past... Do they have something to do with the divination of Jo's future made by the incredible person he found?

ch: 这就回去天元山吧？若有时间亦不妨查看木盒，此物似乎内有乾坤。
en: Maybe it's time to return to Tian Yuan Mountain. I'd like to further inspect the caskets if I have time since they may contain some more secrets.

ch: 你打开木盒，里面瞬间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Views float out and unfold before you.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 只见张三正于一个细小岛屿上与身边的青色之龙侃侃而谈。
en: You see Zhang San standing on a little island. He is talking to the dark-colored dragon at his side.

ch: 我跟你说，三神念中，主神已无人欲，仅存天理，心地光明，勇于牺牲。跟我真的就是一模一样！
en: Do you know? Among the three guys, the Master Soul has turned from worldly, petty demands to the ultimate justice of the universe. He is enlightened and is ready to sacrifice himself. He's just like me!

ch: 哼，心地光明，勇于牺牲？亏你说得出口。亚神呢？他又是一个怎么样的人？
en: Hmph. Enlightened and ready to sacrifice? What a shameless boast. And what about the Senior Soul?

ch: 嘿嘿，亚神猛志犹存，对飞升有着热枕，但也知道自己对八荒负有责任。他会努力达成目标，但不会勉强而为，更多是因势利导。
en: Ha. The Senior Soul is still ambitious. He seeks the way to ascension, but he does not shun his duty to tend the world as well. He pursues his goal in a flexible yet persistent manner and makes use of all occasions encountered.

ch: 绕了一圈，还是在夸赞自己。哼，既然如此，想必次神定也完美无缺了？
en: Again, what a shameless, paraphrased boast. Well, I guess the third one, the Junior Soul, is also a perfect figure.

ch: 不，次神缺点可多了。我甚至觉得有些惊讶，我年轻之时竟是这么一个人吗？简直就是一个愣头青啊！
en: No. He has many shortcomings. Sometimes I even feel astonished, unable to believe he is just the young me. He is a real daredevil!

ch: 如今回头看，心中实在有些惊讶。年轻的我，对飞升竟怀有如此大的热情，而且对周围的事情充满好奇，乃至四处探索。哼，还会因为呈口舌之利，得罪旁人。这不是我，这不是我！
en: But my feeling is understandable if I inspect him from the eyes of a weathered man. When I was young, I was infatuated with the possibility of ascension as well as the world. I used to travel and explore, driven by pure curiosity. And I even annoyed many people just because I wanted to quarrel and argue. No, he's not me!

ch: 嗯，从前我最痛恨的就是那些啰嗦不堪的修仙者，我心中不痛快了，总要引动天雷劈死这些烦人的东西。幸好当年没遇上你，否则你可能已成了一具焦炭了。
en: Yes. In the past, I hated those talkative cultivators the most. Every time when I was upset, I always struck some of them to death with lightning bolts. Good to know you're not one of those poor beings.

ch: 你别打岔，我们继续聊这三清秘法。你想，遇到事情，如果任由年轻的我来决定，就会做出许多鲁莽之事。若由如今的我作决定呢，太过成熟，对任何事情都要考虑周全，又会错失许多良机。
en: We may talk about them later. Now you see my intention in using the secret technique of Qi Triplication? My young soul is too reckless to make a sensible decision, but the one here and now is too conservative and thoughtful to catch a fleeting opportunity.

ch: 次神主神，各处一极端，会因此争执不下，若任由其中一方取胜，我做出的决定都有可能不理性，这个时候，亚神就会出现居中调和，指出主神和次神的好处，也会说二人的不好。
en: The Master and the Junior Souls are incompatible in handling matters, and they always quarrel. I couldn't make a sensible decision with only one of them, and then, the Senior Soul will come as a mediator. He will make comments focusing on both their advantages and disadvantages.

ch: 如此说来，竟是亚神最重要了？
en: I see. Do you mean the Senior Soul is the most important one?

ch: 那也不然。有时候可能是次神和亚神在争吵，主神来调和双方。有时候则是亚神与主神闹出矛盾，最后由次神平息干戈。当然也有可能三个人都在争。
en: Well, no. Sometimes the Senior Soul quarrels with the Junior, and the Master Soul is the mediator. Sometimes the Master Soul disagrees with the Senior, and the Junior Soul finds a reconciliation between them. Sometimes the three all engage in a disputation.

ch: 哼，有趣，三清秘法是将你自身年轻、中年、以及现在三个时期的神念分离。三个时期的自己，都有着各自的立场想法，三个自己都是独特的，他们俱有不足，也各有长处。他们互相纠错，让你尽量做出最好的选择？
en: Sounds fascinating. Your secret technique allows you to divide your soul into three, and the three fellows are yourself as a young man, a middle-aged man, and the one here and now. The three souls all have their feelings and standings as well as imperfect but unique personalities, and you may get insights into making decisions through their debates. Am I right?

ch: 你刚才发动此法，是在做什么重大的决定吗？
en: I see you just used it. Are you facing a big decision?

ch: 究竟何事，不妨说来，我也可以给点意见。
en: You can tell me, and I may help you as well.

ch: 我觉得大可不必，三神念给出了各自的意见。当时次神认为，既遇良友，当浮一大白。主神则现身反对，他以为喝酒乱性，勿如不饮。亚神则说，良友不可辜负，酒亦不该痛饮，但可小酌两杯，借此怡情。
en: Thanks, but the debate among the three is enough. The Junior Soul says nothing pleases him more than to drink with close friends, but the Master Soul disagrees with him. He says alcohol exposes one's innermost nature and is not a good stuff to be consumed. The Senior Soul points out that we may treat the close friend with mellow liquor, provided that we refrain from booze. Moderate drinking strengthens our ties.

ch: 喝酒？你借三清之法，决此无聊之事？！
en: Have a drink? Is it so important that you must let the three souls debate?!

ch: 哈哈，今日没有比这更重要的事了。既遇良友，当浮一大白！走吧，我们去喝两盅。
en: Haha. It is the biggest decision to be made now. Nothing pleases me more than to drink with close friends! Let's go for some liquor.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 只见张三正在对着两个人影在说话。
en: You see Zhang San speaking to two figures.

ch: 真是抱歉，最后还是没能一举击败衡天。如今只好行险一搏，希望由后来者打败衡天吧。接下来，我将以自身为媒介设下结界封印衡天，与此同时，我会暂时堵塞天元山的连通原时间的通道。
en: Sadly, we failed to defeat Hengtian in the end, and now we could only take the last resort and count on other master cultivators. Next, I'll set up an array to seal our enemy using myself as material, and I'll temporarily block Tian Yuan Mountain's passage to its original time.

ch: 自此，天元山通道将接通约一万年前。然后，我要在远古的八荒召唤修为高深的修仙者前来天元山中终结衡天，终结这一切。而我一旦施法，自己也将化为齑粉。不过在此之前，我将会以一气化三清之法将自己神念分离开去。
en: After it is done, the passage will lead to Tian Yuan Mountain existing 100,000 years ago. Then, I'll summon master cultivators from the ancient world here to end our enemy, as well as the disturbance. The spell to be used is consuming, and I'll be reduced to ashes once cast. However, I can divide my soul into three before that by a secret technique called Qi Triplication.

ch: 以三清之法将尔等分离后，你们都会有自己的历练和遭遇，然后不再是我。这对于你们是极为不公的。
en: After I divided my soul into three, both of you will have your own unique experience. You may develop into persons entirely different from me, and I know it's unfair.

ch: 然而眼前是对付衡天的最后机会，事急从权，只好行险一搏。作为中年的我，对于心中认定的事情已无疑惑，当能好好贯彻我的想法，因此我希望你留存于八荒之中，不断搜寻合适的修仙大能，召唤他们来到天元山中。
en: However, now we must take the last opportunity to defeat Hengtian by following a risky decision. You're the middle-aged me, and I know you are determined to carry out what I am planning since all doubts concerning your beliefs have been clarified. Therefore, I'll put you into Ghost Valley. You need to search for master cultivators there and tell them to go to Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 年轻的我，对任何事都锐意进取，定能将引导修仙者来到天元山的事情做好。
en: You're the young me. I know you are always adventurous, and I believe that you will be a great guide in leading the way to Tian Yuan Mountain for cultivators.

ch: 正在此时，张三中年的虚影发出了疑问。
en: Zhang San's middle-aged figure begins to ask something upon hearing it.

ch: 你的担忧不无道理。我也有过考虑，因此我给年轻神念的任务不是引导修仙者前来天元山协助我。而是忠于自己心底的愿望，设法飞升。
en: Indeed. I also thought about it, and I chose another mission for my young soul. He will just pursue his ambition to attain ascension rather than introduce cultivators to Tian Yuan Mountain to help me.

ch: 但我会给他落下禁制，禁止年轻的我进入天元山中。他心怀飞升之念，却又无法进入，一定会千方百计查明其中缘由，因此他会不断的为我指引修仙者前来。
en: But I will ban him from entering Tian Yuan Mountain. He wants to rise to the Immortal Realm, but he can't get close to the key secret of it. Therefore, he must be curious about the reason behind the ban, and in order to solve it, he will ask numerous cultivators to climb up to the Mountain for him and for me.

ch: 张三中年的虚影正在沉吟，年轻的虚影则在请缨。
en: The middle-aged Zhang San is thinking about something. Meanwhile, you see the young soul offering himself to a task.

ch: 你，或者说是年轻的我，最后会慢慢成长变为另外一个人，你会觉得被命运捉弄，十分痛苦。而且此事只要一日不曾解决，你就会一直留在这个痛苦的漩涡之中。
en: You, the young me, will become a person different from the man here and now. You will feel betrayed by fate and live in desperation as long as the problem has not been solved.

ch: 此事对你，其实十分残忍……
en: I know it's cruel for you...

ch: 虚影似乎发出了共识，均在不断点头。
en: The figures are nodding. They seem to reach a consensus.

ch: 传播道心，拯救八荒。不错，这才是眼前最重要的事。
en: Promote Taoist Minds to save the world. Yes. It's the most important thing to do now.

ch: 你打开木盒，里面瞬间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Views float out and unfold before you.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 只见李四醉在酒馆之中，他口角流出酒浆，在桌面聚成一滩，而失去意识的他嘴里还念念有词，正说着什么。
en: You see Jo in a tavern. He leans forward on a table amid a pool of liquor dripping from his mouth. He is murmuring unconsciously.

ch: 别人都能进入天元山中，为什么就我不能……？
en: Why can others enter Tian Yuan Mountain, but I can't?

ch: 我哪里不好了？我修炼十年就突破至悟道之境，已经快过多少修仙者了？
en: Am I slow-witted? I reach Enlightenment after only ten years of cultivation. Isn't it a deed second to but a few cultivators?

ch: 还有，还有，我四方行侠，生平光明磊落，最多也就卖两个聚气丸，赚赚酒钱。这么好的人，哪找了？
en: And am I evil-minded? I am a righteous man who is always willing to help others. The most outrageous thing I have done is just selling Qi Refining Pills to new cultivators. Is there a man as good as me?

ch: 为什么就是进不去天元山？？？飞升……飞升是修仙者梦寐以求之事，我也不例外……
en: Why? Why can't I enter Tian Yuan Mountain? Cultivators all want to ascend to Immortal Realm, and... so do I...

ch: 李四糊糊涂涂的说了一通，终于头一歪，睡倒在桌面之上。
en: Jo continues to babble for a while. Then, his head droops to the tabletop. He falls into a drunken dream.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 李兄，似你这般狂饮滥醉，修为再高也禁不住伤了自家。
en: Brother Jo, your cultivation is profound indeed, but heavy drinking hurts.
Shut up and get away from me!

ch: 李兄，你的为难我都知道。人各有命……
en: Brother Jo, I am with you. People have their own fates...

ch: 人各有命？！你说什么？！这是我的命吗？！
en: Own fates?! Mind your words! Is this my fate?

ch: 你敢再说一遍？！看我不拿老大耳刮子打烂你的狗嘴！
en: How dare you speak like that! Repeat it, and I'll give you a slap on the face!

ch: 李兄，你可以做的事情还有很多很多。何必在这自暴自弃？！这不是我认识的李四！
en: Brother Jo, there are still many other goals waiting for you. Why do you abandon yourself here?! You're not the man I have known!

ch: 你认识的李四？你真的认识李四？你知道我吗？！你知道个屁！你们，你们这些蠢货，至少还有个念想，可我就是进不去天元山。我还能做什么？！
en: The man you have known? Do you really know Jo? Do you think you understand me? No! At least you, and your fellow fools, can hope to attain ascension, but Tian Yuan Mountain rejects me no matter how hard I try. What should I do?!

ch: 嘿嘿，我还能跑到天元山里面，被雷劈死，被火烧死，被水淹死，被石头埋死！！！命，我跟你说，这就是我的命！！！
en: Well, I know. I can enter Tian Yuan Mountain and get struck by lightning bolts, burnt with flames, drowned in torrents, and buried under stones! Do you see? Fate, that's my fate!

ch: 李四歇斯底里的说完这话，双膝一跪，趴在地上嚎啕大哭。他双眼泪水如注，流个不停，伤心难过，已到极处。
en: Jo yells out his words and kneels down. He curls to the ground and begins to cry. Bitter teardrops flow through his face.

ch: 你打开了木盒，光影从中闪出，眨眼间投射出无数虚象。
en: You open the casket. Beams of light emit from it, and views begin to unfold before you.

ch: 哎呦哎哟，头可真痛，昨晚……我发酒疯了吗？
en: Well, my head aches. Did I... have a drunken fit last night?

ch: 哈？你看我这不是废话吗？真抱歉，给你添麻烦了。
en: Eh... No need to answer. Sorry for any inconvenience.

ch: 迷惘之际，的确需要将心中苦水全部吐了出来，才能继续往前走。
en: Sometimes we all need to say everything if we want to live to the next day.

ch: 往前走……是的，我又没入土为安，还得向前看，往前走。多谢你，好兄弟。
en: Live to the next day... Indeed. I should never abandon my hope as long as I am alive. Thank you, my dude.

ch: 我艰难的时候你扶了我一把，现在你需要旁人帮助了，我正好还你人情。
en: You helped me in my dark days. Now I'm repaying your kindness with my assistance.

ch: 你还不了的，你都不知道那时候的你，就像一坨泥，扶都扶不起来。
en: How can you repay it? You were dejected like a spread of mud, and it took me many efforts to uplift you.

ch: 还得了的，你都不知道昨晚的你，就像一坨屎，我碰都不想碰，不过最后还是碰了。
en: I can repay it. Last night you lay on the ground motionlessly like a pile of dung, and it took me no fewer efforts to carry you back.

ch: 你他……嘿嘿……好锋利的嘴巴，好尖锐的舌头！李四认栽了！
en: What the... Well, what a clever reply. You win.

ch: 一向滑稽玩世的李四目视前方，他眼神之中，不自觉流露出一丝惘然，但很快又变得十分坚毅，最后终于笑逐颜开，再次显出李四式招牌表情。
en: You see Jo gazing into the distance. In the mischievous swordsman's eyes, you find a hint of hesitation, then sparks of determination. He smiles again - his characteristic hilarity returns.

ch: 我要设法查明自己不能进入天元山的原因。我进不去天元山的话，就找资质卓绝的修仙者代我进去看，进去查！
en: I will try my best to find out why I couldn't enter Tian Yuan Mountain. If it is inaccessible to me, I'll ask other talented cultivators to enter it and find out the reason for me!

ch: 如果老天非要与我开玩笑，我就违逆天意，改变命运！
en: If my destiny betrays me, I will rewrite it!

ch: 这话听着有点意思，这才是我认识的李四嘛！你不妨多找些资质卓绝的修仙者，我这里多的是聚气丸！都可以给你去坑他们！
en: That's it! That's the man I have known, Jo! You can search for more talented cultivators and sell them Qi Refining Pills! I have piles of them, and if you like, you can just peddle your pills at a higher price and see who'll be duped into buying them!

ch: 胡说！我是在他们最需要帮助的时候，提供帮助！
en: Nonsense! I am helping those who're in direst need!

ch: 只见一名身段曼妙、容貌美丽的女子俏立前方。她一双眼中放出疑惑的目光，正不断打量着你。而从她投来目光的眼睛中可见，此女有一眼珠，内含重瞳，不同一般。
en: A slim and gorgeous woman is standing in front of you. She looks puzzled as she checks you out. What's special about this woman is that one of her eyes has double pupils.

ch: 天元山中，满布凶险，再往前行，恐遭不测。若从此过，还盼道友仔细考虑……
en: Going into Tian Yuan Mountain is like walking on a knife-edge. Go any further and you may get yourself killed. So think twice if you want to pass here, Cultivator...

ch: 以我推断，山中此时有两股强大力量正在交锋，贸然前行，恐怕会遭池鱼之殃。
en: You know what? There are now two powerful forces fighting in the mountain. It won't do you any good if you go there.

ch: 寻常之人无法轻易进入天元山，敢问阁下如何来到此处？
en: Strange. Ordinary people usually can't access Tian Yuan Mountain. How did you get here?

ch: 奇怪，天元山结界已成，山中通道指向万年以前，莫非此人也是……
en: The array in Tian Yuan Mountain has finished, and the path inside the Mountain leads to the world 100,000 years ago. Is this person also...

ch: 原来如此。想必阁下也是当初进入“鬼谷”后，被一名白发苍苍的老者指引来此。
en: I see. You're here because a grey-haired old man showed you the way after you entered Ghost Valley, right?

ch: 飞升？那阁下来得实在不巧。天元山飞上关口目前已经堵塞关闭。
en: Ascension? Bad timing then. The ascension gateway at Tian Yuan Mountain is now blocked and closed.

ch: 我？我与你一样，当初进入“鬼谷”，受一名白发老者指引前来。
en: Me? Like you, I was also told to come here by that old man after I entered Ghost Valley.

ch: 八荒修士，无一不盼望得道飞升。我有心问道，经历千辛万苦来到此处，才发现天元山上两股极强大的力量正互相纠缠争持，也是这两股力量导致天元山飞升关口堵塞关闭。
en: All cultivators in this world long for achieving ascension. I've been in search of the Tao and going through a lot to get here. But two powerful forces are at war here right now. That's why the gateway is blocked and closed.

ch: 如我所料不差，天元山顶，应有两位八荒至强的修仙者彼此角力。那便是琅琊阁主，以及张三。
en: As I expected, two of the most powerful cultivators in this world may be having a duel on the top of Tian Yuan Mountain. They are the Master of the Pavilion and Zhang San.

ch: 两位大能，都是天下数一数二的人物。不过二人因为飞升的方法，产生了极大分歧，因此争执不下。
en: These two grandmasters are the best fighters of all time, but they disagree over how to achieve ascension. Hence the duel.

ch: 他们一日没得定论，无法施展各自的飞升大计，八荒的飞升关口就始终无法打开。唉，我认为我们作为后来者，最重要的便是选定其中一位前辈，然后出手全力协助。
en: As long as they don't come to a conclusion and are unable to achieve ascension, the ascension gateway in this world will remain closed. Alas, our priority now is to choose one of them and do our best to assist him.

ch: 只要他们的飞升大计能够施展开来，那么飞升关口的开启，就有望了。
en: When they proceed on their way to ascension, the opening of the ascension gateway will be within reach.

ch: 只不过，他们二人都各有各的道理，这却叫人好生为难。
en: But now, they both have a good point about ascension, so I don't know which one to choose.

ch: 呵呵，也难怪道友不知。我也是来到这里才将一切想明白的。记得我们从永宁州一路走来时在大城之中看见的琅琊阁吗？
en: Well. It's normal for you not to realize the fact, and so do I. I became aware of what was going on only after I came here. Remember the buildings called Manual Pavilion in towns and cities since we began our journey in Yong Ning?

ch: 衡天便是琅琊阁背后的真正主人，不过他一直醉心探求天地大道，因此隐居不出。他亲自尝试与冥气接触，由此悟出以冥气提升修为，突破至羽化登仙之境的法门。
en: The Master of the Manual Pavilion is Hengtian. He lives in seclusion, immersing himself in exploring the true path of our world. He tried to make contact with the Nether Air and gained insights on how to improve cultivation with it and to reach Reborn and Transcendent realms.

ch: 除此，阁主还将自己的修炼心得公开，让众多修仙者得窥门径，提升修为，并一举进入羽化登仙之境。我偶尔会想，八荒修仙者从阁主手中得到好处，实在太多太多了。
en: Besides, the Pavilion Master also published much of the knowledge acquired from his cultivation, and his insights did help many peer cultivators reach the highest realms. Yes, we cultivators have benefited so much from the Master of the Pavilion.

ch: 阁下似乎脸现疑惑，可是仍有疑问？
en: Any other questions? You seem to be puzzled.

ch: 阁主的飞升之道别开蹊径，让修仙者与冥气共存，使修为大幅提高，从而增加八荒的整体修为。
en: The Pavilion Master provides a unique method to attain ascension. That is, to let cultivators achieve coexistence with the Nether Air. The cultivators may gain considerable power from it, and the world's overall cultivation will also increase.

ch: 只要有越来越多的人从阁主的秘籍中得到启发，增进修为，越来越多的人从凝结冥羽的法子，突破羽化登仙。那么总有一日，八荒的飞升关窍就会打开。
en: The gateway to ascension will open as long as cultivators continue to gain insights from the manuals written by the Pavilion Master and make their breakthrough into Reborn and Transcendent with the method of condensing Nether Feathers.

ch: 阁主高瞻远瞩，不拘一格，还公开自己修炼心得。其胸襟之广，遗惠之多，实在叫我佩服不已。
en: Besides, the Pavilion Master is also a generous man with acute foresight. He has published the knowledge derived from his cultivation, and we all benefited from it. Our Master is indeed an unparalleled figure.

ch: 张三希望通过传播道心，设法拼凑道源本体，让修仙者借此感悟道源，从而得道。
en: Zhang San hopes that by promoting the Taoist Mind, he would manage to reach the true form of the source of the Tao so that cultivators could use it to learn about the source and attain the Tao eventually.

ch: 这个方法倒是稳妥。但是，道源本体究竟是什么样的，没人知道；道心作为道源分化的碎片究竟是什么，也没人能弄明白。
en: It sounds feasible. But no one knows what the true form is like, and no one can figure out what the Taoist Mind, as a fragment of the source of the Tao, really is.

ch: 阁下可是还有其他疑问？
en: Do you have any other questions?

ch: 唉，两位前辈的飞升之法各有各的好处，真是令人难以抉择。只不过，我来此山后，发现了另外一个大秘密……
en: Alas, both of their ways of achieving ascension have their own advantages. It's a tough choice. But after I came to this mountain, I discovered another huge secret...

ch: 万物由成而毁，八荒也不例外。如今离灭世终局已经不远。
en: All things are born to die, and this world is no exception. The end is in sight.

ch: 因此在我看来，阁主的飞升之道或更切实际一些。唉，也许是我作为八荒修仙者，从练气到登仙，实在受了太多阁主的好处，所以偏向他了吧。
en: So if you ask me, the way of achieving ascension advocated by the Master of the Pavilion is more practical. Alas, maybe I take his side because I've benefited a lot from him in my training to be a Transcendent cultivator.
Who do you think I should choose?

ch: 嗯，你跟我想到一块去了。
en: I can't believe we think alike.

ch: 的确。如今张三便认为阁主以冥气提升修仙者修为极大限度扼杀了道心，使他无法开展自己凭借道心触及道源的大计，便出手封印阁主。
en: You're right. Zhang San thinks that the Master of the Pavilion has undermined the Taoist Mind by using the Nether Air to enhance cultivation, making it impossible for Zhang San to access the source of the Tao with his Taoist Mind. That's why he seeks to seal the Master.

ch: 坦白说，张三的做法，我也不太认同。既然你也这么认为，那我便帮助阁主脱困好了。否则阁主被封印一日，八荒飞升的大事业就得耽误一日。
en: I don't like what Zhang San does. I'm going to help the Master out of the seal. Otherwise, the ascension gateway in this world will never be opened.

ch: 道友，事不宜迟，这就快快上山救援阁主吧？嗯，不过这天元山中处处都是危机，你独身闯关未免太过危险。这样好了，此枚辟魔丹，吞服之后可以增强自身实力。请你服下后，再继续闯关吧。
en: Cultivator, the road ahead is bumpy, and going into Tian Yuan Mountain is like walking on a knife-edge. Here is a rare Exorciser Elixir. Eat it and you'll be much stronger. Then go up the mountain, and we'll save the Master of the Pavilion together.

ch: 我自登山以来受到山上镇守的神兽追击，受了轻伤，因此这才退在此处，休养生息，等候伤愈再重新上山。
en: The divine beasts guarding the mountain have been after me since I arrived. I'm injured and have to stay here to recuperate. But I'll continue my way up when I'm fully recovered.

ch: 我个人飞升事小，但救援阁主事大，请道友不必以我为念，快快服下丹药，排除万难，上山营救阁主。
en: Saving the Master is way more important than achieving ascension myself. Don't worry about me. Just take the elixir and go up the mountain.

ch: 我手中灵药，天下间仅此一枚，服下实是无上福缘。
en: This miraculous elixir is unique in this world. Only the most blessed person has the chance to take it.

ch: 夜雨楼将丹药递到你手，娇美的脸上露出笑意，似乎十分期待你的决定。
en: Night Rain puts the elixir into your hands and watches you swallow it. You see a charming smile spread across her face.

ch: 抱歉，其实我一直在提防你。不过既然阁下待我以真诚，我也没必要再旁敲侧击试探于你。
en: Well, I must say that I have been watching you till now. However, now that I have seen your sincerity, I think I don't need any indirect approaches.

ch: 其实我是阁主座下弟子夜雨楼，在此乃是为了营救我师。张三为人狡猾多诈，师父当日来会，我就知道他会设下毒计，埋伏我师。
en: I am Night Rain, a disciple under the Master of the Manual Pavilion. I come here to rescue my Master. Zhang San is always insidious, and I know he would ambush my Master on that day when they met.

ch: 我不放心师父独自前来，因此暗中跟随师父，一同来到天元山中。只不料，张三神通广大，封印师父的同时，竟有余力将我也一并封印在此。
en: My Master decided to come here alone, but I followed him and entered Tian Yuan Mountain as well. However, Zhang San commands a power so formidable that he not only sealed my Master here but also me.

ch: 如今我在山中进退不得，只好一直截杀上山修仙者，为师父破困排除障碍。张三不易对付，因此这枚丹药尤其重要。只可惜，这枚丹药有一个不好，那便是生效太慢。
en: Now I am trapped in the Mountain and can only help my Master to break the seal by killing cultivators who dare to visit. It's hard to defeat Zhang San, but it would be easier with the elixir. However, there is a shortcoming in it - the elixir will be effective only after a while.

ch: 药效发挥效果十分缓慢，若想迅速获得实力上的增强，需另加引导。这样吧，你我交手切磋。我借机传法，让你生成气运，催化药力。如此一来，你就能立即吸收丹药中的力量了。
en: The elixir kicks in very slowly, so if you want to become stronger quickly, you'll need some instructions. How about this? You and I will spar with each other and I'll pass on to you a trick to generate a destiny for you to immediately take in the power from the elixir.

ch: 不服？哼，看来你终究是个心腹之患。
厉害，莫说如今我有伤在身，就算全盛之时，要想取胜只怕也不易。这是刚刚我与你交手时使用的气运，你与我接战数回，应有领悟。如今附于你身，希望能为你提供一点帮助。
en: Awesome. Even if I were not injured, it wouldn't be easy for me to win. So, this is the destiny I used when I fought against you just now. I'm sure you already know something about it. Now it's attached to your body, and I hope you'll find it helpful.

ch: 是吗？可我总觉得张三罔顾八荒安危，私心太重。你想想，道心究竟是什么，根本没人能说明白，张三的法子也没能很显著的提高八荒整体修为。反观阁主之法，已经惠及八荒无数修仙者。八荒的整体实力已不断提升，让八荒山海界不断接近道源。
en: Is that so? But Zhang San always strikes me as somebody who's selfish and has no regard for the stability of this world. Think about it. No one knows what the Taoist Mind is about, and Zhang San's method doesn't prove effective in empowering cultivators. But the Master's method does. Thanks to him, the overall strength of cultivators in this world has been on the rise, allowing us to get ever closer to the source of the Tao.

ch: 最关键的是，八荒终极灭世，已经不远。眼前最急切的就是打开飞升关口，让能够飞升的人尽量离开八荒，飞升脱劫。
en: The most important thing is that the end of this world is in sight. We need to open the ascension gateway as soon as possible so that those who can achieve ascension will find their way out.

ch: 可是，张三……为了验证自己的道心之说，却平白无故的让全八荒的生灵都担上风险。
en: But Zhang San... is putting all the beings of this world at risk just because he wants to validate his theory of the Taoist Mind.

ch: 嗯，知道这些以后，要是给你选，你会帮助谁呢？
不得已，只好把你留在这里了。
en: Hmmm... Is that so? Then I guess I have to leave you here.

ch: 我身为阁主弟子，绝不允许宵小之辈登上山巅，骚扰我师。
en: As a disciple of the Master of the Pavilion, I've got to stop petty challengers from reaching the Mountain's top and defeating my Master.

ch: 屈指一算，来到这里的修仙者已有二十二名，他们都已一一被我处理掉了。而你，将是第二十三名！
en: 22 cultivators have arrived and I've killed all of them. You will be the 23rd!

ch: 哼，本事不错。为何非要与张三作一党，为虎作伥？
en: Hmph, not bad. Why do you gang up with Zhang San? He's evil!

ch: 这里是一枚丹药，服下之后即可增强实力，但同时你体内灵力的也受我牵引。
en: Here's an elixir that can make you stronger, but at the same time, the Energy in your body will be under my control.

ch: 若你协助我阁救援阁主，此丸对你实有说不尽的好处。当然，你也会受到我把持，若你有所异动，我发动药引，你立即灵力溃散，化为人干。
en: If you join me in rescuing the Master, you'll benefit a great deal from this elixir while also being subject to my control. Once you seek to break off from it, I'll activate the elixir, and your Energy will immediately disintegrate, turning you into a mummy.

ch: 你若愿意服下此药，即是对我阁忠心。
en: If you agree to take this elixir, that means you pledge allegiance to our Pavilion.

ch: 我提醒你一句，协助张三绝无生路，救援我师，他一旦脱困定必将生平所学倾囊相授，假以时日，更是携手飞升，好处说之不尽。
en: Let me remind you that there's no way out for you if you join forces with Zhang San. But if you manage to rescue my Master, he'll teach you everything he knows and you may reach ascension together with him. That would be a great achievement.

ch: 是生是死，成龙成蛇，都在你一念之间！作抉择吧！
en: So, to live or to die? Be a hero or a rogue? It's up to you!

ch: 迷途知返，总还算是个聪明人。服下丹药便快快上山，为我琅琊阁尽力效忠，救援我师。
en: Very well. You've made the right choice. Now take the elixir and go up to the mountain. Be loyal to our Manual Pavilion and rescue my Master.

ch: 此药既是天下间最有益的灵丹，也是最阴损的毒药。你把这话记好了，然后赶紧上山救助我师吧。
en: Remember, this is the best elixir and the worst poison. Now go to the mountain to save the Master.

ch: 再作耽误，受苦的不但是我师，亦是八荒所有生灵。
en: More hesitation and my Master and all the creatures in this world will suffer.

ch: 执迷不悟！既是如此，便让你见识一下，我青空重瞳的真正实力！
en: You've made the wrong choice! Fine, now I'll have to show you what my Sky Double Pupils are capable of!

ch: 天真。张三为一己私心，以天下性命，八荒安危为胁，你如何就想不到？
en: How naive! How could you not tell that Zhang San is a selfish man and a threat to the entire world?!

ch: 冥顽不灵的东西，我久不以重瞳杀人，今日正好拿你开刀试锋！受死吧！
en: What a moron! I haven't used my double pupils to kill for quite some time. Take that!

ch: 夜雨楼败于你手，最终倒下身来。她倚在地上，双眼泪流如注。
en: Night Rain has lost to you and collapsed. She's lying on the ground and crying.

ch: 眼前女子眼中似乎有着无限伤心，她嘴巴轻轻念叨着什么，你仔细一听，那仿佛是在说：“是弟子……没用……没能将对手全部拦下……
en: This woman in front of you is wallowing in sadness. She's whispering something to herself. You listen carefully and she seems to be saying: \"Master, I'm... useless... I didn't stop all the opponents...\"

ch: “师父……师父……我什么时候才能回到你身边去？”
en: \"Master... Master... when will I ever go back to you?\"

ch: “师父……还记得那个你在阁中小楼想事的雨夜吗？我怕吵着你，大气不敢透，只得站在你背后……”
en: \"Master... do you still remember that rainy night when you were staying in the small pavilion? I was so afraid of disturbing you that I didn't even dare to speak. I just stood behind you..\"

ch: “凭栏君不语，夜雨淅淅，春风带我入小楼……低眉轻弄弦，不敢惊袖……不敢抬头……”
en: \"By the fence, the gentleman did not speak. The night rain was drizzling, and the spring breeze brought me into the small pavilion... Lowering my eyes and fiddling with the strings, afraid to interrupt... afraid to raise look up..\"

ch: 夜雨楼口中念念有词，素手从怀中探出一支木簪，她尽最后的力气深深的看了木簪一眼后，手便软倒在水上。而木簪亦从她掌中落下，沿着水流慢慢飘到你身前。
en: The moony Night Rain talks to herself and looks heartbroken. She leaves.

ch: 夜雨楼还想伸手抓住簪子，但手臂只微微一抬就无力垂下了。只见眼前之人缓缓合上双眼，一下子便失去生机了。
恭喜道友，贺喜道友，这夜女贼一直在半山上截击来到天元山上的修仙者。若非道友驾临并将之击败，只怕这女贼还会残害无数修仙者。
en: Congratulations, cultivator. That woman was always halfway up the mountain to stop cultivators from going up. If it weren't for you, she would probably kill even more people.

ch: 这个……唉，在下当年来到天元山中，遭到拦截，我不敌这个女魔头，别无他法便对她虚与委蛇，设法套取信任，以求机会离开此地。
en: I... Alas, I came to Tian Yuan Mountain back then and was stopped and defeated. I had no choice but to fake it to win her trust in order to get out of here.

ch: 当日我假意投诚之际，女魔头胁迫我吞下一丸毒丹。如今女魔头已死，在下这便打算前往魔头的魔窟搜索一番设法取得解药。
en: I pretended to be loyal to her and she forced me to take a poisonous elixir. Now that this demon woman is dead, I'll go to her cave and find the antidote.
Do you know where the cave is?

ch: 女魔头虽然厉害，却有个缺点，那便是总爱自言自语犯痴，我趁其分神，从旁偷听，因此知道魔头魔窟的确切位置。
en: She was powerful but wasn't flawless. She always talked to herself, and I listened in to know where her cave was when she was distracted.

ch: 不过这中间却有一个难处，那便是在下身服毒丹，修为大打折扣，还盼道友能护送一路，使在下顺利解去毒质。
en: But the thing is, my cultivation has been greatly reduced because of that poisonous elixir. So I hope you can come with me to the cave and find the antidote.

ch: 道友，女魔头的魔窟之中定有无数稀世珍宝，我们不妨前去搜罗几件有用的宝物。解毒之后，我修为恢复，更可同探天元山，互为照应？
en: Cultivator, there must be all kinds of rare treasures in her cave, and I'm sure we can get some for ourselves. After my poison is cleared, my cultivation will be fully restored, and then we can explore Tian Yuan Mountain together and keep each other company. Isn't that great?

ch: 道友，如今在下身体不济，极需帮助。若我顺利解去体内毒质，定会倾力相报道友恩德。请你帮我一把吧？
en: Cultivator, I don't feel very well, and I really need your help. Once I get rid of the poison in my body, I'll do whatever it takes to return the favor. Please help me!

ch: 这名修仙者面上泛着一股青气，他说完这些更是气促咳嗽不已。他说事情急切，马上就得出发了，他在天元山有熊村附近等候，希望道友能够出力襄助，
en: The cultivator's face looks greenish. He is short of breath and keeps coughing after he finishes talking. He says it is urgent and that he has to leave right away. He will be waiting near Youxiong Village on Tian Yuan Mountain and hopes that you could help him out.

ch: 登山之前，我仍有要事相托。
en: I have another favor to ask before I go up the mountain.

ch: 昔日我曾在华封州旧居留下一支木雕，我想将之取来。只可惜，我如今无法离开此山。只得拜托你将之带来天元山中，到时帮助师父底定大事以后，在山巅转交给我。
en: I left a wooden carving at my old residence in Hua Feng, and I'd like to get it back. But I can't leave this mountain for now. Could you please bring it to the top of Tian Yuan Mountain and give it to me after our Master achieved his ambition?

ch: 木簪留在我昔日故居之中，我在屋中留下几枚玉石。玉石之中灌注我青空重瞳的异能，一旦察觉来人存有异心，即释放灵力，将之击杀。
en: The wooden hairpin was left in my old residence along with some jade stones, into which I injected the power of my Sky Double Pupils. Once they detect any ulterior motive in a visitor, they'll release Energy and kill the person.

ch: 如今你得我授意，前去无碍，但仍须息心正念，否则玉石一旦察觉来者不善，仍会暴起伤人。谨记谨记。
en: You can go there with my permission. But remember, you must have peace and integrity in your mind, otherwise, the jade stones will be triggered to launch an attack.

ch: 方夜雨楼倒在地上，双眼合上，身上已无一丝生机。
en: By exploring the so-called Taoist Mind, Zhang San puts all lives of the world at stack. He won't do it as long as there is one last hint of good faith remaining in him.

ch: 师父虽然不能救所有人，却在尽力打开飞升关口，让更多的人飞升上界，避开八荒灭世。我以为，这才是以大局为重的表现。
en: My Master can't save everyone. But he is trying his best to open the gateway to ascension and allow as many people as he can to rise to the upper realm, therefore escaping from our world's destruction. This choice considers our interests, I think.

ch: 师父曾说，道源每时每刻都在演化进步，我们必须接近道源，才能认识天地法则，宇宙真理。能够触及终极真理，才能称之为“悟道”。
en: He once said that the source of the Tao is always evolving and developing, and we must grasp the truth governing Heaven, Earth, and the cosmos by approaching the Tao's source. Only those who have had a glimpse of the ultimate truth can be seen as reaching Enlightenment.

ch: 天元山为诸界枢纽，连接各个位面。而所谓上界，亦不过是我们接近道源，感悟道源的跳板。位面无穷，前路修远，等待我们修仙者探索的东西，实在太多了。
en: Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms and leads to various dimensions. And the upper realm is but another stepping stone in our journey to the source of the Tao. A long road cutting through infinite dimensions is in front of us, and myriad secrets are waiting to be revealed by cultivators.

ch: 道友，咳咳……在下体内毒质开始发作，前往女魔头的魔窟寻找解药迫在眉睫，能否请你护送我一路？
en: Cultivator, (coughs)... the poison in my body is kicking in. I need to go to the cave and find the antidote as soon as I can. Could you come with me?

ch: 道友大恩，在下没齿不忘。来日我伤势痊愈，定会补报于你。
en: I'll definitely return the favor when I recover, cultivator.

ch: 你护送那名修仙者来到夜雨楼的住处。然而这座“魔窟”周围遍植翠竹鲜花，更兼山环水抱，景色竟是十分优美。可以看出乃是经过精通风水之术的高人刻意布局营造的。
en: You escort the cultivator to where Night Rain lived. This so-called \"cave\" is surrounded by bamboo, flowers, mountains, and water. It is a beautiful place, and its layout was obviously designed by a Feng Shui expert.

ch: 那名修仙者急急忙忙冲入前方房屋，翻箱倒柜了一番找到了一枚丹药，他急急忙忙将丹药吞服，然后长长的吁了口气。
en: The cultivator rushes into the front room and rummages through the boxes to find an elixir, which he eats immediately and then breathes a sigh of relief.

ch: 女魔头有一截像木雕一样的簪子，似乎是开启这间房屋秘间的钥匙。我们也设法找到这支簪子吧？没准当中藏有许多天元山的奥秘，山上仍有许多未知之数呢。
en: The demon woman had a hairpin that looked like a wooden carving and it's probably the key to unlocking the secret room of this house. Let's find it, okay? Maybe we'll get to know more secrets of the mysterious Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 这名修仙者说完便去搜索房屋各处。
en: The cultivator then goes to search the house.

ch: 你在一个抽屉之中找到一个锦盒，而盒子里面则珍而重之的包裹两层油布，掀开以后，里面是一枚刻画八荒山海形势的木雕。此物颜色深层，十分精致，极似一支木簪。
en: You find a box in a drawer. There are two layers of oilcloth inside, and under them, you find a wooden carving depicting this world. This thing is dark in color and very well-made. It looks like a hairpin.

ch: 修仙者跑了过来一把将你手中木簪夺了过去，然后细细把玩观看。此前他身中剧毒，满脸病容，如今解药已服，精神完好，竟露出一副贪婪的神色来。
en: The cultivator runs over, snatches the hairpin out of your hand, and examines it. Free of poison and sick no more, he is energetic after taking the antidote and looks greedy while examining the hairpin.

ch: 取得木簪了，咱们快走吧。魔窟之中时刻充斥危机，不可久留。
en: We've got the hairpin. Now we gotta run. This cave is very dangerous and we can't stay for long.

ch: 是是是……我服下解药，根除多年来体内的隐患，开心过头了。请你拿着。
en: Yes, you're right... I found the antidote and the poison that was bothering me for years is gone. I guess I'm a bit carried away. Take this, please.

ch: 这名修仙者慢慢地将木簪递了过来。但他突然间出手对你进行偷袭。正在此时，屋中青光一闪，一道灵力射来，打中这名修仙者。他全身陷在一片火焰之中，只片刻间一身血肉骨骼已被焚为点点余烬，化作一屋飞灰。
en: This cultivator slowly hands over the hairpin. But then he suddenly makes a sneak attack on you. At that very moment, a flash of green light comes up in the room, and a ray of Energy shoots in and hits him, trapping him in the flames. In just a few seconds, his whole body is burned to ashes.

ch: 此时屋中青光再闪，一道灵力再次发出，朝你额心射来。
en: Another flash of green light comes up and a ray of Energy shoots again at your forehead.

ch: 你朝射来灵力的地方发出攻势，只听龟裂声起，一颗青色的状如眼瞳的圆形碧玉骨碌碌的滚到你面前，然后碎成满地玉屑。
en: You launch an attack towards the place where the Energy is coming from. Then you hear the sound of cracking as a round green jade stone in the shape of a pupil rolls in front of you and then shatters.

ch: 事情已了，这便回去天元山中吧。夜雨楼的住处果然颇有些奇特，我要不要再四周看看呢？
en: Alright. Now I may return to Tian Yuan Mountain. Night Rain's place is indeed very curious. Should I check the surroundings?

ch: 啊，我可差点忘了，你一路护送我至此，我说过要补报于你的。
en: Oh, I almost forgot. You escorted me all the way here. I promised I would return the favor.

ch: 你走在前面，后方突然生出一股强劲威压。你急忙转身应对，只见那名修仙者出手向你偷袭。便在此时，屋中青光一闪，一道灵力射来，打中这名修仙者。他全身陷在一片火焰之中，只片刻间一身血肉骨骼已被焚为点点余烬，化作一屋飞灰。
en: You are walking ahead when a sense of strong coercion suddenly appears behind you. You turn around immediately, only to see the cultivator strike at you. At that very moment, a flash of green light comes up in the room, and a ray of Energy shoots in and hits him, trapping him in the flames. In just a few seconds, his whole body is burned to ashes.

ch: 此时屋中青光再闪，一道灵力再次发出，朝你额心射来。
en: Another flash of green light comes up and a ray of Energy shoots again at your forehead.

ch: 你朝射来灵力的地方发出攻势，只听龟裂声起，一颗青色的状如眼瞳的圆形碧玉骨碌碌的滚到你面前，然后碎成满地玉屑。
en: You launch an attack towards the place where the Energy is coming from. Then you hear the sound of cracking as a round green jade stone in the shape of a pupil rolls in front of you and then shatters.

ch: 事情已了，这便回去天元山中吧。夜雨楼的住处果然颇有些奇特，我要不要再四周看看呢？
en: Alright. Now I may return to Tian Yuan Mountain. Night Rain's place is indeed very curious. Should I check the surroundings?

ch: 夜雨楼屋中摆放家具，布置颇为用心，虽然屋中清凉无人，但布置之中却可看出一丝温馨的感觉来。另外一边有通向后院，似乎后面另有乾坤。
en: The interior design of Night Rain's house is quite impressive. Her place is cool and no one lives there, but it gives a cozy vibe. There is access to the backyard on the other side that seems to lead to another world.

ch: 你信步来到后院，只见这边另有一栋房子，但大门紧锁，上配锁头，似乎需要通过什么东西才能将之开启。
en: As you walk to the backyard, you see another house and the door is locked. Apparently, a key is needed.

ch: 此物与锁子并不吻合，大门依旧紧锁，无法开启。
en: This object can't unlock it, though.

ch: 簪子放入锁头后，竟将锁子打开。门户开处，只见内室布置温馨，极似女性闺房。当中女香微闻，让人遐想。
en: You insert the hairpin into the lock and to your surprise, it works. The door opens to reveal a nicely furnished room that resembles a lady's boudoir. A tantalizingly faint scent of a woman lingers.

ch: 房间尽头置有一张几案，上面平放一块罗盘，罗盘之中设有暗孔，似与先前所得簪子形状吻合。
en: At the end of the room is a table with a compass on it. There is a little hole down the compass and it seems to match the shape of the hairpin.

ch: 同时，罗盘向四周展开后，露出一个瞳子一般的碧玉，里面放出阵阵华彩，在虚空中折射出幅幅画面，观之似乎都是夜雨楼在进入天元山前的记忆投映。
en: Meanwhile, the compass gradually unfolds, revealing a pupil-like jasper that glows amazingly and projects images onto the air. They flash like a reflection of the memories of Night Rain before she went to Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 夜雨楼房间之中的罗盘零件向四方展开，里面放出阵阵华彩，在虚空中折射出幅幅画面，观之似乎都是夜雨楼在进入天元山前的记忆投映。
en: The compass in Night Rain's chamber gradually unfolds with an amazing glow, projecting images onto the air. They flash like a reflection of the memories of Night Rain before she went to Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 你插入簪子后，罗盘向四周展开，不远处竟慢慢显现一间与自己身处位置内一模一样的房屋。
en: You insert the hairpin and the compass gradually unfolds, revealing a residence identical to the one you're in now.

ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
en: The Master of the Pavilion raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

ch: 昔日梦入神机，得见此景，后来反复揣摩，终有所获。如今，就要在夜姑娘面前献丑了。
en: I dreamed of this before and kept thinking about what it meant until I finally got it. Now, I'm going to show you what it's all about.

ch: 上下四维曰宇，古往今来曰宙，我姑且称呼这片黑色的空间为宇宙，而我们所处的八荒正是无垠宇宙中一点微不足道的星芒。
en: The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. I call this darkness the cosmos, and this world we're living in is nothing but a pale little dot in the vast cosmos.

ch: 这么说来，在这片漆黑的宇宙中，还有无数八荒？
en: So you're saying there are many other worlds in the cosmos too?

ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
en: The Master raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

ch: 阁主微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
en: The Master smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应。
en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
en: The Master of the Pavilion smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says \"Nonsense\" while throwing the carved branch at the Master.

ch: 然而阁主只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
en: The Master disappears suddenly and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

ch: 阁主说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
en: The Master once again turns around and leaves, while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...
Night Rain, what do you think of this technique?

ch: 嗯，确实突破了悟道之境，一举踏入从未履足的新境界……只是……只是……
en: Well, it did help me break through Enlightenment to a whole new realm... But... but...

ch: 我知道你的忧虑。我能掌控冥气化为冥羽，你也能。但八荒修仙者未必都有这个本事掌控冥羽。
en: I understand your concerns. I can transform the Nether Air into the Nether Feather and so can you. But not every cultivator in this world can do that.

ch: 不错……一个不慎，冥灵错误交汇，修仙者恐遭爆体而亡之祸。
en: You're right... One little error could lead to terrible deviations that threaten to blow up and kill cultivators.

ch: 那么难道因为他们无法熟练掌握此法，八荒就因此停滞不前么？
en: So just because they can't master this technique the whole world has to be stuck in this impasse?

ch: 嗯，我昔日以青空重瞳观风望气，隐约推知八荒终局，是毁灭……如今逃离这场灾难的唯一办法是飞升上界，离开八荒。
en: I used to watch with my Sky Double Pupils and could see this world heading for destruction... Now the only way out is to leave for the upper realms and achieve ascension.

ch: 不止如此，一切事物的终局都是毁灭。假使我们有幸到达上界，仍要立即设法继续飞升，直到触摸道源，摆脱万千世界的束缚。这才算是真正的“长生”。
en: All things must come to an end. If we are lucky enough to reach the upper realms, we'll have to continue to ascend until we access the source of the Tao and are free from the bondage of all worlds. And that, is true \"immortality\".

ch: 雨楼，我以为你是少数能明白我的人，如何连你也露出疑惑之色？
en: Night Rain, I thought you were one of the few people who truly knew me. But why do you look so confused now?

ch: 不……我只是……只是觉得您胸中所含，致广大而尽精微，无所不包，让人无法窥测。
en: No... I just... realize what you have in your mind is so vast and so subtle that no one could ever decipher.

ch: 任谁都有不知道的事，若有朝一日触摸道源，了解了这寰宇一切，可能你又会觉得本尊浅薄无知之至。
en: We can't know everything. If you manage to access the source of the Tao and learn all the secrets about the cosmos, you may find me fairly shallow and ignorant.

ch: 不，请阁主将雨楼收录门下，雨楼愿意侍奉左右，以求有朝一日，得闻大道。
en: No, please take me as your disciple, Master. I will serve you and learn from you on my way to XII.

ch: 哈哈哈哈，我视你为友，你却要拜我为师吗？
en: Hahahaha, I see you as a friend, but you want to be my disciple?

ch: 雨楼愿执弟子礼，追随师父左右。还请师父万勿嫌弃！
en: I would like to follow you as a disciple. Please don't say no, Master!

ch: 夜雨楼说完，双膝一跪，竟给琅琊阁主行拜师之礼。琅琊阁主迟疑之色一闪而过，最终面对夜雨楼受了她拜师大礼。
en: Night Rain kneels down and gives the Master of the Pavilion the salute of worship. The Master hesitates for a moment before he accepts her salute.

ch: 阁主遥指山下一座风景秀丽的村庄。
en: The Master points at a beautiful village at the foot of the mountain.

ch: 就是他们，这伙人说是得了我的救命之恩，愿意永生永世追随于我。
en: You see those people? They said they would be loyal to me for good because I saved their lives.

ch: 然则本尊大事未了，哪有时间安顿他们？因此我将他们安置于此。此处由我设想上界诸境，再挪移风水构筑而成。以你风水之术，维持此处，应是轻而易举。
en: But I'm too busy to settle them down. That's why I told them to stay here. I modeled this place on the upper realms as I imagined with the art of Feng Shui. With your mastery of Feng Shui, it should be easy for you to manage this place.
How did you save their lives?

ch: 他们都是普通人，身无修为，冥气泄漏之际几乎遭了灭顶之灾，我恰好路过设法散去部分冥气，将他们救出。
en: They're not cultivators, and the leaking of the Nether Air almost killed them. I happened to see it, and I removed the Nether Air from their bodies.

ch: 如今他们视你为依傍，他日若得机缘，师父您飞升离开八荒，他们又如何是好？
en: Now they look up to you as a hero. What are they going to do if you ascend and leave this world?

ch: 若有余力，不妨将他们一并带离。
en: I may take them with me.

ch: 嗯，那雨楼呢？也带雨楼一起飞升吗？
en: What about me? Will you also take me with you?

ch: 以你的修为，辅以青空重瞳异能，当能顺利飞升，何须本尊援手？
en: Your cultivation and Sky Double Pupils will help you ascend easily. I don't think you need my help.

ch: 不，弟子愚鲁，一定无法顺利飞升。到时定要师父拉一把手的。
en: I'm not good enough to do it myself. Please do help me, Master.

ch: 你不会狠心将弟子落下了吧？
en: You won't leave me behind, will you?
I still have something to attend to.

ch: 师父，你先说嘛，你不会是要丢下我不管吧？
en: Master, tell me. You won't leave me behind, right?

ch: 阁主看了夜雨楼一眼，然后转身自行离去；夜雨楼则巧笑嫣然，跟随其后一直催促她的师父带上她一并飞升上界。
en: The Master glares coldly at Night Rain and turns to leave on his own. Night Rain smiles and follows him, persuading him to ascend with her to the upper realms.

ch: 你进入房间之后发现房间之中的摆设布置以及房间布局与之前的房间完全一样，只不过左右调转过来了。因此，这间房子就像是原来房子的镜像倒映。
en: You enter the room and find that the furnishings and layout there are exactly the same as the previous room, except that the left and right sides have been reversed. This room is a mirror reflection of the first one.

ch: 而你进入到，里面果然发现另外一个罗盘，打开之后，同样投映出夜雨楼的记忆投映。
en: As you enter, you see another compass inside, which, when opened, also projects Night Rain's memories.

ch: 琅琊阁主衡天正凭栏沉吟，屋外夜雨淅沥。他偶尔敲响围栏，发出几个声音与室外雨声应和。夜雨楼则正在内室抚琴，听到乃师叩栏，便停了琴音，只垂着榛首，暗暗听着凭栏之人的动静。
en: The Master of the Pavilion and Night Rain are standing side by side on a high ground and looking at a cavern in the distance.

ch: 雨楼，不必拘谨，这里是你的家，又不是我的家。
en: Heroes of this world? There are very few of them, and even fewer when it comes to cultivators who can achieve what you and I have achieved.
That's good. If I'm as invincible as you, Master, I'll be fearless.

ch: 我们一日无法跃升上界，这事也就无法想明白，想得再多，也是枉然。
en: Storms abound at the summit, so be careful when you reach the top. Even the best cultivator has fears. Besides, I'm far from being invincible.

ch: 师父……愿意告诉我，你在想的事情吗？
en: Seriously, Master? Nobody in this world can beat you!

ch: 怎么不愿意？你看事物的角度与我等不一样。正要你一并参研，予我裨益。
en: Not for now. But maybe there will be in the future. For example, that person.

ch: 上次给你提过的道源，神秘莫测；我们修仙者能从中感悟天地大道，宇宙真理；但是道源同样有从我们修仙者身上获取需求的一面。每当我们有新的感悟，道源就有可能从中进行吸纳。
en: Night Rain sees a young cultivator with a bamboo hat on his back carrying things in front of a cave.

ch: 道源因为需要从修仙者身上获取感悟，使“自己”更加完美，会主动对需要进行吸纳的对象进行牵引。
en: That man? I know him. He's famous. But that guy is a self-important clown at best. I don't think he'll make it.

ch: 如果这个地方有足够多的感悟，道源则会表现出非常强大的吸纳欲望。甚至挪移整个位面，使之与自己靠近。一旦足够靠近，飞升之路便由此开启。
en: I beg to differ. I find him free-spirited, upstanding, sensitive, and unique. If anyone were to be a worthy opponent of mine, it would be this man.

ch: 天元山，便是道源为了牵引位面专设的枢纽。哼，我们以为道源包含一切真理，殊不知道源本身也不完美，它能让我们了解世界，也反哺我们，从中完善自己。
en: I don't believe it. If that's the case, why don't you just kill him now to nip the threat in the bud?

ch: 这寰宇啊，真是十分神奇。
en: You know what? Somehow I feel like this young man is quite similar to me, and maybe that's why I have high hopes for him. Alright, we need to go back.

ch: 琅琊阁主衡天说完，又用手指轻敲栏杆。夜雨楼知道师父再次陷入沉思，便敛了敛衣袖，正襟危坐，候在一旁，只偶尔用余光扫视师父，露出一丝不易察觉的甜笑。
en: Oh? Now I get it. You're giving yourself a compliment, Master.

ch: 阁主当先引路走在前面。夜雨楼紧随其后，走了没几步她突然回顾远处青年，目光之中分明透出一丝杀气。
en: The Master leads the way and is followed by Night Rain, who looks back furiously at the young man in the distance.

ch: 阁主身子颤抖不已，他身后延伸一个巨大的阴影，
en: The Master is trembling, a huge shadow cast behind him.

ch: 师父……冥魔非我族类，它不过是在利用你……
en: Master... the Nether Demon is not our kind. It's been using you...

ch: 我又何尝不是在利用它呢？
en: And what makes you think I'm not using it?

ch: 师父，这样一来会让八荒陷入一片冥气之中。这其实是加速终局灭世的到来。
en: Master, the entire world may descend into the Nether Air, which may contribute to its destruction.

ch: 以如今的速度，太慢了。人永远不知道自己的极限在哪里，我们必须要推一推他们，给他们加把劲。
en: It's going too slow at today's rate. They'll never know where their limits are. We need to give them a push.

ch: 本尊已经决定的事，几时轮到你来说三道四？！
en: Since when do you have a say here?!

ch: 师父……我……我只是担心你……冥魔有自己的目的。
en: Master... I... I'm just worried that you... The Nether Demon is up to no good.

ch: 不必担忧……我自有主张。接下来，你只需协助我改变八荒风水，加速冥气泄漏就好了。
en: Don't worry... I know what I'm doing. All you need to do is help me change the Feng Shui in this world and accelerate the leaking of the Nether Air.

ch: 不……只要是您交代下来的事情，我都会给办好的……请放心
en: No... I'll do as you say... I swear.

ch: 好好记住自己说过的话。
阁主没有再理会身边弟子，只是转头离开此处。
en: The Master ignores his disciple and leaves.

ch: 衡天……你就算让我死，我也会招办不误的……
en: Hengtian... Even if you want me to die, I'll do it...

ch: 琅琊阁主身受重伤，他目视天元山巅峰，凌厉的目光之中闪烁一丝无奈。夜雨楼从旁扶持，她看着阁主的目光则充满了温柔。
en: The Master of the Pavilion is seriously injured and looks at the peak of Tian Yuan Mountain helplessly. Night Rain is helping him up and tender are her eyes.

ch: 你快走吧。我连斗女娲、苍龙与张三，如今状态已经很差了。今日可能就要栽在张三手中了。
en: Go now. I've fought Nuwa, Black Dragon, and Zhang San in a row, and I'm a mess now. Zhang San's probably going to kill me.

ch: 你说什么话呢？我这就想办法将女娲苍龙一一困住。师父，这么多事我们都走过来了，今天这关也能撑过去的。
en: What are you talking about? I'll try to trap Nuwa and Black Dragon. Master, we've come a long way, and we can make it this time.

ch: 撑过去，不行了。张三已经有动静了。还记得很久以前，我们第一次相见时就跟你解释过了。
en: It's not going to work. Zhang San is already making a move. Remember what I told you when we first met?

ch: 我都记得，你说得我都记得。上下四维为宇，古往今来为宙，天元山则是连接一切位面的关键枢纽。
en: I remember everything. The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects all realms.

ch: 很好……很好……如今张三已将我们进入天元山的节点冻住。也就是说，天元山中就是我们的时间，但连接到八荒的，则是一万年前。
en: Very good... Very good... Zhang San has frozen the time and space, where we entered Tian Yuan Mountain. That means we're now living the time inside the mountain, but the time out there is 100,000 years ago.
What?! Why did he do that?

ch: 如我所料不差，张三要与我赌命，他准备牺牲自己将我留在天元山中，然后从万年之前召来帮手给我最后一击。
en: As I expected, Zhang San risks his life to trap me here in the mountain and will summon his helpers from 100,000 years ago to kill me.

ch: 以你本事，如今还能冲出天元山封印，迟了就没办法了。快快离开，万勿逗留。
en: But you can still break out of the seal on the mountain today. Time is not on our side. Go now.

ch: 阁主说完，飞身而起往山巅上去了。夜雨楼还想留住师父，已经慢了。
en: The Master then flies up to the top of the mountain. Night Rain wants to make him stay, but it's too late.

ch: 师父……雨楼一路陪着你走过来，绝不会离开你的。我们生也在一起，死也在一起！
en: Master... I've been with you all the way here. I'll never leave you. Even if we were to die, we would die together!

ch: 张三，我就是用尽一切手段，就算身死道消，也不会让你奸计得逞的！
en: Zhang San, I don't care if I die or lose all my cultivation. I'll do whatever it takes to stop you!

ch: 罗盘投映出来的诸多情景似乎都是夜雨楼与一名男子往昔的点点滴滴。而她似乎是刻意将这些东西保留下来了。
en: The many scenes projected by the compass look like what happened between Night Rain and a man in the past. She seemed to have deliberately kept those memories in the compass.

ch: 此时四顾房中，只见左边仍有一处门廊，被封锁起来。
en: You look around the room and see a closed doorway to the left.

ch: 使用木簪后，通道门扉洞开，你沿路行走，来到一处山崖边上，只见远方有一村落，里面人踪迹来去，怡然自乐，彷如世外。
en: You use the wooden pin and unlock the doorway. Walking down the path, you reach a cliff, where a village can be seen in the distance with people coming and going. They look relaxed and delighted as if they were out of this world.

ch: 你来到村中，几名村汉立即投来奇怪目光。观其骨骼精神可知这些都并非修道之人。
en: As you arrive in the village, a few villagers cast strange glances at you. You can tell that none of them are cultivators.

ch: 这些村人说，他们的祖先在冥气的泄露过程中遭难，恰逢琅琊阁主营救。之后，阁主就派遣他的弟子夜仙子照顾他们。
en: The villagers tell you that when their ancestors were suffering a leak of the Nether Air, the Master of the Pavilion came to their rescue. He also sent his disciple, Lady Night, to look after them.

ch: 然则，琅琊阁主固然没有出现，夜仙子也没再前来。不过这些村民十分感激二人对他们所做的一切。他们愿意留在这片乐土中，等候二人归来。
en: But neither the Master nor Lady Night showed up again. But these villagers are deeply indebted to them. They stay in this promised land in the hope that one day they will return.

ch: 接待你的村民都是摇了摇头，他们认为外面的世界十分凶险。只有琅琊阁主为他们特意留下的这片土地才是真正的世外桃源。而他们只愿意留在此处。
en: The villagers who receive you shake their heads. They find the world outside danger-ridden and this land that the Master of the Pavilion left behind for them a true paradise, so they are certainly not leaving.

ch: 你正想离开之际，这些村民都纷纷向你问起琅琊阁主以及夜雨楼的行踪。
en: As you are about to leave, all the villagers start to ask you about the whereabouts of the Master and Night Rain.

ch: 接待你的村民都是摇了摇头，他们认为外面的世界十分凶险。只有琅琊阁主为他们特意留下的这片土地才是真正的世外桃源。而他们只愿意留在此处。
en: The villagers who receive you shake their heads. They find the world outside danger-ridden and this land that the Master of the Pavilion left behind for them a true paradise, so they are certainly not leaving.

ch: 你正想离开之际，这些村民都纷纷向你问起琅琊阁主以及夜雨楼的行踪。
en: As you are about to leave, all the villagers start to ask you about the whereabouts of the Master and Night Rain.

ch: 这些村民听你数说阁主的恶行，都是露出怒容纷纷驳斥于你，并将你赶离村中。
en: When they hear you talking about the Master's evil deeds, they look furious, rebuke you, and shoo you out of the village immediately.

ch: 这些村民听说你不知阁主行踪，都是十分伤心，纷纷痛苦流涕。似乎，琅琊阁主昔日亦曾出手救民，惠及一方。
en: The villagers are upset and even cry when they learn you don't know where the Master is. It looks like they feel really beholden to him for saving their lives.

ch: 这些村民越哭越是伤心，你无法劝慰，只得默默离开了此处。
en: The villagers are so upset they just can't stop crying. There is nothing you can do to console them, so you have to leave.

ch: 你来到夜雨楼指点的地方，只见周围遍植翠竹鲜花，更兼山环水带，景色十分优美。可以看出乃是经过精通风水之术的高人刻意布局营造的。
en: You follow Night Rain's instructions and find the location, which is surrounded by bamboo, flowers, mountains, and water. It is a beautiful place and its layout was obviously designed by a Feng Shui expert.

ch: 你进入房屋后，在一个抽屉之中找到一个锦盒，而盒子里面则珍而重之的包裹两层油布，掀开以后，里面是一枚刻画八荒山海形势的木雕。此物颜色深沉，十分精致，极似一支木簪。
en: You enter the house and find a box in a drawer. There are two layers of oilcloth inside, and under them, you find a wooden carving depicting this world. This thing is dark in color and very well-made. It looks like a hairpin.

ch: 这应该就是夜雨楼嘱托取得的木簪，这就继续登山吧？然则她的住处似乎藏有其他隐秘，我要不要再四周看看呢？
en: It must be the wooden hairpin that Night Rain asked me to get. I can continue to climb the Mountain now, but there may be more secrets hidden around her residence. Perhaps I should walk around to explore before leaving here?

ch: 只见夜雨楼手拿一支奇特簪子独自避在角落之中。她查看簪子时露出从未所见的温柔神情。正觉诧异之时，簪子突然发出异芒，投射出无数虚影组成的片段。
en: You see Night Rain hiding in a corner with a curious hairpin in her hands. She is looking at the hairpin with a warm expression never seen before. You try to understand the strange scene, but the hairpin suddenly glows. Clips of images unfold before you.

ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

ch: 昔日梦入神机，得见此景，后来反复揣摩，终有所获。如今，就要在夜姑娘面前献丑了。
en: I dreamed of this before and kept thinking about what it meant until I finally got it. Now, I'm going to show you what it's all about.

ch: 上下四维曰宇，古往今来曰宙，我姑且称呼这片黑色的空间为宇宙，而我们所处的八荒正是无垠宇宙中一点微不足道的星芒。
en: The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. I call this darkness the cosmos, and this world we're living in is nothing but a pale little dot in the vast cosmos.

ch: 这么说来，在这片漆黑的宇宙中，还有无数八荒？
en: So you're saying there are many other worlds in the cosmos too?

ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
en: The man raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says \"Nonsense\" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
