en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...
Night Rain, what do you think of this technique?

ch: 嗯，确实突破了悟道之境，一举踏入从未履足的新境界……只是……只是……
en: Well, it did help me break through Enlightenment to a whole new realm... But... but...

ch: 我知道你的忧虑。我能掌控冥气化为冥羽，你也能。但八荒修仙者未必都有这个本事掌控冥羽。
en: I understand your concerns. I can transform the Nether Air into the Nether Feather and so can you. But not every cultivator in this world can do that.

ch: 不错……一个不慎，冥灵错误交汇，修仙者恐遭爆体而亡之祸。
en: You're right... One little error could lead to terrible deviations that threaten to blow up and kill cultivators.

ch: 那么难道因为他们无法熟练掌握此法，八荒就因此停滞不前么？
en: So just because they can't master this technique, the whole world has to be stuck in this impasse?

ch: 嗯，我昔日以青空重瞳观风望气，隐约推知八荒终局，是毁灭……如今逃离这场灾难的唯一办法是飞升上界，离开八荒。
en: I used to watch with my Sky Double Pupils and could see this world heading for destruction... Now the only way out is to leave for the upper realms and achieve ascension.

ch: 不止如此，一切事物的终局都是毁灭。假使我们有幸到达上界，仍要立即设法继续飞升，直到触摸道源，摆脱万千世界的束缚。这才算是真正的“长生”。
en: All things must come to an end. If we are lucky enough to reach the upper realms, we'll have to continue to ascend until we access the source of the Tao and are free from the bondage of all worlds. And that, is true \"immortality\".

ch: 雨楼，我以为你是少数能明白我的人，如何连你也露出疑惑之色？
en: Night Rain, I thought you were one of the few people who truly knew me. But why do you look so confused now?

ch: 不……我只是……只是觉得您胸中所含，致广大而尽精微，无所不包，让人无法窥测。
en: No... I just... realize what you have in your mind is so vast and so subtle that no one could ever decipher.

ch: 任谁都有不知道的事，若有朝一日触摸道源，了解了这寰宇一切，可能你又会觉得本尊浅薄无知之至。
en: We can't know everything. If you manage to access the source of the Tao and learn all the secrets about the cosmos, you may find me fairly shallow and ignorant.

ch: 不，请师父将雨楼收录门下，雨楼愿意侍奉左右，以求有朝一日，得闻大道。
en: No, please take me as your disciple, Master. I will serve you and learn from you on my way toward the true path.

ch: 哈哈哈哈，我视你为友，你却要拜我为师吗？
en: Hahahaha, I see you as a friend, but you want to be my disciple?

ch: 雨楼愿执弟子礼，追随师父左右。还请师父万勿嫌弃！
en: I would like to follow you as a disciple. Please don't say no, Master!

ch: 夜雨楼说完，双膝一跪，竟给男子行起拜师之礼来。男子迟疑之色一闪而过，最终面对夜雨楼受了她拜师大礼。
en: Night Rain kneels down and gives the man the salute of worship. The mysterious man hesitates for a moment before he accepts her salute.

ch: 男子凭栏坐看屋外夜雨。他偶尔敲响围栏，发出几个声音与室外雨声应和。夜雨楼则正在内室抚琴，听到乃师叩栏，便停了琴音，只垂着榛首，暗暗听着凭栏之人的动静。
en: The man is sitting beside the rail, gazing into the night and the falling rain. Occasionally, he knocks at the rail with a finger, following the rhythm of raindrops. Night Rain is playing a guqin in the room, and hearing that, she pauses. Amid the subtle silence, she lowers her head and listens to the sounds from the man carefully.

ch: 雨楼，不必拘谨，这里是你的家，又不是我的家。
en: Night Rain, don't be shy. Here is your home, not mine.

ch: 我们一日无法跃升上界，这事也就无法想明白，想得再多，也是枉然。
en: We will never find a solution by mere thinking as long as the upper realms are inaccessible to us. It's in vain.

ch: 师父……愿意告诉我，你在想的事情吗？
en: Master, could you please... tell me what you are thinking about?

ch: 怎么不愿意？你看事物的角度与我等不一样。正要你一并参研，予我裨益。
en: Sure. Your point of view is unique, and our thoughts will complement each other.

ch: 上次给你提过的道源，神秘莫测；我们修仙者能从中感悟天地大道，宇宙真理；但是道源同样有从我们修仙者身上获取需求的一面。每当我们有新的感悟，道源就有可能从中进行吸纳。
en: Remember the Tao's source I mentioned to you last time? It's a mysterious being from which we can learn about the true path and the truth of the universe. However, the source of the Tao also needs us. Every time when new insights emerge in our minds, the Tao's source will try to absorb them.

ch: 道源因为需要从修仙者身上获取感悟，使“自己”更加完美，会主动对需要进行吸纳的对象进行牵引。
en: And by doing that, the Tao's source continues to improve itself. It will also draw worlds with plenty of insights closer.

ch: 如果这个地方有足够多的感悟，道源则会表现出非常强大的吸纳欲望。甚至挪移整个位面，使之与自己靠近。一旦足够靠近，飞升之路便由此开启。
en: That's to say, a world with more insights will be more attractive to the Tao's source, and even the source of the Tao itself may get closer to the world by moving through dimensions. Once the world is close enough to the Tao's source, the gateway to ascension will open.

ch: 天元山，便是道源为了牵引位面专设的枢纽。哼，我们以为道源包含一切真理，殊不知道源本身也不完美，它能让我们了解世界，也反哺我们，从中完善自己。
en: And Tian Yuan Mountain is the gateway. It's the point where the Tao's source attracts various dimensions and realms. See? We always think that the Tao's source contains all the truths of the cosmos, but even the source itself is not perfect. It tells us about the world, and our insights improve it in turn.

ch: 这寰宇啊，真是十分神奇。
男子说完，又用手指轻敲栏杆。夜雨楼知道师父再次陷入沉思，便敛了敛衣袖，正襟危坐，候在一旁，只偶尔用余光扫视师父，露出一丝不易察觉的甜笑。
en: The man finishes speaking. He continues to knock with his fingers, and Night Rain knows he must begin to think about arcane matters again. She folds her sleeves and sits straight beside him, glimpsing the man with a sweet smile.

ch: 男子遥指山下一座风景秀丽的村庄。
en: The man points at a beautiful village at the foot of the mountain.

ch: 就是他们，这伙人说是得了我的救命之恩，愿意永生永世追随于我。
en: You see those people? They said they would be loyal to me for good because I saved their lives.

ch: 然则本尊大事未了，哪有时间安顿他们？因此我将他们安置于此。此处由我设想上界诸境，再挪移风水构筑而成。以你风水之术，维持此处，应是轻而易举。
en: But I'm too busy to settle them down. That's why I told them to stay here. I modeled this place on the upper realms as I imagined with the art of Feng Shui. With your mastery of Feng Shui, it should be easy for you to manage this place.
How did you save their lives?

ch: 他们都是普通人，身无修为，冥气泄漏之际几乎遭了灭顶之灾，我恰好路过设法散去部分冥气，将他们救出。
en: They're not cultivators, and the leaking of the Nether Air almost killed them. I happened to see it, and I removed the Nether Air from their bodies.

ch: 如今他们视你为依傍，他日若得机缘，师父您飞升离开八荒，他们又如何是好？
en: Now they look up to you as a hero. What are they going to do if you ascend and leave this world?

ch: 若有余力，不妨将他们一并带离。
en: I may take them with me.

ch: 嗯，那雨楼呢？也带雨楼一起飞升吗？
en: What about me? Will you also take me with you?

ch: 以你的修为，辅以青空重瞳异能，当能顺利飞升，何须本尊援手？
en: Your cultivation and Sky Double Pupils will help you ascend easily. I don't think you need my help.

ch: 不，弟子愚鲁，一定无法顺利飞升。到时定要师父拉一把手的。
en: I'm not good enough to do it myself. Please do help me, Master.

ch: 你不会狠心将弟子落下了吧？
en: You won't leave me behind, will you?
I still have something to attend to.

ch: 师父，你先说嘛，你不会是要丢下我不管吧？
en: Master, tell me. You won't leave me behind, right?

ch: 男子看了夜雨楼一眼，然后转身自行离去；夜雨楼则巧笑嫣然，跟随其后一直催促她的师父带上她一并飞升上界。
en: The man glares at Night Rain and turns to leave on his own. Night Rain smiles and follows him, persuading him to ascend with her to the upper realms.

ch: 男子身子颤抖不已，他身后延伸一个巨大的阴影，
en: The man is trembling, a huge shadow cast behind him.

ch: 师父……冥魔非我族类，它不过是在利用你……
en: Master... the Nether Demon is not our kind. It's been using you...

ch: 我又何尝不是在利用它呢？
en: And what makes you think I'm not using it?

ch: 师父，这样一来会让八荒陷入一片冥气之中。这其实是加速终局灭世的到来。
en: Master, the entire world may descend into the Nether Air, which may contribute to its destruction.

ch: 以如今的速度，太慢了。人永远不知道自己的极限在哪里，我们必须要推一推他们，给他们加把劲。
en: It's going too slow at today's rate. They'll never know where their limits are. We need to give them a push.

ch: 本尊已经决定的事，几时轮到你来说三道四？！
en: Since when do you have a say here?!

ch: 师父……我……我只是担心你……冥魔有自己的目的。
en: Master... I... I'm just worried that you... The Nether Demon is up to no good.

ch: 不必担忧……我自有主张。接下来，你只需协助我改变八荒风水，加速冥气泄漏就好了。
en: Don't worry... I know what I'm doing. All you need to do is help me change the Feng Shui in this world and accelerate the leaking of the Nether Air.

ch: 不……只要是您交代下来的事情，我都会给办好的……请放心
en: No... I'll do as you say... I swear.

ch: 好好记住自己说过的话。
男子没有再理会身边弟子，只是转头离开此处。
en: The man ignores his disciple and leaves.

ch: 你拿出木簪摸索把玩，未料此物竟突然发出异芒，投射出无数虚影组成的片段。
en: You take out the wooden hairpin for inspection, but suddenly a strange glow emits from it. Clips of images unfold before you.

ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says \"Nonsense\" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...
Night Rain, what do you think of this technique?

ch: 嗯，确实突破了悟道之境，一举踏入从未履足的新境界……只是……只是……
en: Well, it did help me break through Enlightenment to a whole new realm... But... but...

ch: 我知道你的忧虑。我能掌控冥气化为冥羽，你也能。但八荒修仙者未必都有这个本事掌控冥羽。
en: I understand your concerns. I can transform the Nether Air into the Nether Feather and so can you. But not every cultivator in this world can do that.

ch: 不错……一个不慎，冥灵错误交汇，修仙者恐遭爆体而亡之祸。
en: You're right... One little error could lead to terrible deviations that threaten to blow up and kill cultivators.

ch: 那么难道因为他们无法熟练掌握此法，八荒就因此停滞不前么？
en: So just because they can't master this technique, the whole world has to be stuck in this impasse?

ch: 嗯，我昔日以青空重瞳观风望气，隐约推知八荒终局，是毁灭……如今逃离这场灾难的唯一办法是飞升上界，离开八荒。
en: I used to watch with my Sky Double Pupils and could see this world heading for destruction... Now the only way out is to leave for the upper realms and achieve ascension.

ch: 不止如此，一切事物的终局都是毁灭。假使我们有幸到达上界，仍要立即设法继续飞升，直到触摸道源，摆脱万千世界的束缚。这才算是真正的“长生”。
en: All things must come to an end. If we are lucky enough to reach the upper realms, we'll have to continue to ascend until we access the source of the Tao and are free from the bondage of all worlds. And that, is true \"immortality\".

ch: 雨楼，我以为你是少数能明白我的人，如何连你也露出疑惑之色？
en: Night Rain, I thought you were one of the few people who truly knew me. But why do you look so confused now?

ch: 不……我只是……只是觉得您胸中所含，致广大而尽精微，无所不包，让人无法窥测。
en: No... I just... realize what you have in your mind is so vast and so subtle that no one could ever decipher.

ch: 任谁都有不知道的事，若有朝一日触摸道源，了解了这寰宇一切，可能你又会觉得本尊浅薄无知之至。
en: We can't know everything. If you manage to access the source of the Tao and learn all the secrets about the cosmos, you may find me fairly shallow and ignorant.

ch: 不，请师父将雨楼收录门下，雨楼愿意侍奉左右，以求有朝一日，得闻大道。
en: No, please take me as your disciple, Master. I will serve you and learn from you on my way toward the true path.

ch: 哈哈哈哈，我视你为友，你却要拜我为师吗？
en: Hahahaha, I see you as a friend, but you want to be my disciple?

ch: 雨楼愿执弟子礼，追随师父左右。还请师父万勿嫌弃！
en: I would like to follow you as a disciple. Please don't say no, Master!

ch: 夜雨楼说完，双膝一跪，竟给男子行拜师之礼。男子迟疑之色一闪而过，最终面对夜雨楼受了她拜师大礼。
en: Night Rain kneels down and gives the man the salute of worship. The mysterious man hesitates for a moment before he accepts her salute.

ch: 男子正凭栏坐看屋外夜雨。他偶尔敲响围栏，发出几个声音与室外雨声应和。夜雨楼则正在内室抚琴，听到乃师叩栏，便停了琴音，只垂着榛首，暗暗听着凭栏之人的动静。
en: The man is sitting beside the rail, gazing into the night and the falling rain. Occasionally, he knocks at the rail with a finger, following the rhythm of raindrops. Night Rain is playing a guqin in the room, and hearing that, she pauses. Amid the subtle silence, she lowers her head and listens to the sounds from the man carefully.

ch: 雨楼，不必拘谨，这里是你的家，又不是我的家。
en: Night Rain, don't be shy. Here is your home, not mine.

ch: 我们一日无法跃升上界，这事也就无法想明白，想得再多，也是枉然。
en: We will never find a solution by mere thinking as long as the upper realms are inaccessible to us. It's in vain.

ch: 师父……愿意告诉我，你在想的事情吗？
en: Master, could you please... tell me what you are thinking about?

ch: 怎么不愿意？你看事物的角度与我等不一样。正要你一并参研，予我裨益。
en: Sure. Your point of view is unique, and our thoughts will complement each other.

ch: 上次给你提过的道源，神秘莫测；我们修仙者能从中感悟天地大道，宇宙真理；但是道源同样有从我们修仙者身上获取需求的一面。每当我们有新的感悟，道源就有可能从中进行吸纳。
en: Remember the Tao's source I mentioned to you last time? It's a mysterious being from which we can learn about the true path and the truth of the universe. However, the source of the Tao also needs us. Every time when new insights emerge in our minds, the Tao's source will try to absorb them.

ch: 道源因为需要从修仙者身上获取感悟，使“自己”更加完美，会主动对需要进行吸纳的对象进行牵引。
en: And by doing that, the Tao's source continues to improve itself. It will also draw worlds with plenty of insights closer.

ch: 如果这个地方有足够多的感悟，道源则会表现出非常强大的吸纳欲望。甚至挪移整个位面，使之与自己靠近。一旦足够靠近，飞升之路便由此开启。
en: That's to say, a world with more insights will be more attractive to the Tao's source, and even the source of the Tao itself may get closer to the world by moving through dimensions. Once the world is close enough to the Tao's source, the gateway to ascension will open.

ch: 天元山，便是道源为了牵引位面专设的枢纽。哼，我们以为道源包含一切真理，殊不知道源本身也不完美，它能让我们了解世界，也反哺我们，从中完善自己。
en: And Tian Yuan Mountain is the gateway. It's the point where the Tao's source attracts various dimensions and realms. See? We always think that the Tao's source contains all the truths of the cosmos, but even the source itself is not perfect. It tells us about the world, and our insights improve it in turn.

ch: 这寰宇啊，真是十分神奇。
男子说完，又用手指轻敲栏杆。夜雨楼知道师父再次陷入沉思，便敛了敛衣袖，正襟危坐，候在一旁，只偶尔用余光扫视师父，露出一丝不易察觉的甜笑。
en: The man finishes speaking. He continues to knock with his fingers, and Night Rain knows he must begin to think about arcane matters again. She folds her sleeves and sits straight beside him, glimpsing the man with a sweet smile.

ch: 男子遥指山下一座风景秀丽的村庄。
en: The man points at a beautiful village at the foot of the mountain.

ch: 就是他们，这伙人说是得了我的救命之恩，愿意永生永世追随于我。
en: You see those people? They said they would be loyal to me for good because I saved their lives.

ch: 然则本尊大事未了，哪有时间安顿他们？因此我将他们安置于此。此处由我设想上界诸境，再挪移风水构筑而成。以你风水之术，维持此处，应是轻而易举。
en: But I'm too busy to settle them down. That's why I told them to stay here. I modeled this place on the upper realms as I imagined with the art of Feng Shui. With your mastery of Feng Shui, it should be easy for you to manage this place.
How did you save their lives?

ch: 他们都是普通人，身无修为，冥气泄漏之际几乎遭了灭顶之灾，我恰好路过设法散去部分冥气，将他们救出。
en: They're not cultivators, and the leaking of the Nether Air almost killed them. I happened to see it, and I removed the Nether Air from their bodies.

ch: 如今他们视你为依傍，他日若得机缘，师父您飞升离开八荒，他们又如何是好？
en: Now they look up to you as a hero. What are they going to do if you ascend and leave this world?

ch: 若有余力，不妨将他们一并带离。
en: I may take them with me.

ch: 嗯，那雨楼呢？也带雨楼一起飞升吗？
en: What about me? Will you also take me with you?

ch: 以你的修为，辅以青空重瞳异能，当能顺利飞升，何须本尊援手？
en: Your cultivation and Sky Double Pupils will help you ascend easily. I don't think you need my help.

ch: 不，弟子愚鲁，一定无法顺利飞升。到时定要师父拉一把手的。
en: I'm not good enough to do it myself. Please do help me, Master.

ch: 你不会狠心将弟子落下了吧？
en: You won't leave me behind, will you?
I still have something to attend to.

ch: 师父，你先说嘛，你不会是要丢下我不管吧？
en: Master, tell me. You won't leave me behind, right?

ch: 男子看了夜雨楼一眼，然后转身自行离去；夜雨楼则巧笑嫣然，跟随其后一直催促她的师父带上她一并飞升上界。
en: The man glares at Night Rain and turns to leave on his own. Night Rain smiles and follows him, persuading him to ascend with her to the upper realms.

ch: 男子身子颤抖不已，他身后延伸一个巨大的阴影，
en: The man is trembling, a huge shadow cast behind him.

ch: 师父……冥魔非我族类，它不过是在利用你……
en: Master... the Nether Demon is not our kind. It's been using you...

ch: 我又何尝不是在利用它呢？
en: And what makes you think I'm not using it?

ch: 师父，这样一来会让八荒陷入一片冥气之中。这其实是加速终局灭世的到来。
en: Master, the entire world may descend into the Nether Air, which may contribute to its destruction.

ch: 以如今的速度，太慢了。人永远不知道自己的极限在哪里，我们必须要推一推他们，给他们加把劲。
en: It's going too slow at today's rate. They'll never know where their limits are. We need to give them a push.

ch: 本尊已经决定的事，几时轮到你来说三道四？！
en: Since when do you have a say here?!

ch: 师父……我……我只是担心你……冥魔有自己的目的。
en: Master... I... I'm just worried that you... The Nether Demon is up to no good.

ch: 不必担忧……我自有主张。接下来，你只需协助我改变八荒风水，加速冥气泄漏就好了。
en: Don't worry... I know what I'm doing. All you need to do is help me change the Feng Shui in this world and accelerate the leaking of the Nether Air.

ch: 不……只要是您交代下来的事情，我都会给办好的……请放心
en: No... I'll do as you say... I swear.

ch: 好好记住自己说过的话。
男子没有再理会身边弟子，只是转头离开此处。
en: The man ignores his disciple and leaves.

ch: 道友，此处封印十分霸道，对修仙者有害无益，你还是赶快离开此处，绕道再继续登山吧。
en: Good cultivator, the seal here is too overwhelming. It will hurt you if you continue to go from here. Please pick another route if you can.

ch: 你身上气运全赖所服丹药以及我重瞳激发药力聚成，消散极快。若气运消失，不妨重新回到此处，我能以重瞳之力，再次为你激发药力。
en: The destiny on you is from the elixir you took and the power of my double pupils. It will soon disperse, but don't worry. I'll activate the elixir's power for you again if you find its effect is gone.

ch: 夜雨楼说完此话便转身走开，一个人避在远处。
en: Night Rain finishes speaking and steps away into the distance.

ch: 只见她停在远方背对着你，然后温柔地凝视一支从怀中摸出的簪子。片刻后这支簪子生出重重幻象投射于虚空之中。
en: She stops somewhere far from you, leaving you behind her back. She seems to be looking at a hairpin tenderly, and soon, views begin to emerge from the curious object and unfold in nothingness.

ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

ch: 昔日梦入神机，得见此景，后来反复揣摩，终有所获。如今，就要在夜姑娘面前献丑了。
en: I dreamed of this before and kept thinking about what it meant until I finally got it. Now, I'm going to show you what it's all about.

ch: 上下四维曰宇，古往今来曰宙，我姑且称呼这片黑色的空间为宇宙，而我们所处的八荒正是无垠宇宙中一点微不足道的星芒。
en: The four dimensions above and below constitute the space, and the past and present make the time. I call this darkness the cosmos, and this world we're living in is nothing but a pale little dot in the vast cosmos.

ch: 这么说来，在这片漆黑的宇宙中，还有无数八荒？
en: So you're saying there are many other worlds in the cosmos too?

ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
en: The man raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says \"Nonsense\" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...

ch: 天元山上的传送阵竟直通山下？嗯，山上大事未了，应该养精蓄锐，继续探索山上奥秘。
en: To my surprise, the portal on Tian Yuan Mountain leads to somewhere at its foot. Well, urgent matters are calling me there, and I should keep myself in good condition to continue my journey.

ch: 但夜雨楼刚才查看发簪时故意避开我，而那支发簪能显出无数虚象片段，应是藏有许多秘密，我要不要<r>回去夜雨楼那里查探一下</r>呢？
en: But Night Rain steps away from me before starting to inspect her hairpin, and I see many clips emerge from it. It must contain many secrets. Should I <r>come back to Night Rain and investigate</r>?

ch: 天元山中，充满了未知之数，由我以重瞳之力为你聚成气运，稍微提升一下你的实力吧。
en: Various dangers lurk in Tian Yuan Mountain. Here, I'll grant you a destiny. I condensed it using my power of double pupils, and it may enhance you a bit.

ch: 天元山上的传送阵竟直通山下？嗯，山上大事未了，应该养精蓄锐，继续探索山上奥秘。
en: To my surprise, the portal on Tian Yuan Mountain leads to somewhere at its foot. Well, urgent matters are calling me there, and I should keep myself in good condition to continue my journey.

ch: 你正计划接下来的事情，刚从夜雨楼手中取得的簪子却突然透出光芒，无数虚影浮于眼前组成一段事件片段。
en: You're thinking about the next step while the hairpin from Night Rain suddenly glows. Images float into the air, and you see a clip of the past unfold before you.

ch: 恩，夜姑娘青空重瞳果然神妙，让本尊得以用别的眼光看待八荒。本尊没有道友的神奇眼力，只得将脑中的想法演成幻象，让道友观看。
en: Night Rain, your Sky Double Pupils are really something. They allow me to see this world through a different lens. I don't have that incredible vision of yours, though, so I'm going to present the thoughts in my head as floating images for you to see.

ch: 男子说着抬手一拂，周围好像换了一片景幕，立即变成一片漆黑。
en: The man raises his hand and waves, and the surroundings immediately turn pitch black.

ch: 道友果然颖悟，当然也有我们所称的上界。而天元山，则是连接这些不同位面的关键枢纽。
en: You got it, and there are also what we call the upper realms out there. Tian Yuan Mountain is the key link that connects different realms.

ch: 男子再次抬手轻拂，无垠宇宙中两枚球体互相吸引，缓缓接近融合。球体相合后变成一个更大的球体，又被更大的球体吸引，如此循环。终于慢慢接近一个巨大的光球。
en: The man raises his hand and waves again. The two spheres in the infinite cosmos start to draw closer to each other until they merge into a single large sphere, which is again attracted to a larger sphere. Slowly but surely, it moves towards a gigantic sphere of light.

ch: 我们所谓的天地法则，其实也不过是这庞大宇宙中的一环。而这些规则之中，则有道力牵引之说。只要所处位面整体修为足够强大，就会发出强大的引力，与同类互相吸引。
en: What we call the laws of heaven and earth are in fact just a link in the vast cosmos. And among all the laws, there is this law of gravity of the Tao Power. So long as the overall cultivation of one's realm is strong enough, it will unleash a strong gravity and attract its kind.

ch: 当我们的道力足够强大，就会被牵引到一个道力更加强大的位面旁边，这个时候，天元山作为枢纽关键，就会打开通道，我们即可从此离开八荒，去到更高的位面，即所谓“飞升”。
en: When our Tao Power is strong enough, we will be drawn to a realm with a stronger Tao Power, and at this time, Tian Yuan Mountain, as the key link, will open the gateway and we can leave this world for a higher realm. That's how we achieve ascension.

ch: 哼，阁下所说，闻所未闻。雨楼愚鲁，不敢轻信。
en: Hmph, I've never heard of anything like that. This is way beyond my comprehension and I don't buy it.

ch: 男子微微一笑，取过一段落在地上的树枝，并以手指在上面剔划，片刻间那树枝化为一截篆刻精致山海地理的长条木雕。
en: The man smiles and picks up a branch on the ground before he scratches and carves it with his finger. In a few moments, the branch is made into a long wooden carving that depicts the landscape of this world.

ch: 道友悟心非同一般，应该能理解本尊所说。不过一时无法接受罢了。这玩意为我雕刻而成，天下仅此一枚，道友若想再来拜会，不妨持此物前来。我自会安排接应，
en: You're extraordinarily smart, cultivator, so you should be able to understand what I was talking about. It's just that you can't accept it for the moment. I just made this, which is the only one of its kind in this world. If you wish to visit me again, you may come with it.

ch: 男子说完笑笑转身，潇洒离去。夜雨楼秀眉一蹙，说声胡说八道，将木雕照男子背心激射而出。
en: The man smiles and leaves. Night Rain frowns and says \"Nonsense\" while throwing the carved branch at the mysterious person.

ch: 然而男子只一闪即消失不见。下一刻夜雨楼头顶微有动静，她反应过来后，一枚精致木雕已然像簪子一般穿过她的头发，别在上面。
en: The man disappears suddenly, and Night Rain feels something moving over her head, and the next thing she knows, an exquisite wooden carving is in her hair like a pin.

ch: 衣香鬓影，精致木簪，倒也相得益彰。夜姑娘，琅琊阁的大门为你开着。我等你。
en: Your dress and the hairpin complement each other. The door of Manual Pavilion is always open for you. I'll see you later.

ch: 男子说完再次转身离开，夜雨楼则抚摸鬓边簪子，双手颤抖不已。
en: The man once again turns around and leaves while Night Rain strokes the hairpin with a trembling hand.

ch: 他……刚刚只需要轻轻一拂……就能将我头颅打烂……
en: He... could have just smashed my head... by simply waving his hand...

ch: 这支发簪十分古怪，<r>当中或藏有许多不为人知的秘密，要不要先查看一下呢</r>？
en: This hairpin is so strange. <r>It must contain many secrets. Should I inspect it first</r>?

ch: 哦？是你。呵呵，这便是张三的安排吗？
en: Oh? It's you. Hmph, so is this all Zhang San's plan?
It's been a long time, my friend. Do you still remember me?

ch: 还记得吗？云陌异族，风氏燧人；
en: Well. Remember? I'm from the Feng Clan, the alien race in Yun Mo.

ch: 后世称我为女娲，而昔日族中，大家都叫我风里希。
en: I'm known as Nuwa now, but in the old days, my fellow clansmen called me Feng Lixi.

ch: 嗯，原来如此。想必日前天元山发生剧变，生成结界，导致天元山通道接向旧日八荒。如此说来，你我已约有万年不曾见面了，难怪你已不记得我了。
en: It's not surprising to know that you can't recall me. In your eyes, I am just an old friend. But from my point of view, our story took place a long time ago. We haven't seen each other for at least 100,000 years, I guess?

ch: 风里希叮嘱继续上山需要先行参悟第十三律，要不要先到她提及的地方查探一下呢？
我受张三所托，在此接引前来的修仙者。
en: Zhang San asked me to stay here and guide the visiting cultivator.

ch: 如今你在天元山中，时刻受到影响，待我为你唤醒道心，再作前行吧。
en: Now that you're in Tian Yuan Mountain, you're under the influence. Let me elevate your Taoist Mind before you move forward.

ch: 不过，唤醒道心非同一般，需要你我全力激战之际，以我体内盘古真血点燃你蕴藏道心。因此你将与我一战。此战我不会留手，也请你万勿轻忽。
en: But the elevation requires extraordinary efforts. I need to ignite your hidden Taoist Mind with the true blood of Pangu in my body while you and I are having a duel. So I'll do my best to fight you, and so should you.

ch: 不错，你的实力已远超我的想象。
en: Very well. You're way more powerful than I expected.

ch: 后面的路由张三挚友苍龙镇守，苍龙与张三情谊深厚，如你贸然经过，恐怕他会将你视为前来闯关救主的琅琊阁人。
en: The road ahead is guarded by Black Dragon, Zhang San's best friend. If you are to pass there unannounced, he'll probably think you're a member of Manual Pavilion to save the Master.

ch: 张三与苍龙相交之际，曾以第十三律引起苍龙注意，苍龙得闻天籁，而张三喜获知音。是故这第十三律对于苍龙意义非凡。
en: When Zhang San met Black Dragon, he played the Thirteenth Verse to attract Black Dragon's attention. Black Dragon heard the beautiful ethereal music, while Zhang San found a like-minded friend. That's why the Thirteenth Verse is of great significance to Black Dragon.

ch: 而我手中玉笛则是参悟第十三律的关键。因此，张三曾以神念嘱托，希望我将玉笛转赠来者。来人悟得第十三律，即往后方雾海烟渚吹奏。苍龙闻声，自会明白一切。
en: So Zhang San asked me to give the Breaker who comes here a jade flute, which is the key to understanding the Thirteenth Verse. When one fully grasps the Thirteenth Verse, Black Dragon would hear the sound of music and know everything.

ch: 至于第十三律，我始终无法窥破，因此不能助你参悟此律。但我听闻当日张三曾于一个神秘竹林中，斫竹钻孔，创制第十三律。
en: But the Thirteenth Verse is too arcane for me to grasp. It was composed by Zhang San in a mysterious bamboo forest by making holes in the bamboo there.

ch: 据我所知，开天元音，远古希声，起于八荒形成之初，而第十三律亦据此推演所得。
en: As far as I know, the Thirteenth Verse derives from the ancient sound of Tian Yuan, which emerged at the birth of this world. Once it is played, the heavens and the earth would be transformed. Its power is immense.

ch: 而我昔日曾在一处名为“幽篁”的洞天之中，发现远古希声。你前去一探，或能有所发现。
en: I found the ancient sound in a cave called You Huang. Maybe you'll find something there.

ch: 唉，这玉笛原本就是当年机缘巧合下从你手中取走的，现在几经波折，总算兑现承诺将之归还你手了。
你脸现疑惑，想必心中有许多疑问。可是有什么想问吗？
en: You come here but haven't learned about the reasons behind your journey. Perhaps you're confused.

ch: 单从我口中并不能了解张三。要了解他，还是由你亲眼去看看为好。
en: You can't really know Zhang San from what I say. So it's best for you to meet him and see for yourself.

ch: 听闻远古之际，夸父族长昭灵曾在一处遗迹中篆刻壁画预言未来之事，壁画前留有梦尘匣数个，专为印证预言真伪，该匣开启后即能看见张三之事。
en: I heard that in ancient times, Zhao Ling, the chief of the Kuafu Clan, had created murals in the ruins to predict the future. Below the murals are several Dream Dust Boxes, designed to prove his prophecies. Open the boxes and you'll learn Zhang San's stories.

ch: 你若想了解张三，不妨前往遗迹一探。
en: If you want to know what kind of person Zhang San is, go to the ruins.

ch: 那就好。八荒危难，急如星火，还盼你尽快参悟第十三律，赶往山顶。
en: Alright. The world is facing imminent destruction. Please comprehend the Thirteenth Verse and climb up to the Mountain's top as soon as possible.

ch: 只见前方风允婼神情警惕，四处张望；而你的接近亦马上引起他的注意。
en: Feng Yunchuo is looking around warily and sees you approach him immediately.

ch: 唉，小女风里希突然瞒着我来到此处，如今不知去向。让我好生担心。
en: Alas, Feng Lixi sneaked out. I thought she was here, but she's not. I'm looking for my daughter.

ch: 风允婼突然神情变得十分专注，双眼看向前方，他略一思索后便即急步而去。
en: Feng Yunchuo suddenly becomes very focused and looks ahead. After contemplating for a while, he rushes off.

ch: 你跟随风允婼进入一片茂密竹林之中，只转了几转便失去了风允婼踪影。不过此时远方突然有人出声示警。
en: You follow Feng Yunchuo into a dense bamboo forest but soon lose sight of him. Then someone in the distance suddenly speaks out.

ch: 你所在地方突然黑影隆起，一只庞大的妖兽立在前方，对你嘶吼咆哮。
en: A dark shadow rises. A huge monster towers above you, hissing and roaring.

ch: 你将妖兽击败，未料只眨眼之间，妖兽重新聚合，恢复原形。
en: You defeat the monster, but in the blink of an eye, it reshapes into its original self.

ch: 此妖需以特殊方法击杀，平常武技灵技，奈何不得！唉，不得已，只好强行试试！
en: This thing can't be killed without a special technique. Normal martial skills don't work! Fine, I have to give it a go!

ch: 从旁出现的风里希念动咒诀，之后幽深竹林之中刮起狂风。而风声穿过周围竹子竟发出阵阵怪声。与此同时，你身上玉笛亦发出一丝若有若无的异响。
en: Feng Lixi shows up from the side and casts spells, after which a gust sweeps the bamboo forest and makes a strange sound through the surrounding bamboo. At the same time, your jade flute makes an unusual and inexplicable sound

ch: 啊？！这！可以给我看看那笛子吗？
en: What?! Can I see your flute?

ch: 你才将笛子交到风里希手中，前方妖兽已张开血盘之口，挥爪朝你两抓来。风里希闪身避过。但你两却因此被妖兽分隔开去。
en: Just as you hand the flute to Feng Lixi, the monster opens its giant mouth and swings its claws. Feng Lixi dodges them, but the two of you are separated by the monster.

ch: 这……管不了那么多了！你看看你身边一根翠竹，上面已有若干刻度。请你依我所说在上面分别洞穿孔窍！
en: I... We have no choice! See the scales on the bamboo there? Make holes on it!

ch: 你穿孔已毕，风里希再起风咒，那根竹子发出的声音越发古怪。时而仿佛编钟激响，震耳欲聋，时而又似呢喃细语，几不可闻。那妖兽闻此怪响十分难受，竟一把将风里希抓了起来。
en: When you've finished making the holes, Feng Lixi casts spells again and the bamboo starts to make more and more strange sounds. Sometimes it sounds like a deafening chime, and sometimes, an almost inaudible whisper. The sound infuriates the monster and it grabs Feng Lixi with one claw.

ch: 我……我无法施法，请你在末尾再开一孔，距离对上一孔约差三分！孔窍开毕，再以一口真元吹响竹管！
en: I... can't cast a spell now. Make another hole at the end of the bamboo, about three inches away from the previous one! Then blow the bamboo pipe with your true Yuan!

ch: 你含着一口真元对着竹管吹孔喷出，异响再次发出，同时周围竹管纷纷断折，周边实地亦陆续开裂，喷出熔岩。
en: You use your true Yuan to blow the pipe. Once again, it makes a strange sound, while all the surrounding bamboo breaks and the ground cracks, spewing out lava.

ch: 妖兽受怪响波及，痛苦难当，终于松开抓住风里希的大手。此时风允婼突然出现将妖兽制服。风里希眼看父亲现身，忙取匕首割下妖兽身上一物后迅速逃离。
en: The monster is in great pain amid the strange sound and lets go of Feng Lixi. At that moment, Feng Yunchuo suddenly shows up and contains the monster. When Feng Lixi sees her father, she cuts off something from the monster's body with a dagger and flees.

ch: 风允婼眼看女儿遁去，忙急步追赶，二人眨眼间就没了踪影。周围一切亦尽归平静，只余竹管所发余音仍未散去。
en: As his daughter disappears, Feng Yunchuo hurries to go after her. Both of them are gone and all is quiet in the forest, except for the lingering sound from the bamboo pipe.

ch: 方才吹动竹管发出异响，莫非与第十三律有所关联？这里应该就是女娲所说藏有第十三律奥秘的地方了。
en: Does the strange sound of the bamboo pipe have something to do with the Thirteenth Verse? There must be the place Nuwa said to find the secret of the Thirteenth Verse.

ch: 你回到刚才竹林深处静静参研，四周余音飘荡空中，仿佛团团无形气息穿梭流转。
en: You return to the bamboo forest and study the pipe. The lingering sound is there as if it were a mass of invisible breath flowing back and forth in the air.

ch: 竹管经你吹动之后，立即破裂四散，空中所留余音迅速聚合，发出异响。与此同时，你感觉眼前出现一片荒芜大陆，前方岩浆喷射，地裂天崩，轰隆巨响震耳欲聋。
en: When you blow on the bamboo pipe, it immediately breaks up and scatters, and the lingering sound in the air quickly converges into a cacophony of noises. A wasteland emerges before your eyes, with lava spewing out, the earth shattering, and the sky collapsing with a deafening roar.

ch: 你听见一声轰鸣，之前看见的荒芜大陆消失不见，眼前又是竹林景致。但是周围只有倒下的竹子，裂开的土地。附近地面还留有各种奇特纹理，似为余音声波所留。
en: You hear a loud rumbling and then the wasteland disappears and the bamboo forest comes back. But the bamboo is fallen and the ground is cracked with all sorts of unusual textures that look like they are left by the aftershocks of the sound waves.

ch: 你刚刚那样做实在太冒险了，什么远古希声，只怕子虚乌有！
en: That's too dangerous... The ancient sound? There is no such thing!

ch: 可是刚刚的确发出了那种声音了呀！
当时我在竹林中布下竹管阵，打算借之激发远古希声，击杀妖兽。只可惜，有些地方没想明白，因此一直没能成事。
en: I set up a bamboo pipe formation in the forest and thought I could trigger the ancient sound to kill the monster. But there remained something I couldn't understand and I didn't make it work.

ch: 只是没想到，我祭起风咒，却让恩人手中的笛子发出异响，而异响一发，竟带动了竹林竹管发出远古希声，由此逼退了妖兽。
en: I happened to hear similar sounds made by this flute, so I took a chance by following the scales of the flute's holes and having my savior carve them on the bamboo. It worked.

ch: 远古希声？你是从哪里知道这些的？
en: How did you learn all this?

ch: 我在祖先留书找到的。书中说，远古希声来自天地初成之际。这种声音十分宏大，却又不易听见，而且能塑造万物，十分神奇。
en: From a book left by my ancestors. It says that the ancient sound came from the beginning of the heavens and the earth. It's loud yet difficult to hear, and it can shape everything.

ch: 一成一毁总是相生并存，所谓塑造万物，也可能是毁灭万物的意思。刚刚希声一发，就显出十分强大的威力，可见这声音十分危险。你太鲁莽了。
en: With birth comes demise. If something can shape everything, it may destroy everything. Just now, the ancient sound managed to kill the monster. It's very dangerous. You really should have thought twice.

ch: 唉，连你也这么说，只怕父亲又要怪我了。
en: Is that so? Alas, I guess Father will be upset by that.

ch: 哼，知道就好。你来这里是出于一片好意，但一声不响的自个来，只会让我让族长担心！
en: Hmph, so you know about it, huh? I know you meant to help, but coming alone without telling anyone only makes me and Chief worry about you!

ch: 好了好了，末姐姐也来说教了。
风允婼负手前方，他身后站着的是风萍末。其时，风允婼正严辞斥责风萍末
en: Feng Yunchuo is standing with his hands in front of him, and behind him is Feng Pingmo. Feng Yunchuo is giving Pingmo a dressing-down.

ch: 你早就知道里希出来干什么对吧？
en: You knew what Lixi was doing, didn't you?

ch: 你瞒着我？心中可还当我是族长？你说，这演的是哪一出？给我详细道来！
en: And you didn't tell me anything? Do you still see me as Chief? Why did you keep it from me? Explain yourself!

ch: 里希曾与我说，我族恩人曾四方游历，成为八荒之中的修仙大能。她对恩人十分敬佩。再者，她觉得族人世受冥气之苦，惨不可言。因此她一直希望离开族中寻找破解族中厄运的方法。
en: Lixi told me that the savior of our clan had traveled around and was a remarkable cultivator. She admired him a lot. She also felt sorry for our clansmen who suffered the Nether Air. So she had always wished to leave and find a way out for the entire clan.

ch: 八荒广大，我们又何曾已一一探明？在遥远未知的地方也许真有克制冥气的办法也未可知。
en: This world is too vast and there are so many things we don't know about it. There may be a way to contain the Nether Air in a distant and unknown land out there.

ch: 哼，所以她就偷偷来到幽篁洞天？
en: Hmph, that's why she left for You Huang Cave behind my back?

ch: 里希年纪虽小，却非不识轻重。她来此处，乃是为了您身上的旧伤。
en: Lixi may be young, but she knows what she's doing. She came here in search of a remedy for your old injury.

ch: 里希曾说，族长早年为保护族人，身上曾落下暗伤。需服食幽篁洞天之中的妖兽气囊才能痊愈。
en: Lixi said you got injured when you fought to protect our clansmen, and the air bag of the monster in You Huang Cave could heal the problem.

ch: 所以她……她就设法以希声击杀那只遭冥气侵蚀的妖兽……
en: So she... came here and sought to kill the monster with the ancient sound...

ch: 不错。里希虽打定主意到外游历寻找根治族人的办法，但却又十分不放心。她不放心族长您的旧患。所以才偷偷来到此处为你取得妖兽气囊。
en: That's right. Lixi decided to leave the clan and find a way to cleanse the Nether Air, but she was worried about your old injury, Chief. That's why she left behind your back, trying to get the monster air bag for you.

ch: 里希……里希身上真血与我等不同。她极有潜力觉醒，成为我族未来希望。以你眼光应该也已看出来了。我是为了保护她才……
en: Lixi... Her true blood is different from ours. She has the potential to awaken and she's our best hope. You should know that I want to protect her and...

ch: 族长，我们不妨这样看待此事。若里希体内真血果然非比寻常，这不更应提早外出历练？
en: Chief, since Lixi's true blood is so extraordinary, isn't it all the more reason to let her leave the clan and grow stronger?

ch: 荒唐！她身系我族存亡之重，怎能冒险在外？
en: Ridiculous! She's the key to the very survival of our clan. I can't let her risk her life!

ch: 族长身系我族存亡之重，不也冒险在外？
en: You're also the key to the very survival of our clan, Chief. But you're already risking your life, aren't you?

ch: 族长，里希长大了，未来她的成就会比你我都高，你看她刚刚不就克制了幽篁洞天之中的妖兽了？我们应该尽早放手的。
en: Chief, Lixi's going to achieve much more than you and I. She managed to contain the monster in You Huang Cave, right? Let her do what she wants to do.

ch: 若族长仍不放心，我可以陪伴里希左右保护她平安。她对我始终有几分依恋，我也偶得机缘，并未被冥气侵蚀，不致惹来修仙者注意。
en: I can keep her company and protect her if you don't want Lixi to be on her own. She likes me, and I've yet to be corrupted by the Nether Air, which keeps me under the radar of cultivators.

ch: 风允婼脸现迟疑之色，他思索良久，仍无头绪，无奈下只发出一声长叹。
en: Feng Yunchuo looks hesitant and he ponders for a long time. He still can't make up his mind and gives a deep sigh.

ch: 只见远方风里希走在路上，但前路突然转出两人，正是风萍末与风允婼。
en: In the distance, Feng Lixi is walking down the road when two people suddenly show up. There they are. Feng Pingmo and Feng Yunchuo.

ch: 我知道的，父亲，我错了，我这就回族中。
en: I know, Father. I'm sorry. I'll go back with you to the clan.

ch: 族长、里希，你们先聊。我稍后再来。
en: Chief, Lixi, you two talk. I'll see you later.

ch: 里希，我知道你一直想到外面游历。且不说在外多有凶险，你怎知不会扑空一场，白费功夫？
en: Lixi, I know you've always wanted to see the world. But do you have the slightest idea how crazy this world is and that your efforts may not pay off?

ch: 父亲，族人太苦了。若有一线机会，我都愿意去尝试，去为他们争取。你说过，身为族长，保护族人就是你不能推卸的责任。我是你的女儿，保护他们，也是我的责任。
en: Father, our people have been suffering too much, and for too long. Even if there's only a glimmer of hope, I'll seize it to give them a better life. You said you were obliged to protect them as Chief. I'm your daughter, and I share your obligation.

ch: 也许，这就是我们的命呢？
en: But maybe it's our destiny to suffer?

ch: 不，岂有生来就注定要受苦这种说法？如果这是命，女儿就去改了它！
en: No, nobody is destined to suffer! If this is our destiny, I've got to change it!

ch: 嗯……需知道，出门在外，远非家中可比。
en: Well... Life away from home is not easy. You need to brace yourself for that.

ch: 父亲……你答应让我离开族中？
en: So, Father... does that mean you'll let me leave?

ch: 哼，再不答应，恐怕你得隐瞒于我离家出走了。不过你不要高兴太早，我会让风萍末一路上看着你，否则以你眼下本事，独自离家只怕眨眼就要遭殃。
en: Hmph, if I don't, you'll find a way out anyway. But listen, I'll send Feng Pingmo along so that she can keep an eye on you. Otherwise, you won't be able to save your own skin.

ch: 嗯，风萍末体质奇特，与常人无异，由她保护，不易遭外人察觉你的真实身份。
en: Yes, she's got a unique physique that makes her appear like a non-cultivator. She can help cover up your true identity.

ch: 啊，这个……给你，可以治你旧患。
en: So, this... is for you. A remedy for your old injury.

ch: 哼，本事不差，竟查到以远古希声击杀幽篁洞天内的大妖兽。先回家准备准备吧。风萍末在等着了。
en: Hmph, not bad. You managed to find out how to kill the Mythical Beast in You Huang Cave with the ancient sound. Alright, go back home and get ready. Feng Pingmo is waiting for you.

ch: 风允婼说完急急转过身去，带着女儿返回族中。
en: Feng Yunchuo then turns around and takes her daughter back to the clan immediately.

ch: 你依女娲指示来到一个石洞之中，深入后发现前方石壁分为三面，左中右分别篆刻：狩仙真血、双圣会面、赠笛之会；此外边角仍有一些壁画，不过大都已经残缺不存，仅有两三幅仍能查看。
en: You follow Nuwa's instructions and arrive at a stone cave. Deep in the cave, you find that the stone wall there is divided into three parts with three murals: True Blood of the Hunting Fairy on the left, Meeting of the Two Saints in the middle, and Gifting the Flute on the right. A few other murals can also be found around the corners, but most of them are broken and crumbling. Only two or three remain legible.

ch: 石壁之上篆刻一个男子正与一名女子恶斗，男子体内有一个发光的圆球，而女子体内有一滴血液。另外，石壁前方放置一个完整的秘匣，似能开启。
en: Above the stone wall is a mural of a man fighting against a woman. A glowing orb is inside the man's body and a drop of blood is inside the woman's body. You also find a secret box right in front of the stone wall.

ch: 秘匣一经开启，里面怪象纷呈......
en: You open the box, only to see a bizarre world.

ch: 只见一名人身蛇尾满脸煞气的女子正与张三鏖战。两人遥遥相对，分别以灵力攻击对方，僵持不下。
en: A serpent-tailed woman is fighting with Zhang San, her killing vibe high. They keep a distance away and are battering each other with Energy, but neither of them seems to have the upper hand.

ch: 二人各以性命相搏，胜负即将分晓。就在此时该名女子脸上煞气消去，同时身上浓重的冥气亦慢慢飘散，她跪倒抱头，似乎十分难受。张三则退开半步，一脸诧异。
en: Both of them are determined to kill the other, and it looks like the fight is finally coming to an end. At that very moment, the woman's killing vibe disappears, and the heavy Nether Air on her body fades away. She falls to her knees and holds her head in great distress. Astonished, Zhang San steps back.

ch: 但他立即醒转，又上前攻向那名女子。危急中女子急拔腰背饰物扫向张三。那件饰物状如长笛，挥动之际同时响起一丝若有若无的声音，张三似乎受到声音影响，出手稍慢，只来得及将对手手中玉笛缴下避过一击，而她则已趁机远遁。
en: But he immediately goes forward and strikes the woman, who takes out something from her waist and swings it at Zhang San. A faint sound is heard from the flute-like object in her hand. Zhang San is distracted and his moves slow down a bit. He manages to snatch the jade flute from his opponent's hand and dodge the blow, while she has taken the opportunity to escape.

ch: 这……就是狩仙子吗？好厉害的冥妖！这是……笛子吗？
en: So she's... the Hunting Fairy? This Nether Demon is insane! Is this... a flute?

ch: 石壁之上是一个头戴竹笠的男子，他眼看远方，而远方则是连绵山川。另外，石壁前方放置一个完整的秘匣，似能开启。
en: Above the stone wall is a man with a bamboo hat on his head. He's looking into the distance, where mountains roll into the horizon. In front of the stone wall, you see a secret box.

ch: 秘匣一经开启，里面怪象纷呈......
en: You open the box, only to see a bizarre world.

ch: 张三走在路上，只见前方一名身形曼妙的女子缓缓走近，那是冥妖狩仙子。张三皱了皱眉，立时骈指捻诀，准备与之决斗。
en: As Zhang San walks along the path, he sees a slender lady coming closer to him. She is the Hunting Fairy, a Nether Demon. Zhang San frowns, moves his fingers, and casts a spell, all ready to strike.

ch: 请不要误会，我没有恶意。
en: Please don't get me wrong. I come in peace.

ch: 我是来道谢的。先前我遭到琅琊阁劫持，受冥气感染，丧失神智，沦为旁人傀儡，多亏与你一战，触发我体内变化，这才清除所有冥气觉醒过来。
en: I'm here to say thank you. When I was kidnapped by Manual Pavilion, I was infected by the Nether Air and lost my sanity, completely at the mercy of those people. But our duel triggered a transformation in my body, cleansed my Nether Air, and brought me back to X.

ch: 不错，你果然有所察觉。如我所料不差。当日你我交手之际，因为全力应战，体内盘古真血全部觉醒。
en: That's right. I knew you could tell. I was fighting with all my might, and that awakened the true blood of Pangu in my body.

ch: 当时，我仿佛看见了天地四维，无穷宇宙，心底也产生无穷无尽的喜悦。这，应该是你将你的道心传递给我了？
en: I felt like I could see the four dimensions of heaven and earth and the vast cosmos. My heart was filled with endless joy. So I suppose you passed on your Taoist Mind to me, right?

ch: 那之后，我凭借盘古真血与道心相互作用，终于辟除体内冥气，并恢复了神智。也是道心，让我窥见了盘古真血的神妙。
en: After that, the interaction between my Pangu blood and Taoist Mind removed the Nether Air in my body and restored my sanity. The Taoist Mind has also allowed me to see the wonder of the true blood of Pangu.

ch: 当日一战，在下也是受益匪浅。如非你盘古真血的阳和之力，我的道心亦无法升华成长。
en: I also benefited a great deal from our fight. If it weren't for the Yang power of your Pangu blood, my Taoist Mind wouldn't have been able to grow.

ch: 道心传递到你身上之后，我感受到自己道心亦被塑造一新。那颗道心质朴纯和，十分剔透。你，不是一个恶人。
en: Ever since my Taoist Mind was passed on to you, it has been reshaped too, and I find it incredibly kind and pure. Turns out you're not an evil person.

ch: 我不是恶人？昔日丧失神智，所作恶事只怕不少。唉，今日前来，乃是为道谢，如今致意毕了。也该走了。
en: I'm not? I can't even remember how many evil deeds I did back when I lost my sanity. Alas, now that I've expressed my gratitude, it's time to say goodbye.

ch: 姑娘，且慢……今后，你有何打算？
en: Hold on, Lady... So, what's your plan now?

ch: 昔日我有一位朋友，从永宁州一直去到赤幽州，最后成为仙盟领袖。我很仰慕这位朋友，因此打算今后也四方游历，凭借这盘古真血的异能为八荒生灵做点好事，也算为我的过去赎罪……
en: A friend of mine went from Yong Ning to Chi You and then became the head of the Cultivator Alliance. I admire that, so my plan is to travel around and see the world. If I could also do good with the power of my Pangu blood, that would be an atonement for my sins...

ch: 四方游历，为八荒生灵做点好事？有意思。
en: Travel around and do good? Interesting.

ch: 张三目送她远去，然后转头看向另外一边。只见远山起伏，连绵不尽，张三略一迟疑，也终于迈开脚步，朝远方走去。
en: Zhang San watches her go away before he turns to look at the other side. Rolling mountains undulate and sweep down to the horizon. He hesitates for a while and then keeps walking down the road.

ch: 石壁之上篆刻一名男子将笛子递给一个人身蛇尾的女子。而男子似乎正在交代女子一些重要的事情。另外，石壁前方放置一个完整的秘匣，似能开启。
en: Above the stone wall is a mural of a man handing a flute to a woman with a snake's tail. He seems to be explaining something very important to her. In front of the stone wall, you see a secret box.

ch: 秘匣一经开启，里面怪象纷呈......
en: You open the box, only to see a bizarre world.

ch: 张三在远山前吹起玉笛，雾霭之中一个女子人影显露出现，
en: Zhang San plays his jade flute on a mountain. A woman is silhouetted against the fog.

ch: 久违了，张三。哦？你的道心并不稳定，可是遇有什么困难？
en: It's been a long time, Zhang San. Well, your Taoist Mind is getting irregular. What's wrong?

ch: 琅琊阁主意欲飞升上界，因此造成四方灾劫。我想阻止他。
en: The Master of the Pavilion seeks to ascend to the upper realms and calamities ensue. I need to stop him.

ch: 琅琊阁主，八荒唯一。要在他手上取胜，又谈何容易？
en: He's the best cultivator in this world. It won't be easy for me to beat him.

ch: 既是如此，那便打消这个念头吧。
呵呵，记得从前我跟你说过那名游历八荒的朋友。在我眼里，他从来不会放弃，遇有任何困难都不会。也是为此，那位朋友才能从永宁州一步步走到赤幽州，成为仙盟之主吧？
en: Well, remember that friend I told you about who was traveling around the world? No matter what happened, he never gave up. And that's probably why he came a long away from Yong Ning to Chi You and eventually became the head of the Cultivator Alliance.

ch: 如今你是后继之人，胸中志气，反而不如？
en: You're also a member of the Alliance. Where are your courage and resolve?

ch: 可惜！这位前辈所处时代终究太过久远，仙盟之中的记事也散轶不全，我无法从中推知其英风侠骨。
en: Unfortunately, this heroic former head of the Alliance lived in a time ages ago, and the incomplete archives in our Alliance don't document his stories.

ch: 听闻八荒远古，曾有三神器流传，辗转去到有缘人手中。我记得这位朋友手中便有其中一件神器。当年这位朋友，持神器、落金乌、平东海、破冥山、败刑天，统领仙盟，对抗兽潮，功绩那是数不尽数。
en: I've heard that in ancient days, there were three divine weapons, and this friend of mine had one of them. Empowered by it, he defeated the Golden Crow and Xingtian, conquered the East Sea and Nether Mountains, headed the Cultivator Alliance, and repelled the Wave of Monsters. He was a legend.

ch: 张三闻言，不禁陷入沉思，过了片刻之后眉头才舒展开来，最后露出恍然之色。
en: Zhang San is deep in contemplation when he hears that. After a few moments, he begins to look relaxed and less confused.

ch: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！你说得不错，是我器局小了。
en: Hahaha! You're right. I failed to see the big picture.

ch: 其实我想得一法，对付衡天。此法不易施行，不过或有一线胜机。
en: Actually, I've already got a plan. Things are going to be tough, but it may work.

ch: 不错，我想请你坐镇天元山中，接引我所选定之人。另外，我也拜托另一挚友帮忙，这是当年你对我出手时被我侥幸夺得的笛子，我凭此物在幽篁洞天中成功推演出第十三律，到时以此物响声必能唤醒我那朋友。
en: Yes, I would like you to stay in Tian Yuan Mountain and guide the person I select. I've also asked another friend for help. This is the flute I took from you when we fought, and I managed to compose the Thirteenth Verse with it in You Huang Cave. Play the flute, and my friend will heed the sound of the music.

ch: 一旦听到笛中希声，我那朋友就明白一切了。
en: Once he hears the flute, he'll know what's going on.

ch: 呵呵，说起来这支笛子其实也是我那位朋友当年于慌乱中交到我手中的。
en: You know what? I got this flute from my friend back in the day amid chaos.

ch: 话说回来，你……为何不亲自交给他？
en: But why don't you... give the flute to your friend yourself?

ch: 张三只是微笑，女娲则注视着他，二人良久不语，四方只闻天风吹拂之声。
en: Zhang San smiles and doesn't utter a word while Nuwa looks at him. They remain silent for a long time. The only sound heard is the gust of wind.

ch: 也许这是我的命吧？剩下的拜托你了。
en: Maybe this is my destiny. Alright, so now I'm counting on you.

ch: 张三起了个调子，再次吹响玉笛。一曲终了，他便将之交到女娲手中然后转身离去。
en: Zhang San starts to play his jade flute again. He finishes the tune and hands the flute over to Nuwa before he leaves.

ch: 边角残余壁画之中刻画头戴竹笠的男子正在带领一部分手下与另外一名男子对战，另一名男子抱胸傲立，不可一世。壁画前方秘匣已然损坏。
en: The remaining mural in the corner depicts a man wearing a bamboo hat leading his followers in a battle against a domineering opponent, who holds his arms and stands upright proudly. The secret box in front of the mural is damaged.

ch: 边角残余壁画之中刻画一个头戴竹笠的男子正在一片竹林中摸索一枚笛子。壁画前方秘匣已然损坏。
en: The remaining mural in the corner depicts a man wearing a bamboo hat groping for a flute in a bamboo forest. The secret box in front of the mural is damaged.

ch: 石壁之上留有数行文字：“昭灵上祖曾言八荒将面临终极灭世。为验证此说，上祖合共遗留八八六十四处石壁预言，以验证预言之真实。”
en: On the walls, you find several lines of writing. \"Zhao Ling the ancestor had predicted the demise of this world. To verify his prophecy, he created a total of 64 murals on stone walls.\"

ch: “此处推算皆已通过梦尘宝匣验证，可知八荒前途堪虞，我族命运堪虞。”
en: \"His prophecy has been validated by the Dream Dust Boxes. Obviously, the world is in jeopardy, and so are the lives of our people.\"

ch: “我夸父一族与八荒命运关联，上祖遗训需以一切方法，改变八荒终极命运，以延续盘古血脉。”
en: \"My Kuafu Clan shares the destiny of this world, and our ancestors told us to do whatever it takes to reverse the destruction of this world and continue the lineage of Pangu.\"

ch: “八荒不亡，则我族不亡，切记切记。”
en: \"Remember, the survival of this world is the survival of our clan.\"

ch: “梦尘宝匣乃上祖天工之作，可窥见未来之事，现取走余下宝匣以核验祖师其余石壁预言。”
en: \"The Dream Dust Boxes are works of art by the ancestors and offer a glimpse into the future. I take the remaining boxes to verify the other prophecies as depicted on the murals.\"

ch: “另，梦尘宝匣施以昭灵上祖推演秘术，珍贵难得，硕果仅存，后人需时加维护，勿使损坏。”
en: \"PS. The Dream Dust Boxes are imbued with Zhao Ling the ancestor's secret art. They are rare treasures. Protect them.\"

ch: 下方石壁残破脱落，已不能辨别上面字迹。
en: The stone wall below is so dilapidated that the writing on it is all illegible.

ch: 五音浑然，律吕和谐。第十三律……张三……那仿佛已是很久远的事了。
en: The symphony of the five tones, the harmony of so many notes. The Thirteenth Verse... Zhang San... They seem to come from eons ago.

ch: 哦，原来不是张三，只是……一介修仙者？
en: Well. You're not Zhang San. You're... just a cultivator?

ch: 你，回答我，所奏从何而来？
en: Tell me. How could you know the tune?

ch: 前方苍龙蛰伏，深眠不醒……
en: Black Dragon curls before you. He is sleeping...

ch: 你将笛子气孔附于嘴前，然后调真元，吐气息，将灵力灌注于笛子管窍之间。第十三律奏响，片刻之间山中曲声悠悠，四方余音袅袅。天地仿佛亦由此融入曲声之中，浑然交泰。
en: You hold the flute to your mouth and concentrate your power. Then, you send a breath imbued with energy into it.

ch: 第十三律奏响，片刻之间山中曲声悠悠，四方余音袅袅。天地仿佛亦由此融入曲声之中，浑然交泰。
en: The Thirteenth Verse begins. In a moment, an ethereal melody floats throughout the space, melting the world into its dulcet tune.

ch: 面前苍龙听了你的话后，玛瑙般的双眼放出凶光，下一刻嘴巴一张，发出一声震吼。
en: Hearing your explanation, Black Dragon glares at you. His agate-like eyes glow with horrible enmity. Then, he lets out a deafening roar.

ch: 第十三律来自创世元音，远古希声，岂是你此等肉体凡胎能参悟得了？
en: The Thirteenth Verse comes from creating notes at the very beginning of the world. Such an ancient sound is beyond mortal's ears, and how could you create it by yourself?

ch: 敢在吾面前胡言乱语？！今日叫你受五雷轰顶之劫！
en: You dare lie to me?! Meet your retribution of lightning bolts!

ch: 面前苍龙闻言，鬃须戟张，布满利齿的嘴巴猛一张开，发出一声惊天动地的啸吼。
en: Black Dragon's quills stand like spikes upon hearing your explanation. He lets out a deafening roar, revealing the sharp teeth hidden in his mouth.

ch: 我欣赏桀骜不驯之人，却痛恨被此辈冒犯。
en: Unyielding persons are worthy of my respect as long as they don't offend me.

ch: 等着骨肉成泥，死无全尸吧，修仙者！
en: Cultivator! I'll smash you to smithereens!

ch: 无名道心，第十三律，玉笛来龙……
en: The Nameless Taoist Mind, the Thirteenth Verse, the Jade Flute, and the dragon...

ch: 你……是张三指引前来之人……所幸及时压服前方结界生出的影响……
en: You... followed the guide of Zhang San... Fortunately, the fight between us helped me to subdue the influence of the array ahead...

ch: 我原为上界白璧上的一道龙纹石刻，意外跌落八荒下界，为创世元音唤醒，最终化为应龙。
en: I used to be a carving on a jade plate known as Nine Dragons in the upper realm, but I fell into this world. Then, I was wakened by the creating note and became a winged dragon.

ch: 昔日好友张三几番重托，希望我镇守此间，设法维持封印，并击退琅琊阁来救之人。
en: My friend, Zhang San, entrusted me with a significant mission. He hoped I to guard here and maintain the seal, as well as drive the minions from the Manual Pavilion away.

ch: 我举手抬足之际即能引动天雷，一切自然而然。昔日翱翔飞行无意之中已不知击死几多不入流的修仙者，不知所谓“出手”又是从何说起？
en: I am a natural summoner of lightning bolts, and they are just following me wherever I go. Many petty cultivators have perished under my unintentional bestowing when I soar on the sky, and why would you call it as \"attack\"?

ch: 哼，不过刚才之事却又另当别论。
en: Hmph. But there is another reason behind it.

ch: 从此上山，就是张三封印琅琊阁主衡天的地方。我受张三重托守护前方封印。
en: Here, a path leads to the place where the Master of the Pavilion is sealed by Zhang San. I am a guardian of the seal, following Zhang San's instruction.

ch: 然而张三的封印终究太过霸道，虽然我已远离封印之处，仍然受到封印之力的影响。
en: But Zhang San's seal is something to be feared of. Though I am far from the seal, I am still influenced by it.

ch: 再则，受困的琅琊阁主衡天也一直竭尽全力破解封印。此人果然不同寻常，即使困在结界之中，力量减弱，所发灵力仍然有部分穿透结界，涌出外面。
en: And the trapped Master of the Pavilion keeps trying his best to break the seal. He is a powerful opponent, and even though he has been trapped inside the array for so long, his weakened power still seeps away into the world.

ch: 而我，长年受两股力量的影响，已然十分虚弱。故此刚刚失去常性，发出攻势。
en: My strength has long been impacted by the two kinds of power, and I am too feeble to maintain my nature. That's why I went wild and attacked you.

ch: 前方结界为张三苦心创制，一旦划定界限，天下之间，所有东西都无法出入。当然，也包括你。
en: The array ahead is conjured by Zhang San with effort. Once set, it will block everything, including you, from passing through it.

ch: 张三希望我镇守在此，是为我实力强悍，能为你暂时打开结界进入击败阁主。
en: Zhang San asked me to guard here because he knew I could open the array for a while and let you enter it to defeat the Master.

ch: 但是，长久以来，我已被结界之力，以及阁主破界之力反复摧残，眼下已无力为你开路。
en: However, the attrition from the two sources - the array itself and the Pavilion Master's attempt - has consumed much of my power. Now, I am too weak to open the array.

ch: 我早已察觉自己修为正逐渐衰减，不堪破界。唯今之计是重回昔日张三推演结界之处，设法从蛛丝马迹之中洞悉山巅阵法原理。
en: I have already known this situation. The only hope to enter the array is to return to where Zhang San conjured it and deduce the theory behind it using hints and clues there.

ch: 还记得早年我从白璧脱离后几番苦寻，终于找到一处仙洲龙眠屿暂时栖息。后来我又邀请夸父一族昭灵上祖来到仙洲为我推算未来之事。他便也在仙洲中暂住下来了。
en: Cultivator, do you remember the place where your journey began? The place is called Ghost Valley, and it was conjured by Zhang San in Tian Yuan Mountain as his last solution.

ch: 昭灵当时于仙洲一个名为鱼眼洲的小岛上留下大量推演痕迹，里面包含无穷义理。事成后，昭灵又将占卜结果以特制的元关锁全部封存，以防旁人机缘进入窥见天机。
en: Years ago, Zhang San invented a secret technique and conjured an island called Dragon's Haven for me to dwell in as an exercise. The theory behind it has been polished and improved in conjuring Ghost Valley afterward.

ch: 我与张三相识后，他时常来到仙洲之中与我相聚。他查看昭灵上祖的留下的推演法门以及元关锁，终于触类旁通，创出一个奇特的封印。你只需前往仙洲，查看昔日昭灵上祖的竹庐前留下的推演秘文，就能发现许多天元山巅的结界线索，从而打开结界。
en: We used to meet on the island from time to time, and he also left many insights into exploring the source of the Tao and knowledge in practicing incredible spells. Perhaps you can find the key to the array there.

ch: 不过，龙眠屿作为一处洞天，非真非幻，变动不居，寻常之人不易寻得。如今我予你一口吐息，到时你去到指定之处，吹开裂隙，当能从容进入。
en: The Dragon's Haven exists somewhere out of time and space and is inaccessible to ordinary people. Here, I'll condense a destiny for you using my breath, and you can perform Geomancy there to find it.

ch: 苍龙说到这里，之前气势似乎突然收敛，暗藏的霸气瞬间荡然无存。
en: Black Dragon pauses. He seems to become a creature less formidable, and his majestic atmosphere vanishes.

ch: 我，另有一事相托。昔日张三曾留下一件东西藏于仙洲群山水潭之中，他在里面收藏一件物品，希望留给我。
en: Besides, I have to ask you to do me a favor. Years ago, Zhang San left something beneath the lake on the island, which contained a souvenir that he wanted to gift to me.

ch: 那物品是留给我的信物，借此纪念彼我之间的友谊。
en: Yes, it's a souvenir. A reminder of our friendship.

ch: 昔日我一直没将那东西放在眼里，现今却很希望将之打开，看看里面到底藏着什么……你身负我之吐息，届时若你能设法取得此物，我当能从中感知。
en: I used to look down upon it, but now I want to open it and see what's inside... Now I've bestowed my breath upon you, and if you could get it, I'll also know.

ch: 苍龙一直念叨，可渐渐已听不清他说话的内容了。苍龙似在追忆前事，然而他慢慢合上了眼垂下了龙首，依在山壁边上，隐没于层云之中。
en: Black Dragon continues to murmur, but his words are carried away by the wind. The Dragon seems to be lost in his past, and he closes his eyes. His head leans on the cliff beside him amid the dense clouds that envelop everything.

ch: 我受好友重托，镇守天元山中，防止旁人进入，破坏山巅结界。任何人等不得从此通过！
en: I am entrusted by my friend to guard Tian Yuan Mountain. I must prevent anyone from destroying the array on the Mountain's top. No one shall pass from my side!

ch: 宵小之辈，上天有好生之德，今日饶你一名，下山之后，罚你永世不得接近天元山！
en: Petty cultivator, I spare you only because Heaven hates killing. Go away now, and you'll be banned from entering Tian Yuan Mountain forever!

ch: 苍龙转头遥望苍天，接着发出一声叹息。苍龙似在追忆前事，然而他慢慢合上了眼垂下了龙首，依在山壁边上，隐没于层云之中。
en: Black Dragon gazes into the sky and sighs. The Dragon seems to be lost in his past, and he closes his eyes. His head leans on the cliff beside him amid the dense clouds that envelop everything.

ch: 你来到苍龙指示的地点，深吸一口气，将苍龙吐息呼出。片刻后，前方空间受吐息影响，缓缓裂开一道口子。
en: You follow Black Dragon's words and find the place. Then, you take a deep breath and exhale the Dragon's essence into the air. A crack opens before you, revealing the scenery of limpid lakes and lush hills inside it.

ch: 你进入洞天后，只见远山连绵，环抱一个大湖。当中湖水受到山势围拢，前宽后窄，远看就像一条游鱼。而湖心有一座翠竹茂密的小岛，仿如鱼眼，估计就是苍龙所说的鱼眼洲。
en: You send the Dragon's breath into it, and the crack widens to welcome you.

ch: 你踏上小洲，闲步于如墨竹影之中；举目一看，只见竹荫深处，立着一座竹庐。而里面空无一人，似乎搁置已久。
en: Bamboos grow in the central sandbank. Inside the bamboo forest, you find a hut made of bamboo sticks. Perhaps it is the dwelling of Zhang San, Black Dragon's best friend.

ch: 你进入竹庐之中，发现地上全是各种推演的思路。边角上用尖刀刻着一幅画，画中则是另一个竹林，你对这个地方感到似曾相识，仿佛曾在何处见过。
en: You step into the hut and find there are flowcharts and diagrams of various divination on the ground. You notice a knife-caved picture at the corner, which reveals the scene of another bamboo forest. A strange familiarity comes into your mind; it seems that you have already seen the forest before.

ch: 地上文字应是昔日夸父族昭灵上祖推演的思路。张三应该就是从中发现奥秘继而触类旁通创制出特殊封印的。
en: I see. Zhang San conjured an alternative space to seal the Pavilion Master. I remember the bamboo forest when I was young when the old master told me to go to Tian Yuan Mountain. Is there a special space set by Zhang San? Or, is the old man Zhang San?

ch: 如今应可回去天元山上，将最后道路打通了。不过这处龙眠屿中似乎另有隐秘，要不要再探索探索呢？
en: Now maybe the time has come. It seems that I can return to Tian Yuan Mountain and remove the last obstacles on the road.

ch: 你从大湖离开，于空中鸟瞰龙眠屿，可见大湖后方是连绵丘陵，大片山峰之中有一个小湖，那就是苍龙所指的地方。
en: You follow Black Dragon's words and leave the large lake to see the Dragon's Haven from above. You find numerous hills behind the large lake, and there is a little lake amid the mountains. It must be the lake the Dragon mentioned.

ch: 你来到小湖之中，只见一个模样怪异的东西悬于半空。此物应该就是苍龙所说的元关之锁。
en: You come into the little lake and find a curious device floating in the air. It must be the Crucial Lock mentioned by Black Dragon.

ch: 你拨动元关锁后，当中数之不尽纠错交缠的直木，竟退出来一条。直木一旦退出，则露出里面空间，而当中则有光影投出。
en: You try to stir the lock, and one of the wooden sticks interlocking with each other moves out from its core. Beams of light emit from the space previously occupied by the stick.

ch: 元关锁直木重新复位，而元关锁中直木互相绞合的空隙中透出光亮，似乎可以继续拨动其余构成锁子的直木。
en: The wooden stick is reset to its position, and beams of light continue to emit from the space behind the interlocking sticks. Maybe you can try to move other sticks in the lock.

ch: 关元锁直木重新复位，而元关锁中直木互相绞合的空隙中透出光亮，似乎可以继续拨动其余构成锁子的直木。
en: The wooden stick is reset to its position, and beams of light continue to emit from the space behind the interlocking sticks. Maybe you can try to move other sticks in the lock.

ch: 面前所见天地陷在一片混乱中。地上裂纹开开合合，炽热的岩浆从中冒出，抬头看去，天上铅云密布看不见一线天光。有时怪响一发，竟将高空云层震裂，掉落零星碎片。
en: The world is in chaos. You see cracks emerge and close on the ground, red-hot lava gushing from them. The sky is heavily laden with clouds, blocking beams of sunlight out. Occasionally a strange bang comes from nowhere, and shards fall from clouds shaken by the sound.

ch: 此时岩浆喷涌，在一个低洼之处聚成大片池子，并迅速将周围草木、岩石融化。然而此时，一片白璧却安然无恙从岩浆中浮了出来。
en: Meanwhile, torrents of lava flow into a basin and melt all plants and rocks inside it. Then, a white jade plate floats up from the glowing pool, its appearance intact.

ch: 天地之间异响频繁，就在此时，那片漂浮在岩浆上面的白璧突然发生皲裂，继而白光猛闪，一条青色长龙破壁而出，腾飞高空。
en: Strange bangs continue. Just at the time, you see the jade plate begins to crack. White beams flash around, and a black dragon flies out from the jade into the cloud.

ch: 至此眼前情景一变，只见一名须髯略白的修仙者靠在一个奇怪的木条交汇体上正查看着什么。
en: You see a cultivator with a slightly grey beard. He is leaning on a curious structure made of wooden sticks and is watching something.

ch: 喂……老东西，快来看，这是不是你？是不是？！喂，你出生了啊！哇，好强的样子！身上还带电呐！
en: Hey... old guy! Have you seen it? Is it you? It's the same as you! Hey, you're born! Wow, you're so strong! You have electronic sparks!

ch: 莫以“喂”作呼唤……更勿以“老东西”相称……
en: Don't address me with \"Hey\" or call me as \"old guy\"...
Come and see it! Or you will regret it!

ch: 苍龙凑近一看，神情立即变得十分震惊。
en: Black Dragon comes near and takes a look. His expression betrays his astonishment.

ch: 哎呀，可惜了，那块龙纹白璧若还能搞到手，一定能卖很多灵石吧？
en: Well, what a pity. If you kept the dragon-patterned jade plate, it must be worthy of many Spirit Stones now.

ch: 胡搅蛮缠，岂可将上界白璧与八荒灵石相提并论？
en: Nonsense. The jade plate is a treasure from the upper realm, and it would be inappropriate to price it in Spirit Stones in this world.

ch: 不能相提并论，那就说明的确可以卖很多灵石了吧？那或者是要很多龙纹白璧才能买得一枚灵石？哈哈哈哈哈！
en: Inappropriate to price it in Spirit Stones? Do you mean it can really be traded for millions of Spirit Stones? Or do you mean you can only earn one Spirit Stone with millions of dragon-patterned jade plates? Hahaha!

ch: 喂，这个元关锁十分玄妙，应是什么高人遗下的吧？而且怪就怪在这里面还有一些你的往事。
en: Hey, that Crucial Lock looks odd. It must come from a master artisan. And it recorded some of your past. That's even odder.

ch: 不单往事，还有未来之事。许久以前，八荒夸父族中曾有一名族人拥有至为纯正的盘古之血，此人善于占卜后世之事；当时我以一滴应龙心血作为交换，让此人帮我推算未来，以窥见我是否能于未来顺利回归上界。
en: Not only your past but also your future. Eons ago, there was a clansman in the Kuafu Clan with the purest Pangu's blood. He could make incredible divination, and I asked him to help me see my future by giving him a drop of my dragon's blood. I wondered if I could return to the upper realm someday.

ch: 夸父族人答应此事，来到洞天，八十年闭关不出，推算了我的前途命运，再以元关锁封住，以防后人随意窥见。而此人即是夸父族的一代神算昭灵上祖。
en: The man agreed to help me. Then, he found a cave and lived there in seclusion for eighty years. In the end, he managed to make the said divination, and he sealed the result in a Crucial Lock to keep it secret. He was Zhao Ling the ancestor, a legendary prophet in his clan.

ch: 怪不得，怪不得，他在竹庐之中关于结界的推演已使我受益匪浅，眼前元关锁更让我大开眼界。
en: No wonder his divination is so insightful. I have seen the divined results on arrays in the bamboo hut, and that Crucial Lock also amazes me.

ch: 昭灵推演之中，亦有不少关于你的事情，仔细看看没准能看见你日后的惨淡收场。
en: The divination of Zhao Ling also mentioned your future. Do you want to know how pathetic your ending will be?

ch: 哼，我才不看。昭灵是夸父族中一代英杰不假，但未必就能算尽一切。未来由我一手掌握，岂是旁人能推算得了？
en: No. Zhao Ling was indeed a master predictor, but he may not tell out all events in one's life. The master of my fate is myself, not a man lived centuries ago.

ch: 慢着，这里面有我未来的事吗？昭灵不是给你算的命？怎么会有我？不行我还是得看看！
en: Well... You say the divination mentioned me? Zhao Ling asked only your question, then why did he mention me? Hey, let me see it, and just forget my comment on him.

ch: 苍龙还想说话，那名头戴斗笠须髯略白的修仙者早已掠空而过，跑到元关锁前摸索查看。
en: Black Dragon is about to speak, but the gray-bearded cultivator with a bamboo hat has already flown nearer. He runs to the Crucial Lock and starts to inspect it.

ch: 一名背负竹笠的修仙者正在为一支支竹子穿孔，洞开一个个孔窍。
en: A cultivator carrying a bamboo hat is making holes in bamboo tubes. He has already left many holes.

ch: 嗯，幽篁洞天之中似被希声影响，以致于这里周围留有余音。这些刻孔都是人为的，当年定有人在此进行刻画。
en: Yes. It seems that You Huang Cave has been influenced by ancient sounds, and they still resonate around here. These holes are made by human beings, and I believe that there must be someone carving some patterns in the past.

ch: 若能破解这里面的难题肯定很有趣。世间普遍认为只有五音十二律。参透此处玄机之后，我定要创制第十三律，叫世人大开眼界！
en: It must be fascinating to figure out the principle behind them. People believe that there are only five tones and twelve verses exist, and after comprehending the theory here, I would create the Thirteenth Verse and surprise the world!

ch: 嗯，这样安置竹管应该就可以了。
en: This will work, I guess. The predecessors who have left clues here are truly masters.

ch: 修仙者把一支支的竹子安放整齐，然后将吹孔一一贯通，并以奇特的软管连到自己手中笛子之中。
en: The cultivator arranges bamboo tubes into a particular pattern and pierces through each of them. Then, he connects the tubes to the flute in his hands with curious soft pipes.

ch: 他吸了口气将竹子吹响后，一声长鸣恍如龙啸，响彻九天。同时铅云瞬间遍布头顶，顷刻之间大雨倾盆，放眼远眺，还可见几道旋风接天生成。
en: He takes a deep breath and sends it into the bamboo tubes. A sharp, clear sound resonates like a dragon's voice through space. Grey clouds gather above him, and soon torrential rain pours down. On the horizon, tornados extend and reach the ground.

ch: 此时，天空中云层破开，射入一缕天光，继而一条青龙于空中逶迤而来停在张三面前。青龙发出一声咆哮，双眼死死盯着张三，似在打量眼前人类。
en: Meanwhile, a beam cuts through heavy clouds. A black dragon soars through the air and descends before Zhang San, his eyes staring at the man.
The creating note and the ancient sound?!

ch: 错了，这可有些不一样。这是在下自创的，第十三律。
en: No. It's something different. It's the Thirteenth Verse I created.

ch: 一轮满月高悬空中，其时清辉洒地，照得湖面一片柔光。只见张三舒展身体坐在地上，旁边苍龙则探头而出。一人一龙正在闲谈。
en: A full moon drifts into the sky. Its chilly glow sparkles on the lake's surface. You see Zhang San sitting on the ground leisurely, chatting with the Dragon peeping beside him.

ch: 其实，你的第十三律究竟从何而来？下界修仙者真有机缘感悟此等希声？
en: To be honest, I wonder where you found the Thirteenth Verse. And is it possible for cultivators in the lower realm to learn it?

ch: 昔年我与一位朋友交手时，从她手上夺得一支笛子。那笛子所用的竹子十分奇特，极少得见。我几番搜寻，最后终于找到了那片竹林。
en: Years ago, I fought against one of my friends and seized a flute from her. It was made from a rare bamboo tube, and after painstaking searches, I found the forest where the species grow.

ch: 那片竹林就更是奇怪了，里面都是缕缕余音飘荡空中，地上奇特纹理此起彼伏，像是被什么无形气浪反复推动而成。我从这些蛛丝马迹之中反复推演，终于形成第十三律。
en: The bamboo forest was stranger than anything I knew. Lingering sounds reverberated amid it, and there were curious textures made by something like airflows on the ground. I divined many times using the clues, and finally, I created the Thirteenth Verse.

ch: 喂，讲讲你的故事呗。你老是强调什么你是上界的龙，和我们这些八荒的修仙者不一样。
en: Well, now it's your turn to tell me about yourself. You always say you're a dragon from the upper realm, and you're different from the cultivators here like me.

ch: 哼，我原是上界“九族龙纹”璧上篆刻的一条应龙，因为各种原因，白璧分裂脱落，我因此掉落下界来到八荒。
en: Hmph. I used to be a winged dragon carved on the jade plate called Nine Dragons in the realm. The plate shattered into pieces for some reason, and I fell into this world because of it.

ch: 初来此地，八荒为盘古巨人劈开生成未久，天地之间，正不断被重新塑造。那时周围发出各种创世元音，远古希声。然而时至今日，早已听不到那种声音了。
en: At the time I arrived here, the world was just split apart by Pangu, and everything was being created between the sky and the earth. Various creating notes and ancient sounds resonated around, but since then, they have been nowhere to be heard.

ch: 在上界，那种声音能通过仙人的调律重现。九族龙纹存放之处，即常有仙人弹奏那种声音。
en: Immortals in the upper realm can reproduce the sounds by tuning. In the place where the jade plate was stored, I could hear them being played by immortals.

ch: 长年留在八荒，白璧的灵气也逐渐消散，当时正巧是八荒形成的紧要关头，塑造之声发出，竟然将白璧重新唤醒，而我亦在此时挣脱白璧，破空离去，成为八荒之中的一条应龙。
en: After years of attrition in this world, the Qi inside the jade plate seeped away. Just at the subtle time when the world was being generated, a creating note sounded and wakened the jade plate again. Shortly after, I escaped from it and flew into the sky, and became a winged dragon in this world.

ch: 你的第十三律来自创世元音，远古希声，因此我初闻此律便十分惊讶，并将此律视为回归上界的关键线索。
en: Your Thirteenth Verse comes from these creating notes and ancient sounds. Therefore it surprised me the first time when I heard it. I also see it as a key to my return to the upper realm.

ch: 希望你不要会错意了，你我不是朋友。你，只是我回归上界的关键。
en: Don't overread my words. We're not friends. You're but a person to be utilized in my returning journey.

ch: 你说的话，我一个字都不信。第十三律所奏曲调都是我的心声。言语行为都能虚伪作假，但心声不会。
en: I don't believe what you have said. The Thirteenth Verse comes from my innermost feelings. Persons may disguise themselves with words and actions, but their feelings cannot be covered up.

ch: 你对我的心声产生感应，那至少说明你的内心光明磊落。
en: My feelings can touch you as well, which at least means your nature is honest.

ch: 我的内心当然光明磊落。我不就一直告诉你，我在利用你吗？
en: I am honest, indeed. I always tell you that I'm making use of you.

ch: 哈哈，不是这个意思。是说你正直可靠，足以托付大事。这在八荒大陆之中，可是难得的品质。
en: Haha. I mean something else. I mean, you're upstanding and reliable and can be trusted in critical matters. Such character is rarely to be seen in the world.
Understand it as you like. I don't care.

ch: 嗯，我不会看错的。仙盟还有要事，我去处理一下，改天再来看你。
en: Yes, I believe in my eyes. I'll leave for urgent matters in Cultivator Alliance. See you later.

ch: 张三朝身边的苍龙挥手作别后，便即御剑而去。
en: Zhang San bids goodbye to the Dragon and strides away.

ch: 你正想离开，不知触发了什么机关，湖岸树藤巨木相继挪开，露出一条不知通向何处的道路。
en: You are about to leave, but you seem to trigger a secret device. Vines and trees around the lake's shore move away, and a path leading to somewhere unknown reveals itself.

ch: 你从湖中离开，沿山路一直前行，不多时已进入地底一个隐秘窟穴，而里面同样留存一个元关锁。
en: You leave the lake and walk down the mountain path. Shortly after, you enter a cave beneath the earth, and there is also a Crucial Lock inside it.

ch: 关元锁直木重新复位，而元关锁中直木互相绞合的空隙中透出光亮，似乎可以继续拨动其余构成锁子的直木。
en: The wooden stick is reset to its position, and beams of light continue to emit from the space behind the interlocking sticks. Maybe you can try to move other sticks in the lock.

ch: 只见张三坐在鱼眼洲中，旁边苍龙游在水中，探出半边身子，正与张三说话。
en: Zhang San is under a tree. He is playing the Thirteenth Verse with his jade flute, and Black Dragon emerges from mists following its notes. His agate-like eyes are gazing at the man curiously.

ch: 你所说的道源，森罗万象，难窥际崖。即使是你们所说的上界，对之了解亦不过冰山一角。更何况是我们？
en: This time I see Cultivator Alliance endures a bitter defeat against the Manual Pavilion. Perhaps I underestimated our opponents.

ch: 哈哈，我们？你不以上界应龙自居了？
en: You'll lose if your plan remains unchanged.

ch: 我在上界不过是一枚具有灵性的白璧，后来破壁而出，生于斯长于斯，说是八荒应龙，不是合情合理？
en: Yes? As a mighty creature, you must have wonderful pieces of advice.

ch: 好好好，不再挤兑你了。我们继续说道源之事。
en: My interest only lies in two matters. One is to return to the upper realm. Another is the Thirteenth Verse. I don't care about anything except for them.

ch: 这不过都是我的浅见，未必就是道源真相。我认为道源自己本身就在不断完善自身。我们所说的天地规则，也未必一成不变，只要道源成长，肯定也会对法则进行修补演化。
en: No. Actually, you're afraid that your assistance will render me more foolhardy and reckless. I know you're always considerate.

ch: 这不就和你所说的道心升华十分相似吗？道心不断成长而至升华，从而对道源发生感应，设法从中吸纳精华，再使道心本身作出成长。
en: Don't express your affection to an uninterested person. I find you just because I am attracted by your Thirteenth Verse, which is similar to the sounds in the upper realm and the creating notes at the beginning of the world.

ch: 可以说，你发现的所谓道心，亦暗暗遵循道源一切演化法则。道源分化，即成千万道心。道心聚合，则还原道源本体。
en: I know. So I am asking you to do me a favor, that is, to listen to me complaining. You must feel annoyed now, yes? You have said many times. Well, except for talking about my misfortune, today I also bring something to you that you must be interested in.

ch: 当然，设以无限之道心，只怕也难还原道源之万一。
en: Zhang San waves his hands and reveals a crack before him. Inside it, a vast lake spreads in front of lush mountains and hills covered by otherworldly plants.

ch: 万物并作，吾以观复，可说是道源的最好写照。至于我们，作为个体的目光，要想看明白一切，真是千难万难。
en: Zhang San rides on the Dragon's back and guides him to enter the crack. Then, they descend to a piece of land at the center of the lake.

ch: 作为无限寰宇的个体，原本就是沧海蜉蝣，不值一提。知道自己的渺小，总比目空一切来得要好。
张三但闻斯语，不禁露出担忧的神情。
en: An island is an isolated but habitable land surrounded by water. Here is an island in the vast lake, and I'll call it \"central sandbank\". It makes a good place to dwell in for me, and all the rest here are yours.
Well, I mean, where is this space from...

ch: 你跟我说过你以前在上界的情景，我依你描述给你造了一片地方，我将此地命名为“龙眠屿”，为你所有。如今你已是一方仙主啦，哈哈。
en: You have told me the scenery in the upper realm you have seen, and I conjured a place according to it. Here, the Dragon's Haven, the place is yours. Now you are a \"landlord\", haha.
Isn't it similar to what you have said?

ch: 造这个可是费了我好多心思。可能你不相信，我借了天元山背后的玄机来搭建这个地方的。你不是跟我说过吗？天元山是沟通诸界的关键，我一查勘果然如此。这个龙眠屿也是这个道理。只不过我如今初得门径，没法熟练运用，不然再接通仙盟就方便多了，打开个口子就到了。如此一来，仙盟呆无聊就来这边散心。你这臭脸看烦了就回到仙盟避难。
en: It is a tricky place for me to conjure. Believe it or not, I made it using the principle behind Tian Yuan Mountain. You have told me that Tian Yuan Mountain is a crossroad leading to many realms, and my study proved it. The Dragon's Haven follows the same theory, but now I have just practiced it a bit and still need more training to command the technique. If I could master it, I'll connect here to Cultivator Alliance with a little crack. Therefore, I'll have two retreats. One is the Alliance without the naughty dragon, and another is here without mundane matters.

ch: 哈哈，今日就此作罢。仙盟之中还有要事，下次再跟你唠。这龙眠屿中可有说不尽的奥妙。
en: Haha. That's all I'd say today. I need to deal with urgent matters in Cultivator Alliance. See you next time! The Dragon's Haven is certainly a place full of mysteries.

ch: 张三大笑声中，挥手召出飞剑，乘风而去。
en: Zhang San laughs. He summons a flying sword and soars away into the distance.

ch: 你赢不了我，我也无法胜你。今日就此作罢。
en: You cannot defeat me, and I cannot defeat you. We could only reach a stalemate today.

ch: 加上我呢？你我之间的账也该清算一下了。
en: What if I join in the battle? Time to settle the matters between us.

ch: 狩仙子？很好。我不去找你，你倒自己送上门来了。
en: The Hunting Fairy? Good. I'm too busy to track you, but you walk into my trap.

ch: 阁主与张三实力只在伯仲之间，此时加上女娲合力围攻，马上只有苦苦抵挡的份。
en: The Pavilion Master and Zhang San are equal opponents, and now he can only resist attacks from Zhang San and Nuwa with all his might.

ch: 衡天，我再给你一个机会。就此罢手吧。
en: Hengtian, I'll spare you if you abandon your plan.

ch: 罢手？我要打开飞升关口，让八荒修仙者飞升上界，避过八荒灾劫。这做的是好事，为什么要罢手？
en: Abandon my plan? I'll open the gateway to ascension. Then, all cultivators here will enter the upper realm and be free from the ultimate destruction. I used Nether Air to grant cultivators a chance to reach Reborn and Transcendent, and all I've done are just! Why should I abandon my plan?

ch: 动手吧，此人执迷不悟，已经无法说服。
en: Do what should be done. This person is too obsessive to be persuaded.

ch: 风里希，若你此后躲得远远的，我倒奈何你不得。偏偏你又自个投到我面前来。
en: Feng Lixi, you could get rid of me once you stayed at a safe distance afterward. But today you meet me here.

ch: 衡天举掌一握，女娲突然全身冒出冥气，双眼同时变得黯然无光。她玉手一挥，大量冥气立即朝张三卷来。原本与阁主战斗中稳占上风的张三，瞬间被逼得左支右绌。
en: Hengtian grasps his hands, and gushes of Nether Air flow out from Nuwa's body. Her eyes become dull, and, following her gesture, waves of ominous Nether Air come overwhelmingly to Zhang San. The tide turns; Zhang San must try his best to defend himself.

ch: 我的目标是制造一具完美的仙体，风里希是绝佳的“材料”，因此我在她体内种下心枷，好使一直操控。不过，风里希的盘古真血觉醒之后，心枷便再无反应，而我便也无法遥遥操控于她了。
en: I aim to forge a perfect immortal vessel, and Feng Lixi is the most suitable \"material\" for me. Therefore, I put a Mind Fetter inside her as a handle for me to control. But after the awakening of her Pangu blood, I lost connection to my little device, and I could not control her anymore...

ch: 直到她再次来到我面前。张三，今日会死的人，是你。
en: ... Till she shows up before me again. Zhang San, today it's you that will be killed.

ch: 张三不断尝试再次激活女娲盘古之血，阁主从旁伺机偷袭，他看准一个时机，重重命中对手，同时将他手中玉笛打落。
en: Zhang San keeps trying to activate the Pangu blood in Nuwa while the Pavilion Master continues to issue sneak attacks. Finally, a strike hits Zhang San and knocks the jade flute in his hands down.

ch: 张三，少了玉笛，第十三律也吹奏不来了吧？哈哈哈哈哈。接下来，就是取你性命了。
en: Zhang San, now your flute is lost, and you can't play the Thirteenth Verse anymore! Hahaha, then meet your death!

ch: 此时远方一声啸鸣，震彻山巅。苍龙横空而来，张口就将衡天咬住叼走，一龙一人瞬间就在空中争斗起来。
en: Just at this time, a clear roar pierces through distant mountains. Black Dragon charges down from high above and takes the Master away with his mouth. They start to fight in the air.

ch: 你已受伤，不宜再战，快快离开，万勿耽搁。
en: You are wounded. Better to fight another day. Please retreat quickly.

ch: 张三得了苍龙帮助，没有离开，反而专心致志给女娲清除体内心枷禁制。
en: Black Dragon helps him out of trouble, but Zhang San is still here. He is busy lifting the Mind Fetter put on Nuwa.

ch: 张三扶在石壁上大声咳嗽，吐出两口血来。此时天风响起，苍龙由远而近，逶迤来到张三面前。
en: Zhang San supports himself against a cliff. He coughs painfully and spits mouthfuls of blood. A whistling wind comes from above. Black Dragon soars through the air and descends down to meet him.

ch: 还留在这里做什么？女娲呢？
en: Why are you still here? Where is Nuwa?

ch: 朋友，我是不是很厉害？我再次激活了她的道心，彻底将心枷清除掉了。她，终于完全摆脱衡天的控制了。
en: My friend, am I marvelous? I activated her Taoist Mind again and shattered the Mind Fetter. She finally gets rid of the Pavilion Master.

ch: 我拜托她帮助我重新找回玉笛。第十三律可以克制阁主冥气，不能丢失。
en: I asked her to find the jade flute for me. The Thirteenth Verse can be used to counter the Nether Air from the Master, and I need the flute to play it.
You mean you want to fight him again?! Are you mad?

ch: 我固然身受重伤，但今日阁主连场恶战，也已锐气大挫，今日正是一举击杀此人的良机。
en: I am indeed heavily wounded, but after so many harsh battles, the Master's condition is no better than mine. The opportunity to kill him comes.

ch: 乱来！失去笛子，没有第十三律，如何与阁主冥气抗衡？
en: That's crazy! You have lost your flute, and your Thirteenth Verse cannot be played. How can you fight the Master in his Nether Air?

ch: 没有笛子我就该认输了吗？笛子终究是一件东西而已。
en: Do you remember the Dragon's Haven and the Crucial Lock? These are the results of my divination about the exceptional occurrences in Tian Yuan Mountain. Now I decide to conjure an array to trap the Pavilion Master on the Mountain's top.

ch: 就算你成功将衡天困住，也不过是个不胜不败之局……
en: Even if you managed to trap Hengtian, it's just another stalemate. You know how to utilize your Taoist Mind and how to conjure a space, but the Pavilion Master is also formidable. After being trapped in it for a long time, he will undoubtedly find his way out.
That doesn't matter. I have another plan to defeat him.

ch: 我说过，我的目的是回归上界。我绝不会陪着你将性命丢在天元山上的。你现在跟我走，回去好好养伤。你要留下，我绝不会再冒险来救。
en: Well. I have told you that I just want to return to the upper realm. To die with you on Tian Yuan Mountain is not my future. Now leave here with me and take a rest in a safe place, and if you decide to stay here, I will never return to rescue you twice.
I see. Thanks for your company.

ch: 为了八荒、为了修仙者，值得做到这个地步？
