en: Are the world and the cultivators worthy of your sacrifice?

ch: 值得！一路走来，目睹一切灾难，我无法无动于衷。再说，我自己也想飞升呢。
en: Yes! I have seen too many disasters in my cultivation, and I feel I couldn't just sit and see. And I want to attain ascension too.

ch: 张三，我再说一遍，我绝不会留下，也不会再来救你了！
en: Zhang San, once again! I will never stay here nor return to rescue you twice!

ch: 张三休息了一阵，气息渐平，他回过头来朝苍龙微微躬身，然后手指虚空，召来佩剑，驾空而去。
en: Zhang San takes a brief rest. His breath calms down, and he turns back to see Black Dragon. He bows to the creature slightly before he summons out his flying sword and glides away into emptiness.
Zhang San is engaging in a tough battle against the Master.

ch: 张三，你太傻了。你原本有机会抽身逃去的。
en: Zhang San, you're a fool. You should have fled from me.

ch: 今日，我们把事情了一了吧。
en: Let us settle our matters today.

ch: 当然！把你了结了，本尊就再无后顾之忧了。
en: Good! I'll solve my last trouble by wiping you out.

ch: 张三，你坏就坏在太过自大，如今你失了玉笛，无法发出第十三律，今日就是你的死期了！
en: Zhang San, your bane is your arrogance. Now your jade flute is lost, and the Thirteenth Verse cannot be played. You will die today!

ch: 大家称我张三，我又岂止第十三律一样本事？你失算了！
en: I am called Zhang San, and I certainly prepared skills other than playing the Thirteenth Verse. You miscalculated me.

ch: 战斗场景中出现一个封印。圈住了阁主。
en: A seal emerges and traps the Pavilion Master inside.

ch: 这是我仿天元山特性创造的界域；界内无时间无空间，无法让你去到任何地方，也无法让你前往任何时间节点。阁主，从此以后，便永生永世留在里面吧！
en: It is a special array made based on the features of Tian Yuan Mountain. There is neither time no space inside the array, which means you will be unable to go anywhere or appear at any other point in time. Master, now you will stay inside it forever!

ch: 张三身体呈现粒子化效果，慢慢飘散消失。
en: Zhang San vanishes into the air like particles and disappears.

ch: 你寻路离开，未料走着走着，已重新回到张三竹庐之中。
en: You try to leave. But after several steps, you find yourself inside Zhang San's bamboo hut again.

ch: 你依李四指点来到八荒地根之中，昏暗中可隐约见得一人席地踞坐。此人半隐在黑暗之中，难辨面目。但从其身上气质，流露灵力，所释威压，已可推定眼前之人正是琅琊阁主，衡天！
en: You follow Jo's guide and enter the Earth's node. Amid the dimness, you see a figure sitting cross-legged on the ground. You cannot discern his appearance, but from the details like his presence, his energy, and his coercion, you know he is the Master of the Manual Pavilion, Hengtian!

ch: 此处乃本尊静修之地，擅入者，死！
en: This secluded place is made for my training. Die, you interrupter!

ch: 哼，没想到还有点本事，无妨。冥魔，这可如何是好？
en: Hmph. You're mightier than I thought. Fine. What should I do, Nether Lord?

ch: 你需要我的帮助？老规矩，答应我的请求就好了。
en: You need my help? As always, accept my request first.

ch: 当日我教你法子以冥气感染八荒修仙者，使他们实力突飞猛进，你只允许我附于你身；如果这次帮助了你，你必须让我进入到八荒之中！桀桀桀桀……
en: I used to teach you the technique of inflicting Nether Air on cultivators, thus granting considerable power to them. However, you only agreed to let me possess you. If this time you want my assistance, you must let me enter the world above us! Xaxaxa...
Enter the world above us? Hmph. Not unacceptable.

ch: 哦？你答应了？很好很好。就是这个人吗？来，我借你力量，你借多少都可以。只要你答应，我全部力量借给你都行，嘿嘿，嘿嘿嘿嘿。
en: Well, you seem to accept it. Good. You mean this one? I see. Now you can take my power. You can take as much as you can... No, you can take them all as long as you accept my request! Hehe. Good, good.

ch: 小朋友，你的实力确实让我意想不到。既然如此，只好换一种玩法了。
en: Little one, your power is truly beyond my imagination. We'll have to try something new.

ch: 这个声音和衡天作了几次对答之后，前方地脉枢纽处冒出腾腾黑烟。同时，李四所赠包裹发出动静，一个虚影于半空生成，浮于你面前。而虚影不是别人，正是张三！
en: The dialogue between the mysterious voice and the Master ends. Next second, you see dark vibes flow out from the Master, and a horrible shadow reveals itself.

ch: 无知蝼蚁，见识一下本尊的真正实力吧！
en: Ignorant one. Now perish under my full strength!

ch: 道友，衡天在地脉参悟的秘法十分霸道。他强行分离冥气所有杂质，以求获得最精纯的冥力。一旦衡天炼成冥力，就会以之发出攻势，此着雷霆万钧，无可匹敌。
但是万物相辅相成，他排除出来的冥气杂质却是最精纯的灵力。我认为那就是形成道心的特殊灵力。我姑且称之为愿力。
<r>愿力都是蓝色灵球，一旦出现场中，请尽力拾取吸纳，一旦愿力足够，就会形成共鸣，化为气罩。道友赶快进入气罩，即可避过衡天的万钧一击</r>。
锦囊中现身的虚影说完徐徐消散，隐没于前方腾腾紫雾之中。而身上所携李四所赠包裹也终于化为灰烬。
何许人也？！哼，也罢。识法未必就能破法。
你将阁主击杀后，他身后一股奇特的黑气逐渐消散，而阁主身体亦逐渐枯萎佝偻，终于化为泥尘，一股飘散。
en: You killed the Pavilion Master. The strange dark vibe behind him disappears, and your opponent's body slowly withers into ashes. Soon, there are only mud and floating dust.

ch: 此时回望八荒大地，只见四方冥山上的冥气逐渐消弭，层层绿意从中透出，上面石壁从中破开，流出汩汩清流，碧草绿树，横生漫长，只片刻之间死气沉沉的冥山已然生机勃发。
en: You turn back to see the world again. The Nether Air surrounding Nether Mountains has disappeared, and plants begin to grow. Limpid streams flow from the cracks on cold rocks, and minutes after, the once-barren cliffs are covered by verdant foliage.

ch: 多年后的一个清晨，你体内灵机剧震，伴随而来的是遍布全身的快感。你还没明白这是怎么回事，身体便已漂浮起来，逐渐往无穷的上空升腾。
en: A usual morning years after, you feel your spiritual nodes start to vibrate, bringing you a kind of utmost satisfaction never felt. Before you can understand it, your body begins to float upward.

ch: 放眼四顾，只见远方都是修仙者在不断飞升。
en: Around you and in the distance, there are so many cultivators ascending into the sky.

ch: 没有衡天的世界，张三发现的道心在众多修仙者体内成长发芽，并成功突破桎梏。时光飞逝，多年之后，由于八荒整体修为的持续提升，飞升关窍由此打开。
en: Without the Pavilion Master, the Taoist Minds found and promoted by Zhang San grow in many cultivators, and their development is no longer halted. As time goes by, the gateway to ascension finally opens with the accumulation of cultivation in this world.

ch: 这一日，一道黄光来自天外，射落天元山巅，同时你体内灵机震动，你知道最终飞升的时刻到来了。你的身体慢慢变得越来越轻，顺着黄光轨迹慢慢向上飘飞。
en: Today, a golden beam from outside the canopy sheds on the top of Tian Yuan Mountain. With the vibration of your spiritual nodes, you know the time for ascension comes. Following the beam, you float upward as your body becomes lighter and lighter.

ch: 八荒飞升关窍开启之后，由于道力亲和之故，八荒大陆越发接近道源本体，越来越多的修仙者道心亦因此隐约感受到道源本质，体内道心纷纷觉醒，并跟随你之后陆续飞升。
en: After the gateway to ascension opens, the world gets closer to the true form of Tao's source because of the natural attraction of Tao Powers. Many cultivators have felt the essence of the source with their Taoist Minds, and they attain ascension after you with awakened Taoist Minds.

ch: 八荒，终于走在张三期许的方向上。
en: Finally, Zhang San's expectation comes true.

ch: 只见前方一人傲立山巅，远眺八荒胜景。而他听到你前来的动静后，亦徐徐回首。
en: You see a man standing on the mountain's top, gazing at the vast landscape. Hearing your steps, he turns back to meet your eyes.

ch: 本座在此山巅逗留，已经过去很久很久了。你是第一个来到的修仙者。
en: I've stayed here for a long time. You are the first cultivator to visit me.
May I ask who you are?
I am Hengtian, the Master of the Manual Pavilion.

ch: 愚不可及！上界位面，恃强凌弱，终有一日，将蚕食下界。八荒难逃此劫，届时生灵涂炭，一朝尽毁。
en: How foolish! The upper realms see us as their prey, and they will devour our world someday. It's an inevitable ending, and all of us will perish.

ch: 本尊打开八荒飞升关窍，跃升上界。此着上可参得无上之道，中可使天下修士规避八荒终局，下可选拔天资绝俗的修仙者协同助力。
en: I opened the gateway to ascension here and could enter the upper realms by it. My method, once applied, can help me grasp the ultimate Tao. Besides, it can save all cultivators from perishing with the world and can summon extraordinary persons to help me.

ch: 可笑那张三倒行逆施，打的挽救八荒的旗号，却心怀鬼胎，借八荒生灵验证连自己也一知半解的道心，妨碍我飞升大计，真正用心恶毒。
en: However, Zhang San acts in my contradiction. He says he'll save the world, but he harbors evil. By using the excuse, he tests the theory of Taoist Minds on innocent lives, and the principle behind it is unknown even to him. He is the real evildoer that cuts my way to ascension.

ch: 本尊再问你一次，要跟随本尊飞升上界，追求至高无上之道，抑或与张三株守八荒坐等灭世？
en: Now I ask you again. Do you want to follow my step and attain ascension into the upper realm and grasp the ultimate Tao, or stay with Zhang San to face the inevitable?

ch: 本尊的佳弟子果然忠心耿耿，看来若非有她，这些年来我亦无法专心致志，破除张三结下封印。
en: She is truly a loyal disciple. Thanks to her effort, I can focus on breaking the array set by Zhang San for such a long time.

ch: 你能来到山巅，想必已对此处情形有所了解，本尊欲打开飞升关键，带领绝俗之士，飞升上界，参悟至高无上之道，避过八荒终极灭世。
en: Now that you have climbed to the top of the Mountain, you must have known all that's happening here. I want to open our gateway to ascension and enter the upper realm with extraordinary persons. Therefore, the ultimate Tao will be accessible to us, and we will not perish with the world as well.

ch: 张三不识时务，持道心之说，与本尊作对，延误飞升时机，贻害八荒未来，已被本尊击杀。
en: Zhang San dared to act in contradiction with me using his excuse of Taoist Minds. So, I killed him to protect the gateway to ascension and to save the world.

ch: 如今正是危急存亡之秋，成吾臂助，本尊脱劫而出，自能挽救危亡，你日后更能与本尊同参宇宙道源，此中好处说之不尽。不知你意下如何？
en: Today our world faces a critical choice. If you help me to break my seal, I will prevent the world from destruction, and you will be benefited as well. For example, following my instruction, you will gain insight into the Tao behind our universe. How about my advice?

ch: 可笑！八荒之中，天地之间，羽化登仙的修炼法门源于本座。就是让你披荆斩棘来到此处的本事，亦不过是本座从道源参透所得的一点余绪。
en: Ridiculous! Do you know your technique of cultivation, as well as your method to reach your top realms, are my inventions? Even your skills that have helped you a lot in battles are petty tricks disclosed by me as I try to understand the Tao's source.

ch: 如今竟凭这身微末本领与本尊对抗？萤火之光岂敢与皓月争辉？受死吧！
en: And you want to fight me with this cheap stuff? You're arrogant enough to stare at the Sun! Now, die!

ch: 你的见识不差。不过，张三分出神念一直指引你前来，你真的想清楚了？哼，<r>也许你按他意思去做，这世界又是另一番局面呢</r>？
突破到羽化登仙的办法源于本尊。本尊能给你突破到羽化登仙的机会，自然<r>也能收回你的境界，封印你的仙法</r>。哼，应该怎么选，你再好好想想吧。
识时务者为俊杰，你能明白本尊的苦心，倒也算是可造之材。不过，你真的愿意忤逆张三么？哼，<r>也许你按他意思做，这世界又是另一番局面呢</r>？
本尊一手开创突破羽化登仙的法门，我若允许，你当然能够顺利跃升境界；我若不允，<r>收回你的境界，封印你的仙法</r>，也是易如反掌。现在生也由你，死也由你，好好想想吧。
冥羽，仙法？这不是属于你的东西，本座要取回了。
en: Hahaha. Nether Feather? Heavenly Arts? They are not your power. I'll take them back.

ch: 阁主全身灵力逐渐消散然后倒下，他最后看你的眼神仍然桀骜不驯，嘴角还带着一丝不屑。不过他最终还是化为了一缕烟云，消散在你面前。
en: The energy of the Pavilion Master disperses. He falls down to the ground, his eyes gazing at you with untamed ambition. Then, he sneers with contempt and vanishes into a strain of dust before you.

ch: 这一切都结束了，而你离开了这座接通一万年后的巍巍高山。八荒的大难因此解除，这片大陆再次回到昔日的道路上。
en: The disturbance ends, and you return to your time from the Mountain connecting to the world 100,000 years after. The world restores the old course of development, and its inevitable ending has been evaded.

ch: 这一切都结束了，而你离开了这座接通一万年后的巍巍高山。八荒的大难因此解除，这片大陆再次回到昔日的道路上。时光飞逝，许多年后，不知何故，八荒冥气再一次汹涌泄漏，局面再度陷入一片混乱。同时，有大能横空出世，此人携神技纵横八荒，全无敌手。不日登上天元山巅，睥睨八荒。
en: Time goes by. Many years have passed, and for some reason, the Nether Air gushes out again, causing great troubles throughout the world. But at the same time, a master cultivator also blazes a way out with incredible skills. Soon, the person climbs onto Tian Yuan Mountain with second-to-none power.

ch: 一日，前方一名华服男子虎步龙行，逐渐走近，仔细一看，竟发现此人注视远方，并且嘴角上挂着一丝不屑的笑意。
en: One day, you see a fine-robed man walking in a haughty posture. He comes close to you, and to your surprise, he is staring somewhere in the distance with a contemptuous sneer.

ch: 循华服男子眼光看去，只见天地交接之处，一个头戴竹笠的青袍男子手持玉笛，正怒视华服男子，缓缓逼近。
en: You follow his eyes and find another man on the horizon. The man is clad in a blue robe, a bamboo hat on his head. He walks toward the fine-robed man with a flute in hand, gazing at him furiously.
The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.

ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，很好很好。在这八荒之中，也只有真正的强者，才配活下去。
en: Hahaha. Good. Only those with true abilities can survive in this world.

ch: 识时务者为俊杰，所幸阁下最后关头仍能醒悟过来。不过，此事远远没有那么简单。
en: It requires great insight to recognize an unstoppable trend. Fortunately, you managed to see through it in the end. But it is more complex than you thought.

ch: 张三以一气化三清之法将自己神念一分为三，其中他的主神携肉身将我封印，因此道力耗尽，被我一举击杀，消散无存。次神则作茧自缚，无法进入天元山中。
en: Zhang San divided his soul into three by a method called Qi Triplication, and the Master Soul sealed me here with himself and all of his Tao Power. This soul has already been exterminated by me. The Junior Soul has been banned from entering Tian Yuan Mountain, which is a silly decision made by his master.

ch: 最为关键的是亚神仍留存于他自构的鬼谷之中，并一直寻觅唆使修仙者前来骚扰。此神念一日不灭，则本尊不得安。
en: However, the Senior Soul still exists in Ghost Valley, a place conjured by himself, and he keeps picking cultivators to harass me. If I want a peaceful life, then I must kill the Senior Soul as well.

ch: 当日张三临死反扑，借天元山为诸界枢纽的特性辅以自悟的秘术构筑特殊界域将本尊囚禁于此。
en: Zhang San left his last counterattack on the day I killed him. He conjured a special space to trap me here using the feature of Tian Yuan Mountain as the key link connecting realms, as well as his secret technique.

ch: 他牺牲自己结成的封印的确十分厉害。不过万事不离道源藩篱，我已参透他的封印关键，破困只是早晚之事。
en: I must say his technique is incredible. However, everything exists inside the limits of the source of Tao, including his seal. Now I know its core theory, and it's just a matter of time to break it.

ch: 如今，正是本尊破除封印的关键时刻。因此当前最重要的是铲除张三亚神，让本尊再无后顾之忧。
en: And this opportunity comes. The most important thing to be done right now is to get rid of his Senior Soul, which has always been troublesome for me.

ch: 本尊无法离开山巅，故不得不假手于你，击杀张三，终结一切。本尊已探明鬼谷位置，还请你设法前往，将之击杀。
en: I am still trapped on the Mountain's top, and I must ask you to do it. I have figured out the location of Ghost Valley in Tian Yuan Mountain; please come there to kill Zhang San. Then all will be settled.

ch: 不必劳师动众，前往鬼谷了。
en: No need to take such a long trip to Ghost Valley.

ch: 衡天。看来这些年来你受困山巅，已经摸到一丝门道了。
en: Hengtian. Years trapped here have brought you more insights.

ch: 难道你的封印就是什么不传之秘吗？
en: And you think your seal is something never comprehensible?
The Senior Soul. Finally, you leave your shelter? No, maybe I'll call you Zhang San now.

ch: 衡天，剩下的你只管看着就好了。
en: Hengtian. You can just sit and see what's happening.

ch: 嗯，你仅为一个神念，又以大部分灵力维持封印以及鬼谷，已无力杀死我，因此你要加强封印力度，让我无法对你出手？呵呵，如今你苟延残喘，就算只是眼前这位小友，只怕你也已抵挡不住。
en: Good. I guess you will enhance the seal and prevent me from attacking you? After all, you're just a soul, and you have spent a large portion of your energy on maintaining your seal and Ghost Valley. I don't believe you could kill me now since you're too feeble to resist... even the attacks from this little one.

ch: 你我之间的事，不妨之后再清算明白！如今，我必须先弥补一个过失。
en: We can settle these later if you like! Now, I must make up for a mistake.

ch: 我当初指引修仙者前来山中，乃是为了铲除衡天。只可惜，来人不曾助我，反而转投对手麾下。
en: I guided a cultivator into Tian Yuan Mountain to kill an evildoer called Hengtian, but the person I picked allied with my enemy.

ch: 琅琊阁主，罔顾生灵，泄露冥气，祸害八荒，使众多修仙者被冥气蚕食爆体而亡，更让八荒大地，沦为一片炼狱。他的种种劣迹，诸多恶行，实是罄竹难书。
en: The Master of the Pavilion is the true evildoer. He releases Nether Air into the world and causes many cultivators to annihilate under the ominous dark vibe. That Nether Air also turns many places into wastelands. He has committed crimes that are beyond our words.

ch: 而你，却听信他一片歪理，为虎作伥？！
en: And you are convinced by him and become his minion?!

ch: 你，是因为我才走到这一步的，现在也该由我来纠正这个错误。
en: But I am also responsible for your choice. So I'll make up for it.

ch: 你身死道消之际，即我破困而出之时！你万万料不到，我遭封印之后，仍能反败为胜吧？
en: I will break your seal immediately at the time you die! Are you surprised? Even if I am sealed here, I can still turn the tide!

ch: 道友，如今仍有一线生机可以逆转乾坤。我传你秘法借天元山的神奇力量再次封印阁主！
en: My friend, there is one last hope to pursue. I teach you my technique, and you seal the Pavilion Master with the power of Tian Yuan Mountain!

ch: ……是你？！哼，竟还想着教唆来人效法于你么？
en: ... It's you?! Ah. Are you trying to find an heir to your career?

ch: 道友，若任由阁主出世，则八荒危矣！不过此法十分霸道，一经施展，你肉身立即撕裂损毁，神念亦即崩溃离析。你，愿意舍弃一切，反戈一击吗？！
en: My friend, our world will be in peril once the Master breaks the seal! However, the technique needs to employ intense power. It will shatter your body and disperse your soul once cast. Now tell me, do you want to issue a desperate counterattack with your life?

ch: 衡天缓缓抬手准备给你最后一击，便在此时，远空传来一个声音。
哼，我虽暂时受困，但迟早会摆脱你束缚，直捣鬼谷，掀掉你的乌龟壳的！
en: Hmph. I am trapped for now. However, the day will come when I break your seal again and burn your shelter into ashes!

ch: 衡天话音才落，一股灵力涌来让你感觉一阵天旋地转，好容易缓过来了，已身处一片神秘竹林之中。你睁眼一看，只见一名头戴斗笠的老者正垂首坐在一方棋坪前面。
en: The mysterious person ignores Hengtian. He waves his hand, and a torrent of energy overwhelms you. After your dizziness has gone, you find yourself in a bamboo forest.

ch: 唉，天意。琅琊阁主，天下第一。要胜过他，又谈何容易？做到这个地步，真是难为你了。
en: Well. That's our fate. The Master of the Pavilion is second to none in this world, and defeating him is certainly an impossible challenge. You have done all you can, and I appreciate your efforts.

ch: 道友，还记得吗？这里是鬼谷，当初也是在这里，我指引你来到天元山的。
en: My friend, do you remember here? Here is Ghost Valley, the place where I told you to go to Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 这座鬼谷比较特异，乃是我亲手构筑的一处特殊洞天。我与鬼谷，相互依存，不能分离。鬼谷关闭，我随之湮灭。我的神念耗尽，鬼谷亦不复存在。
en: This Ghost Valley is a special space conjured by me inside Tian Yuan Mountain. I belong here, and it needs me. I will be gone once the Valley closes, and the Valley will disappear once I cease to exist.

ch: 但是，鬼谷不能就此消亡。如果任由琅琊阁主衡天破解山巅封印重新出世，八荒将陷入前所未有的困局。鬼谷仍需有人坐镇，召唤修仙者，前往山巅，击败衡天……
en: But Ghost Valley needs to be here. If the Master of the Pavilion managed to break the seal and enter our world, we'd face a fatal dilemma. The Valley still needs its maintainer to guide cultivators to the Mountain and to defeat the Master...

ch: 我本身仅余一丝神念，刚刚离开鬼谷，前往助你，更是元气大伤，如今已经即将消亡。而你舍弃自身，封印阁主，肉身毁灭，仅余的神念亦即将消散。
en: I am just a fraction of my soul. The trip from Ghost Valley to your assistance is too consuming for me. I'll disperse in seconds, and so as your soul; since you sealed the Master with your life, and now your body has been shattered.

ch: 我拟将自身道心仅余的道力转移与你，让你得以继续留存鬼谷之中。此事原应由我肩负，不该牵累于你的。可是现在已别无他法了……
en: I am going to transfer my only remaining Tao Power from my Taoist Mind to yours to ensure you can continue to exist in the Valley. I know by doing this, I'll also transfer my duty to you, but it's my last resort...

ch: 眼前之人说完后，抬手朝你轻轻一拂后，便双手垂下没了动静。
en: \"Please.\" The man taps at your forehead with his index and middle fingers. Then, he falls into silence; his head droops down.

ch: 你刚刚触碰竹笠老者，他便化为空气中的一股尘埃，他身上的青衣以及竹笠亦因此滑落地面，随即化为灰烬。你的面前仅余一方棋盘。
en: You reach out your hand to touch the old man, only to see him vanishing into ethereal dust. His blue robe and bamboo hat fall to the ground.

ch: 此时身前窸窣声起，一名修仙者徐徐来到，她呆了片刻，终于问道：“……此地是何处？”
en: A rustling noise comes from behind. It's a cultivator. The young person hesitates for a while and finally asks, \"... Where am I?\"

ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，冥羽，仙法？这不是属于你的东西，本座要取回了。
en: Hahaha. Nether Feather? Heavenly Arts? They are not your power. I'll take them back.

ch: 小友，不要气馁！过去、现在、未来，八荒成败在此一举。我来助你。
en: My friend, don't feel frustrated! The past, the present, and the future of the world lie in our last effort! I'm here!
Zhang San?! What a haunting pest!

ch: 小友，羽化登仙并非只有与冥气相处一途，你道心滋养多时，已经成熟，我来为你点破天机，重塑境界！
en: My friend, the path to reaching the highest realm is not limited to cultivating with Nether Air. Your Taoist Mind has matured after a long time of development, and now let me shape it into its true form!

ch: 李四大喝一声，食指点中你的额心，就在这一刻，你眼前仿佛看见无垠远空，万千银河。这电光石火的一刻里，你似乎已经历了无限时光，正感不知所措，这一切突然烟消云散。你清醒过来，眼前仍是天元山巅，而身处仍是八荒大陆。
en: Jo shouts out and touches your forehead with his index finger. Immediately, boundless skies and galaxies unfold before you, and you seem to have experienced infinite time in a fleeting moment. Before you know what's happening around you, the sublime illusion fades away. You still stand on the top of Tian Yuan Mountain, supported by the firm earth of the world.

ch: 宇宙四维无边，天地八方广大，未必就只有你衡天有法子能突破至羽化登仙之境。
en: The dimensions in the cosmos extend to eternity, and the vast space between heaven and earth allows myriad possibilities. Hengtian, your answer to breakthrough into the highest realm is not the only solution.

ch: 小友，你的道心已经升华，并重新突破至羽化登仙之境，请尽力一战，底定胜局！！
en: And my friend, your Taoist Mind has undergone promotion. Now you achieve your breakthrough into our highest Realm again. Please fight and defeat the Pavilion Master with all your might!

ch: 手下败将，竟还痴人说梦！
en: A defeated opponent should just admit his failure!

ch: 你感觉此前凝聚的仙力逐渐分解，紧接着冥羽亦迅速散去。只片刻间，你的仙法已无法使用，同时也无法再次唤出冥羽协助战斗。
你失去仙力及冥羽之后生出的空虚之感逐渐消散。眨眼间，体内灵力竟自发聚成灵羽，仙力亦重新生出。
多亏小友完成了我未竟之事。
en: Thank you, my friend. You accomplished what I failed to.

ch: 不得不接受啊！张三就是李四，李四就是张三。唉，可是我怎么会变成这么个正儿八经的人呢？难道人慢慢都会变成自己不喜欢的样子吗？真让人费解。
en: What a tricky fate! I have to admit Zhang San is me, and I am him. But how could I grow up into such a serious person? Will all of us become someone despicable to ourselves someday? I have no clue.

ch: 留给我的时间不多了，说正经的。这不过是一万年后的阁主，但离开天元山还有一个你所处时间的阁主，他也正在操控这一切，只要他还在，眼前的悲剧还会再一次上演。
en: Well, my ending will soon come, and here is an important hint. The Pavilion Master here is just the same person existing after 100,000 years, and if you leave Tian Yuan Mountain and return to your time, you will find another Pavilion Master on that timeline. He is plotting and scheming behind all of the turbulences, and such disaster will emerge again once he continues to live.

ch: 刚刚你与衡天交手之际，我才想通一些事。依我推断，一万年前的衡天应在八荒地脉中心闭关，努力参研冥气以及道源奥妙。
en: The Pavilion Master at your time is carrying out his study on Nether Air and Tao's source at a secluded place, where I deduced, based on the investigation from Cultivator Alliance, is the Earth's node where the earth veins connect beneath the world.

ch: 八荒地脉为冥气与八荒灵力交通之地，旁人无法轻易到达，他在那里既隔绝一切尘想专心参研道源奥妙，亦守护地脉控制八荒冥气泄露，真正一举两得。哼，琅琊阁主，果然厉害。
en: The Qi's energy and Nether Air flow together at the node, and the place is inaccessible to ordinary people. Freed from all worldly disturbances, he can immerse himself in his study of the Tao's source. Meanwhile, he could also get control of the gushes of Nether Air and release them into the world. By retreating there, that shrewd man achieved two goals at the same time.

ch: 如今你道心已经升华，定能独当强敌。剩下的只能交给你了。
en: Now your Taoist Mind has been promoted, and I believe in your ability to defeat him. I'm counting on you. We're counting on you!

ch: 我？我已经不在了。你给我说山上的情况后，让我想起了许多往事。我明白了自己的真正使命，又担心你独自面对衡天，便冒险越过我的主神念对我的禁制，进到山中找你。
en: I? I will be gone. The last fraction of my soul will disperse in seconds. It's sad to be absent from the decisive battle, and I could only leave the last part of the plan for you.

ch: 李四说完，微微露出笑意，同时他身上裙摆亦无故自燃起来并徐徐向上蔓延。眼看李四便要化为一阵飞灰。
en: Jo finishes speaking with a grin. Flames emerge from the rims of his robe and slowly climb upward, and soon he will end up in ashes.

ch: 不过，李四突然抖了个激灵，想用手拍灭身上燃烧的火焰，但始终无法将之扑灭，他只有急急忙忙的将一个包裹递给你。
en: Jo quivers in a slight surprise. He tries to put down the fire with his hands, but his efforts are in vain. He only has time to stuff a pack to you.

ch: 李四将东西交给你后，这才笑嘻嘻的舒了口气。而他亦慢慢被烈火燃烧全身，最终化为漫天余烬。
en: Seeing you received it, Jo sighs in relief and steps away from you. His figure is engulfed by fire, and shortly after, all that remain are only drifting embers.

ch: 那么，还剩下最后一件事要做了。
en: Now, there is one last thing to do.

ch: 对了对了！差点忘了给你说！刚才我看衡天对于冥气的运用已经妙入巅毫，想必他此刻也正使用冥气护住自身，并以此隔绝八荒一切外物。你想，作为屏障，有什么比冥气更好呢？
en: Well, another thing to tell you! I found Hengtian can make a perfect commanding on the Nether Air, and I guess he must be protecting himself with that dark vibe right now, for the Nether Air is the ideal barrier against living beings.

ch: 昔日我四方游历，曾觅得此符箓图谱。凤仙宝箓当中所含阳炎十分猛烈，可暂时辟开交缠的冥气。不过需配以赤幽州吞天·饕餮的犄角才能制成此符。若要前往地脉关元，说不定还需用上此物。
en: I traveled the world in the past and found this chart of a legendary Charm. The Phoenix Talisman condenses fierce power of fire into it, and you may disperse the Nether Air for a while with it. It must be made with the horn of Skydevourer - Taotie, one of the most formidable beasts in Chi You. You may find the Charm useful once you enter the junction of Earth's veins.

ch: 这是我最后能给你的东西了，请收下吧。对了，念在我一直在帮助你，千万要记得我啊，嘿嘿！李四去也！
en: Take my last gift, please. And remember me, for I helped you many times. Well, bye! I'll go.

ch: 进山后，我先受到禁制对我的轰击，后又遭山上封印的压制，体内灵力已然崩溃，现在最后一丝神念亦将消散。可惜不能陪着你走完最后一程，剩下的只能让你独自面对了。
en: I made my last attempt entering the Mountain, and I underwent the wrath of the ban, as well as the restriction from the seal here. Now my energy has been consumed, and even the last fraction of my soul will soon disperse. Sad to be absent from the decisive battle, and I can only leave the last part of the plan for you.

ch: 衡天落败后瘫坐地上一脸不屑的笑看着你，然而他只笑了笑便没了呼吸。大事已了，你正想离开，未料腹中竟迅速升起一股剧痛之感。
en: Hengtian is defeated. He sits listlessly on the ground, looking you up and down. Then, he begins to speak with sinister laughter, \"You... shall not win. Remember the elixir you took?\"

ch: 还待细想身体出现的奇特状况，痛楚已急速加剧，你甚至觉得体内脏器正急速朽烂瓦解。你挣扎起来，终又坐倒地上，如此再三终于失去了意识。
en: Hengtian makes a gesture of pinching. Suddenly, you feel your entrails crushed into ashes. Agony engulfs you. You try to stand up again, but your last effort only allows you to sit.

ch: 此时此刻，前方除去两个瘫坐地上再无动静的躯体，唯有虎虎天风，吹彻山巅。
en: The Master of the Pavilion laughs, but his jarring voice is soon gone. All there remains are two bodies, sitting still in front of each other, amid the gales that sweep over the Mountain's top.

ch: 时光飞逝，许多年后，不知何故，八荒冥气再一次汹涌泄漏，局面陷入一片混乱。同时，有传一名大能横空出世，并携神技纵横八荒全无敌手。
en: The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.

ch: 一日，一名华服男子虎步龙行走在路上。此人嘴角上挂着一丝不屑的笑意正看着远方。
en: One day, a fine-robed man walks down the road in a haughty posture. He is staring somewhere in the distance with a contemptuous sneer.

ch: 循华服男子眼光看去，只见天地交接之处，一个头戴竹笠的青袍男子手持玉笛，正怒视身边华服男子，徐徐接近。
en: You follow his eyes and find another man on the horizon. The man is clad in a blue robe, a bamboo hat on his head. He walks toward the fine-robed man with a flute in hand, gazing at him furiously.
The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.

ch: 你逐渐醒来，只见前方李四一脸担忧的看着你。
en: You wake up gradually and find Jo watching you worryingly.

ch: 你什么都不记得了吗？那天你上山以后，就一直没有重新来到山下。我等了许久，终于有一天，看见你从高空摔落，昏倒在地。
en: Are you lost all of your memory? You came to the Mountain and were gone. I waited for you at the foot of the Mountain for so long. Finally, one day I noticed you falling from the sky.

ch: 不久后你苏醒过来，发了疯一样往山上冲，可结果也像我一样遭遇风雷水火山泽之劫，最后还被一道天雷打在天灵盖晕倒在地。而你这一昏迷，就过去好久了，粗粗算来，总有好几百年了吧？
en: You woke up shortly afterward, but all you've done were rushing to the Mountain again and again. You were also rejected by various accidents like me, and in the end, were struck by a lightning bolt on your forehead. You fell into a coma for several... Let me calculate... Several centuries at least.

ch: 看来你也落得跟我一样的命运了！咦？远处有人前来？嘿嘿，是受我指引来到的修仙者！
en: You're caught by a tricky fate same to mine! Well? A person is approaching. Ha, it's a cultivator following my guide!

ch: 李四脸现怜悯之色，深深的看了你一眼，这才打起精神走上前去。
en: Jo gazes into your eyes with sympathy. Then, he braces himself up to greet the visitor.

ch: 从永宁州一路到此，仿佛就是一场大梦。你竭力回忆前事的同时，迷迷糊糊的跟随李四走上前去，果见远方一名神凝气清的修仙者慢慢走近。
en: Your journey from Yong Ning to here is like a dream. You try to recollect what has happened to you and follow Jo's steps listlessly. A brisk and fresh cultivator catches your sight.

ch: 这名修仙者来到你面前，手按腰间武器。他先打量了一下李四，然后一脸凝重的注视着你问道：“我受李四前辈指引前来，敢问此处可是天元山？”
en: The person comes in front of you, with a hand resting on the weapon fastened at the belt. The new visitor looks at Jo for a moment, then turns to watch you solemnly, \"Senior Jo told me to go here. Is the place Tian Yuan Mountain?\"
The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.
The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.
The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.
The disturbances have been settled. The story pauses here; it may continue someday.

ch: 你来了？在天元山中可有发现？
en: You're here? Any new findings in Tian Yuan Mountain?

ch: 你来了？在天元山中可有发现？
en: You're here? Any new findings in Tian Yuan Mountain?

ch: 嘿嘿，你果然不同一般，没死在上面。快快快，告诉我山上是什么情形？
en: Wow. I know such an extraordinary cultivator like you will not perish on the Mountain. Come on, tell me what's going on there?

ch: 夜雨楼……她是琅琊阁主的大弟子……有一只当世罕见的青空重瞳……
en: Night Rain... She is the head disciple of the Master of the Pavilion... Her Sky Double Pupils are so special in the world...

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 当年我进入天元山勘踏由此察觉山中情况特异……
en: Years ago, I surveyed Tian Yuan Mountain and found the place strange... Therefore, I made my attempt to conjure space for the first time following the Mountain's features. Then, I got my connection to the ancient world with the technique and gave hints to cultivators, asking them to investigate Nether Air in Chi You...

ch: 是衡天命夜雨楼另外布置风水之局牵引八荒形势，导致冥气急剧泄露……
en: And Hengtian asked Night Rain to alter the Feng Shui in the world, leading Nether Air to rush out...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.

ch: 哈哈……多谢你告诉我这些，你继续上山吧。记得……记得再遇见什么尽可能下山告诉我……
en: Haha... Thank you for telling me these things, now you can continue to explore the Mountain. Remember... to let me know if you found anything noteworthy, please...

ch: 你来告诉我山上情况吗？李四洗耳恭听！
en: Do you come here to tell me what's going on there? Come on, I'm listening!

ch: 女娲……已经式微的盘古之血？！
en: Nuwa... That already declined Pangu blood?!

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 女娲是阁主捕捉的魔族之人，她体内盘古之血十分活泼，呈现即将觉醒之兆……
en: Nuwa is a Demon member caught by the Pavilion Master. Her Pangu blood was active at that time, and soon her strength would be awakened...

ch: 是……是我！当日是她先将我道心升华，我道心升华后再反过来刺激了她的盘古之血，让她正式觉醒！
en: It's... me! On that day, she promoted my Taoist Mind first, and my Taoist Mind activated her Pangu blood in turn, thus awakening her!

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.

ch: 朋友，快快上山，继续告诉我接下来的事情。
en: My friend, return to the Mountain now. I'm expecting what you can bring to me next time.

ch: 咳咳！你不是经过的吧？我知道的，你肯定是特意来告诉我上面情形。你来，给我好好说，细细说！
en: Ahem! You must come here for a reason, and I know you must find more secrets in the Mountain! Here, tell them to me!

ch: 苍龙……九族龙纹……创世元音……远古希声……
en: Black Dragon... The jade plate of Nine Dragons... Creating note... Ancient sound...

ch: 我和他是朋友吗？他总是装作一副崖岸自高的样子。
en: Is he my friend? He has always been, or always pretends to be, aloof.

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 与阁主决战那天，苍龙要我离开……我知道他在担心我……他还是留下来了……他舍弃了自己回归上界的机会，留下来帮我了……
en: Black Dragon wanted me to leave as we fought the last battle against the Pavilion Master... I knew he was worrying about me... He chose to stay there... He stayed there to help me at the cost of his chance to return to the upper realm...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，抚着头一脸痛苦的看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.
Well... Black Dragon... Is he still there?

ch: 你……你上山……快上去……万万不能等了……
en: You, now... go to the Mountain quickly... right now...

ch: 你……你来做什么？我……我是谁……
en: Why... do you come here? Who... Who am I...

ch: 夜雨楼……她是琅琊阁主的大弟子……有一只当世罕见的青空重瞳……
en: Night Rain... She is the head disciple of the Master of the Pavilion... Her Sky Double Pupils are so special in the world...

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 当年我进入天元山勘踏由此察觉山中情况特异……
en: Years ago, I surveyed Tian Yuan Mountain and found the place strange... Therefore, I made my attempt to conjure space for the first time following the Mountain's features. Then, I got my connection to the ancient world with the technique and gave hints to cultivators, asking them to investigate Nether Air in Chi You...

ch: 是衡天命夜雨楼另外布置风水之局牵引八荒形势，导致冥气急剧泄露……
en: And Hengtian asked Night Rain to alter the Feng Shui in the world, leading Nether Air to rush out...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，尽力收敛痛苦神色，然后勉强露出笑容看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.

ch: 呵呵……这是当年的事？你……你上山吧。我想静一静……
en: Eh... That's what happened at that time? You... can return to the Mountain. Now leave me alone...
Why would he do it? Didn't he know I would grow into a different person under his decision? Why would he ban me from entering... What did he think about...

ch: 啊？！我记起来了……她就是狩仙子！
en: Ah?! I recalled her nickname... She is Hunting Fairy!

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 她是让后世仙盟日夜头痛的恐怖对手……是狩猎修仙者的杀手！
en: A dreadful opponent against Cultivator Alliance for generations... She became a grim huntress for cultivators!

ch: 这一切……都是因为琅琊阁主，将她捕获并强行灌输冥气……他是希望将狩仙子变成超越仙体的存在……
en: The Master of the Pavilion... made her transform by capturing her and infusing Nether Air into her... He wanted to shape that Hunting Fairy into someone more formidable than an immortal vessel...

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 你……还呆在这里干什么？你走！你走！快上山！
en: Why... are you still here? Go away! Go back to the Mountain!

ch: 我是谁？我……是被张三玩弄股掌上吗？不是真的……不是真的……
en: Who am I? Am I just a toy in Zhang San's hands? No... It's not true...

ch: 苍龙……九族龙纹……创世元音……远古希声……
en: Black Dragon... The jade plate of Nine Dragons... Creating note... Ancient sound...

ch: 我和他是朋友吗？他总是装作一副崖岸自高的样子。
en: Is he my friend? He has always been, or always pretends to be, aloof.

ch: 李四露出痛苦的表情，继而用手抚头，似乎在极力回忆着什么的样子。
en: Jo grimaces painfully. Then, he rests his head in his palms, trying to recall something.

ch: 与阁主决战那天，苍龙要我离开……我知道他在担心我……他还是留下来了……他舍弃了自己回归上界的机会，留下来帮我了……
en: Black Dragon wanted me to leave as we fought the last battle against the Pavilion Master... I knew he was worrying about me... He chose to stay there... He stayed there to help me at the cost of his chance to return to the upper realm...

ch: 李四自言自语说了一通后，抚着头一脸痛苦的看着你。
en: Jo seems to be speaking to himself. He tries to soothe his expression and gazes at you with a half-hearted smile.
Well... Black Dragon... Is he still there?

ch: 事态紧急，你快上山，一刻、不，半刻也不能等了……
en: It's urgent. Go up to the Mountain right now. Quickly. Go there now...

ch: 凤仙宝箓……画制此灵符需要费心寻得饕餮犄角，眼下时间紧迫，<r>还是先前往地脉关元一探吧</r>。
en: The Phoenix Talisman... Its ink needs to be made with Taotie's horn. Maybe the most urgent matter now is <r>to enter the junction of Earth's veins and find what's going on there</r>.

ch: 你来到地脉关元，只见前方充斥由冥气组成的雾气。这些雾气缭绕纠缠，组成屏障，阻隔一切外来之物。
en: You made your way into the junction, only to find dense clouds of Nether Air. They form a barrier impenetrable to all intruders.

ch: 衡天凭借冥气将自己与外界隔绝开来，要设法散去面前冥气，才能进入地脉。
en: Hengtian isolates himself from the world with the Nether Air. If I want to enter the junction, I must disperse that dark vibe first.

ch: 李四曾说凤仙宝箓可暂时解开前方冥气封印。而制作此物则需击杀饕餮，取其犄角……
en: Jo said that the Phoenix Talisman might be useful in driving away the Nether Air here, and to draw such a charm, I need to kill Taotie and take its horn...

ch: 已取得饕餮犄角，这便赶紧<r>画出凤仙宝箓吧</r>。
en: Now I've got Taotie's horn. It's time to <r>draw the Phoenix Talisman</r>.

ch: 凤仙宝箓一旦成符，黄纸周围暖流涌动，传到你体内，瞬间遍及周身。而你此前连场激斗积累的阴翳堵塞之感立即一扫而空。
en: You finished drawing. The Phoenix Talisman glows with a warm aura. Its balmy energy flows into your body, sweeping away your fatigue from previous harsh battles.

ch: 接下来，就是前往地脉关元，辟开冥气阻隔，击杀衡天了。
en: Next, the Nether Air in the junction can be driven away, and the final fight against Hengtian will come.

ch: 凤仙宝箓一旦发动，随即无火自燃。生成的阳炎瞬间将关元前面冥气驱散净尽。
en: You take out the Phoenix Talisman, and it starts to burn automatically. Soon, the Nether Air has been dispersed under its incandescent flame.

ch: 地脉关元前的冥气已暂时消散……
en: The Nether Air enveloping the junction of Earth's veins has been driven away for now...

ch: 前方地脉关元冥气缭绕，形成团团紫云。这些紫云时而幻作人形，时而聚成建筑，不断演化各种情景。
en: The Nether Air in the place gathers into dense clouds. These ominous clouds are moving, changing into buildings, persons, and other bizarre figures.

ch: 没想到最后还是功亏一篑……明明快能成功了……道心是虚妄之说……怎么就不明白呢？起来，起来，咱们再战！
成王败寇，更复何言？是我输了……
衡天，你说什么？你怎么可能输？我怎么可能输？
唉……最后的结局竟是这样吗？
你知道吗？道心才是窥探道源，还原道源的终极法门……衡天罔顾天生灵，罪大恶极……
我矢志改命……没想到最后还是归于宿命……

en: I don't want to know anything
What about the piece of bamboo?
What about the piece of bamboo?
Why don't you go there yourself?

ch: 这话你和他们也说过吧？
en: Maybe you've said it to them too?
Ask the same to the speaker
Do you know where the cave is?
What kind of person is Zhang San?
Blow the bamboo pipe as said
Try to learn the Thirteenth Verse
Make a flute using the bamboo
Check the mural on the left
Check the mural in the middle
Check the mural on the right
Any other things I can do?
May I ask who you are?
Jo asks me to kill you

ch: 山腰女修士请求相救阁下
en: A priestess asks me to rescue you
I'll do it if it's our last resort
I must seal him even if I die
You can call it... Ghost Valley...
Who are you, in the end?
Tell findings in Sea of images
Tell findings in Altar of immortality
Tell findings in Sandbank of mist
Tell findings in Sea of images
Tell findings in Altar of immortality
Tell findings in Sandbank of mist

ch: 前往山脚有熊村与李四一会
en: Meet Jo at Youxiong Village, which is located at the foot of the mountain.

ch: 应李四所托，寻找夸父族人的洞穴遗址，并破解其封印。
en: Investigate the Kuafu Clan's divination cave as Jo said.

ch: 回到有熊村告知李四，已为其破解遗址封印。
en: Tell your findings from the place to Jo.

ch: 前往洞中暗径查探，并履行李四之嘱托。
en: Follow the secret path inside the cave and finish the task entrusted by Jo.

ch: 李四之事已经解决，回到天元山中继续登上山顶。
en: You have told Jo your findings. Return to Tian Yuan Mountain and continue to climb to its top.

ch: 一名受到夜雨楼胁迫吞下毒丹的修仙者希望你能护送他去到女魔头的魔窟之中搜寻解药。
en: Night Rain forced a cultivator to swallow a poisonous elixir. Now the cultivator wants you to escort him to the cave where the demon woman lived to find the antidote.

ch: 护送此名修仙者前往夜雨楼的住处寻找解药。
en: Escort the cultivator to the residence of Night Rain to help him find the antidote.

ch: 回到天元山中继续挑战。
en: Return to Tian Yuan Mountain to continue your journey.

ch: 夜雨楼交代，让你在上山之前前往她的故居找到一支木簪并将之带给她。
en: Night Rain wanted you to find a wooden hairpin for her from her past residence before you entered the Mountain.

ch: 夜雨楼留有嘱托，将簪子带到山巅，待帮助琅琊阁主底定大事后，再转交给她。
en: Night Rain hoped you to bring the hairpin to the Mountain's top and then give it to her after the Pavilion Master's plan has been fulfilled.

ch: 养精蓄锐，继续登上天元山。
en: Continue to climb up to Tian Yuan Mountain after you restored your health.

ch: 女娲给出地点，前往该处能了解到未来张三发生的事情。
en: Follow Nuwa's guidance to the place where you can learn about what happened to the future Zhang San.

ch: 跟随风允婼深入幽篁洞天。
en: Follow Feng Yunchuo to enter You Huang Cave.

ch: 回到天元山中，唤醒镇守山中的苍龙。
en: Return to Tian Yuan Mountain and wake Black Dragon guarding there.

ch: 前往幽篁洞天参研第十三律借此唤醒天元山苍龙。
en: Go to You Huang Cave to learn the Thirteenth Verse, the key to waking Black Dragon in Tian Yuan Mountain.

ch: 前往龙眠屿寻找破解结界的方法，从而进入天元山巅。
en: To arrive at the top of Tian Yuan Mountain, you need to find out the key to the array there in Dragon's Haven.

ch: 回到龙眠屿寻找纪念之物。
en: Find the reminder of friendship in Dragon's Haven.

ch: 你已学会解除封印的法门，回到天元山中，继续登山，前往山巅。
en: The key to dissolving the seal has been found. Return to Tian Yuan Mountain and continue your journey to its top.

ch: 击杀吞天·饕餮并取其犄角以制作凤仙宝箓。（<r>赤幽州中之吞天·饕餮或赤幽州噬魂塔中的饕餮妖兽均有几率产出饕餮犄角，若有必要重新获取，可前往击杀取得此物</r>。）
en: Kill Skydevourer - Taotie and take its horn to make the Phoenix Talisman.

ch: 利用饕餮犄角制作凤仙宝箓。（需前往技艺界面画符分项制作此物；<r>赤幽州中之吞天·饕餮或赤幽州噬魂塔中的饕餮妖兽均有几率产出饕餮犄角，若有必要重新获取，可前往击杀取得此物</r>。）
en: Use Taotie's Horn to make the Phoenix Talisman.

ch: 仙箓已经齐备，前往地脉关元驱散冥气并进入挑战琅琊阁主衡天。
en: Now you've got the Phoenix Talisman. Time to disperse the Nether Air in the junction of Earth's veins and fight against Hengtian, the Master of the Pavilion.

ch: 前往地脉关元进行查探。
en: Go to the junction of Earth's veins and see what's going on there.

ch: 信封已经泛黄，可以看出写好以后已经保存很长一段时间了。信中内容大体是希望夸父族后人继续隐瞒李四身世真相。
en: The envelope is tainted with a brownish hue. It has been kept here for a long time after finished. The writer hoped his future clansmen help him conceal the truth about Jo's past.

ch: 信封较新。书写者文辞较为幼稚，可知此人定是一名性子朴实，只为追求真理的夸父族巨人。信末巨人还对李四表现出信心，觉得他能自己站起来。
en: The envelope is new. The writer composed the letter with simple words - he must be a candid giant from the Kuafu Clan, eager to seek reasons behind abnormalities. The writer expressed his confidence in Jo, saying he could get back on his feet.

ch: 一支十分精致的木雕。端近细看，可见此物从侧面雕刻的八荒山海地理，离远粗看则似一支木簪。
en: An exquisite wooden carving. It seems to be a wooden hairpin, but a closer examination will reveal its carving of the landscape of this world on its side.

ch: 据说是远古之时，夸父一族预测八荒未来运势时的“重八验证”的片段，当中似乎全是关于李四个人命运的片段。
en: It recorded a clip from the Sixty-Four Validations on the world's future made in ancient times by the Kuafu Clan. It seems to be talking exclusively about Jo's fate.

ch: 据说是远古之时，夸父一族预测八荒未来运势时的“重八验证”的片段，当中似乎全是关于李四个人命运的片段。
en: It recorded a clip from the Sixty-Four Validations on the world's future made in ancient times by the Kuafu Clan. It seems to be talking exclusively about Jo's fate.

ch: 李四的秘藏。相传昔日大能打算凭借此符驱散赤幽州冥气。只因此符箓制作繁难，无法轻易产出，故藏于宝楼，不再使用。其后辗转为李四所得。
en: A secret treasure of Jo. It is said that a master cultivator intended to disperse the Nether Air in Chi You using it, but the plan was proven infeasible due to the extreme difficulty in making the charm. The chart was then archived somewhere until it was rediscovered by Jo.

ch: 饕餮犄角十分特异，妖兽死亡，犄角亦同时化去。若有有幸取得一星半点，并将之混以特殊矿物制成朱砂，可使符箓产生质变。据闻部分珍贵符箓需以此物为媒才能画成。
en: A rare trophy from Taotie. The horn will usually turn into ashes once Taotie is dead, and even a shard of it can grant considerable power to talismans if one grounded it with special ores to make a cinnabar-like powder. Some extraordinary talismans need to be drawn with this material.

ch: 凤为浴火之鸟。相传昔日八荒大能与九天凤鸟达成协议，以道符为媒，借其羽翼阳炎为己用。其后八荒冥气扩散，该大能凭此宝箓燃起真火，成功驱散冥气，保住一方仙民。
en: Phoenix revives from the most fierce flames. It is said that in the past, a master cultivator had an agreement with a phoenix, hoping to introduce its flame into the world with charms. Then, the Nether Air started to spread into the world, and the cultivator ignited True Flame with the charm to protect people from perishing.

ch: 通透晶莹的白玉笛子，上面微微泛着一阵香气，但同时又存有一股微弱的血腥之味。此外，该笛长度较一般玉笛为长，且笛身洞开十三孔，不类寻常笛子。据传昔有大能，吹奏此笛，引凤来龙，九天云霞为之尽赤。
en: A translucent flute made of purest jade. A curious fragrance drifts around it, but amidst the pleasant scent hides a hint of blood. With a length longer than ordinary flutes and a total of thirteen holes, it is said to be a master cultivator's instrument. The legendary owner once played a tune with it to summon dragons and phoenixes, and the melody tinted the clouds a glorious crimson.

ch: 你跟随风允婼进入一片茂密竹林之中，但前方已不见他的踪影。正感疑惑之际，远方竟突然有人出声示警。
突然间，前方黑影隆起，一只庞大的妖兽站了起来，对你嘶吼咆哮。
你将妖兽击败，未料只眨眼之间，妖兽重新聚合，恢复原形。
此妖需以特殊方法击杀，平常武技灵技，奈何不得！
从旁出现的风里希念动咒诀，之后幽深竹林之中刮起狂风。而风声穿过周围竹子竟发出阵阵怪声。与此同时，你身上玉笛亦发出一丝若有若无的异响。
你身上玉笛的异响越来越大，甚至带动着竹林之中的怪声。而笛声竹响彼此应和，逐渐形成道道声浪，不断割裂周围物品。那只妖兽受声浪影响变得十分难受，挣扎再三终于转头逃逸，片刻不见踪影。
眼看妖兽逃去，风里希先是松了口气，继而露出失望之色，她回望你身上玉笛显出一副若有所悟的样子。就在此时风允婼突然赶到，急步朝女儿走来。风里希见状大惊失色，立即转身离去，朝妖兽逃逸方向而去。
啊？是恩人。刚刚明明看见小女就在此处，为何一转眼又不见了？这小女孩究竟在想什么呢……
风允婼心中似有牵挂，因此无心多说。他与你寒暄两句后，略一思索，也追逐风里希而去了。
方才竹管发出异响，莫非与第十三律有所关联？这里应该就是女娲所说藏有第十三律奥秘的地方了。
你回到刚才竹林深处，只觉四周余音飘荡空中，仿佛团团无形气息穿梭流转。
你尝试凭借感悟吹动手中玉笛，不料四方竹子立即破裂四散，空中所留余音亦迅速聚合，发出异响。与此同时，你眼前情景一变，只见周围岩浆喷射，地裂天崩，仿佛洪荒创世。
你听见一声轰鸣，之前看见的荒芜大陆已消失不见，眼前又是竹林景致。但是周围只有倒下的竹子，裂开的土地。附近地面还留有各种奇特纹理，似为余音声波所留。
玉笛所发异响应是唤醒苍龙的关键，这便回去继续挑战吧。
玉笛所发异响应是唤醒苍龙的关键，这便回去继续挑战吧。
你正计划之后的去向，未料远方发出剧震，整个赤幽州仿佛为之一动。同时，远方传出一片奇怪的声浪。这股声浪朝四方扩散，扬起大片尘埃。
只见前方插着各种长短不一的竹管，这些竹管显然按照一定规律安置。而竹管阵中，困着上次于竹林遭遇的妖兽。竹阵外围则是风里希，她此时正持一枝竹笛不断吹奏出阵阵乐声。
前方妖兽为竹阵所发异律影响不断挣扎，但眼看你接近，仍然发出一声巨吼，朝你扑来。
妖兽被你击倒后，身上伤口迅速愈合，眼看马上便要重新站起，破阵而出。
恩人，情势危急！请借你笛子一用！
风里希接过玉笛，立即吹奏起来。而竹阵受到玉笛带动，终于发出上次竹林所发异响。
而妖兽受到竹阵异律影响，竟节节寸断，化为满地碎屑。不过同时，你交给风里希的玉笛竟在她手中逐渐气化消解。
风里希眼看玉笛消失，十分焦急，然而在她张开手掌之际，玉笛竟重新出现在掌心。她一时没弄明白缘故，竟糊涂起来了。
恩人，对不起，把你笛子弄坏了。这东西我暂时替你保管吧？我以后一定会设法将笛子还给你的！里希先走一步啦！
风里希再看了看手中时而隐没时而出现的玉笛，终于咬了咬牙，走近妖兽尸体处取走一物然后急步离去。她前脚才走，风允婼便已赶到，他看了看远遁的女儿，便也急步追了上去。
此间事了，还是赶快回到天元山中吧。
此间事了，还是赶快回到天元山中吧。

en: Try to learn the Thirteenth Verse

ch: 跟随风允婼深入幽篁洞天。
en: Follow Feng Yunchuo to enter You Huang Cave.
Investigate the strange waves of sound in the distance.

ch: 妖兽发出一声吼叫向你袭来。
en: The monster pounces on you with a roar.

ch: 妖兽怪叫一声落荒而逃…
en: The monster flees with a shriek...

ch: 一种阴毒的丹药，极难炼制。能使人脉息逆转灵气倒冲，废修士功法，且数月内不可使用高阶功法。
en: An insidious elixir extremely difficult to concoct. Once taken, it will cause a cultivator's Qi to flow reversely through the veins. Use to disable a cultivator's Martial Arts; its victim will be unable to cast any Martial Arts in higher realms for several months.

Teleport here will remove the mark.

ch: 你路经一条河流，一名白发苍苍的长须老者从旁走出，拦住了你的去路。
en: You pass by a river and a grey-haired and long-bearded old man steps out of the way and stops you.

ch: “年轻人，你是否愿意接受来自河神的考验？”
en: \"Young man, would you accept the test of the River God?\"

ch: 你转过身，不顾而去。身后之人则发出一声长叹。
en: You ignore him and leave. He lets out a long sigh behind you.

ch: 老者背过身去，说道：“我转过身去，你选一本最珍贵的秘籍，丢入河中。”
en: The old man turns around and says: \"I will turn away while you choose the most precious manual of yours and throw it into the river.\"

ch: 你捡起脚边的一块石头，扔进水中。
en: You pick up a stone next to your feet and throw it into the river.

ch: 你趁老者转身之际，悄无声息离开了此地。
en: Very quietly you take your leave as the old man turns away.

ch: 在你丢下的物品即将落水之时，老者轻轻抬手，其化为一道金光飞入老者手中。
en: As the thing you throw is about to fall into the river, the old man raises his hand slightly and that thing turns into a ray of golden light that flies into his hand.

ch: 老者悠悠转身，手上拿着三本秘籍，询问道“你刚才丢掉的是这本{getUnitProp|A|0}、还是{getUnitProp|A|1}、还是这本{getUnitProp|A|2}？”
en: The old man slowly turns around with three manuals in his hand and asks: \"Did you just throw {getUnitProp|A|0}, {getUnitProp|A|1}, or {getUnitProp|A|2}?\"

ch: 老者点点头说：“很好，阁下心地光明、诚实不欺，另外两本秘籍，便一并送你吧。”
en: The old man nods: \"Very well. You're a person of integrity. I'll give you the other two manuals too.\"

ch: 老者点点头说：“很好，阁下内心坚定，能面对诱惑却坚定本心，定能修成大道，你的秘籍就归还于你吧。”
en: The old man nods: \"Very well. You stand firm and resist the temptation. I can tell you have what it takes to achieve the great path. I'll give back this manual to you.\"

ch: 老者怒目一张，斥道：“无耻之徒，竟然敢欺瞒老朽？！”说话间，老者挥手召来天雷一道，将你击得头昏脑涨。
en: The old man glares at you and snaps: \"Shame on you! You tricked me?!\" He waves his hand and summons lightning, which strikes you so hard that dizziness overpowers you.

ch: 待你缓过神来后，湖面之上，更无旁人。老者已然消失不见了。
en: When you've recovered your senses, not a soul is on the lake anymore. The old man is nowhere to be found.

ch: 老者眉头一皱“嗯？你刚才丢的是哪一本？...罢了，就把你选的这本秘籍给你吧”，说罢便离开了。
en: The old man frowns: \"Hmm? Which manual did you just throw into the river? Fine, I'll just give you this one you chose\". Then he leaves.

ch: 老者眉头一皱“嗯？你刚才丢的是哪一本？...罢了，就把你选的这本秘籍给你吧”，说罢便离开了。
en: The old man frowns: \"Hmm? Which manual did you just throw into the river? Fine, I'll just give you this one you chose\". Then he leaves.

ch: 你丢下的物品即将落水之时，老者飞快转身接住了它。
en: As the thing you throw is about to fall into the river, the old man turns around immediately to catch it.

ch: 老者悠悠转身，手上拿着三本秘籍，询问道“你刚才丢掉的是这本{getUnitProp|A|0}、还是{getUnitProp|A|1}、还是这本{getUnitProp|A|2}？”
en: The old man slowly turns around with three manuals in his hand and asks: \"Did you just throw {getUnitProp|A|0}, {getUnitProp|A|1}, or {getUnitProp|A|2}?\"

ch: 老者满脸慈祥，对你露出嘉许的笑意。“纯厚朴实，确是为人处世的道理，不过……”
en: The old man looks exceptionally kind and smiles approvingly at you: \"Blessed are the pure and simple, but...\"

ch: 老者摘下伪装露出山贼真容,双眼凶光毕露。“修仙一途尔虞我诈，不留点心眼，可活不到飞升成仙那天！”
en: The old man takes off his disguise and reveals his mean bandit look. His eyes fixate on you fiercely: \"Cultivation is not for the faint-hearted. If you don't get smart enough, you won't live to see the day you ascend!\"

ch: 你自知不敌，只能愤愤离去，暗下决心他日定要讨伐此贼。
en: You know that you're no match for the old man, so you have no choice but to leave. Distressed and aggrieved, you vow to avenge yourself and attack him.

ch: 老者眉头一皱，摘下身上伪装，大喝道：“果如所料，修仙者尽是充满机心，贪婪成性之辈！”
en: The old man frowns, takes off his disguise, and yells: \"I knew it! Cultivators are all designing and greedy scums!\"

ch: 面前老贼露出山贼本来面目，一脸狰狞的朝你扑来。
en: The old man reveals his mean bandit look as he stares at you fiercely and pounces on you.

ch: 你战胜了山贼，夺回了属于你的秘籍。
en: You've defeated the bandit and managed to get back your manual.

ch: 你战胜了山贼，拿回了自己的秘籍，并对山贼进行了一番搜刮。
en: You've defeated the bandit, managed to get back your manual, and frisked him.

ch: 你不敌此贼，施展遁术逃离了此地。
en: You are no match for the bandit and flee with the Exit Formula.

ch: 丢一本普通秘籍（紫色及以下品质）
en: Throw a normal manual (Epic or lower quality)

ch: 使用后无法使用任何技能，但速度很快，有拖尾，碰到敌人会造成雷属性伤害。持续10秒，如果停止下来，则会每秒扣最大体力10%。
en: Cannot use any skills after the use, but is fast and has aftereffects. Deals Lightning Stats Damage when touching an enemy; lasts 10 seconds. Once it stops, 10% of the maximum Vitality per second is deducted.

ch: 把最大值30%的灵力转化为护盾，持续15秒。
en: Converts 30% of the maximum Energy into a shield for 15 seconds.

ch: 一张符可随机召唤1只带有特殊效果的小兵，小兵的实力境界和玩家正相关。（会小概率额外召唤出2种更强的小怪）
en: 1 talisman summons 1 random minion with a special effect. The minion's Power Realm is positively correlated with the player. (There is a small probability that 2 additional stronger minions will be summoned.)

ch: 召唤法阵持续10秒，作用时间内在法阵中被击杀的敌人会变为子弹攻击其他敌人。
en: The Summoning Array lasts 10 seconds; enemies killed in the array during the 10 seconds will turn into bullets and attack other enemies.

en: Documents how to draw the Thunder Talisman.

ch: 记载着灵盾符的绘制方式。

ch: 记载着封锁符的绘制方式。
en: Documents how to draw the Blockage Talisman.

ch: 记载着甘露符的绘制方式。
en: Documents how to draw the Manna Talisman.

ch: 记载着神目符的绘制方式。
en: Documents how to draw the Divine Eye Talisman.

ch: 记载着祈天符的绘制方式。
en: Documents how to draw the Sky Prayer Talisman.

ch: 记载着诱兽符的绘制方式。
en: Documents how to draw the Monster Lure Talisman.

ch: 释放符纸内的雷电之力覆盖自身，使移动速度上升，并给予触碰自身的敌人造成雷属性伤害，持续一段时间。期间由于雷电之力的影响，使用者将无法使用技能和道具，同时会不间断引发雷劫劈向自身，造成伤害；若命中其他单位，也会造成伤害。
en: Unleash the power of lightning from the charm to cover oneself, gaining bonus Agility for a while and dealing Lightning damage to enemies touched. The charm contains tremendous Lightning power, and anyone using it will be unable to cast any skill or use any item under its effect. Meanwhile, lightning bolts will also be summoned to strike the charm's user; the bolts will also inflict damage on other units.

ch: 吸收使用者的灵力，转化为保护自身的护盾，持续一段时间。
en: Consume its user's Energy to generate a shield in a duration.

ch: 以符为媒介，沟通亡者，使之听从号令出现在战场内！
en: Use it to connect with the deceased and summon them into the battlefield as your minions.

ch: 以符之力，沟通地脉，锁住范围内生灵的部分灵魂之力，使之自动攻击你的敌人，持续一段时间。
en: Use it to link to the Earth's veins and form a soul cage. Units inside the cage will be captured and attack your enemies for a duration.

ch: 沟通地脉之力标记脚下格子，打开小地图单击标记图标可进行传送。
en: Unleash the power of land vein to mark the tile under feet. Teleport by opening the region map and clicking on the Mark icon.

ch: 燃烧符纸沟通天地风水灵脉，以形成天然迷惑大阵，陷入其中将很难离开。
en: The talisman is burned to connect with Feng Shui and spiritual veins of heaven and earth and form a natural Confusion Array. Once trapped in it, nobody can find their way out.

ch: 沟通神目之力使视野拓展，能发现常人无法觉察到的情况，但有时也会被不好的东西缠上。
en: Connecting with the Power of the Divine Eye expands the vision and enables one to detect things that are not easily perceptible, but sometimes one may get caught up in some undesirable things.

ch: 设下法坛，沟通天地之力，改变天气！
en: Set up an altar to connect with the power of heaven and earth and change the weather!

ch: 散发特殊的气息，引来不明的妖兽聚集在附近。
en: A peculiar breath is emitted that draws strange monsters to gather in the vicinity.

ch: 起坛燃符，霎时雷云聚顶。祈天之术，收阳降雨，驱龙掣电，急急如律令！
en: Raise the altar, burn the talisman, and the overwhelming clouds begin to gather. The heavenly art harnesses the sun and the rain as well as taming the dragon and the lightning. Go!

ch: 天地回应了你的符箓，天气正在发生变化......
en: Heaven and earth have heeded your Charm. The weather is changing...

ch: 符纸燃尽，随着一声炸响，你的法坛随之损坏，天地并未出现变化！此地灵气已然耗尽......
en: The talisman burns out. With a blast, your altar is damaged and heaven and earth remain the same! The Qi of this place is running out...

ch: 起坛燃符，霎时雷云聚顶。祈天之术，收阳降雨，驱龙掣电，急急如律令！
en: Raise the altar, burn the talisman, and the overwhelming clouds begin to gather. The heavenly art harnesses the sun and the rain as well as taming the dragon and the lightning. Go!

ch: 你在此地设下法坛，操控着灵力使符箓缓缓飞到法坛中央。
en: You set up an altar here and use your Energy to drive the charm to fly up slowly to the center of the altar.

ch: 此地不宜摆下法坛，需要另寻他地！
en: This is not the right place to set up an altar. I need to go somewhere else!

ch: 天地一片寂静，符力正被一股残余的妖气所阻隔。你暂时无法沟通此天气！
en: Nothing happened. A lingering breath of some monster blocks the charm's power. You cannot change the weather here for now.

ch: 妖道，尔敢搅乱天气，今日我定要替天行道在此灭杀你。
en: Demon, you've disturbed the weather! I'm going to enforce the law of heaven and kill you today.

ch: 由于天气变化过快，附近的村民叫苦不迭！
en: The weather is so fickle that the villagers nearby are rattled and distressed!

ch: 由于天气变化过快，附近的叫苦不迭！有修仙者远远探查了此处，又急忙溜走了！
en: The weather is so fickle that the villagers nearby are rattled and distressed! Deterred, some cultivators have traveled here from afar and immediately run away!

ch: 你观察天气的变化，对天地的感悟加深了！但同时你也发现附近的因天气频繁更换而叫苦不迭，心中魔道的种子加深了！
en: You observe the changes in the weather and your sense of heaven and earth is sharpened! But at the same time, you find that those villagers nearby are rattled and distressed by the fickle weather, which seems to contribute to your craving for a demonic way of life.

ch: 感谢道友，没有你改变天气吓走妖兽，在下怕是凶多吉少，此恩没齿难忘！
en: Thank you, cultivator. Had you not changed the weather to scare away the monster, I would probably have been killed already. You saved my life!

ch: 若我不是修仙者，该怎么应对这多变的天气！
en: If I were not a cultivator, how would I cope with the fickle weather?

ch: 若我的修为能更进一步，断不会对此等行径坐视不管。
en: If my cultivation could be further advanced, I wouldn't just sit by and do nothing about this evil deed.

ch: 好厉害的手段，竟能操纵天气，有机会一定要学习一番！
en: You can manipulate the weather? Awesome! Please enlighten me!

ch: 道友举力换天，倒是威风凛凛。只是弄得生灵涂炭，不怕汝之仙途就此截断？
en: It was drizzling and windy last night, but I still couldn't sober up. Now look at you. All-powerful and awe-inspiring. Aren't you afraid this is detrimental to your cultivation?
I had no idea there was such a talisman in this world!

ch: 符纸燃碎以后，周围渐渐有妖兽被吸引过来了！（消耗10天）
en: As the talisman is burnt out, monsters are drawn to the area! (costing 10 days)

ch: 你祭出瞬移符标记了此处地脉！（打开小地图可查看标记）
en: You've used the Teleportation Talisman to mark the land vein here! (Open the region map to see the mark.)

ch: 你祭出瞬移符，但即使燃尽符纸，也未能标记此处地脉！
en: You've used the Teleportation Talisman, but you fail to mark the land vein here even after the talisman burns out!

ch: 你刚祭出瞬移符，却见一道灵光闪过，符纸已然化为粉末！
en: A flash of Energy light flares the minute you use the Teleportation Talisman, which is immediately smashed to smithereens!

ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！
en: The space is vibrating inexplicably. Something must have gone wrong!

ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！
en: The space is vibrating inexplicably. Something must have gone wrong!

ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！
en: The space is vibrating inexplicably. Something must have gone wrong!

ch: 空间异动，似乎出了一些差错！

ch: 你是不是能看到......你是不是能看到......回答我......回答我......嘎嘎嘎
en: Can you see it... Can you see it... Answer me... Answer me... (Clack Clack Clack)

ch: 谁来帮帮我呜呜......谁来帮帮我呜呜......
en: Somebody! Help! Boo-hoo... Help me! Boo-hoo...

ch: 谁来帮帮我呜呜......谁来帮帮我呜呜......
en: Somebody! Help! Boo-hoo... Help me! Boo-hoo...

ch: 你是不是能看到......你是不是能看到......回答我......回答我......嘎嘎嘎
en: Can you see it... Can you see it... Answer me... Answer me... (Clack Clack Clack)

ch: 你眼前出现了一个奇特的方形物件！
en: An odd square object appears before your eyes!

ch: 你眼前出现了一个奇特的方形物件，突然一团黑影猛的扑向你！
en: An odd square object appears before your eyes, and suddenly a black shadow pounces on you!

ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力缓缓飞入你的眼中。渐渐你看到周围竟有一些阴冷之气？！
en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes. Slowly but surely, you see the Yin aura around you!

ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力从中缓缓飞入你的眼中。你好似看到一丝宝气在空中一闪而过！
en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes. You seem to see a ray of glory aura flash by!

ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力缓缓飞入你的眼中。
en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes.

ch: 符箓灵光闪烁，神目之力缓缓飞入你的眼中。你看到周围冒着许多黑气！！！
en: The charm's Energy light flickers and the Power of the Divine Eye slowly gets into your eyes. You see a mass of black aura bubbling up around you!

ch: 符纸缓缓烧完，也未能得到回应！
en: The talisman slowly burns out, but still, there is no response!

ch: 天空下起了蒙蒙细雨，一股柔和的灵气渐渐覆盖在周围！
en: A puff of tender Qi gradually covers your surroundings as it's drizzling!

ch: 此处好似是一座小型陵墓，是否要进去查探一番？
en: Here is a tomb. Enter it and see what's inside?

ch: 这坟墓周围凝固着一团怨气，还是小心为上......
en: A vile aura drifts around the tomb. Be careful...

ch: 你靠近了坟墓，暂时无事发生，你打算......
en: You approach the tomb. Nothing happened for now. You decide to...

ch: 突然坟口开裂，从中出现了一枚陈旧地符箓。
en: Suddenly, the tomb splits open. A worn charm emerges from inside.

ch: 你凝结法力劈中坟墓，竟惹出藏在里面的魔物。
en: You cleave the tomb with condensed energy, but the evil creature inside has also been awakened.

ch: 你不想打扰亡者地安宁，选择了离开。
en: Let the deceased rest. You leave.

ch: 视野+1，可能会看到常人无法看到的东西！
en: Vision +1. May be able to see things that normally can't be seen!

ch: 释放符纸内的雷电之力覆盖自身，使移动速度上升&608201_jsgd&，给予触碰自身的敌人造成雷属性伤害&608203_qtsh&，持续&608206_cxsj&秒。期间由于雷电之力的干扰，使用者将无法使用技能和道具，同时会不间断引发雷劫劈向自身，造成雷属性伤害&608203_qtsh&，若命中其他单位（包括友方），则造成&608203_qtsh&的伤害。\n●跑快点,莫让天雷击中你的天灵盖！--符法上潦草写着这样的文字
en: Release the power of lightning to cover its user, granting additional &608201_jsgd& Agility and dealing &608203_qtsh& Lightning damage to enemies touched in &608206_cxsj&s. Under the Charm's power, its user cannot cast skills or use items and will take &608203_qtsh& Lightning damage from lightning tribulations. The lightning bolts will also strike other units (allied and enemies), dealing &608203_qtsh& damage to them.\n●Run, quickly! Or the lightning bolts will fall on your head! -- A scribble on the charm

ch: 沟通地脉之力标记脚下格子，打开小地图单击标记图标可进行传送。\n●沟通八荒地脉，即可一步到天涯。--风水师
en: Unleash the power from the Earth's veins to mark the tile you're currently on. You can teleport to the marked tile by clicking on the Mark icon on your map.\n●The flow beneath the ground can carry us everywhere. -- A Feng Shui master

ch: 燃烧符纸沟通天地风水灵脉，以形成天然迷惑大阵，陷入其中将很难离开。
en: The talisman is burned to connect with Feng Shui and spiritual veins of heaven and earth and form a natural Confusion Array. Once trapped in it, nobody can find their way out.

ch: 沟通水木灵气形成能够滋养身躯的露珠，有一定的治疗效果。
en: Connecting with the Water and Wood Qi forms dewdrops that help nourish the body and have healing effects too.

ch: 沟通神目之力使视野拓展，能发现常人无法觉察到的情况，但有时也会被不好的东西缠上。\n●魑魅魍魉，必将无所遁形。
en: Connect with the Divine Eyes to expand one's vision. The charm enables one to detect things that are not easily perceptible, but sometimes one may get caught up in some undesirable things.\n●There will be no room for evils.

ch: 设下法坛，沟通天地之力，改变天气！\n●天地不仁，以万物为刍狗，圣人不仁，以百姓为刍狗。
en: Set up an altar to change the weather with primordial power!\n●The Cosmos treats everything as nothing; the sage treats everybody as nobody.

ch: 散发特殊的气息，引来不明的妖兽聚集在附近。
en: A peculiar breath is emitted that draws strange monsters to gather in the vicinity.

ch: 此物需要2名修仙者使用灵力对撞才能击碎，击碎时可将破坏者传到此符连接在十万大山内的遗迹。
en: This charm needs to be activated by shattering it with combined energy from 2 cultivators. Once activated, the cultivators will be teleported to an ancient ruin in Hundred Thousand Hills.

ch: 精力不足！无法进行邀约！
en: Stamina too low. Unable to invite.

ch:
炼气境的界元石可帮助修仙者感悟炼气境的秘籍。界元石的品质越好，影响的词条就越多。
<g>●打开需要学习的炼气境秘籍，点击【道源感悟】按钮即可使用界元石去学习秘籍。
●使用界元石需要较高的道心坚定度（按J进入修炼界面，点击道莲可查看道心坚定度）；
●使用界元石需要自身已拥有同类型技能。</g>
en:
You may use an Enigmatic Stone in Qi Refining to learn Manuals in its same realm.
<g>●To use it, open the manual you want to learn, and click on [Merge Insights].
●You need to keep your Taoist Mind Dedication above a threshold to gain insights from the Stone. You may check your Dedication by pressing J and clicking on the Taoist's Lotus at the top of the interface.
●You need to have skills of the same type before learning a specific manual with the Stone.</g>

ch:
筑基境的界元石可帮助修仙者感悟筑基境及以下的秘籍。界元石的品质越好，影响的词条就越多。
<g>●打开需要学习的筑基境秘籍，点击【道源感悟】按钮即可使用界元石去学习秘籍。
●使用界元石需要较高的道心坚定度（按J进入修炼界面，点击道莲可查看道心坚定度）；
●使用界元石需要自身已拥有同类型技能。</g>
en:
You may use an Enigmatic Stone in Foundation to learn Manuals in or below its realm.
<g>●To use it, open the manual you want to learn, and click on [Merge Insights].
●You need to keep your Taoist Mind Dedication above a threshold to gain insights from the Stone. You may check your Dedication by pressing J and clicking on the Taoist's Lotus at the top of the interface.
●You need to have skills of the same type before learning a specific manual with the Stone.</g>

ch: 你感受到附近某处冥气浓厚。
en: You feel a source of heavy Nether Air nearby.

ch: 你前往一探，发现地面像是被撕裂开了一个大口，从中源源不断涌出冥气。
en: You walk forward and see a large opening on the ground, from which a constant stream of Nether Air is spewing out.

ch: 你回到仙盟，召集众人商量对策，各大宗门已严阵以待，随时准备好前往讨伐冥妖，只需盟主一声令下，为赤幽洲阵亡的同道报仇雪恨。
en: You return to the Cultivator Alliance, rally the members there, and ask them for a countermeasure. All the major sects are on standby and ready to attack the Nether Demons. Once the Alliance Master gives his order, everybody will set out to avenge the death of their fellow cultivators from Chi You Continent.

ch: 仙盟众修仙者成功剿灭了此处冥妖，想必冥妖受此重创后，近日不敢再犯。
en: The cultivators of the Cultivator Alliance have succeeded in slaying the Nether Demons here. A heavy blow is dealt to those demons, and they will not dare to attack again.

ch: 你眼见战况不佳，下令所有人撤出冥窟，回仙盟修养。
en: Your camp is at a disadvantage, so you tell everyone to retreat from the Nether Cave and return to the Cultivator Alliance to recuperate.

ch: 召集仙盟成员，前往一探
en: Rally the members of the Cultivator Alliance and go check it out.

ch: 不想被冥气感染，远离此地
en: Stay away from this place if you don't want to be infected by the Nether Air.
Go attack the Nether Demons now!
A thug who pretends to be the River God

ch: 接受好意，跟随前往村落
en: Accept the offer and follow them to the village.

ch: 云游之时，天色渐晚，但你已经不清楚自己身处何处。忽见前方有一个小村庄，不由想去找找村中问问路
en: It's getting late when you're travelling around, but you have no idea where you are. Then all of a sudden, you see a small village ahead, and you decide to go there and ask for directions.

ch: 你被村民热情邀约至村中，其他村民听说有修仙者前来，前来围观。忽然一道声音从屋外传来，大家的注意力被吸引了过去。
en: The friendly villagers invite you to enter the village. A crowd comes to see what you are all about when they are told a cultivator has arrived. Suddenly, a noise comes from outside the room and draws everyone's attention.

ch: 你不愿停留，谢绝了对方好意，对方看你态度坚决也便不再坚持，在问过路后你便继续出发了。
en: You don't want to stay any longer and decline the offer of the person, who doesn't insist on making you stay. You continue on your journey after you ask the way.

ch: 啊，这... 夜半三更，共处一室...
en: What? I... In the middle of the night and alone in a room...

ch: 一会儿， 各家前来向你们献上酒食。觥筹交错之后，你们二人对于对方有了些许了解。随后，夜已深了，该歇息了
en: Shortly afterwards, villagers come to bring you alcohol and food. After a few drinks, you both get to know each other better. It's getting late and time to go to bed.

ch: 你有所顾虑，最终还是谢绝了对方好意，于是村民们也不再坚持，将你送到了村口。但这座小村庄好像有什么神秘之处，不久你又迷了路，一直在村庄中兜兜转转，怎么也出不去。 折腾到了天明后，你才终于找到离开的路。
en: You hesitate and finally decline the offer. The villagers don't insist and take you to the entrance of their village. But there is something odd about this place. You get lost again soon afterwards and find yourself going round and round within the village, unable to find your way out. You don't find an exit until the next morning.

ch: 你与对方聊了很多，有修行的理解，也有对方过往的经历。相谈甚欢，你们之间气氛也欢快了起来。
en: You two have a good talk about your understanding of cultivation and exchange your life stories. The vibe is good and you're having a great time in the room.

ch: 一夜无话，第二日你离开了小村庄，继续远行
en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

ch: 修仙以来，你从没有如此放松过。第二天的你和村民道别，离开了小村庄。日后，你回忆起这段愉快的时光，却发现这座神秘的小村庄仿佛消失了一般，再也找不到了...
en: You've never been so relaxed since you became a cultivator. The next day, you wave goodbye to the villagers and leave. However, when you recall this fond memory, the mysterious little village seems to have vanished and can no longer be found...

ch: 一夜无话，第二日你离开了小村庄，继续远行
en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

ch: 你与对方聊了很多，有修行的理解，也有对方过往的经历。相谈甚欢，你们之间气氛也欢快了起来。
en: You two have a good talk about your understanding of cultivation and exchange your life stories. The vibe is good and you're having a great time in the room.

ch: 一夜无话，第二日你离开了小村庄，继续远行
en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

ch: 修仙以来，你从没有如此放松过。第二天的你和村民道别，离开了小村庄。日后，你回忆起这段愉快的时光，却发现这座神秘的小村庄仿佛消失了一般，再也找不到了...
en: You've never been so relaxed since you became a cultivator. The next day, you wave goodbye to the villagers and leave. However, when you recall this fond memory, the mysterious little village seems to have vanished and can no longer be found...

ch: 一夜无话，第二日你离开了小村庄，继续远行
en: The sound of silence during the night. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

ch: 你刚坐到对方身边，但立刻被对方拉住你，威胁索要给予5000灵石
en: This person grabs you the minute you sit down next to him and threatens you to give him 5,000 Spirit Stones.

ch: 你挣脱了对面，却遇对方反抗，在对方即将喊出来之时你指间凝结道法，攻向对面
en: You manage to break free from him but are met with fierce resistance. As he's about to shout out, you gather the Tao between your fingers and attack.

ch: 解决了麻烦后，你继续休息，一夜过后你离开了小村庄，继续前行
en: Free from troubles, you proceed to sleep. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

ch: 为了省事，你决定破财消灾，递给对方5000灵石。对方倒也信守诺言，不再为难你
en: To save yourself the trouble, you decide to give him 5,000 Spirit Stones. He keeps his word and leaves you alone.

ch: 但你自觉晦气，还是决定离开了这个小村庄
en: But you decide to leave the village because you think this place brings bad luck.

ch: 虽然你拒绝付钱，但对方也不想闹大，只能作罢，随后离去。
en: You refuse to pay, but he doesn't want to make a big deal out of it. He gives up and leaves.

ch: 但你自觉晦气，还是决定离开了这个小村庄
en: But you decide to leave the village because you think this place brings bad luck.

ch: 对方目光一冷，向你袭来！
en: He's glaring at you coldly and pounces on you!

ch: 解决了麻烦后，你继续休息，一夜过后你离开了小村庄，继续前行
en: Free from troubles, you proceed to sleep. You leave the small village and travel on the next day.

Pick up the Willpower on the ground immediately!

ch: 马上进入法阵躲避伤害！
en: Enter the array to save your skin now!

ch: 尚未学习此类技艺\n画符需要学习图谱
en: You haven't learned this artisanship skill!\nYou need the corresponding Chart to make Talismans.

ch: 注：画符图谱可通过完成酒馆任务“符箓奇闻”获得
en: Tip: Talismans books and Charts can be purchased at the Market in various towns.

ch:
玩法说明：
<o>参照笔迹图形的虚影部分，按住鼠标左键进行描绘，将虚影部分绘制完成，点击按钮提交完成画符</o>
1.画符共有3次机会，其中通过1次即可获得符箓产出；但3次均为通过画符将会失败，无法获得符箓产出
2.符箓绘制需要在限定时间内完成，光标外圈的金色圆环即为倒计时标记；超时将损失1次画符机会
3.提交绘制结果后，会将已绘制部分与虚影部分进行比对计算，虚影均被涂满且未涂出范围外方可判定通过
4.拖动鼠标绘制的过程可以中断，无需将将整个笔迹图形一笔画完
tc:
玩法說明：
<o>參照筆跡圖形的虛影部分，按住滑鼠左鍵進行描繪，將虛影部分繪製完成，點擊按鈕提交完成畫符</o>
1.畫符共有3次機會，其中通過1次即可獲得符籙產出；但3次均為通過畫符將會失敗，無法獲得符籙產出
2.符籙繪製需要在限定時間內完成，光標外圈的金色圓環即為倒計時標記；超時將損失1次畫符機會
3.提交繪製結果後，會將已繪製部分與虛影部分進行比對計算，虛影均被塗滿且未塗出範圍外方可判定通過
4.拖動滑鼠繪製的過程可以中斷，無需將將整個筆跡圖形一筆畫完
en:
Game Rules:
<o>Press and hold LMB to draw the talisman following the shade of indicated strokes. After finished the drawing, click Done to submit.</o>
1. You have 3 attempts to draw a talisman. If all attempts failed, you would not obtain a usable Charm.
2. You need to finish the drawing within a given time. The golden circle outside the cursor is the countdown timer, and you would lose 1 attempt once the talisman hasn't been finished after the time ran out.
3. Your drawing will undergo a check after finished. To pass the check, the drawing should cover all indicated shades and be without redundant strokes that are out of them.
4. It's OK to release LMB during drawing. The talisman can be finished with multiple strokes.

ch: “哎哟！！！”一声惨叫伴随着树枝被折断的声音从附近传来，似乎有人从空中掉下来了。
en: \"Ouch!\" A painful shout comes with the sounds of cracking twigs. Maybe someone has fallen from the sky.

ch: 有一修仙者躺在地上，身上歪七扭八盖着一些符箓，周遭水木灵气正被符箓牵动缓缓融入此人体内，似乎正在为其疗伤？！你决定？
en: A cultivator lies on the ground, covered by a pile of charms. The water and wood Qi here are being attracted by them and are flowing into his body like they are healing him! You decide to...

ch: 随着你缓缓注入灵力，他的手指已可以微微攥动......
en: You infuse your energy into the cultivator. Soon, his fingers begin to move...

ch: 突然，一股吸力从其体内凶猛扑来，你赶忙运转灵力收紧自身，却无法阻止体力灵力念力的丢失......难道说他要恩将仇报把你吸干？！
en: Suddenly, a siphoning power rushes out and engulfs you. You hastily defend yourself with your energy, but your loss of Vitality, Energy, and Focus is inevitable... Will you end up being drained by the one you saved?

ch: 正当你即将陷入绝望之时，吸力猛地一消。他恢复神智了？！只见其周身灵力开始如呼吸般一张一缩，大量精纯的水木灵力汇聚在周围，缓缓补充着你的体力灵力，感觉有点飘飘然......
en: Just before you are caught by desperation, the strange power fades away. You see him waking up, and the Energy in the cultivator is rising and falling like breaths. You two are enveloped by dense and pure water and wood energies, and a feeling of satisfaction comes to you...

ch: 咳咳，小友心地纯良，不趁人之危，实属难得。此番救治之恩，咱家定当没齿难忘。不过也需提醒一下小友，仙途艰难，切莫让自身置于危难之中，你与咱家境界相差过大，方才咱家的残存灵力被你引动，自主吸食你的精气神，差点酿成大祸！方才若是小友丢掉了性命，那咱家的道心恐怕也将摇摇欲坠！
en: Thank you for healing me and not killing me. You're such a generous person rarely seen in the world, and I will certainly repay you. But please allow me to give you a piece of advice, that is, don't take unnecessary risks. The difference between our realms is so huge that it had my remaining Energy to siphon off yours. Luckily, a fatal accident has been avoided! If you die from it, my Taoist Mind will also be shaken!

ch: 未待你回应，只见从其身上飞出几样物品落入你的手中......
en: Something from him flies into your hands before you can make a reply...

ch: 咱家这个人呢，不善交际！小友多有担待，这些物件你只管拿上，咱家身上只有符箓相关的物件，希望能对小友有所帮助。
en: Pardon my clumsy expression. My friend, please take these as my gratitude. I have only items related to talismans and charms. Hope you'll find these useful.

ch: 咱家还要在此休息一些时日，小友请便吧。
en: I need to take a rest here for some days. Feel free to leave if you have to.

ch: 此人手掌内侧还蜷着一张符箓，身躯覆盖着微微灵光，这似乎也是某种符箓的效果。但不知何由，其身上散发着一股强烈的天道威压，仿佛受过天谴一般......你打算？
en: Inside his palm is another piece of charm, and you see a faint aura glowing on the cultivator's body. You think the aura is also produced by some charm, but you also noticed a fierce and strange coercion on him, which is similar to the effect caused by the wrath from Heaven... What do you want to do?

ch: 此人体质奇特，你尝试多次亦无法伤其分毫！
en: You can't hurt him. Maybe the cultivator's constitution is too special.

ch: 你趁其昏迷重伤，将其杀害.....
en: You killed him as your victim is in a coma...

ch: 你在此人腰间发现了一份符谱。
en: You find a Talisman chart on his belt.

ch: 突然，一股吸力从其体内凶猛扑来，你赶忙运转灵力收紧自身，此人灵力怪异，得小心为妙......
en: Suddenly, a siphoning power rushes out and engulfs you. You hastily defend yourself with your energy, alarmed by the strange flow of energy on him...

ch: 不消片刻，这人就悠悠转醒了。一瞬间从其眼中闪过一丝防备，不过随即转为释然......
en: Moments after, he slowly wakes up. A trace of wariness flits in his eyes, but then it fades away.

ch: 咳咳，感谢道友相助之恩，待咱家先自行疗伤......
en: Well, thanks for helping me, and I'll heal myself now...

ch: 只见他周身灵力如呼吸般一张一缩，符箓引来的大量精纯的水木灵力涌入其身躯，不消片刻竟已修复得七七八八......好强的身躯！！！你不禁称奇。世间竟还有如此体质可以承受这般猛烈的灵力入体。
en: The energy in the cultivator is rising and falling like breaths. Torrents of water and wood energies are attracted by the charm and flow into his body, and soon, his wounds have been largely cured... What a mighty figure! You're surprised by the endurance of the constitution in withstanding the fierce energy.

ch: 吁......感觉真不错！再次谢过道友，小小心意不成敬意！
en: Ah... I'm feeling much better! Thank you again, and please take these as my gratitude.

ch: 言罢，从其腰间飞来几个物件悬在你的身前，是一些符箓。
en: Something flies to your front from his belt. They are Talisman charts and finished charms.

ch: 知之为知之，不知为不知，咱家有啥说啥......
en: What do you want to know, my friend?

ch: 上个月，咱家在云陌州改造瞬移符时发生了意外，被传去了一个奇异的地方，里面危险重重！！就算是咱家，也只能是侥幸逃出哇。
en: An accident occurred when I tried to improve Teleportation Talismans in Yun Mo. I was teleported to a strange place and had a narrow escape.

ch: 打开背包物品栏，学习所得符谱；再进入技艺栏进入画符界面，选择需要炼制的符箓，进入炼制界面。炼制前需要准备好需要的材料。符箓相比于其他手段，只需炼制出来并拥有足够的念力，即可使用！
en: First, you need to learn the Charts from your inventory. Then go to Talismans in the Artisanship interface and select a charm to make it. Remember to prepare enough materials for them. Once a charm has been made, you can use it as long as your Focus meets its requirement, which is different from other products crafted with Artisanship.

ch: 提升画符资质的道具可于那坊市间觅得，至于这符箓的图谱嘛…千金难求！！我俩也算缘分一场，待他日我二人重逢之时，有关那符箓之事，定当知无不言言无不尽！
en: You can buy books and charts for drawing Talismans at the Market in various towns.

ch: 不了不了，自从那件事以后，咱家就一直很倒霉，不想节外生枝，只想留得性命，好去专研符箓。嗯…在那之前还是先去附近的酒馆饮上几盅罢，哈啊哈啊哈啊……
en: Well, no. I had many accidents since that. Now I just want to study these charms, and I'm not craving further risks.
Senior, why did you get hurt

ch: 向徒弟传授了功法，需要一定的时间恢复功力，半年内不可再向他人传授功法
en: This person has taught Martial Arts to an Apprentice and is restoring power. Next teaching of Martial Arts will be available after a half year.

ch: 向师父学习了功法，需要一定的时间精进功法，半年内不可再向他人学习功法
en: This person has learned Martial Arts from a Master and is practicing them. Next learning of Martial Arts will be available after a half year.

ch: 需要一定的时间恢复功力，暂时不可再向他人传授功法
en: Teach the person Martial Arts. After successful teaching, you need some time to restore power before the next teaching.

ch: 需要一定的时间精进功法，暂时不可再向他人学习功法
en: Learn Martial Arts from this person. After successful learning, you need some time to practice before the next learning.

ch: 攻击力+8，剑法资质+25，你所习得的碎星剑将被替换为天翎剑意，你所习得的绝影剑将被替换为天翎剑意绝影式。
en: Your Brokenstar Sword will be replaced by Empyrean Edge.

ch: 攻击力+8，火灵根+25，你所习得的地火术将被替换为分元地火。
en: Your Groundfire will be replaced by Scorching Eruption.

ch: 攻击力+8，木灵根+25，你所习得的荆棘术将被替换为幽盈碧羽。
en: Your Entangling Thorn will be replaced by Verdant Quills.

ch: 攻击力+8，土灵根+25，你所习得的<r>流沙术</r>将被替换为<r>镇域流沙</r>。
en: Your Entangling Thorn will be replaced by Verdant Quills.

ch: 攻击力+8，刀法资质+25，你所习得的断斩将被替换为醉饮狂刀。
en: Your Sever will be replaced by Sword Boost.

ch: 你从小就觉得精神世界中有高山大海，有珍奇异兽，有一切的一切。所谓雕梁画栋抑或萧然漏室对于你来说根本没区别。你的需要，不假外求。
en: Zhang San's exclusive Destiny, beginning info text

ch: 你从小就备受瞩目，外界的几名大宗长老数度来到你家，想将你收为亲传弟子，还曾有神秘组织邀你加盟。不知这到底是什么原因，然而你在旁人眼中就是如此一个出类拔萃的人物。
en: Night Rain's exclusive Destiny, beginning info text

ch: 你曾在旷野之中追逐一颗闪耀紫光的彗星，然则你追上之后彗星已在天空燃尽化作漫天明霞。你很失望，但自此之后，你紫气绕身，恍如华衣。还因此得了个诨号，天韵童儿。
en: You chased a violet comet in a vast wilderness when you were a kid. You finally ran to it, only to see the strange visitor had split into dazzling beams. The fact saddened you, but from then, a purple aura enveloped you like a fine robe and brought you the nickname of Violet Kid.

ch: 自你降生之日起，就有一件素衣包裹着。你不明白这是为什么，但每当你拿起这件衣服细细端详的时候，你就会生出一股使命感。将来，你要赐予旁人一样很重要的东西，可那是什么呢？
en: You were clad in a white robe when you were born. You don't know why you received it, but a feeling of something great comes to you when you look at the robe. Maybe in the future, you will bestow another person a significant gift... But what is it?

ch: 自打记事以来，你便一直觉得自己不属于八荒这个地方。甚至，你觉得自己只是活在一场梦中，而周围一切都是不真实的。你很想将使你生出这种错觉的原因找出来。
en: You are always carefree, but the reason behind your nonchalance is that you feel you are but an outsider to this world. Sometimes you even feel like you're living in an ethereal dream, and you hope to find out the truth about the strange feeling one day.
