en: Sir Mighty, you look so bad...

ch: 小家伙，刚刚虽然是用你的血限制血魔，但却是我施术来激活你的真血的，我可是很累的！
en: Because I'm tired, little friend. You provided us your blood, but it was I that activated the power in it with my secret technique. It's really hard!

ch: 大个子……我们、我们这就去找给你续命的法子吧？
en: Sir Mighty... Maybe now we could set out to sustain your soul?

ch: 小家伙，那个稍微放后一些。我想回去白源，看看族人，看看……武罗……
en: Well, maybe later. I want to be back to Bai Yuan and meet my clan members there, and I'll meet... Jagu...

ch: 只见江岚燕俏立前方，而更远处则是血微。其师神色惨然，似乎十分失望的样子。而你的接近让江岚燕生出警觉，她回过头来看了你一眼，便即转身而去。虽只一瞬间，你却看见江岚燕眼含泪光。
en: You see Jiang Lanyan standing before you. She is looking at her master, but Sanguira seems pale and frustrated. Sensing you are here, Lanyan turns back and glares at you, and steps away. At the very moment, you find her eyes brimmed with tears.
Why are you here? Go away!

ch: 江岚燕听你询问后，再也忍耐不住，眼中泪水汹涌而出。
en: Hearing your question, Jiang Lanyan bursts into tears.

ch: 当时，师父跟我说……血魔的法子没用……
en: At that time, she told me that, the Blood Lord's method is ineffective...

ch: 师父……自从击败血魔以后，你便一直心神恍惚，这是为什么呢？血魔已经击败，界元石也已夺回。难道……里面没有记录延寿之法，或者此法很难实现？
en: Master... You're always at a loss after we defeated the demon, and I wonder why? We have slain the Blood Lord and reclaimed the Enigmatic Stone. Or... is the record in the stone blank, or the technique is hard to follow?

ch: 界元石记录了延寿之法，血魔以身实践，也确是行之有效。
en: The technique of prolonging life is in it. And the Blood Lord has proved its effectiveness.

ch: 太好了！师父！我们这就去修炼这延寿之法吧。
en: That's great! Then let's practice it, master!

ch: 血微无奈笑笑，然后合掌一握，那枚飘泛血光的界元石应手碎裂。江岚燕花容失色，急忙拾取地上界元石碎片。
en: Sanguira smiles sadly and clenches her fist. The crimson Enigmatic Stone shatters into pieces following her gesture. Jiang Lanyan is astonished by the action, and could only hurry to collect the shards of the stone on the ground.

ch: 族中先祖创制的延寿之术，便是血魔损人利己的炼魂之法。我族尊长一直希望击杀这个贻害八荒的毒瘤，我又岂能为保性命，重蹈覆辙？
en: The technique invented by my ancestor is the soul-refining art practiced by the Blood Lord. My ancestor always hoped to eradicate the evildoer, and I shall not allow another demon to be born.

ch: 我们再想办法改变你们族人的寿短的宿命，一定有办法的！一定有！
en: Then let's find another way to prolong your clan member's life! We will do it! I believe!

ch: 这是血氏一族的命。命者，定也。注定的东西又要怎么改呢？
en: This is our fate. Fates are not subject to change. They just wait for everyone.

ch: 血微举头望天，脸上充斥了无奈与憔悴之色。
en: Sanguira looks into the far sky helplessly. She seems exhausted.

ch: 师父已经放弃了……她的命，也到头了……
en: My master has given up... And her life will soon end...

ch: 师父都放弃了，我还要怎么样？师父都放弃了，我还能怎么样？！
en: She has given up! Then what can I do? What could I do?!

ch: 江岚燕呜咽不止，泪下如雨，早已说不出话来了。
en: Jiang Lanyan's voice trembles with sorrow. Tears flow down her face, turning her words into a saddening sob.

ch: 江岚燕呜咽不止，泪下如雨，早已说不出话来了。
en: Jiang Lanyan's voice trembles with sorrow. Tears flow down her face, turning her words into a saddening sob.

ch: 祖先成功创制功法后十分开心，族人终于可以摆脱短寿之患。然而他稍一细想便已发现不对，因为功法炼人魂魄，损人利己。
en: My ancestor used to be proud of the technique he invented since his clan members could then live long. However, he soon found it was actually an evil art of soul refining that would be detrimental to others.

ch: 那功法是祖先天才之作，他不忍将之销毁，然而考虑再三终于还是将其付之一炬。然而就在他迟疑之际，血星河已偷录副本，暗中修炼，并且大成。
en: But it was his masterpiece, and it's always hard to destroy such a work. Finally, he decided to burn the manuscript, but before that, Sanguine Riverstar made a copy of it and practiced it to its perfection.

ch: 血星河持此功法在外行凶，先祖几番纠集人手拟击杀血星河，奈何他功法已成，无法击杀。祖先只得暂时以神石镇压，不过血星河同时也重伤了我族祖先。
en: He then committed many crimes with it. My ancestor made several attempts to kill the traitor, only to find him invincible. Therefore, he suppressed Riverstar with the stone, but the intrepid move also brought him a fierce battle and appalling wounds.

ch: 先祖料得血星河迟早有一日会破困而出，故回到族中，参研妙法，拟破去血星河的炼出分魂的功法。
en: He believed that the traitor would one day break out of his jail, and he decided to figure out a method to counter the technique of refining souls.

ch: 分魂延寿之法本已臻于完满，再要破解自然十分困难。先祖自立自破，万分艰苦，又身负血星河血咒之伤，终于油尽灯枯，不日离世。他临去之际留下遗愿，即击杀血星河。
en: But it was not easy. The technique was already without any flaws, and, suffered from both trying to overturn his long-cherished work and the wound caused by Riverstar's blood curse, my ancestor perished soon after the fight. His last will is, to kill Sanguine Riverstar.

ch: 先祖嘱托后人务必诛杀血星河，只是弥补自己犯下的错误……族人尊敬先祖则为他隐瞒了这里面的实情，因此血氏后人大都不知道这里面的曲折……
en: He made such a will to make up for his fault... And his descendants concealed the truth from further generations out of respect. Now their story is unknown to most of our clan members...

ch: 然而界元石中却将祖先创制炼魂之法的过程记录下来了……如果我使用炼魂之法延寿，那么我只会变成另一个血星河……
en: But the technique has been fully recorded in the Enigmatic Stone. If I dare to practice the art to prolong my life, I would become another Sanguine Riverstar...

ch: 岚燕，这边的事告一段落，我们也该与禹前辈等人告别了。
en: Lanyan, time to say goodbye to Senior Yu and others. We have finished what we came for.

ch: 不干嘛。啊，对了，那日毁去记录血魔邪修之法的部分界元石，剩下半枚完好无缺，还能利用，我拟将毕生绝学精要输入石中，供你日后参悟。
en: Nothing special. By the way, do you remember the Enigmatic Stone I destroyed that day? I shattered only half of it containing the evil technique, and the rest half of the stone is intact. I plan to record all my knowledge in it for you to learn in the future.

ch: 你不是一直怨我藏私不教吗？其实你修为未到，强行领悟为师所学，易出意外。有了界元石，一切就方便了。你顺利突破境界后，即使我不在也能自行学习。
en: I know your complaint that I keep so many martial arts my secrets. That's because I'm afraid this knowledge would bring you danger if you try to comprehend things that are beyond your cultivation. Now, with the help of the Enigmatic Stone, I could gift all I know to you, and you could as well learn from it after your breakthrough.

ch: 血微将界元石捧在手心，递到徒弟面前。江岚燕看着界元石，眼泪汹涌而出。血微无奈笑笑，江岚燕则一咬牙抢过界元石，转头跑到你面前，将之塞到你手中。
en: Sanguira hands out the Enigmatic Stone to her disciple. Jiang Lanyan looks at the stone and the lonely smile on her master's face with tearful eyes. Then, she grips the stone from her master's palms and presses it into your hands.

ch: 徒儿不要什么界元石！徒儿一身所学都是师父亲传，从前如此，今日如此，往后……往后也是如此！
en: I don't need your Enigmatic Stone! All my martial arts come from you. They were taught by you, and they will only be taught by you!

ch: 岚燕，师父时日无……日后又该怎么传你道法呢？
en: Lanyan, but my end is near... How could I teach you in the future?

ch: 徒儿记得师父平日谆谆教诲，遇到困难万勿放弃，师父自己却先放弃了！
en: I still bear your teaching in mind. You said that, never give up no matter how difficult things may become. But now you give up first!

ch: 师父的心愿是击杀族中恶人，收回界元石，改变族人的命运。徒儿的心愿是侍奉师父左右，将师父的绝学发扬光大。
en: Your wish is to eradicate the traitor in your clan and reclaim the Enigmatic Stone, and mine, to accompany you and honor your martial arts.

ch: 徒儿不相信，不相信只有血魔损人利己的办法能延师父之寿。延长师父寿命办法，只是我们还没发现而已！
en: I don't believe that only the evil technique from the Blood Lord could extend your lifespan, no! There must be other methods waiting to be found!

ch: 如果师父族人能创造出邪修之法延寿长生，我们为什么不能？师父，我们去找，去创造不用害人又能长生的办法！
en: If your clan members could devise the evil art, they could as well find good ones! Let's go! Let's find the real, harmless technique of longevity ourselves!

ch: 江岚燕说着哭着，一把抱住师父。血微背对徒弟，肩膀微微颤抖，良久良久，却一言不发。
en: Jiang Lanyan chokes with emotion. She gives her master a hug from the back. You see Sanguira's shoulders trembling slightly, but she remains silent for a long time.

ch: 江岚燕闻言喜极而泣，而血微也露出淡淡的笑容。
en: Jiang Lanyan bursts into joyful tears, and Sanguira also grins with a faint smile.

ch: 江岚燕见你不要，手一甩，已将界元石狠狠丢了出去。只见那枚宝石在天空划了个弧，栽落远方谷底，消失无踪。
en: Seeing you decline her gift, Jiang Lanyan throws the stone away. The Enigmatic Stone glides through the air in a curve and falls into the deep valley in the distance.

ch: 徒儿不要什么界元石！徒儿一身所学都是师父亲传，从前如此，今日如此，往后……往后也是如此！
en: I don't need your Enigmatic Stone! All my martial arts come from you. They were taught by you, and they will only be taught by you!

ch: 岚燕，师父时日无……日后又该怎么传你道法呢？
en: Lanyan, but my end is near... How could I teach you in the future?

ch: 徒儿记得师父平日谆谆教诲，遇到困难万勿放弃，师父自己却先放弃了！
en: I still bear your teaching in mind. You said that, never give up no matter how difficult things may become. But now you give up first!

ch: 师父的心愿是击杀族中恶人，收回界元石，改变族人的命运。徒儿的心愿是侍奉师父左右，将师父的绝学发扬光大。
en: Your wish is to eradicate the traitor in your clan and reclaim the Enigmatic Stone, and mine, to accompany you and honor your martial arts.

ch: 徒儿不相信，不相信只有血魔损人利己的办法能延师父之寿。延长师父寿命办法，只是我们还没发现而已！
en: I don't believe that only the evil technique from the Blood Lord could extend your lifespan, no! There must be other methods waiting to be found!

ch: 如果师父族人能创造出邪修之法延寿长生，我们为什么不能？师父，我们去找，去创造不用害人又能长生的办法！
en: If your clan members could devise the evil art, they could as well find good ones! Let's go! Let's find the real, harmless technique of longevity ourselves!

ch: 江岚燕说着哭着，一把抱住师父。血微背对徒弟，肩膀微微颤抖，良久良久，却一言不发。
en: Jiang Lanyan chokes with emotion. She gives her master a hug from the back. You see Sanguira's shoulders trembling slightly, but she remains silent for a long time.

ch: 江岚燕闻言喜极而泣，而血微也露出淡淡的笑容。
en: Jiang Lanyan bursts into joyful tears, and Sanguira also grins with a faint smile.

ch: {name|A}，我现在偶尔会看见阿禹的一些往事……近日我看见的却是这样的……
en: {name|A}, now I can see things of Yu's past, but recently I found a really strange clip...

ch: 嗯，你不认得我了。找出你的真身可是费了我一番功夫呢。
en: You don't recognize me? I made a huge effort to find your whereabouts.

ch: 我勘踏八荒发现了一个旁人不易察觉的秘密，那便是洪水的成因，乃是有人故意引导八荒风水导致的。而你，虽然没本事影响八荒风水，造成洪荒，却打算乘着这个东风，以图私利。
en: I'll share a secret with you, that is, the cause of the flood. It is unknown to nearly all of us, and I found it only after I surveyed the world. Someone hid behind the scene and changed the Feng Shui of our world, and incurred the disaster. I believe the person is not you, since you're too weak to impose such an influence. However, you still planned to gain profit from the disaster.

ch: 当年白源的洪水也是你干的好事吧？你发现了另外一个枢纽可以帮助你引发更大的洪水。洪水一发，就能夺去无数人性命，你便能……
en: And tell me, the flood in Bai Yuan years ago was also your plan, right? You found a crucial point to a greater flood, and if you overwhelmed more living beings with the floodwater, you could...

ch: 阁下究竟是谁？竟有本事洞悉八荒风水底细……
en: But who you are? You saw through the pattern of Feng Shui in the entire world...

ch: 你承认这一切？那对不起了。这神石终究有被你突破的一日，你又是杀之不死的。我只好加固一下封印防止你破困而出，为祸四方。
en: And I've seen through your plan. You'll soon or later break out of the stone that suppresses you, and I know you will not die. Therefore, I come here to enhance your seal, in case the notorious evildoer escapes.
For the world's sake, I must.

ch: 你有朝一日会死去，而我却会一直活着，总有一天我会突破你的息壤。你说白源区！到时我要炼化每一个白源区的人！我要先砍掉他们的手脚，折磨到他们生不如死，再叫他们受炼魂之痛！！
en: Never mind, I know you will die. I'll outlive you and your Xirang someday. Thanks for reminding me of Bai Yuan, it sounds like a fit goal for me! All human beings there will be my prey - I'll cut their limbs and torture them to death, and refine their souls!

ch: 白源区的风水已经受到影响，你等着吧！我还要引发洪水将白源区冲成一处死地，让你们绝族绝祀！
en: Now you just need to wait and see. The Feng Shui in Bai Yuan has been affected. I'll induce the flood to your homeland and devour all your clan members on it!

ch: 没想到大个子和那个血魔还有这段往事，阿禹一定很担心白源区的情况，很想回去亲自恢复白源区的风水呢……唉，我却没办法帮助他……
en: I didn't expect that our sir mighty knew it from the Blood Lord. He must be worrying about Bai Yuan and want to restore the Feng Shui there himself, but I can't help him... Sigh.

ch: {name|A}，大个子决定了要回去白源区。你也陪我们回去看看好吗？
en: {name|A}, our sir mighty decides to be back to Bai Yuan. Could you travel with us?

ch: 真是胡闹，仙长自己也有重要的事情要做，怎能一直麻烦人家呢？
en: What a whimsical idea. The senior cultivator must be very busy, and it's not proper to bother another person so many times.

ch: 阿禹说着突然跪倒，阿嬉从旁搀扶。
en: Suddenly, Yu kneels on the ground. Xi could only support him from the side.

ch: 大个子，我们先找办法治好你吧？
en: Sir Mighty, maybe we should find a treatment for you first?

ch: 不，我们先回白源区，那里才是我的故乡呀！走！
en: No need for that. Let's return to Bai Yuan, my homeland. Let's go now!

ch: 放心，我答应过阿嬉，我爬也要爬回去的。
en: Don't worry. I'll keep my promise to Xi. I'll return there at any cost.

ch: 阿嬉受阿禹指示，搀扶着他回到白源区山间。阿禹环顾周围，发现除去草木山石，更无别物，遂露出失望的神色，阿嬉正要带走阿禹，正在此时，一名丽人缓缓走来。
en: Yu instructs Xi to support him, and the two walk to a place on the mountain of Bai Yuan. Seeing there are only rocks and woods, Yu seems disappointed. Xi is about to lead Yu away, but just at that moment, a graceful lady comes to them.

ch: 当初我们约定，水患平定就回来重聚。我如今总算回来了……
en: I said I would be back after the flood was controlled. And now here I am...

ch: 阿禹轻轻挣脱阿嬉扶持，摇晃着要朝武罗走去，只是他终究太过虚弱，走到半途便跪倒地上。武罗连忙上前扶住了他将他带到一边坐下歇息。
en: Yu withdraws his arm from Xi's and stumbles to Jagu. But his steps are too feeble now, and he kneels on the ground halfway. Luckily, Jagu comes to his side and supports him to sit somewhere.

ch: 遇到一点意外……不过没关系啦。我可是遵守约定回来了。
en: An incident... But I'm here. I kept my promise.

ch: 阿嬉，当时取得血魔界元石后，我反复阅读里面的记录，除去血魔吸人魂力的法子，还有许多假想，其中一个我以为或能对禹前辈现在的情况有些帮助。
en: Xi, I read the record in the Enigmatic Stone from the Blood Lord and found many valuable ideas in it except for the evil technique. One of them may be helpful to Senior Yu now.

ch: 界元石中的假想是将人的魂灵设法转为器灵，此法十分霸道，普通人的魂灵根本无法承受。不过禹前辈一族似乎异于寻常凡人，而且禹前辈体内某些特质应该已经觉醒，或能抵受改造之力。
en: That is, to transform a human being's soul into an Artifact Spirit. It is a risky move since the souls of ordinary people are too fragile to undergo such a transformation. However, I noticed Senior Yu is different from them, and something in him has already been awakened. Maybe his soul could endure it.

ch: 一旦改造成功，所得魂灵需附器物之上，借以存形。到时将禹前辈魂灵还原，并设法附于铁尺上，那么禹前辈不就是等于再活过来了吗？不过这只是我的猜想……
en: If succeeded, the soul would be able to exist on an artifact. I guess Senior Yu could be alive again once we transform his soul and introduce it to the Iron Shard. But it's only a guess...

ch: 而且将魂灵转移到器物之上还需要陨幽谷的灵物拂霜石，此物藏于暮仙州陨幽谷中，不易寻得。禹前辈是否能撑过来，可难说得很。
en: And we need a medium to introduce souls. It is the Frostsoul Gem in the Fallen Valley of Mu Xian, which is hard to find. I'm uncertain if Senior Yu could wait for so long.

ch: 此时阿禹由武罗搀扶来到面前，他三番四次向血微以及你致谢，末了又向阿嬉致谢，然而阿嬉已不见了。
en: Yu steps toward you with Jagu's support. He says many thanks to Sanguira and you, but when he is about to express gratitude to Xi, he found the girl is not here.

ch: 刚才我发现有人越过白源区法阵去到外面，莫非是阿禹说的那名姑娘吗？
en: I saw someone slip out of the array of Bai Yuan. Could the person be the girl mentioned by Yu?

ch: 不好……她……她应该去陨幽谷了！她去为禹前辈你去拂霜石寄存神魂……
en: Oh, no... She must be on her way to the Fallen Valley! She's going to find the Frostsoul Gem for your soul...

ch: 血微将改造石的阿禹魂灵的想法说了，然后说服阿禹此法可行，不妨放手一搏，武罗赞成此议，然而阿禹却沉吟不语。
en: Sanguira explains her plan to Yu and tells him that it may be a daring but effective move. Jagu agrees with her, but Yu does not speak.

ch: 仙长，可否请你将阿嬉带回；我知道阿嬉很喜欢你，她应该愿意听你的劝。唉！小姑娘不知天高地厚，那个地方岂是她可以随意进出的？
en: Senior cultivator, could you bring Xi back? The girl is very fond of you, and I guess you would convince her. Alas! Ventures the Fallen Valley as a kid... She's too reckless.

ch: 如今我已奄奄一息，所谓改造魂灵不过尽人事而已。比起让你们冒险犯难，我更盼能和阿嬉道个别。
en: Now my days are numbered, and the transformation may be futile as well. I'd like to say my last goodbye to Xi rather than to see you risking your lives for my reason.

ch: 道友，我和岚燕尽量维持禹前辈神魂，并设法改造禹前辈魂灵将之附于铁尺上面。你带回阿嬉姑娘之余，若有余暇，不妨一探陨幽谷取得灵石。
en: Fellow cultivator, we'll sustain Senior Yu's soul and try to carry out our plan. You may as well take the gem from the Fallen Valley as you set out for Xi.

ch: 不，血仙长一番好意，阿禹心领。但请勿再为我冒险了。快快将阿嬉带回就好。我时间无多……只想和阿嬉好好道别……
en: Thank you, Sanguira, but please save your effort. Just bringing Xi back would be okay... I want to bid her farewell, and nothing more.

ch: 阿嬉正在陨幽谷徘徊游走，似乎遇到恼人难题。你才来到她便看见了你，并兴冲冲的走了过来。
en: Xi is wandering in the Fallen Valley worriedly. Seeing you're here, she rushes to you in a high mood.

ch: 我笨死了，竟不自量力来到这陨幽谷中，忘了谷中还有许多可怕的妖兽，{name|A}，你带着我进去杀死妖兽找到灵石好不好？
en: I'm so silly! I forgot there are terrible monsters and entered the Fallen Valley alone. {name|A}, since you find me here... Maybe you could also slay them and find the gem with me?

ch: 阿嬉听了这话，不知用什么法子放出金光，想要逃走，不过你只一伸手便将这小女孩拿了回来。
en: Xi tries to escape you in a dazzling golden glow. But the next moment, you catch the girl with a single hand.
Let me go! Yu will die soon.

ch: 所以你该尽快回去话别
en: So let's be back for a goodbye.
No... I don't want him to leave us...

ch: 你、你是说你会帮我吗？{name|A}，阿禹撑不了多久，我们快去陨幽谷中寻找拂霜石吧。这是我剩余的绝神砂，给你使用吧！
en: Well? {name|A}, you say you would help me! No time to waste. Here are my portions of Ultima Sand, and let's begin our search for the Frostsoul Gem now!

ch: 拿到拂霜石，我们快快回去白源区吧！女仙长会为阿禹维持他的残灵的。
en: Here it is! Let's return to Bai Yuan now with the Frostsoul Gem we found and help the lady with her next steps!

ch: 拿到拂霜石，我们快快回去白源区吧！女仙长会为阿禹维持他的残灵的。
en: Here it is! Let's return to Bai Yuan now with the Frostsoul Gem we found and help the lady with her next steps!

ch: 你和阿嬉回到白源区中，只见江岚燕与血微默立一旁，而阿禹头歪着靠在武罗肩上，虽然双眼合上，不过脸上充满幸福的笑意。阿嬉从你手中接过拂霜石，颤颤巍巍走了过去。
en: You returned to Bai Yuan with Xi. Jiang Lanyan and Sanguira stand beside Yu, and Yu rests his head on Jagu's shoulder. His eyes are closed, but you find him smiling. Xi takes the Frostsoul Gem from you and steps quietly forward.

ch: 女仙长，这是你说的拂霜石……快帮阿禹改造灵魂吧！
en: Lady cultivator, this is the gem you need... Please help him!

ch: 前、前辈……大个子睡着了吗？
嗯，阿禹睡着了。他害怕你赶不回来，所以托我给你传话。
en: Yes. He asked me to pass on a message to you in case you cannot be back on time.

ch: 阿禹说，这趟旅程能认识你他很开心。阿禹说，如果天下无事他最大的愿望是回来白源区。而你，帮他实现了这一切。
en: He said that he is glad to have you as his companion on the journey. His biggest wish was to return to Bai Yuan if the world were freed from the disaster, and you made it possible.

ch: 他还说，如果不是你一直鼓励他，他无法支持到这里来。希望你接下来的日子每天都开开心心。
en: He also said he is grateful to you. He wouldn't be here without your warm words. He wishes you to be happy all the day.

ch: 而我也很想好好多谢你。稍微和他聊过才知道后面许多变故。多谢你把阿禹带回来了。
en: And I am grateful to you, too. I talked to him and knew things I'd never heard of since then. Thanks for bringing Yu back.

ch: 你……你不是白源的山神嘛？你施法救大个子呀！快！
en: You... are the mountain goddess here! Please save him with whatever a spell. Please!

ch: 抱歉，此事非我力所能及。
武罗抱着阿禹回入深山之中，只片刻间，身形便已消失了。
en: Jagu holds Yu in her arms and steps into the mountain moments after.

ch: 岚燕姐姐，她……她怎么好像一点都不会难过？
en: But... Miss Lanyan, do you know why is she so calm?

ch: 哀莫大于心死……她应该才是最难过的人吧？只是……装作不难过罢了。
en: It's the greatest sorrow. I guess she must be sad, but her sadness is beyond words and expression.

ch: 岚燕，此事何不从另外一个角度看呢？禹前辈此前做的所有事都是为了苍生，他只想大家都好好的。你想，他会希望武罗难过，希望阿嬉姑娘难过吗？
en: Lanyan, maybe we could see it from another point of view. Senior Yu did everything for the world, hoping all of us could live happily. It would let him down if he found Jagu and Xi were sad.

ch: 武罗应是当今世上最了解禹前辈的人，她会拂逆禹前辈的一片好意吗？阿嬉，你要拂逆禹前辈一片好意吗？
en: Jagu is the closest acquaintance of Yu now, and she will certainly not let him down. And you? Xi, do you want to be happy as he hoped, or be sad and disappoint him?

ch: 眼看武罗回到山中，各人互道珍重，分别离去，从此走向各自的轨迹。
en: Jagu walked into the mountains, and the rest also bid goodbye to each other, leaving for their own way.

ch: 你和阿嬉回到白源区中，只见阿禹双眼阖上，歪倒在武罗身边，似乎已无生机。他身边江岚燕与血微一同合力施法续命，然而发出的灵力均如石沉大海，了无反应。
en: You returned to Bai Yuan with Xi, and found Yu resting beside Jagu, his eyes closed. Jiang Lanyan and Sanguira are channeling their energy to him, but their effort is in vain.

ch: 拂霜石，我已经带回来了！快、快救救阿禹！
en: Here is the Frostsoul Gem! Please save Yu now!

ch: 看来，你便是阿嬉姑娘了。阿禹托我给你带话，要我好好谢谢你。
en: It seems that you're the girl, Xi. Yu passed on you a message, saying that he is so grateful to you.

ch: 你们胡说什么……阿禹还好好的！他答应过我会坚持下去的，会找法子努力活下去的！血！我的血！之前是我的血流到铁尺上所以大个子活过来了！
en: No, nonsense! Yu is here! He promised me to live no matter how many difficulties he would meet! He just needs some help! Here, my blood! It flowed to the Iron Shard and woke him!

ch: 阿嬉露出一副如梦初醒的表情，摸出阿禹的铁尺，然后狠狠割破自己指头不断往上面涂抹鲜血。
en: Xi seems to have recalled something. She takes the Iron Shard out and cuts through her finger, and smears her blood from the deep wound onto the shard.

ch: 血微轻轻一挥手将阿嬉拍晕，然后施法为她止住手指伤口。
en: Sanguira gives the girl a light slap to calm her down and begins to tend her wound.

ch: 多谢你将阿禹送回来。也许这就是阿禹的命吧？八荒海阔天高，正是您施展身手的地方，武罗虽在白源区中也会日夜祷告，期盼你逢凶化吉，诸事顺遂。
en: Thanks for bringing him back, and maybe it's his fate. The world is so vast to wander, and during your journey, I would stay here and pray to the immortals, hoping your way would be smooth.

ch: 武罗抱着阿禹离开，血微想了想也跟随而去。只眨眼间，山中已空无一人。
en: Jagu holds Yu in her arms and walks away, followed by Sanguira. There is only you the next moment.

ch: 一道人影闪过，你下意识捂住口袋，却发现背包中似乎多了件东西。
en: A shadow runs by. You cover your pockets but realize there's something new in your Inventory.

ch: 你回到白源区中，只见远山上一只“奇怪”的小小妖兽正追逐着一个高大健壮的男子。你仔细一看，发现那竟是阿禹！而那小妖兽突然站起，却是……阿嬉扮的……
en: You returned to Bai Yuan. A curious little monster is chasing a tall, strong man in the hills - he's Yu! Then, the monster stands up before your eyes, and you found it... a girl.

ch: 呜嗷！我要吃掉你，哈哈哈哈哈。
你吃我好了，我不能、我不能丢下武罗！
en: Come and eat me! I won't leave Jagu alone!

ch: 你都长这么大了，怎么还像个孩子一样……
en: You are an adult now, but you behave really like a boy...

ch: 孩子？不，我是男人！男人就应该挡在……挡在女人身前！
en: A boy? No, I'm a man! I... I'm supposed to protect you!

ch: 哈哈哈哈哈，大个子你看起来好傻！
en: Hahaha. You look so cute, Sir Mighty!

ch: 唔，可是，当年就是这样的！
en: Well? But I did do that in the past!

ch: 去去去，阿嬉跟武罗吃果子去！我跟仙长好好说话。
en: Okay, Xi! Find Jagu there, she prepared fruits for you. Let me talk to our senior cultivator.

ch: 好久不见，仙长可否移步一聚？
en: Greetings. We haven't met for so long. I found a place fit for a talk, and I'll wait for you there.

ch: 仙长来了？哈哈，看仙长脸有讶色，可是心中存有许多疑问？
en: Good day, senior cultivator. You seem surprised, and I guess you must have questions.

ch: 想必仙长心中定有许多疑问。
en: You must have many questions to ask me.

ch: 愚公离世，他有什么打算，已无从考究。不过我私心揣度，却是这样的。
en: Foolish Old Man has passed away, and I could only guess his intention from what I know.

ch: 其实愚公很早察觉到铁尺的古怪，隐约知道铁尺之上附有残魂。他推想前事，猜到留在铁尺上的魂灵便是我。
en: I suppose he had noticed the Iron Shard and its oddness a long time ago and knew a soul was residing in it. He soon figured out the identity of the soul from our legends.

ch: 愚公情知自己不久人世，便希望有人暂时领导族人。智叟空有机谋，不足以论大事，阿嬉虽有潜质，但年纪幼小不堪大任。那么放眼白源遗民之中，更有何人能当大任呢？
en: But he also knew his end was near, and he must find a fit chief for his clan. Wise Old Man could only put out lofty and impossible plans, and the girl, Xi, though talented, was too young at that time. He then picked another candidate from the residents of Bai Yuan.

ch: 愚公想到了亲手打造“禹王屏”的我。当时我附于铁尺上无知无觉，但仍有一丝执念，那便是看看天下洪水是否已经治平。
en: It was me. The man knew my deed in creating Yu's Barrier, and I was in the Iron Shard at that time. I was kept away from the outer world, but I still remembered my wish, that is, to see if our land is freed from the flood.

ch: 愚公隐隐察觉到我对潜力十分巨大的阿嬉有趋近之性，便下决心一搏。希望我由此苏醒。
en: He also noticed a tendency of bringing me and the clever girl close, and therefore he decided to take the move, hoping I could someday be awakened.

ch: 可是人心鬼蜮，又能依赖谁去完成此事呢？仙长曾造福于白源，愚公只好将这番机缘寄托在您身上。
en: But it was hard to find a trustworthy person for his plan. Foolish Old Man recalled your deeds in his homeland and regarded you as a capable choice.

ch: 只要有仙长保驾护航，阿嬉、铁尺总有一日能有一番机缘吧？愚公不可谓不用心良苦。
en: That is to say, the man believed that Xi will find the secret of the Iron Shard once you decide to assist us. He made the plan with a sharp perception.

ch: 按理说，这位愚公乃是我的后人，但我总觉得他更像一位长辈。唉，愚公智慧渊深，非禹所及。
en: If we address him according to our family tree, Foolish Old Man was actually my descendant. However, in my eyes, he was as caring and considerate as my elder. He was named Foolish but was in fact full of wisdom.

ch: 血魔之事，我也是此番重生以后这才从江岚燕师徒口中将这里面的来龙去脉搞明白了。
en: The Blood Lord... I knew more about him from Jiang Lanyan and Sanguira only after I revived.

ch: 这血星河与血氏另一祖先一同研究如何延长寿命。血氏的另一先祖天资聪颖，想到了凝练分魂的法子。
en: Sanguine Riverstar and another ancestor in the clan tried to expand their clan member's lifespan. The other ancestor designed an extraordinary technique of condensing an alternative soul.

ch: 血星河立即加以完善，并将其这损人利己的法子打算到八荒众生身上。他，打算借洪水杀死八荒生灵，从中窃取亡者魂力，凝练分魂。
en: And Riverstar improved it. Then, he took the living beings in the world as his prey. He planned to wipe them out with the flood and refine another soul of his own using the souls of the deceased.

ch: 血氏未料自己苦心创制的功法，竟会被师弟如此利用，失落之余也狠下心来要封印血星河。不过血星河机警非常，临机反扑还是将血氏伤了。
en: That took the ancestor by surprise. He found himself betrayed by his junior brother, and the event led him to think about eradicating the demon. However, his opponent was fierce, and though fell under the seal in the end, Riverstar still wounded the ancestor.

ch: 血氏知道血星河一日未死，仍会为祸八荒，于是忍着巨大伤痛回到族中，将杀死血星河的秘法告知族人，这才离世。
en: The ancestor was aware that Riverstar would soon or later escape the seal and carry out his plot, so he staggered back to his clan and left the method to kill the demon for his descendants, and died.

ch: 此时天下洪水已逐渐形成，血星河为恶日甚，竟千辛万苦将部分洪水引到白源区中，我当时年轻识浅，与血星河有过一番冲突，也不慎被他利用……
en: At that time, the flood had started to rampage, and so did Riverstar's ambition. He even induced some floodwater into Bai Yuan. I had a conflict with him before, but I was too careless, and he took advantage of me...

ch: 所幸我体内之血至刚至正，能克制此獠。机缘巧合下，血星河终于被封印于息壤之下。这也是多赖毕方之力了。
en: Fortunately, my blood counteracted his influence. After many attempts, we sealed Sanguine Riverstar with Xirang - yes, Bi Fang had also helped a lot in it.

ch: 不过即使如此，血星河仗着血氏的凝练分魂之法，仍然杀之不死。直到血氏的后世传人江岚燕的师父携克制血星河之法出手，这才将此獠杀死。
en: However, boosted by his evil technique, Riverstar is still a creature that cannot be slain. The demon continued to live, till Sanguira, the master of Jiang Lanyan, came to end him with the method she found.

ch: 当日我一息尚存，几乎绝命，恰好阿嬉匆忙赶回将自己的鲜血涂于水尺之上。她的鲜血既是烧毁我魂灵的毒焰，也是滋养我剩余残魂的养分。
en: I thought it would be my final day, but Xi hurried back at the moment and smeared her blood on the shard. Her blood warms my soul by igniting and consuming it.

ch: 得了阿嬉鲜血的帮助，我顿时恢复了部分意识。阿嬉当日几番请求我不要放弃，言犹在耳，当下我咬牙苦撑。恰好血微从旁发现我一点魂灵未曾泯灭，便与她的弟子全力救援于我。
en: The blood brought me out of unconsciousness. She implored me not to give up - I still remember her sincere words. Luckily, Sanguira also noticed that my soul did not fully disperse and retrieved it together with her disciple.

ch: 最后再以你从陨幽谷取得的拂霜石将我神念附于水尺之上。我因此侥幸留下了性命。如今我依附水尺之上，非人非鬼、非妖非魔，着实有点好笑。
en: Then they managed to introduce my soul into the shard with the Frostsoul Gem you found, and here I am. Now I live on an iron shard, existing in a curious state different from human beings, ghosts, or demons.

ch: 不过我因此留下性命，得以好好看看这世界，这还有什么不满足的呢？
en: But my life has been saved. Today I can see the world again with my eyes, and I feel like that's all I wanted.

ch: 仙长一路相伴，助我良多，阿禹却一直没有机会好好向仙长致意，这回请仙长来到白源，便是为了好好向你道谢。
en: Thank you, senior cultivator. You helped me a lot in our journey, but I have little to repay you. So I invite you to Bai Yuan to express my utmost gratitude.

ch: {name|A}是修仙者，是大能，谁跟你计较这个！快走快走，武罗姐姐说要给我看看那只大猫呢！
en: {name|A} is a cultivator! Such a master cultivator has many things to take care of after listening to your gratitude! Let's go! Miss Jagu said she would allow me to see the big cat!

ch: 小鬼，你应该喊武罗做山尊或者女神才对！怎能没大没小的乱喊？
en: Little one, you should address her as a mountain deity or goddess! Calling her Miss Jagu is not proper.

ch: 武罗姐姐都不介意我这么喊，就你计较！
en: She never told me that she dislikes it, so maybe you can take it easy!

ch: 仙长，这个是当日血微留下给我的，我从此长居白源，此物于我用处不大，倒不如给你了。另外这是血微师徒留下的书信，江岚燕姑娘猜你一定会回到此处，因此将书信留在这里了。
en: Senior cultivator, this is a gift from Sanguira. It would be useless for me since I'll be living in Bai Yuan in the future, so you may take it. And here are two letters from Sanguira and Jiang Lanyan. Lanyan guessed you would return here one day and asked me to keep them.

ch: 阿禹才将宝物塞到你手中，不远处的阿嬉已急步跑了过来。她对你咧嘴一笑，然后拉着阿禹去到武罗身边；三人指点白源风物，悠游山中胜景，不多时已去得远了。
en: Just when Yu puts them into your hands, Xi runs to him merrily. She grins at you and brings Yu away to Jagu's side. The three are sightseeing along their way, and soon they walk out of your sight.

ch: 武罗和阿禹并肩坐着，阿禹挨着武罗，似乎身体使不出半分力气。他看见阿嬉回来，双眼终于闪出一丝神采。身边的武罗则轻轻将阿禹扶好，让其端坐。
en: Jagu and Yu sit side by side. Yu rests on Jagu's shoulder, seeming exhausted. Seeing Xi is back, a gleam flits in his eyes, while Jagu supports him to sit straight.

ch: 小姑娘，你回来啦？多谢你啊，我原本以为治平洪水是完成了一件不可能的事，不料这场跟阿嬉的旅程走得比以前更是艰难千倍万倍。
en: Little friend, you're back! Thank you. I used to think subduing the flood was difficult enough, but now I found the journey with Xi is much harder than it.

ch: 没有你，我就没法看看这这治平洪水后的世界，就没有勇气走完这一程，就不能回来与武罗相聚……小姑娘啊，你为什么在哭？
en: I can accomplish it only because of you. I wouldn't be able to see the peaceful world myself or finish my last journey, or visit Jagu for the last time... Hey, why are you weeping?

ch: 我没有哭……没有……你看我不是在笑吗？
你嘴上在笑，可眼睛却在哭……
en: You smile with only your lips, and your eyes are tearful...
I don't want you to leave...

ch: 为什么舍不得呢？我以后就在白源区里了。我会一直陪着大家，陪着阿嬉。
en: Why would I leave? I'll be living in Bai Yuan at everyone's side, as well as yours.

ch: 是的，大个子以后陪着阿嬉。
en: Yes, our Sir Mighty will be here with Xi.

ch: 阿禹说完这话，苍白的脸上突然泛起一层血色，无神的眼睛闪起流星般璀璨的光芒，嘴角也泛起一丝满足的笑容，随后慢慢阖上眼睛。武罗微微一笑，朝你与阿嬉躬身行了一礼然后搀扶阿禹渐行渐远，慢慢消失于山岚雾霭之中。
en: A blush emerges on Yu's pale face. He smiles in satisfaction; a bright glimmer begins to shine in his blank eyes. Then he closed his eyes. Jagu grins and bows to you and Xi, and supports Yu away. The two are soon enveloped by the mountain mist.

ch: {name|A}，阿嬉心里感觉很奇怪，似乎很难过，但又似乎松了一口气感到轻松愉快，这是为什么？嗯，是了，阿禹离开了所以阿嬉难过，阿禹如愿回到这里，所以阿嬉开心。可是大人都是这样的吗？
en: {name|A}, I have a strange feeling now. Perhaps I am sad, but seeing them there, I seem to be happy at the same time. Do you know why? Well, I find an answer. I was sad because Yu left me, and I am happy because he finally returns to his homeland. Will adults feel the same?

ch: 唉，我真希望好像以前一样，什么都不知道，嘻嘻哈哈的过完一天又一天……
en: Sigh. I really miss the life in the past when I was carefree and without worries all day...

ch: {name|A}，多谢你。如果不是你，可能我就错过和大个子话别的机会了。
en: {name|A}, thank you again. You brought me the last chance to say goodbye to our sir mighty.

ch: 阿禹说，没有我，他不可能坚持到这里。可是没有你，我却没办法一直鼓励阿禹。这次出来太久了，我去找智叟伯伯报个平安啦，告诉他已经将铁尺带回来了。
en: Yu said that he wouldn't be able to be back here without me, and I also want to say, I wouldn't be able to encourage him along the way without you. Alright! I've been out for a long time, and now I'll talk to Grandpa Wise. I'll tell him I'm safe and sound, and I bring the Iron Shard back!

ch: 阿嬉朝你挥手作别，然后别过脸朝自己村中跑去。
en: Xi waves you goodbye. Then, she turns away and runs toward her village.

ch:
天涯久暌，展书望安。
还记得当日我心中难过的时候，向你诉苦，你则激励我和师父一起努力。
多亏有你，我才鼓起勇气跟师父说出了心底话。
现在师父和我仍和以往一样，四处奔波。
只是，以前为了寻找血魔，找回师父族中的界元石。
en:
Greetings, my friend.
Thanks for your encouragement. I remember the day when I told you my woes, and you cheered me up with your warm words.
Because of your inspiration, I finally decided to tell my master what I thought.
Now we continue our journey as before, but our aim is no longer the Blood Lord and the lost Enigmatic Stone.

ch:
现在则是寻觅延长师父寿命的方法。
师父说，看见禹前辈这么努力，自己也就没有放弃的理由了。
她现在是真的拼了命的去找法子延长自己以及自己这一族人的寿命的。
就不久前我们才进入一个大书库，师父在里面翻看道典，记下的笔记足有数百页之多！
en:
We are in search of methods to prolong my master's life.
She said that Senior Yu's steadfastness heartened her to overcome difficulties once more.
And now, she is carrying out her painstaking research on the wonderful technique for her clan and herself.
Recently, we visited a library, and I found my master's notes are hundreds of pages - all of them are taken from the tomes there!

ch:
师父日夜忙碌，话更少了，可看起来却更温柔更开朗了。
多谢你，如果不是你鼓励我，我也不敢说出那些话，师父也不会改变。
不说了，我看见前方有一家十分出名的饭店，用天下罕有的“啸天元元鼎”烹饪了一锅“九转灵气焖当康足”！
我要买来孝敬师父！
en:
My master is much busier now. She speaks less but smiles more.
Thank you again. If I hadn't heard your words, I wouldn't be able to encourage my master, and she would neither change her mind.
But let's stop here! There is a famous restaurant before us, and its signature dish is Slow-braised Dangkang Trotter in Sky Roarer's Primal Cauldron!
We'll have a taste!

ch:
见字如唔。
这一趟与道友的旅程血微获益良多，终生难忘。
往日我汲汲于延长寿命，总是忘记看看身边的景色、事物。
血魔之事后，许多事情我都已经释怀了。也学着岚燕留意起身边的事物。
我这才明白自己过去奔走忙碌，已空自错过了许多好看的风景，好吃的食物。
en:
Greetings.
Thanks for being my companion in the journey, I'll remember the days we spent together.
In the past, I was obsessed with finding the method to extend my lifespan and let so many sceneries and anecdotes around me slip.
Luckily, I finally realized it after we slayed the demon, and am trying to appreciate the beautiful world like Lanyan did.
Then, I found the world is full of spectacular landscapes and delicacies.

ch:
其实长寿夭折的区别，更多在于生活是否有意义吧？
有不少凡人，虽然只有短短数十年寿命，却也能做得许多惊天大事。
反观很多修仙者，虽然得享长寿，却没有好好利用自己的寿命为有益之事。
从这一角度看的话，浪费光阴之人虽寿而夭，珍惜时光的人虽夭而寿。
en:
Maybe the most important thing for us is not to live a long life, but a meaningful one.
Many ordinary people lived only for decades, but their deeds were recorded and praised by the world.
On the contrary, many cultivators lived for centuries, but they did little for the world in their prolonged lifespan.
Therefore, I think what really matters is not a lasting or fleeting life, but our contribution to the world made during it.

ch: 命数之事不能强求，亦无法强求；却不代表我能放任自流，该争取的仍需争取。\n近日我遍阅道典，颇有心得，炼得灵丹二枚，我自己吞服一丸，能略微延长自身寿命。\n灵丹是极好的，不过血氏一脉体质让灵丹效用大打折扣，所余效力不及十分之一。
en: Our lifespan has been set, and it's usually futile to extend it at any cost. However, I'd still like to carry out my research and see if I could win over my fate.\nRecently, I gained much insight from ancient tomes and concocted two life-extending elixirs. I already took one and found it beneficial.\nHowever, our clan's blood counteracted its effect to about one-tenth on me.

ch: 无论如何，这都是一个好的开始，总有一日血微必能将此丹研制成功，根绝我族短寿之患。\n随信附赠血微此次炼制的丹药，道友骤遇强敌之际，不妨使用。
en: It is a good beginning for me anyway. Someday I'll invent the right pill to cure the curse that haunted us for generations.\nI also sent another elixir for you with the letter. It would be useful if you are about to confront a powerful enemy.

ch: 你服下此丹，但觉气血加速，心跳如雷，但只片刻间不适感尽去，体内竟生出无穷力量。
en: You take the elixir. Your blood starts to circulate furiously and your pulse quickens, but soon, your body is brimmed with incredible vitality.

ch: 这些日子，那根烧火棍总算不作妖了。不过现在我得常常去擦干净那玩意。真麻烦啊！\n对了，咱们村里有个家伙说想要见一见你，是个啰嗦的家伙。\n我发誓，我刚认识这人的时候，他不是这样的！
en: That shard has finally calmed down now, but I need to wipe it clean frequently, that's annoying!\nBy the way, someone in our village wants to meet you. A talkative one.\nHe is really different from what he was when we met for the first time!

ch: 不过他既然几番恳求我请你来村里玩，那我就勉为其难，把这事办了。\n你不知道我为了传这信给你，损失了多少饴糖！\n所以你一定要来，我在白源等你，切记！
en: But he has asked me to invite you here many times, and now I decide to do him a favor.\nThe letter you're reading cost me so many candies!\nSo, be sure to visit us in Bai Yuan! Please bear it in mind!
You know the East Sea's past?

ch: 所以你该尽快回去话别
en: So let's be back for a goodbye.

ch: 愚公当初为何让我插手此事？
en: Why Foolish Old Man found me?
Joy and woe come side by side

ch: 你完成阿禹心愿，应该开心
en: You're happy on finished his wish

ch:
道源感悟功能描述:
消耗自身已学会的同类型技能，可直接学会此秘籍。同时继承消失技能的其中一个词条和部分经验值。

使用条件:
1.需要消耗界元石*1
2.道心坚定度达到70%;
3.自身已学会同类型技能。
en:
Merge insights from a skill and a manual.
You may instantly learn a manual at the cost of a learned skill of its same type. You may as well pick an affix from the consumed skill and put it into the new one. The new skill will also receive a bonus Skill EXP from the consumed one.

Requirements:
1. Merging insights will cost 1 Enigmatic Stone.
2. Your Taoist Mind Dedication needs to be at least 70%.
3. You have learned the manual's same-type skill.

ch: 是否离开，离开不消耗界元石。
en: Give up merging? Your Enigmatic Stone will not be spent.

ch: 新技能可以将自身的一个词条与旧技能一个词条替换，替换结束后会继承旧技能的部分经验值。\n词条替换功能并非完全自由！请留意系统提醒！
en: You may replace an affix in the new skill with a selected affix from your learned skill. The new skill will also receive a bonus Skill EXP from the learned skill.\nNote: There are restrictions in replacing affixes. Please pay attention to the notices in merging.

金乌作乱，十日凌天，永宁州生灵涂炭。\n当此之际，后羿射落九日，终于挽回一州安宁。
en: A long time ago, there were ten golden crows transformed into suns and scorched Yong Ning.\nHou Yi shot nine of them down and restored the peaceful life of his people.

ch: 河罗鱼作乱，扰动东海怒涛。\n精卫化为灵鸟，口衔息壤，填平东海。华封州由此转危为安。
en: The East Sea was disturbed by Leviathan.\nJingwei braved the ocean with her wings and filled the sea with Xirang, thus saving Hua Feng from a disaster.

ch: 阿夸追逐金乌，一路西行，撞开冥山。\n他肉身虽殁，一身精血却化为养分，造就一片桃林，遗惠八荒。
en: Agar chased the sun all the way toward the west and finally opened a crack in Nether Mountains with his life.\nA forest of peach trees emerged at the place he perished - a verdant bestowal to the world.

ch: 斗魂仙祠供奉的上仙，据传昔日曾用凰拳打遍四海，更凭凤爪踏尽八方，实属一方斗神。
en: An immortal from Battle Soul Shrine. His fists are formidable and his claws are rapid. That's why he got this title.

ch: 衡天座下弟子，身怀青空重瞳。\n她窥破天地风水之余，更凭一双素手牵引着八荒运势。
en: She is the trusted disciple of Hengtian, a formidable lady with Sky Double Pupils.\nShe knows everything about the Feng Shui in this world and weaves its fate with her hands.

ch: 你听说了吗？近日琅琊阁公开了一部分界元石的信息。
en: Recently, the Manual Pavilion announced its findings on a treasure called Enigmatic Stone. Have you heard of it?

ch: 孤陋寡闻的东西！当你学习更深奥神妙的功法时，就不得不舍弃从前悟出的心得对不对？
en: Hey, you're too ill-informed! In the past, when we found a more advanced Martial Art, we must abandon what we learned and begin to work on the new manual, right?

ch: 若你拥有这件宝物，就可以用它保留你以往参研功法时感悟出来的重要心得。
en: And now, if we have the stone in hand, we could pick some insights from our previous martial arts to preserve.

ch: 若你以后得了机缘学习到更为强大的功法，还能从界元石中将保留的心得提取出来，并完美契合到新功法之中。
en: What's more, the insight recorded in it could be put into your new Martial Art if you happen to find a near-perfect one.

ch: 什么？！还有此等神妙之物？！琅琊阁实是造福我等修仙者啊！
en: Well? That's incredible! The Manual Pavilion is really doing good for us!

ch: 我们赶紧去<r>琅琊阁</r>询问<r>关于界元石</r>之事吧，这次发现的石矿极为有限，过了这村就没这店了。
en: Let's set out to the <r>Manual Pavilion</r> to ask about their findings on that <r>Enigmatic Stones</r>. It's said that the precious ore is so rare, and our opportunity knocks but once.

ch: 仙长你好，近日八荒地脉变化，从而让部分界元石显露于世。而我阁已查知其确切方位。
en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, some Enigmatic Stones emerge from earth veins, and our Pavilion has found their whereabouts.

ch: 这界元石可刻录保留以往修炼功法时感悟出来的心得，并能将其融合到新修炼的功法里。乃绝世之妙宝。
en: The Enigmatic Stone is a treasure for cultivators. It can record the insights from your previous Martial Arts and put them into another once you are about to learn a new manual.

ch: 如今只需交纳一定灵石以供我阁启动新一轮的秘籍研究即可获知界元石所在。
en: If you want to know where the mysterious stones are, you could pay the Pavilion some Spirit Stones, since we need funds to carry out our new research on manuals.

ch: 我阁一向旨在不遗余力提高修仙者修为，若仙长对此感兴趣，不妨到各地<r>琅琊阁管理员</r>处询问关于<r>界元石之事</r>。
en: The Manual Pavilion is always glad to help our fellow cultivators. If you are interested in the <r>Enigmatic Stone</r>, please ask <r>Pavilion Clerks</r> in cities and towns for more information.

ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此，只需要提供500灵石即可获知八荒至宝界元石位置所在。
en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals. If you are also here for the whereabouts of the Enigmatic Stone, you could exchange the information with 500 Spirit Stones.

ch: 如今我阁急需灵石维持编修计划，除去仙长目前身处的小店外，其余各州已发现界元石矿藏的琅琊阁也已发出告示，以界元石的位置交换灵石。
en: We are in urgent need of funds for our research. Except for the store you're in, other Manual Pavilions throughout the world have all posted their findings on the distributions of Enigmatic Stones nearby, as well as their needs for Spirit Stones.

ch: 若仙长对界元石仍有需求，不妨前往我阁分号，继续获知界元石分布位置。
en: If you need more Enigmatic Stones, you may visit the Pavilion's other branches. They may as well know where could you find them.

ch: 界元石效用神妙，从古至今都为修仙者所看重。仙长若有心取得此物，可要赶紧了。
en: The Enigmatic Stone has always been a treasure craved by cultivators. Please hurry up in case it was seized by others.

ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。
en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。
en: The blocking crystal clusters have been destroyed. Behind them, you find a dark path leading to an unknown destination.

ch: 元灵被你击溃后，渐自化为一股青岚。烟光映照下，可见洞窟深处藏有一枚闪闪发亮的晶石。那，即是界元石。
en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turns into a cyan haze, and amid it, you see something shining at the deepest end of the cave. It's the Enigmatic Stone.

ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此，只需要提供500灵石即可获知八荒至宝界元石位置所在。

ch: 元灵被你挫败后，慢慢化作一团青气。微光照耀下，只见洞窟内壁镶嵌闪烁异芒的晶体。那，便是琅琊阁提及的界元石。
en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turns into a cyan haze, and amid the dim light, you see something shining on the wall of the cave. It's the Enigmatic Stone mentioned by the Manual Pavilion.

ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此我阁愿意公开部分界元石的确切位置，以换取灵石。不知仙长是否有意获取这界元石呢？
en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals and would like to trade with you our findings on the whereabouts of Enigmatic Stones for our fund. Are you interested?

ch: 仙长，这界元石乃八荒地脉石芯增生形成的灵石矿藏。自古即为善于堪舆的修仙者所青睐，并千方百计挖掘获取。
en: Dear cultivator, the Enigmatic Stones are a kind of special ore grown from the heart of the earth veins. They were sought after for centuries by cultivators excelling in Geomancy.

ch: 界元石为了应对古时修仙者采挖之举，因此衍生出强大的自卫能力。
en: Therefore, the Enigmatic Stones developed means to defend themselves.

ch: 它们化生元灵，并模仿学习前来采挖的修仙者的各种功法，从而提升自己实力，击退来犯者。
en: They formed Enigmatic Souls and learned from the cultivators searching for them, and acquired many Martial Arts to drive intruders away.

ch: 也因为这个缘故，界元石所生元灵实力绝不亚于强大的修仙者。仙长前往地脉分支取得界元石，可千万要小心。
en: After years of development, the power of those Souls is now equal to some master cultivators. Please do be careful in your search for them.

ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。
en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

ch: 石窟中原本被晶体遮蔽的地方已被凿开，露出一条不知通向何处的阴暗小道。

en: The blocking crystal clusters have been destroyed. Behind them, you find a dark path leading to an unknown destination.

ch: 元灵遭你击溃，随即化作烟云渐次消散。其时石洞深处突现光芒，十分夺目。细看下发现那正是琅琊阁提及的界元石。
en: The Enigmatic Soul has been defeated. It turned into a haze and soon disappeared. Suddenly, a dazzling beam emits from the deepest end of the cave, and following it, you find the Enigmatic Stone mentioned by the Manual Pavilion.

ch: 仙长，如今我阁正在启动新一轮的秘籍编修计划，急需灵石运营诸事以及进行功法验证。因此我阁愿意公开部分界元石的确切位置，以换取灵石。不知仙长是否有意获取这界元石呢？
en: Greetings, senior cultivator. Recently, we need Spirit Stones to cover our expenses in daily operations and a new study on manuals and would like to trade with you our findings on the whereabouts of Enigmatic Stones for our fund. Are you interested?

ch: 嗯，不是小店看轻了仙长。这界元石万分稀有，能保存至今的，其本身一定饱含灵力。若感知外界冒犯，便可能生成元灵击退来人。
en: Well, please take the stones seriously. The Enigmatic Stones are rare treasures, and those that haven't been extracted now are all brimmed with energy. Once they feel they're threatened, their soul will emerge as the intruder's opponents.

ch: 界元石自古以来一直为修仙者喜爱。修仙者多次试探采挖，元灵则屡屡与修仙者交锋，将其击退。因此我们八荒修仙者已经间接将界元石培养得十分厉害。
en: The Enigmatic Stones are craved by cultivators for centuries, and they have seen many powerful but careless intruders being defeated and dispelled. That is to say, they also gained experience in numerous battles against us.

ch: 所以界元石一旦化灵，无异于大能修士，绝代强者。仙长到时还需小心应对。
en: So, please do be careful. The Souls of Enigmatic Stones are fearsome opponents equal to master cultivators of our kind.

ch: 你抵达界元石窟。昏暗中，只见里面一簇簇的晶石闪闪发亮，并接续相连形成长蛇一般的形态。这些晶体组成的“长蛇”盘旋交织于洞中，遮蔽了前路。
en: You find the cave as instructed. Clusters of crystal glitter in the dim place, forming a shimmering serpent-shaped row. These interwoven rows extend to the deep of the cave, blocking your path.

ch: 而石窟中段的晶体已被毁坏凿开，露出一条阴暗小道。
en: The crystal clusters in the middle of the cave have been destroyed, revealing a dark path.

ch: 地脉柱石周围能量闪烁，似乎感受到了威胁并拒绝着所有来者！！！
突然，能量集中至一处，一只远古修士的虚影渐渐形成......
这些记录文字的纸张顶端写着“某某行纪增补·地脉潜行实录”某某二字已辨认不清。文字内容似乎详实地记载了有关地脉的各种特性，不过书页因为被水打湿，大多文字已辨别不清。
en: There is a title on the top of each page. It reads, \"Travel Diary in (illegible) - Record on the Course of Earth Veins There, Amended Version\". Its content is a seemingly comprehensive document on earth veins and their properties, but the pages are wet and the writings are largely unreadable.

ch: 前往永宁州的地脉石窟取得界元石。
en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Yong Ning and find Enigmatic Stone.

ch: 前往华封州的地脉石窟取得界元石。
en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Hua Feng and find Enigmatic Stone.

ch: 前往云陌州的地脉石窟取得界元石。
en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Yun Mo and find Enigmatic Stone.

ch: 前往暮仙州的地脉石窟取得界元石。
en: Enter the cave of earth veins in Mu Xian and find Enigmatic Stone.

ch: 记录大冶台确切所在的地图。其中有许多标注详细写明了每一个险地应该如何通过。绘制这张地图应该倾注了制作者大量心血。
en: A map recording the route to the Supreme Anvil, with plenty of notes guiding its readers through the dangers along the way. It must be compiled with unimaginable effort.

ch: 三阴绝脉，灵根废弃；此体质加持之修仙者无法正常吸纳灵气，不能修炼练气境以上境界的功法，终其一生，无缘仙途。
en: A special constitution with no available spiritual roots. Persons with the constitution will be unable to absorb Qi or learn martial or spiritual skills, thus are impossible to become cultivators.

ch: 你于大冶台中遭受阳炎冷电交相侵袭，体内因此激发了某种潜能。你全身暖流迸涌，舒适不已。\n体力上限增加5%
你与身怀阳炎之人切磋，其体内异气亦随交手之际度入尔体。你因此感觉浑身通泰。\n体力上限增加5%
大能横空出世，你有重大功劳，琅琊阁感念你陪伴有功，故赠此号。
增加体力最大值，更容易获得修仙者的喜爱。
你陪伴身怀三阴绝脉之人重塑身体，度过难关，有冶成精金，锻得赤铁之功，故有此号。
依照所得地图前往大冶台一探。
此地与天上日月并行，十分神奇。
取得浩然之气才能增强实力，解决十日凌天的大患！
就算再危险十倍我也要进入这地方一探究竟！
这点气息，让我感受到无穷宇宙……这是为何？
这就是浩然气了吗？我的心中热热的，似乎再无犹豫，再无顾虑……
有了这点浩然气，我就能执神弓，落金乌了！
敌人十分厉害，究竟是什么东西影响着这些妖物……
浩然之气竟使这些失智妖物变得如此强悍……今日先行撤退吧。
这地方好奇怪……里面藏有什么秘密吗？
听说这里面留有浩然之气，不知是真是假？
我要将浩然之气带走，让兄弟姐妹们增强实力，好一起对付何罗鱼！
好神奇！这气息附在身上，让我感觉轻飘飘的。
这是什么感觉？好暖和呀。
这感觉就像在母亲的怀里，温暖、舒适、安然……这是为什么呢？浩然之气……这是气息的名字？
好可怕的地方，今日没办法探明，改天再来好了。
何罗鱼即将作乱于东海，我不能在这里丢了性命！今天先离开好了。
八荒这鬼地方竟有这样一个奇特的地方，有趣，有趣！
嘿！我就没见过这种时空错乱的洞天。这八荒大陆还是有点东西哈。
以前的老大说，浩然气是很了不起的东西，我要不要进去瞧瞧呢？
哇！这究竟是为什么？我拳头特别有劲儿！浩然气！这是浩然气！
这是为什么？我从来没感受过这气息！说不清道不明的。

嘿嘿，道友，我想说，你还是选错了……
你背后狂风骤起，那名修仙者竟以雷霆万钧之势对你发起攻击。
你将此人击败，䑏疏肉身亦慢慢化为微尘，天风一吹，立即化为漫天烟气消散不见。看来，䑏疏额角是为至宝，亦不过子虚乌有。
甚好。道友不要再插手此事了，就等我来斩杀此妖，还暮仙州一个安宁吧。
人心鬼蜮，向来难测，你不想插手此事，故选择离开。未料背后突然发出轰鸣，一股巨大的烟尘冲上半天，继而劲气扑面而来，将附近一切尽数夷平。
你回看远处，只觉此前有关那青马的一切便如一场梦幻。
䑏疏之角确为至宝，但此妖为恶亦是证据确凿，我贪图妖角，并不妨碍我替天行道，铲除恶兽。
道友，你在怀疑在下？如今妖兽负伤，又复受困，正是击杀此妖的良机。你要么这就离开，不要妨碍我。要么与我一并合力击杀妖兽。

你将对手击败，青马伤口似亦已好转。它慢慢直起后腿，站了起来，艰难的挪移着。此时脚步声起，又有修仙者相继来到。
刚才的打斗声响应是从此处发出。
不要再耽搁了，为了这妖物已经有四五名道友受伤了。
他们最好都伤了、死了……那么便剩下你我……呃啊！！你要……独吞……
你说得不错，最好大家都伤了、死了。但还剩下你我也不见得有什么好……䑏疏之角是我的……是我的！咦！
这名修仙者发现了你与䑏疏，双眼中立即射来贪婪和凶狠的光芒。
哦，刚刚的事情你都看在眼里了吧？哎呀，䑏疏也在。真是太好了。那怨不得我了……你去死吧！！
你将对手击败，䑏疏似乎又恢复不少，已能踢踏踢踏的走了起来。不过此时又有两名修仙者察觉这边的动静相继赶到。
快动手！这妖物还走不动！
你与修仙者接连战斗，发出偌大动静。此次群起捉捕䑏疏的修仙者相继发现你们的踪迹，纷纷赶来。
䑏疏腿脚似乎已经恢复的差不多，它半蹲下身来，似乎正等待你坐上背后，一起离开。
䑏疏四蹄飞起，跃至空中。此时一名修仙者从旁而至，扬手间一段白索飞出，缠向青马。那白索见风即长，变成十多丈长的匹练不断缠绕青马。
青马最终因被捆绑而掉落地上，再也无法动弹。这时人声大作，四方修仙者纷纷朝这边聚拢逼近。青马眼中露出神光，同时额角闪闪发亮。
同时你眼前再度浮现出那名男子与青马的情景。其时男子正竭力控制掌中法阵，吸纳冥气，降下冥山。但地上符文已渐渐暗淡，情况即将失控。
可恶……太勉强了！天地之变，终究不是人力所能抵挡……
此时青马的额角泛起闪光，一股力量从角上溢出传到男子手上。他地上的阵法原本已黯淡无光，此时再度明亮起来。
啊？！是你……在帮我？！这便是额角的真正力量……很好！把你角上力量借给我吧！
青马额角的力量不断涌入你手掌上，同时你掌中胀满之感越来越厉害……
你挥手间，扬出一道碧绿气浪。这道气浪朝四方扩散，眨眼间将周遭夷为平地……
敌人都被打败了……䑏疏呢？
青马被捆绑地上，无法动弹，他的额角变得暗哑无光。他回头看了看你，发出一声嘶鸣。声音之中虽有无奈，却也不乏威严。
你在接触青马的一刻，眼前隐约幻化一片模糊的情景。
前方紫雾迷蒙，四周紫黑色的山峰次第崛起。男子在地上画着一个阵法以之吸收着冥气，旁边的青马额角亦是光芒闪烁。
哼，好马儿，那我们就并肩将这段泄露冥气的枢纽封印了吧！
一人一兽合力施法，前方雾气却越来越多，渐渐形成强大气流吹拂人兽。
青马发出一声怒嘶，不退反进，竟挡在男子身前，迎着紫气艰难前进。
青马没听男子喝斥，反而迎着气流缓缓前进。男子眉头一皱，从怀中摸出一段白索对青马挥出，将其缠住。白马被缚，无法与冥气相抗，最终被冥气吹飞。
马儿，离开这里以后尽可能的跑吧。可不要再被觊觎你顶上尖角的人盯上了！
男子说完继续施法，双掌间阵法变得额外明亮。周围的冥气则像滚滚巨浪，一边朝男子身上袭去，一边被不断吸阵法之中。
不多时冥气尽被吸纳，四周崛起的冥山山体亦相继崩裂消散。
青马重获自由，再度站起。它眼中原本的哀色慢慢褪去继而露出威严，然后转头看着你。
青马似乎听懂了你的话，他轻轻发出一声嘶鸣，对你作出回应。
青马似乎对你点了点头，然后转过身去撒开四蹄，跃上半空化作一道青影消失于远空之中。
青马似乎对你点了点头，然后踢踏两步走到你身前站定。而你则取出炼妖壶将青马吸进壶中。
这只古时协助大能解决暮仙州冥山之患的妖兽飘零多时，终于有了自己的归宿。
半空中青影一闪而过，你发现那只额生一角的青马再次出现在你面前。
只见那马儿嘴上叼着一本秘籍，并将之交到你手后，便迈开蹄子离开了。
只见那马儿嘴上叼着一本秘籍，并将之交到你手。然后站定看着你。
你刚接过青马递来的秘籍，眼前突然浮现一片情景。
那名男子正站在秘窟前凝神苦思，他身边的青马则一直留意四周情状。
秘籍都十分高深，这究竟是个什么遗迹？又是什么人曾在这里面钻研秘籍？
这处遗址是你带我来的。马儿啊，你说呢？我们一路发现的这些遗址当中到底藏着什么秘密？
哼，琅琊阁是个什么神秘组织，为什么要这样推演这些秘籍……
他们和冥山崛起究竟有什么关联……

只见那马儿用嘴轻轻咬着你的衣袖似乎要带你去什么地方。
马儿将你带到充满妖气之地，前方定必满布凶险，可要跟随进入？
马儿协助你将前方妖物尽数歼灭后，用蹄足刨开土地，挖出若干宝物。
它将宝物挖出以后，用凌厉的目光看了你一眼，便踏着脚步离开了。
你还没搞明白眼前情况，只见青马额角微微发出光芒，你眼前突然窥见一片幻象。
男子走在前方目视远方山势，后面青色角马轻步跟随，眼看男子停定脚步，便发出一声嘶鸣。
按照山势，此处应该是泄气之处，那边则是围堵收截的关隘。这是人为布置的。若我所料不差，这种风水之地通常藏有异宝。
男子指点远山，侃侃而谈。青马停在旁边，俯首倾听，偶尔踢足地上，发出一两声脆响。
哈哈，我每次都说得忘形了。难为你还一字不漏的听了去。马儿马儿，我们过去看看吧。
男子轻拍青马背脊，与其一并前行，往远处山隘去了。
你正打算专心学习秘籍，忽觉半空中掠影闪过，定睛看时，却是那青马。
青马朝你发出一声嘶叫，然后在不断奔腾纵跃，似乎在提示着什么。
你不明所以，正想将青马喝退，再回看手中秘籍。正当此时，你原本感觉难以参透的难题竟一一贯通。
你知道那是青马故意展现各种情状借以对你进行启发，然而当你抬头时，前方马影无踪，只有几缕扬起的微尘未曾落下。
你还在潜心回想那些最新感悟的东西，没想到眼前突然浮现一片奇特的情景。
男子正于浓荫下读书，旁边青马发出踢踏蹄响，轻轻走近。
为何你好像总对我看的书很感兴趣？也罢，我就给你讲解讲解吧。
男子说完真的将手中秘籍的阅读心得逐一说出。一个人给妖兽讲授秘籍本就奇特，更为古怪的是马儿亦专心倾听。他们一个讲一个听，俨然便是一对师徒。
我看这些，都是为了查出那个关键枢纽。究竟这人是通过什么法子将枢纽隐藏起来的呢？高明。

说起你的角，据闻驩疏额角含有极大灵力，而且一生之中仅能使用三次。驩疏成胎不易，能够安然出生更是万中无一。
而驩疏婴儿在出生之际便已使用了一次额角灵力，以保住自身性命。这么说的话，你的额角应该还能再使用两次。剩下两次给我用一下吧，怎样？
咦，你生气了？马儿啊马儿，我这不是开玩笑吗？
驩疏感通人心，似乎听懂了这名男子的话。它露出不愉之色，转头离开。那名男子哈哈大笑，跟上走远的驩疏，与它并肩远去。
